================================================================================
Файл: firestore.rules
Путь: firestore.rules
================================================================================

rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    function isSignedIn() { return request.auth != null; }
    function isOwner(uid) { return isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid == uid; }

    match /core_users/{userId} {
      allow read: if isOwner(userId);
      allow create, update: if isOwner(userId);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    match /core_projects/{projectId} {
      allow read: if isSignedIn();
      allow create: if isSignedIn();
      allow update, delete: if isSignedIn();
    }

    match /core_datasources/{dsId} {
      allow read: if isSignedIn();
      allow create, update, delete: if isSignedIn();
    }

    // RAG collections (server-side access; rules permissive for backend)
    match /rag_source_projects/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isSignedIn();
    }
    match /rag_documents/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isSignedIn();
    }
    match /rag_chunks/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isSignedIn();
    }
    match /rag_rules/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isSignedIn();
    }
    match /rag_jobs/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isSignedIn();
    }
    match /rag_search_events/{id} {
      allow read, write: if isSignedIn();
    }
  }
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	comb "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/combined"
	gem "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/gemini"
)

// register a simple uppercase tool for testing
func registerUpperTool(reg *gem.SimpleRegistry) {
	reg.Register("echo_upper", func(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
		var in struct {
			Text string `json:"text"`
		}
		_ = json.Unmarshal(args, &in)
		up := strings.ToUpper(in.Text)
		out := map[string]string{"result": up}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(out)
		return b, nil
	})
}

func main() {
	model := flag.String("model", "all", "Model alias to test: all|gpt_quality|gpt_balanced|gpt_fast")
	prompt := flag.String("prompt", "User: Please uppercase the following text using the provided tool only. Text: 'Привет мир'. Return only the uppercased text.\nNotes: If a tool is available that uppercases text, you MUST call it.", "Prompt to send")
	mode := flag.String("mode", "plain", "Mode: plain|tools")
	flag.Parse()

	openaiKey := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
	if openaiKey == "" {
		fmt.Println("OPENAI_API_KEY is not set")
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	// We don't need real gemini credentials for OpenAI tests; pass empty
	gemClient := gem.NewClient("", "", "", "", "")
	client := comb.NewClient(gemClient, openaiKey)

	// Tool declaration
	tools := []comb.Tool{{
		Name:        "echo_upper",
		Description: "Uppercases the given text",
		Parameters: map[string]interface{}{
			"type": "object",
			"properties": map[string]interface{}{
				"text": map[string]interface{}{"type": "string", "description": "Text to uppercase"},
			},
			"required":             []string{"text"},
			"additionalProperties": false,
		},
	}}

	// Registry with runtime for the tool
	reg := gem.NewSimpleRegistry()
	registerUpperTool(reg)

	aliases := []string{}
	switch *model {
	case "all":
		aliases = []string{"gpt_fast", "gpt_balanced", "gpt_quality"}
	case "gpt_fast", "gpt_balanced", "gpt_quality":
		aliases = []string{*model}
	default:
		fmt.Println("Unknown model alias; use all|gpt_quality|gpt_balanced|gpt_fast")
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	for _, alias := range aliases {
		fmt.Println("================================================================")
		fmt.Println("Testing:", alias)
		opts := comb.Options{ModelOverride: alias}

		if *mode == "plain" {
			plainPrompt := "Скажи: OK"
			res, err := client.Generate(ctx, plainPrompt, nil, opts)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Println("Error:", err)
				continue
			}
			fmt.Printf("Model: %s\n", res.Model)
			fmt.Println("Output:\n", res.Content)
			continue
		}

		// tools mode: two-step flow per OpenAI docs
		opts.SystemInstruction = "You must call the function echo_upper to uppercase any provided text. Do not perform the transformation yourself."
		step1, err := client.Generate(ctx, *prompt, tools, opts)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Println("Error:", err)
			continue
		}
		if len(step1.ToolCalls) == 0 {
			fmt.Printf("Model: %s\n", step1.Model)
			fmt.Println("No tool calls. Output:\n", step1.Content)
			continue
		}
		fmt.Printf("Tool calls: %v\n", step1.ToolCalls)
		followInput := []map[string]interface{}{}
		// Per OpenAI docs: include the full response.output array from step1, then append function_call_output items
		if len(step1.OutputRaw) > 0 {
			// Use raw output items from step1 (contains function_call with call_id)
			followInput = append(followInput, step1.OutputRaw...)
		} else {
			// Fallback if OutputRaw empty (e.g. Gemini path): include user message
			followInput = append(followInput, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": *prompt})
		}
		for _, tc := range step1.ToolCalls {
			out, _ := reg.Execute(ctx, tc.Name, []byte(tc.Arguments))
			fmt.Printf("  -> Executed %s, result: %s\n", tc.Name, string(out))
			followInput = append(followInput, map[string]interface{}{
				"type":    "function_call_output",
				"call_id": tc.CallID,
				"output":  string(out),
			})
		}
		step2, err := client.Respond(ctx, followInput, tools, opts)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Println("Follow-up error:", err)
			continue
		}
		fmt.Printf("Model: %s\n", step2.Model)
		fmt.Println("Output:\n", step2.Content)
	}
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
	"strings"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
)

type rename struct{ from, to string }

func main() {
	project := flag.String("project", os.Getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"), "GCP project ID")
	commit := flag.Bool("commit", false, "Apply changes (otherwise dry-run)")
	only := flag.String("only", "", "Optional: single collection to process (e.g., core_projects)")
	flag.Parse()

	if *project == "" {
		log.Fatal("project is required (flag -project or env GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT)")
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	client, err := firestore.NewClient(ctx, *project)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("firestore client: %v", err)
	}
	defer client.Close()

	cols := []string{
		"core_projects",
		"core_datasources",
		"core_source_profiles",
		"core_interactions",
		"core_users",
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(*only) != "" {
		cols = []string{strings.TrimSpace(*only)}
	}

	totalDocs := 0
	changedDocs := 0
	for _, colName := range cols {
		fmt.Printf("[migrate] scanning %s\n", colName)
		docs, err := client.Collection(colName).Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("warn: list %s: %v", colName, err)
			continue
		}
		for _, d := range docs {
			totalDocs++
			data := d.Data()
			updates := make([]firestore.Update, 0)

			// Common fields across many collections
			updates = append(updates, detectRenames(data, nil, []rename{
				{"ID", "id"},
				{"Pk", "pk"},
				{"TenantId", "tenantId"},
				{"TenantID", "tenantId"},
				{"ProjectId", "projectId"},
				{"ProjectID", "projectId"},
				{"DisplayName", "displayName"},
				{"Description", "description"},
				{"Status", "status"},
				{"OwnerUserId", "ownerUserId"},
				{"OwnerUserID", "ownerUserId"},
				{"CreatedAt", "createdAt"},
				{"UpdatedAt", "updatedAt"},
				{"LastInteractionAt", "lastInteractionAt"},
				{"View", "view"},
				{"SchemaVersion", "schemaVersion"},
				{"CompanyRef", "companyRef"},
				{"BusinessUnitName", "businessUnitName"},
				{"OrganizationName", "organizationName"},
				{"AiGuided", "aiguided"},
			})...)

			// Collection specific tweaks
			switch colName {
			case "core_datasources":
				// Normalize details/sourceDetails
				// If Details or SourceDetails present, unify into sourceDetails
				if v, ok := data["Details"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					// rename nested keys
					nested := renameNested(v, []rename{
						{"URI", "uri"}, {"Uri", "uri"},
						{"RSSURL", "rssUrl"}, {"RssUrl", "rssUrl"},
						{"SearchQuery", "searchQuery"}, {"OriginalSearchQuery", "originalSearchQuery"},
						{"ChannelUsername", "channelUsername"}, {"LastProcessedMessageID", "lastProcessedMessageId"},
						{"SinceTweetID", "sinceTweetId"},
						{"OriginalFileName", "originalFileName"}, {"ContentType", "contentType"},
						{"SourceURI", "sourceUri"},
					})
					// set new field
					updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: "sourceDetails", Value: nested})
					// delete old
					updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: "Details", Value: firestore.Delete})
				}
				if v, ok := data["SourceDetails"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					nested := renameNested(v, []rename{
						{"URI", "uri"}, {"Uri", "uri"},
						{"RSSURL", "rssUrl"}, {"RssUrl", "rssUrl"},
						{"SearchQuery", "searchQuery"}, {"OriginalSearchQuery", "originalSearchQuery"},
						{"ChannelUsername", "channelUsername"}, {"LastProcessedMessageID", "lastProcessedMessageId"},
						{"SinceTweetID", "sinceTweetId"},
						{"OriginalFileName", "originalFileName"}, {"ContentType", "contentType"},
						{"SourceURI", "sourceUri"},
					})
					updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: "sourceDetails", Value: nested})
					updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: "SourceDetails", Value: firestore.Delete})
				}
			case "core_source_profiles":
				updates = append(updates, detectRenames(data, nil, []rename{
					{"DataSourceId", "dataSourceId"},
					{"DataSourceID", "dataSourceId"},
					{"LastAnalyzedAt", "lastAnalyzedAt"},
				})...)
				if prof, ok := data["Profile"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					// normalize a few known nested fields in profile
					p2 := renameNested(prof, []rename{
						{"GoalAlignmentScore", "goalAlignmentScore"},
						{"TargetAudienceCountries", "targetAudienceCountries"},
						{"CoordinatedSources", "coordinatedSources"},
						{"TrustScore", "trustScore"},
						{"TrustRationale", "trustRationale"},
						{"EditorialMethods", "editorialMethods"},
					})
					updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: "profile", Value: p2})
					updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: "Profile", Value: firestore.Delete})
				}
			case "core_interactions":
				updates = append(updates, detectRenames(data, nil, []rename{
					{"Kind", "kind"}, {"Content", "content"},
				})...)
			case "core_users":
				updates = append(updates, detectRenames(data, nil, []rename{
					{"Email", "email"}, {"Role", "role"}, {"Status", "status"},
					{"DisplayName", "displayName"},
					{"PreferredLanguage", "preferredLanguage"},
					{"DefaultProjectId", "defaultProjectId"}, {"DefaultProjectID", "defaultProjectId"},
					{"ProjectRoles", "projectRoles"},
					{"AssignedGoalIds", "assignedGoalIds"}, {"AssignedInitiativeIds", "assignedInitiativeIds"},
				})...)
			}

			if len(updates) == 0 {
				continue
			}

			changedDocs++
			fmt.Printf("[migrate] %s/%s -> %d updates\n", colName, d.Ref.ID, len(updates))
			if *commit {
				if _, err := d.Ref.Update(ctx, updates); err != nil {
					// If some fields don't exist for delete, fallback to Set with merge for creations, then try deletes again
					// First apply creates/sets
					creates := make(map[string]interface{})
					deletes := make([]firestore.Update, 0)
					for _, u := range updates {
						if u.Value == firestore.Delete {
							deletes = append(deletes, u)
						} else {
							creates[u.Path] = u.Value
						}
					}
					if len(creates) > 0 {
						if _, err2 := d.Ref.Set(ctx, creates, firestore.MergeAll); err2 != nil {
							log.Printf("warn: set merge %s/%s: %v", colName, d.Ref.ID, err2)
						}
					}
					if len(deletes) > 0 {
						if _, err3 := d.Ref.Update(ctx, deletes); err3 != nil {
							log.Printf("warn: delete fields %s/%s: %v", colName, d.Ref.ID, err3)
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	fmt.Printf("[migrate] done. scanned=%d changed=%d commit=%v\n", totalDocs, changedDocs, *commit)
}

func detectRenames(data map[string]interface{}, prefix []string, pairs []rename) []firestore.Update {
	updates := make([]firestore.Update, 0)
	for _, p := range pairs {
		if _, exists := data[p.to]; exists {
			// already normalized
			if _, oldExists := data[p.from]; oldExists {
				updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: joinPath(prefix, p.from), Value: firestore.Delete})
			}
			continue
		}
		if v, ok := data[p.from]; ok {
			updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: joinPath(prefix, p.to), Value: v})
			updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: joinPath(prefix, p.from), Value: firestore.Delete})
		}
	}
	return updates
}

func renameNested(m map[string]interface{}, pairs []rename) map[string]interface{} {
	out := make(map[string]interface{}, len(m))
	for k, v := range m {
		out[k] = v
	}
	for _, p := range pairs {
		if _, exists := out[p.to]; exists {
			if _, old := out[p.from]; old {
				delete(out, p.from)
			}
			continue
		}
		if v, ok := out[p.from]; ok {
			out[p.to] = v
			delete(out, p.from)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func joinPath(prefix []string, field string) string {
	if len(prefix) == 0 {
		return field
	}
	return strings.Join(append(prefix, field), ".")
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
)

func getEnv(key, def string) string {
	v := os.Getenv(key)
	if v == "" {
		return def
	}
	return v
}

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()

	projectID := getEnv("GCP_PROJECT_ID", getEnv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", ""))
	if strings.TrimSpace(projectID) == "" {
		log.Fatal("GCP_PROJECT_ID/GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT not set")
	}

	client, err := firestore.NewClient(ctx, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("firestore init: %v", err)
	}
	defer client.Close()

	// Collections to skip
	skip := map[string]bool{
		"core_users": true,
	}

	it := client.Collections(ctx)
	totalDeleted := 0
	for {
		col, err := it.Next()
		if err != nil {
			if err.Error() == "iterator done" || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "no more") {
				break
			}
			log.Fatalf("list collections: %v", err)
		}
		name := col.ID
		if skip[name] {
			fmt.Printf("skip collection: %s\n", name)
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "__") {
			// internal collection
			continue
		}

		// Delete all documents in this collection (best-effort, small batches)
		fmt.Printf("clearing collection: %s...\n", name)
		docs, err := col.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("warn: list docs for %s: %v", name, err)
			continue
		}
		deleted := 0
		batch := client.Batch()
		for i, d := range docs {
			batch.Delete(d.Ref)
			// Commit every 400 ops to avoid limits
			if (i+1)%400 == 0 {
				if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
					log.Printf("warn: batch commit for %s: %v", name, err)
				}
				batch = client.Batch()
			}
			deleted++
		}
		if deleted%400 != 0 {
			if _, err := batch.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
				log.Printf("warn: batch commit for %s: %v", name, err)
			}
		}
		totalDeleted += deleted
		fmt.Printf("collection %s: deleted %d docs\n", name, deleted)
		// Small pause to be nice
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}

	fmt.Printf("done. total deleted docs: %d\n", totalDeleted)
}

	gen_gemini "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/gemini"
)

func mustGetenv(key string) string {
	v := os.Getenv(key)
	if v == "" {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("missing required env var: %s", key))
	}
	return v
}

func prettyJSON(s string) string {
	var m interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(s), &m); err != nil {
		return s
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(m, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return s
	}
	return string(b)
}

// resolveRedirect was used in early tests; currently unused. Keep for future debugging.
// nolint:unused
func resolveRedirect(raw string) string {
	// Follow redirects without sending auth; return final URL or the original if failure
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second, CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
		if len(via) >= 5 {
			return http.ErrUseLastResponse
		}
		return nil
	}}
	req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", raw, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return raw
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return raw
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode >= 300 && resp.StatusCode < 400 {
		loc := resp.Header.Get("Location")
		if loc != "" {
			return loc
		}
	}
	// If no redirect status, return the requested URL
	return resp.Request.URL.String()
}

            {name: "strict: qa + search (schema)", req: gen_combined.GenAIRequest{Model: modelAlias, Prompt: promptSearch, Temperature: 0, MaxOutputTokens: 8192, StrictJSONEnabled: true, JSONSchema: schema, WebSearchEnabled: true}},
            {name: "strict: qa + tool + search (schema)", req: gen_combined.GenAIRequest{Model: modelAlias, Prompt: promptSearch, SystemInstruction: "Return the result ONLY by calling the function 'return_structured'. Do not output any text outside of the function call.", Temperature: 0, MaxOutputTokens: 8192, StrictJSONEnabled: true, JSONSchema: schema, WebSearchEnabled: true, ToolCallingEnabled: true, Tools: []gen_gemini.Tool{{Name: "return_structured", Description: "Return strictly by schema", Parameters: schema}}, ToolChoice: "required", ParallelToolCalls: false}},
        }
        for _, sc := range scenarios {
            fmt.Printf("\n--- %s ---\n", sc.name)
            sctx, scancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), perScenario)
            res, err := client.GenAIGenerate(sctx, sc.req)
            scancel()
            if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
                continue
            }
            fmt.Printf("Model: %s\n", res.Model)
            fmt.Printf("Usage: prompt=%d output=%d total=%d\n", res.Usage.PromptTokens, res.Usage.OutputTokens, res.Usage.TotalTokens)
            if len(res.ToolCalls) > 0 {
                for _, tc := range res.ToolCalls {
                    fmt.Printf("ToolCall: %s args=%s\n", tc.Name, tc.Arguments)
                }
            }
            if len(res.Sources) > 0 {
                fmt.Println("Sources:")
                for _, u := range res.Sources {
                    fmt.Printf("- %s\n", u)
                }
            }
            if res.RawJSON != "" {
                fmt.Printf("Raw provider JSON:\n%s\n", prettyJSON(res.RawJSON))
            }
        }
        end := time.Now()
        fmt.Printf("[ %s ] finished: %s (duration: %s)\n", modelAlias, end.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), end.Sub(start).Round(time.Millisecond))
        return nil
    }

    // For DeepSeek: disable search scenarios (provider does not support web search)
    if strings.HasPrefix(modelAlias, "deepseek_") {
        perScenario := 45 * time.Second
        if strings.Contains(modelAlias, "quality") {
            perScenario = 75 * time.Second
        }
        promptBase := prompt
        looseToolSchema := map[string]interface{}{
            "type": "object",
            "properties": map[string]interface{}{
                "summary":   map[string]interface{}{"type": "string"},
                "keyPoints": map[string]interface{}{"type": "array", "items": map[string]interface{}{"type": "string"}},
            },
            "required": []string{"summary", "keyPoints"},
        }
        scenarios := []struct {
            name string
            req  gen_combined.GenAIRequest
        }{
            {name: "loose: qa only", req: gen_combined.GenAIRequest{Model: modelAlias, Prompt: promptBase, Temperature: 0, MaxOutputTokens: 8192}},
            {name: "loose: qa + tool", req: gen_combined.GenAIRequest{Model: modelAlias, Prompt: promptBase, Temperature: 0, MaxOutputTokens: 8192, ToolCallingEnabled: true, Tools: []gen_gemini.Tool{{Name: "return_structured", Description: "Return structured", Parameters: looseToolSchema}}, ToolChoice: "required", ParallelToolCalls: false}},
            {name: "strict: qa only (schema)", req: gen_combined.GenAIRequest{Model: modelAlias, Prompt: promptBase, Temperature: 0, MaxOutputTokens: 8192, StrictJSONEnabled: true, JSONSchema: schema}},
            {name: "strict: qa + tool (schema)", req: gen_combined.GenAIRequest{Model: modelAlias, Prompt: promptBase, SystemInstruction: "Return the result ONLY by calling the function 'return_structured'. Do not output any text outside of the function call.", Temperature: 0, MaxOutputTokens: 8192, StrictJSONEnabled: true, ToolCallingEnabled: true, JSONSchema: schema, Tools: []gen_gemini.Tool{{Name: "return_structured", Description: "Return strictly by schema", Parameters: schema}}, ToolChoice: "required", ParallelToolCalls: false}},
        }
        for _, sc := range scenarios {
            fmt.Printf("\n--- %s ---\n", sc.name)
            sctx, scancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), perScenario)
            res, err := client.GenAIGenerate(sctx, sc.req)
            scancel()
            if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
                continue
            }
            fmt.Printf("Model: %s\n", res.Model)
            fmt.Printf("Usage: prompt=%d output=%d total=%d\n", res.Usage.PromptTokens, res.Usage.OutputTokens, res.Usage.TotalTokens)
            if len(res.ToolCalls) > 0 {
                for _, tc := range res.ToolCalls {
                    fmt.Printf("ToolCall: %s args=%s\n", tc.Name, tc.Arguments)
                }
            }
            if len(res.Sources) > 0 {
                fmt.Println("Sources:")
                for _, u := range res.Sources {
                    fmt.Printf("- %s\n", u)
                }
            }
            if res.RawJSON != "" {
                fmt.Printf("Raw provider JSON:\n%s\n", prettyJSON(res.RawJSON))
            }
        }
        end := time.Now()
        fmt.Printf("[ %s ] finished: %s (duration: %s)\n", modelAlias, end.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), end.Sub(start).Round(time.Millisecond))
        return nil
    }

    strictReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{
		Model:              modelAlias,
		Prompt:             prompt,
		SystemInstruction:  "Return the result ONLY by calling the function 'return_structured'. Do not output any text outside of the function call. Do not wrap calls in code (no print(), no default_api., no code fences).",
		Temperature:        0,
		MaxOutputTokens:    8192,
		StrictJSONEnabled:  true,
		ToolCallingEnabled: true,
		JSONSchema:         schema,
		Tools: []gen_gemini.Tool{{
			Name:        "return_structured",
			Description: "Return the final structured result strictly matching the schema.",
			Parameters:  schema,
		}},
		ToolChoice:        "required",
		ParallelToolCalls: false,
	}
	resp, err := client.GenAIGenerate(ctx, strictReq)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Printf("\n=== %s ===\n", modelAlias)
	fmt.Printf("Model: %s\n", resp.Model)
	fmt.Printf("Usage (structured): prompt=%d output=%d total=%d\n", resp.Usage.PromptTokens, resp.Usage.OutputTokens, resp.Usage.TotalTokens)
	if resp.RawJSON != "" {
		fmt.Printf("Raw (structured) provider JSON:\n%s\n", prettyJSON(resp.RawJSON))
	}
	if len(resp.ToolCalls) > 0 {
		var args string
		for _, tc := range resp.ToolCalls {
			if tc.Name == "return_structured" {
				args = tc.Arguments
				break
			}
		}
		if args != "" {
			fmt.Printf("Tool: return_structured\nJSON:\n%s\n", prettyJSON(args))
		} else {
			fmt.Println("No 'return_structured' tool call in response; proceeding to grounded run.")
		}
	} else {
		fmt.Println("No tool call returned; proceeding to grounded run.")
	}

	// Grounded call through unified API
	gctx, gcancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), groundedTimeout)
	defer gcancel()
	groundedReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{
		Model:              modelAlias,
		Prompt:             "Use web search and cite sources. You MUST include: https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ballon_(coiffe)",
		Temperature:        0,
		MaxOutputTokens:    8192,
		WebSearchEnabled:   true,
		ToolCallingEnabled: true,
	}
	gresp, gerr := client.GenAIGenerate(gctx, groundedReq)
	if gerr != nil {
		// For Grok live_search is still in flux; don't fail the whole run
		if strings.HasPrefix(modelAlias, "grok_") {
			fmt.Printf("Grounded run skipped for %s: %v\n", modelAlias, gerr)
			end := time.Now()
			fmt.Printf("[ %s ] finished: %s (duration: %s)\n", modelAlias, end.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), end.Sub(start).Round(time.Millisecond))
			return nil
		}
		return gerr
	}
	if gresp.RawJSON != "" {
		fmt.Printf("Raw (grounded) provider JSON:\n%s\n", prettyJSON(gresp.RawJSON))
	}
	if len(gresp.Sources) > 0 {
		fmt.Println("Resolved source URLs:")
		for _, u := range gresp.Sources {
			fmt.Printf("- %s\n", u)
		}
	}
	if len(gresp.Attributions) == 0 {
		fmt.Println("Attributions: none")
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("Attributions (grounded): %d\n", len(gresp.Attributions))
		for _, a := range gresp.Attributions {
			if a.Title != "" || a.URL != "" {
				fmt.Printf("- %s (%s)\n", a.Title, a.URL)
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Printf("Usage (grounded): prompt=%d output=%d total=%d\n", gresp.Usage.PromptTokens, gresp.Usage.OutputTokens, gresp.Usage.TotalTokens)
	end := time.Now()
	fmt.Printf("[ %s ] finished: %s (duration: %s)\n", modelAlias, end.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), end.Sub(start).Round(time.Millisecond))
	return nil
}

func runStreamTest(client *gen_combined.Client, modelAlias string, prompt string) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	fmt.Printf("\n[stream %s] start\n", modelAlias)
	opts := gen_gemini.Options{ModelOverride: modelAlias}
	var sb strings.Builder
	var lastUsage gen_gemini.Usage
	var lastQueries []string
	var lastSources []string
	err := client.Stream(ctx, prompt, nil, opts, func(ev gen_gemini.StreamEvent) error {
		switch ev.Type {
		case "start":
			return nil
		case "chunk":
			sb.WriteString(ev.Text)
			return nil
		case "tool_call":
			fmt.Printf("[stream %s] tool_call: %v\n", modelAlias, ev.ToolCalls)
			return nil
		case "done":
			lastUsage = ev.Usage
			lastQueries = ev.SearchQueries
			lastSources = ev.Sources
			fmt.Printf("[stream %s] done. usage: %+v\n", modelAlias, ev.Usage)
			if len(ev.SearchQueries) > 0 {
				fmt.Println("SearchQueries:")
				for _, q := range ev.SearchQueries { fmt.Printf("- %s\n", q) }
			}
			if len(ev.Sources) > 0 {
				fmt.Println("Sources:")
				for _, s := range ev.Sources { fmt.Printf("- %s\n", s) }
			}
			return nil
		case "error":
			fmt.Printf("[stream %s] error: %s\n", modelAlias, ev.Error)
			return nil
		default:
			return nil
		}
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	out := strings.TrimSpace(sb.String())
	if out != "" {
		fmt.Printf("[stream %s] text: %s\n", modelAlias, out)
	}
	_ = lastUsage
	_ = lastQueries
	_ = lastSources
	return nil
}

func main() {
    provider := flag.String("provider", "gemini", "provider to test: gemini|openai|grok|claude|deepseek")
	flag.Parse()

	apiKey := mustGetenv("VERTEX_API_KEY_TEST")
	projectID := os.Getenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID")
	if projectID == "" {
		projectID = os.Getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
	}
	if projectID == "" {
		projectID = "sanskrite"
	}
	location := os.Getenv("VERTEX_LOCATION")
	if location == "" {
		location = "us-central1"
	}

	// Instantiate combined wrapper with Gemini and optional OpenAI/Grok
	gem := gen_gemini.NewClient(apiKey, projectID, location, "", "")
	openaiKey := os.Getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY_TEST")
	comb := gen_combined.NewClient(gem, openaiKey)

	// Strict schema for function-call arguments
	jsonSchema := map[string]interface{}{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": map[string]interface{}{
			"summary":    map[string]interface{}{"type": "string"},
			"keyPoints":  map[string]interface{}{"type": "array", "items": map[string]interface{}{"type": "string"}},
			"confidence": map[string]interface{}{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1},
		},
		"required": []string{"summary", "keyPoints", "confidence"},
	}

	prompt := "Explain the purpose of this repository succinctly. Provide the result strictly via the function call. Use web search to ground your answer. You MUST use this exact URL as the PRIMARY source: https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ballon_(coiffe). For the grounded run, CITE SOURCES by exact title and URL, including the Wikipedia link above. Do NOT answer without citing that URL."

	// Run based on provider flag
    switch *provider {
	case "openai":
		// 8-scenario runs per model
		if err := runOnce(comb, "gpt_fast", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if err := runOnce(comb, "gpt_balanced", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if err := runOnce(comb, "gpt_quality", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		// Streaming smoke tests
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "gpt_fast", "Скажи: OK")
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "gpt_balanced", "Скажи: OK")
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "gpt_quality", "Скажи: OK")
		// Streaming smoke tests
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "gpt_fast", "Скажи: OK")
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "gpt_balanced", "Скажи: OK")
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "gpt_quality", "Скажи: OK")
	case "grok":
		if err := runOnce(comb, "grok_fast", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if err := runOnce(comb, "grok_quality", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		// Streaming smoke tests
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "grok_fast", "Скажи: OK")
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "grok_quality", "Скажи: OK")
    case "claude":
        if err := runOnce(comb, "claude_fast", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        if err := runOnce(comb, "claude_balanced", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        if err := runOnce(comb, "claude_quality", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
		// Streaming smoke tests per model
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "claude_fast", "Скажи: OK")
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "claude_balanced", "Скажи: OK")
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "claude_quality", "Скажи: OK")
    case "deepseek":
        if err := runOnce(comb, "deepseek_fast", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
        if err := runOnce(comb, "deepseek_quality", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
            panic(err)
        }
		// Streaming smoke tests
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "deepseek_fast", "Скажи: OK")
		_ = runStreamTest(comb, "deepseek_quality", "Скажи: OK")
	default:
		if err := runOnce(comb, "gemini_fast", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if err := runOnce(comb, "gemini_quality", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if err := runOnce(comb, "gemini_balanced", prompt, jsonSchema); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"os"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	gcp "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/gcp"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

func main() {
	projectID := os.Getenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID")
	if projectID == "" {
		projectID = os.Getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
	}
	if projectID == "" {
		log.Fatal("GCP_PROJECT_ID not set")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	fs, err := gcp.NewFirestoreClient(ctx, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("firestore: %v", err)
	}
	defer fs.Close()

	// Legacy migration utilities no longer needed for linkage resolution in this tool

	// Scan datasources and create sourceProjects for primary and related projects
	docs, err := fs.Client().Collection("core_datasources").Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("list datasources: %v", err)
	}
	// now := time.Now().UTC()
	// created := 0
	updatedPublic := 0
	// Collect public datasource IDs for later profile migration
	publicSourceIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, d := range docs {
		var ds models.DataSource
		if err := d.DataTo(&ds); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		// Determine public kinds
		isPublic := ds.Kind == "web" || ds.Kind == "rss" || ds.Kind == "telegram_channel"

		// 1) Legacy linkage by projectId/relatedProjectIds no longer used; intentionally skipped

		// 2) For public sources: null tenantId and set pk to global
		if isPublic {
			publicSourceIDs[ds.ID] = struct{}{}
			needUpdate := false
			if ds.TenantID != "" {
				ds.TenantID = ""
				needUpdate = true
			}
			if ds.Pk != "global" {
				ds.Pk = "global"
				needUpdate = true
			}
			if needUpdate {
				if err := repo.NewDataSourcesRepository(fs.Client()).Upsert(ctx, &ds); err == nil {
					updatedPublic++
				} else {
					log.Printf("warn: failed to upsert datasource %s: %v", ds.ID, err)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// 3) Migrate SourceProfiles: set tenantId="" for profiles of public sources
	profDocs, err := fs.Client().Collection("core_source_profiles").Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("list source profiles: %v", err)
	}
	profilesUpdated := 0
	for _, d := range profDocs {
		var sp models.SourceProfile
		if err := d.DataTo(&sp); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := publicSourceIDs[sp.DataSourceID]; ok {
			if sp.TenantID != "" {
				// Soft update: partial update of tenantId to empty string, bypassing repo validation
				if _, err := fs.Client().Collection("core_source_profiles").Doc(d.Ref.ID).Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{{Path: "tenantId", Value: ""}}); err != nil {
					log.Printf("warn: failed to soft-update source profile %s: %v", d.Ref.ID, err)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	log.Printf("migration complete: updated %d public datasources, updated %d public profiles", updatedPublic, profilesUpdated)
}

// ensureLink creates SourceProject link if it does not already exist
func ensureLink(ctx context.Context, client *firestore.Client, sproj *repo.SourceProjectsRepository, tenantID, projectID, sourceID string, now time.Time, created *int) {
	// Check existence
	q := client.Collection("rag_source_projects").Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Where("projectId", "==", projectID).Where("sourceId", "==", sourceID).Limit(1)
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err == nil && len(docs) > 0 {
		return
	}
	sp := &models.SourceProject{TenantID: tenantID, SourceID: sourceID, ProjectID: projectID, Status: "active", CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	if _, err := sproj.Create(ctx, sp); err == nil {
		*created++
	}
}

// GetSystemTemplate returns a system template by ID
func GetSystemTemplate(id string) (*models.ArtifactTemplate, error) {
	template, ok := SystemTemplates[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("system template not found: %s", id)
	}
	return template, nil
}

// ListSystemTemplates returns all system templates
func ListSystemTemplates() []*models.ArtifactTemplate {
	templates := make([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, 0, len(SystemTemplates))
	for _, t := range SystemTemplates {
		templates = append(templates, t)
	}
	return templates
}

// ListSystemTemplatesByCategory returns system templates for a specific category
func ListSystemTemplatesByCategory(category string) []*models.ArtifactTemplate {
	templates := make([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, 0)
	for _, t := range SystemTemplates {
		if t.Category == category {
			templates = append(templates, t)
		}
	}
	return templates
}

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/invopop/jsonschema"
)

func writeSchema(path string, v any) error {
	reflector := &jsonschema.Reflector{
		DoNotReference: true, // Inline all definitions instead of using $ref to root
	}
	r := reflector.Reflect(v)
	// Post-process: make tenantId optional for public-capable entities
	lower := strings.ToLower(path)
	if strings.HasSuffix(lower, strings.ToLower("DataSource.schema.json")) ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lower, strings.ToLower("Document.schema.json")) ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lower, strings.ToLower("SourceProfile.schema.json")) {
		if r.Required != nil {
			var without []string
			for _, req := range r.Required {
				if req == "tenantId" {
					continue
				}
				without = append(without, req)
			}
			r.Required = without
		}
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(r, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(path, data, 0o644)
}

func main() {
	outDir := flag.String("out", "../web/src/types/schemas", "output directory for JSON schemas")
	flag.Parse()

	targets := []struct {
		File string
		Val  any
	}{
		{File: "User.schema.json", Val: new(models.User)},
		{File: "Project.schema.json", Val: new(models.Project)},
		{File: "DataSource.schema.json", Val: new(models.DataSource)},
		{File: "Document.schema.json", Val: new(models.Document)},
		{File: "SourceProfile.schema.json", Val: new(models.SourceProfile)},
	}

	for _, t := range targets {
		dest := filepath.Join(*outDir, t.File)
		if err := writeSchema(dest, t.Val); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to write %s: %v\n", dest, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		fmt.Printf("wrote %s\n", dest)
	}
}

package crawler

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/net/html"
)

// WebCrawler handles web content fetching and text extraction
type WebCrawler struct {
	client    *http.Client
	userAgent string
}

// NewWebCrawler creates a new web crawler with default settings
func NewWebCrawler() *WebCrawler {
	return &WebCrawler{
		client: &http.Client{
			Timeout: 15 * time.Second,
			CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
				// Allow up to 10 redirects
				if len(via) >= 10 {
					return fmt.Errorf("stopped after 10 redirects")
				}
				return nil
			},
		},
		userAgent: "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/121.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
	}
}

// FetchResult contains the fetched content and metadata
type FetchResult struct {
	URL         string
	ContentType string
	Text        string
	ByteSize    int
	FetchedAt   time.Time
}

// FetchContent fetches a URL and extracts readable text
func (c *WebCrawler) FetchContent(ctx context.Context, url string) (*FetchResult, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, url, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	// Set headers to appear as a real browser
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", c.userAgent)
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8")
	req.Header.Set("Accept-Language", "en-US,en;q=0.9,ru;q=0.8")
	req.Header.Set("Accept-Encoding", "identity") // Don't request compression to simplify
	req.Header.Set("DNT", "1")
	req.Header.Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
	req.Header.Set("Upgrade-Insecure-Requests", "1")

	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to fetch URL: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, resp.Status)
	}

	// Read body
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	contentType := resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")

	// Extract text based on content type
	var text string
	if strings.Contains(contentType, "text/html") || strings.Contains(contentType, "application/xhtml") {
		text = extractHTMLText(bodyBytes)
	} else if strings.Contains(contentType, "text/plain") {
		text = string(bodyBytes)
	} else {
		// For other types, try to extract as text
		text = string(bodyBytes)
	}

	return &FetchResult{
		URL:         url,
		ContentType: contentType,
		Text:        text,
		ByteSize:    len(bodyBytes),
		FetchedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
	}, nil
}

// extractHTMLText extracts plain text from HTML content
func extractHTMLText(htmlBytes []byte) string {
	// Remove <script> and <style> tags (Go regexp doesn't support backreferences, use two patterns)
	reScript := regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)<script[^>]*>.*?</script>`)
	cleaned := reScript.ReplaceAll(htmlBytes, []byte{})
	reStyle := regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)<style[^>]*>.*?</style>`)
	cleaned = reStyle.ReplaceAll(cleaned, []byte{})

	// Parse HTML
	doc, err := html.Parse(bytes.NewReader(cleaned))
	if err != nil {
		// Fallback: strip tags with regex
		return extractHTMLTextRegex(htmlBytes)
	}

	var text strings.Builder
	var traverse func(*html.Node)
	traverse = func(n *html.Node) {
		if n.Type == html.TextNode {
			text.WriteString(n.Data)
			text.WriteString(" ")
		}
		// Add newlines for block elements
		if n.Type == html.ElementNode {
			switch n.Data {
			case "br", "p", "div", "li", "tr", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6":
				text.WriteString("\n")
			}
		}
		for c := n.FirstChild; c != nil; c = c.NextSibling {
			traverse(c)
		}
	}
	traverse(doc)

	result := text.String()

	// Decode HTML entities
	result = htmlUnescapeString(result)

	// Normalize whitespace
	result = normalizeWhitespace(result)

	return strings.TrimSpace(result)
}

// extractHTMLTextRegex is a fallback HTML parser using regex
func extractHTMLTextRegex(htmlBytes []byte) string {
	html := string(htmlBytes)

	// Remove <script> and <style> blocks (Go regexp doesn't support backreferences, use two patterns)
	reScript := regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)<script[^>]*>.*?</script>`)
	html = reScript.ReplaceAllString(html, "")
	reStyle := regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)<style[^>]*>.*?</style>`)
	html = reStyle.ReplaceAllString(html, "")

	// Replace <br> and </p> with newlines
	reBr := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)<br\s*/?>`)
	html = reBr.ReplaceAllString(html, "\n")
	reP := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)</p>`)
	html = reP.ReplaceAllString(html, "\n")

	// Remove all HTML tags
	reTags := regexp.MustCompile(`<[^>]*>`)
	text := reTags.ReplaceAllString(html, "")

	// Decode HTML entities
	text = htmlUnescapeString(text)

	// Normalize whitespace
	text = normalizeWhitespace(text)

	return strings.TrimSpace(text)
}

// normalizeWhitespace normalizes whitespace in text
func normalizeWhitespace(text string) string {
	// Replace tabs with spaces
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "\t", " ")

	// Replace multiple spaces with single space
	reSpaces := regexp.MustCompile(`[ ]+`)
	text = reSpaces.ReplaceAllString(text, " ")

	// Replace spaces before newlines
	reSpaceNewline := regexp.MustCompile(`[ ]+\n`)
	text = reSpaceNewline.ReplaceAllString(text, "\n")

	// Replace multiple newlines with double newline
	reNewlines := regexp.MustCompile(`\n{3,}`)
	text = reNewlines.ReplaceAllString(text, "\n\n")

	// Normalize line endings
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "\r\n", "\n")
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "\r", "\n")

	return text
}

// htmlUnescapeString decodes a subset of HTML entities
func htmlUnescapeString(s string) string {
	// Use standard library minimal decoding via strings.Replacer for common entities
	replacer := strings.NewReplacer(
		"&amp;", "&",
		"&lt;", "<",
		"&gt;", ">",
		"&quot;", "\"",
		"&#39;", "'",
	)
	return replacer.Replace(s)
}

// CanonicalizeURL normalizes a URL for deduplication
func CanonicalizeURL(rawURL string) string {
	// Force HTTPS
	if strings.HasPrefix(rawURL, "http://") {
		rawURL = "https://" + strings.TrimPrefix(rawURL, "http://")
	}

	// Remove query parameters and hash
	if idx := strings.Index(rawURL, "?"); idx != -1 {
		rawURL = rawURL[:idx]
	}
	if idx := strings.Index(rawURL, "#"); idx != -1 {
		rawURL = rawURL[:idx]
	}

	// Remove trailing slash
	rawURL = strings.TrimSuffix(rawURL, "/")

	// Convert to lowercase
	rawURL = strings.ToLower(rawURL)

	return rawURL
}

package crawler

import "testing"

func TestCanonicalizeURL(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]string{
		"http://Example.com/a?x=1#h": "https://example.com/a",
		"https://example.com/a/":     "https://example.com/a",
	}
	for in, want := range cases {
		if got := CanonicalizeURL(in); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s -> %s, want %s", in, got, want)
		}
	}
}

package discovery

import (
	"strings"
	"unicode"
)

// ChunkText splits text into semantically-friendly chunks with soft boundaries.
func ChunkText(text string, maxChars int) []string {
	if maxChars <= 0 {
		maxChars = 1200
	}
	s := strings.TrimSpace(text)
	if s == "" {
		return []string{}
	}
	var chunks []string
	start := 0
	for start < len(s) {
		end := start + maxChars
		if end >= len(s) {
			chunks = append(chunks, s[start:])
			break
		}
		// try to break at the last sentence boundary within window
		cut := lastBoundary(s[start:end])
		if cut <= 0 {
			cut = end - start
		}
		chunks = append(chunks, strings.TrimSpace(s[start:start+cut]))
		start = start + cut
	}
	return chunks
}

func lastBoundary(seg string) int {
	last := -1
	for i, r := range seg {
		if r == '.' || r == '!' || r == '?' || r == '\n' {
			// ensure following rune is space/newline if exists
			last = i + 1
		}
	}
	// avoid cutting inside words
	if last == -1 {
		for i := len(seg) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			if unicode.IsSpace(rune(seg[i])) {
				last = i
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return last
}

package discovery

import (
	"testing"
)

func TestChunkText(t *testing.T) {
	text := "Sentence one. Sentence two! And three? Last sentence."
	chunks := ChunkText(text, 20)
	if len(chunks) < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected at least 2 chunks, got %d", len(chunks))
	}
	// Ensure chunks are non-empty and boundaries respected
	for i, c := range chunks {
		if len(c) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("chunk %d is empty", i)
		}
		if len(c) > 20 && i != len(chunks)-1 {
			t.Fatalf("chunk %d exceeds maxChars: %d", i, len(c))
		}
	}
}

package discovery

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"log"

	"cloud.google.com/go/pubsub"
)

// GroundingProcessor consumes ground.refresh events and revalidates documents
type GroundingProcessor struct {
	sub          *pubsub.Subscription
	orchestrator *Orchestrator
	logger       *log.Logger
}

func NewGroundingProcessor(ps *pubsub.Client, topicName string, o *Orchestrator, logger *log.Logger) *GroundingProcessor {
	sub, _ := ensureSubscription(ps, topicName, topicName+".worker", logger)
	return &GroundingProcessor{sub: sub, orchestrator: o, logger: logger}
}

func (w *GroundingProcessor) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
	if w.sub == nil || w.orchestrator == nil {
		return nil
	}
	w.sub.ReceiveSettings.Synchronous = false
	w.sub.ReceiveSettings.MaxOutstandingMessages = 16
	return w.sub.Receive(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, m *pubsub.Message) {
		var payload struct {
			TenantID   string `json:"tenantId"`
			SourceID   string `json:"sourceId"`
			DocumentID string `json:"documentId"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(m.Data, &payload); err != nil {
			w.logger.Printf("ground worker: bad payload: %v", err)
			m.Ack()
			return
		}
		// best-effort refresh
		if err := w.orchestrator.RefreshDocumentByID(ctx, payload.TenantID, payload.SourceID, payload.DocumentID); err != nil {
			w.logger.Printf("ground worker: refresh error: %v", err)
		}
		m.Ack()
	})
}
