package realtime

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"strings"

	"cloud.google.com/go/pubsub"
)

// Subscriber binds Pub/Sub topics to WS hub broadcasts per tenant
type Subscriber struct {
	client *pubsub.Client
	hub    *Hub
	logger *log.Logger
}

func NewSubscriber(client *pubsub.Client, hub *Hub, logger *log.Logger) *Subscriber {
	return &Subscriber{client: client, hub: hub, logger: logger}
}

func (s *Subscriber) Start(ctx context.Context, topicNames ...string) error {
	if s.logger != nil {
		s.logger.Printf("subscriber: starting for %d topics", len(topicNames))
	}
	for _, tname := range topicNames {
		subID := tname + "-ws-broker"
		sub := s.client.Subscription(subID)
		exists, err := sub.Exists(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			if s.logger != nil {
				s.logger.Printf("subscriber: error checking subscription %s: %v", subID, err)
			}
			return err
		}
		if !exists {
			t := s.client.Topic(tname)
			if ok, _ := t.Exists(ctx); !ok {
				if s.logger != nil {
					s.logger.Printf("subscriber: topic %s not found; skipping subscription", tname)
				}
				continue
			}
			created, err := s.client.CreateSubscription(ctx, subID, pubsub.SubscriptionConfig{Topic: t, EnableMessageOrdering: true})
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			sub = created
		} else {
			// If subscription exists but ordering is not enabled, recreate for genai.stream, verified.stream and artifact topics
			if cfg, err := sub.Config(ctx); err == nil {
				if !cfg.EnableMessageOrdering && (tname == string(EventGenAIStream) || tname == string(EventVerifiedStream) || strings.HasPrefix(tname, "artifact.")) {
					_ = sub.Delete(ctx)
					t := s.client.Topic(tname)
					created, err := s.client.CreateSubscription(ctx, subID, pubsub.SubscriptionConfig{Topic: t, EnableMessageOrdering: true})
					if err == nil {
						sub = created
					} else {
						s.logger.Printf("subscriber: recreate with ordering failed for %s: %v", subID, err)
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if s.logger != nil {
			s.logger.Printf("subscriber: subscribing to %s (subscription: %s)", tname, subID)
		}
		go s.run(ctx, sub)
	}
	if s.logger != nil {
		s.logger.Printf("subscriber: started successfully for %d topics", len(topicNames))
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *Subscriber) run(ctx context.Context, sub *pubsub.Subscription) {
	_ = sub.Receive(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, m *pubsub.Message) {
		tenant := m.Attributes["tenantId"]
		et := m.Attributes["eventType"]
		projectID := m.Attributes["projectId"]

		// Diagnostics: log genai/artifact/verified deliveries with project routing and conn counts
		if s.logger != nil && (strings.HasPrefix(et, "genai.stream") || strings.HasPrefix(et, "artifact.") || strings.HasPrefix(et, "verified.stream")) {
			connCount := 0
			if projectID != "" {
				connCount = s.hub.GetProjectConnCount(tenant, projectID)
			}
			s.logger.Printf("subscriber: deliver et=%s tenant=%s project=%s connCount=%d attrs=%v", et, tenant, projectID, connCount, m.Attributes)
		}

		// DEBUG: log analysis.status events
		if et == "analysis.status" && s.logger != nil {
			s.logger.Printf("subscriber: received analysis.status for tenantId=%s, payload=%s", tenant, string(m.Data))
		}

		// DEBUG: log agent.update events
		if et == "agent.update" && s.logger != nil {
			connCount := 0
			if projectID != "" {
				connCount = s.hub.GetProjectConnCount(tenant, projectID)
			}
			s.logger.Printf("subscriber: received agent.update for tenantId=%s, projectId=%s, connCount=%d, payload=%s", tenant, projectID, connCount, string(m.Data))
		}

		// Try object payload first
		var obj map[string]interface{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(m.Data, &obj); err == nil {
			envelope := map[string]interface{}{
				"type": et,
				"data": obj,
			}
			// Verified.stream events: route by verified code from payload
			if strings.HasPrefix(et, "verified.stream.") {
				if code, ok := obj["code"].(string); ok && code != "" {
					s.hub.BroadcastVerified(code, envelope)
				}
			} else if projectID != "" {
				// Prefer routing by project if present
				// Pass-through projectId inside envelope for FE-side checks too
				obj["projectId"] = projectID
				s.hub.BroadcastJSONProject(tenant, projectID, envelope)
			} else {
				s.hub.BroadcastJSON(tenant, envelope)
			}
			m.Ack()
			return
		}

		// If array payload, broadcast each element (object only)
		var arr []interface{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(m.Data, &arr); err == nil {
			for _, el := range arr {
				if o, ok := el.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					envelope := map[string]interface{}{
						"type": et,
						"data": o,
					}
					if strings.HasPrefix(et, "verified.stream.") {
						if code, ok := o["code"].(string); ok && code != "" {
							s.hub.BroadcastVerified(code, envelope)
						}
					} else if projectID != "" {
						o["projectId"] = projectID
						s.hub.BroadcastJSONProject(tenant, projectID, envelope)
					} else {
						s.hub.BroadcastJSON(tenant, envelope)
					}
				}
			}
			m.Ack()
			return
		}

		s.logger.Printf("subscriber: json error: %s", string(m.Data))
		m.Ack()
	})
}

Файл: ws.go
Путь: internal/realtime/ws.go

package realtime

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
)

// Hub manages websocket clients per tenant
type Hub struct {
	upgrader websocket.Upgrader
	// tenantId -> set of connections
	conns map[string]map[*websocket.Conn]struct{}
	// tenantId -> projectId -> set of connections (only for clients that sent subscribe)
	projConns map[string]map[string]map[*websocket.Conn]struct{}
	// verifiedCode -> set of connections (for verified.stream events)
	verifiedConns map[string]map[*websocket.Conn]struct{}
	// connection ids for diagnostics
	connIDs map[*websocket.Conn]string
	mu      sync.RWMutex
	logger  *log.Logger
}

func NewHub(logger *log.Logger) *Hub {
	return &Hub{
		upgrader: websocket.Upgrader{
			ReadBufferSize:  1024,
			WriteBufferSize: 1024,
			CheckOrigin:     func(r *http.Request) bool { return true },
		},
		conns:         make(map[string]map[*websocket.Conn]struct{}),
		projConns:     make(map[string]map[string]map[*websocket.Conn]struct{}),
		verifiedConns: make(map[string]map[*websocket.Conn]struct{}),
		connIDs:       make(map[*websocket.Conn]string),
		logger:        logger,
	}
}

// ServeWS upgrades the connection and registers it to the tenant bucket
func (h *Hub) ServeWS(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, tenantID string) {
	c, err := h.upgrader.Upgrade(w, r, nil)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("ws upgrade: %v", err)
		return
	}

	h.mu.Lock()
	if _, ok := h.conns[tenantID]; !ok {
		h.conns[tenantID] = make(map[*websocket.Conn]struct{})
	}
	h.conns[tenantID][c] = struct{}{}
	// assign connection id for diagnostics
	h.connIDs[c] = uuid.NewString()
	h.mu.Unlock()

	// simple ping loop
	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(30 * time.Second)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			<-ticker.C
			if err := c.WriteControl(websocket.PingMessage, []byte("ping"), time.Now().Add(5*time.Second)); err != nil {
				h.removeConn(tenantID, c)
				_ = c.Close()
				return
			}
		}
	}()

	// read pump: handle simple control messages and detect close
	go func() {
		defer func() { h.removeConn(tenantID, c); _ = c.Close() }()
		c.SetReadLimit(1024)
		c.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(60 * time.Second))
		c.SetPongHandler(func(string) error { c.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(60 * time.Second)); return nil })
		for {
			mt, msg, err := c.ReadMessage()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			// Process subscribe messages (text frames with small JSON)
			if mt == websocket.TextMessage && len(msg) > 0 {
				// minimal parsing without extra deps
				// expect {"type":"subscribe","projectId":"..."} or {"type":"subscribe","verifiedCode":"..."}
				if bytesIndex := indexOfSubscribe(msg); bytesIndex {
					if pid := extractProjectID(msg); pid != "" {
						h.addProjectSubscription(tenantID, pid, c)
						// send ack back
						ack := map[string]interface{}{
							"type": "ws.subscribed",
							"data": map[string]interface{}{
								"tenantId":  tenantID,
								"projectId": pid,
								"connId":    h.getConnID(c),
								"ts":        time.Now().UnixMilli(),
							},
						}
						if err := c.WriteJSON(ack); err != nil {
							if h.logger != nil {
								h.logger.Printf("ws: failed to send subscribe ack conn=%s tenant=%s project=%s err=%v", h.getConnID(c), tenantID, pid, err)
							}
							h.removeConn(tenantID, c)
							_ = c.Close()
							return
						}
						if h.logger != nil {
							h.logger.Printf("ws: subscribed conn=%s tenant=%s project=%s", h.getConnID(c), tenantID, pid)
						}
					} else if vcode := extractVerifiedCode(msg); vcode != "" {
						h.addVerifiedSubscription(vcode, c)
						// send ack back
						ack := map[string]interface{}{
							"type": "ws.subscribed",
							"data": map[string]interface{}{
								"verifiedCode": vcode,
								"connId":       h.getConnID(c),
								"ts":           time.Now().UnixMilli(),
							},
						}
						_ = c.WriteJSON(ack)
						if h.logger != nil {
							h.logger.Printf("ws: subscribed conn=%s verifiedCode=%s", h.getConnID(c), vcode)
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}()
}

func (h *Hub) removeConn(tenantID string, c *websocket.Conn) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	connID := h.connIDs[c]
	
	// Log which projects this connection was subscribed to
	var subscribedProjects []string
	if pm, ok := h.projConns[tenantID]; ok {
		for pid, set := range pm {
			if _, hasConn := set[c]; hasConn {
				subscribedProjects = append(subscribedProjects, pid)
			}
		}
	}
	
	if set, ok := h.conns[tenantID]; ok {
		delete(set, c)
		if len(set) == 0 {
			delete(h.conns, tenantID)
		}
	}
	if pm, ok := h.projConns[tenantID]; ok {
		for pid, set := range pm {
			delete(set, c)
			if len(set) == 0 {
				delete(pm, pid)
			}
		}
		if len(pm) == 0 {
			delete(h.projConns, tenantID)
		}
	}
	// Remove from verified subscriptions
	for vcode, set := range h.verifiedConns {
		delete(set, c)
		if len(set) == 0 {
			delete(h.verifiedConns, vcode)
		}
	}
	delete(h.connIDs, c)
	
	// Log removal for debugging
	if h.logger != nil && len(subscribedProjects) > 0 {
		h.logger.Printf("ws: removed conn=%s tenant=%s projects=%v", connID, tenantID, subscribedProjects)
	}
}

// BroadcastJSON sends payload to all clients of tenant
func (h *Hub) BroadcastJSON(tenantID string, v interface{}) {
	h.mu.RLock()
	set := h.conns[tenantID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()
	if len(set) == 0 {
		// DEBUG: log when no clients are connected for analysis.status
		if env, ok := v.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if t, hasType := env["type"].(string); hasType && t == "analysis.status" {
				h.logger.Printf("ws: no clients connected for tenantId=%s (analysis.status)", tenantID)
			}
		}
		return
	}

	// DEBUG: log analysis.status broadcasts
	if env, ok := v.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
		if t, hasType := env["type"].(string); hasType && t == "analysis.status" {
			h.logger.Printf("ws: broadcasting analysis.status to %d client(s) for tenantId=%s", len(set), tenantID)
		}
	}

	for c := range set {
		if err := c.WriteJSON(v); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("ws write error: %v", err)
			h.removeConn(tenantID, c)
			_ = c.Close()
		}
	}
}

// BroadcastJSONProject sends payload only to clients of tenant subscribed to projectId
func (h *Hub) BroadcastJSONProject(tenantID, projectID string, v interface{}) {
	h.mu.RLock()
	pm := h.projConns[tenantID]
	var set map[*websocket.Conn]struct{}
	if pm != nil {
		set = pm[projectID]
	}
	connCount := len(set)
	h.mu.RUnlock()
	if connCount == 0 {
		// Log for genai.stream events to diagnose missing subscriptions
		if env, ok := v.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if t, hasType := env["type"].(string); hasType && strings.HasPrefix(t, "genai.stream") {
				if h.logger != nil {
					h.logger.Printf("ws: BroadcastJSONProject skipped (no connections) tenant=%s project=%s type=%s", tenantID, projectID, t)
				}
			}
		}
		return
	}
	// Log for genai.stream events
	if env, ok := v.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
		if t, hasType := env["type"].(string); hasType && strings.HasPrefix(t, "genai.stream") {
			if h.logger != nil {
				h.logger.Printf("ws: BroadcastJSONProject sending to %d connection(s) tenant=%s project=%s type=%s", connCount, tenantID, projectID, t)
			}
		}
	}
	for c := range set {
		if err := c.WriteJSON(v); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("ws write error: %v", err)
			h.removeConn(tenantID, c)
			_ = c.Close()
		}
	}
}

func (h *Hub) addProjectSubscription(tenantID, projectID string, c *websocket.Conn) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := h.projConns[tenantID]; !ok {
		h.projConns[tenantID] = make(map[string]map[*websocket.Conn]struct{})
	}
	if _, ok := h.projConns[tenantID][projectID]; !ok {
		h.projConns[tenantID][projectID] = make(map[*websocket.Conn]struct{})
	}
	h.projConns[tenantID][projectID][c] = struct{}{}
}

func (h *Hub) addVerifiedSubscription(verifiedCode string, c *websocket.Conn) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := h.verifiedConns[verifiedCode]; !ok {
		h.verifiedConns[verifiedCode] = make(map[*websocket.Conn]struct{})
	}
	h.verifiedConns[verifiedCode][c] = struct{}{}
}

// naive helpers to avoid json unmarshalling for tiny control frames
func indexOfSubscribe(b []byte) bool {
	// check for \"type\":\"subscribe\"
	if len(b) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	s := string(b)
	return strings.Contains(s, "\"type\":\"subscribe\"")
}

func extractProjectID(b []byte) string {
	s := string(b)
	// very small and permissive extraction
	const key = "\"projectId\""
	idx := strings.Index(s, key)
	if idx < 0 {
		return ""
	}
	tail := s[idx+len(key):]
	colon := strings.Index(tail, ":")
	if colon < 0 {
		return ""
	}
	tail = tail[colon+1:]
	// trim spaces and quotes
	tail = strings.TrimSpace(tail)
	if len(tail) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	if tail[0] == '"' {
		tail = tail[1:]
		end := strings.IndexByte(tail, '"')
		if end >= 0 {
			return tail[:end]
		}
	}
	// fallback until comma/brace
	end := strings.IndexAny(tail, ",}")
	if end >= 0 {
		return strings.TrimSpace(tail[:end])
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(tail)
}

func extractVerifiedCode(b []byte) string {
	s := string(b)
	const key = "\"verifiedCode\""
	idx := strings.Index(s, key)
	if idx < 0 {
		return ""
	}
	tail := s[idx+len(key):]
	colon := strings.Index(tail, ":")
	if colon < 0 {
		return ""
	}
	tail = tail[colon+1:]
	tail = strings.TrimSpace(tail)
	if len(tail) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	if tail[0] == '"' {
		tail = tail[1:]
		end := strings.IndexByte(tail, '"')
		if end >= 0 {
			return tail[:end]
		}
	}
	end := strings.IndexAny(tail, ",}")
	if end >= 0 {
		return strings.TrimSpace(tail[:end])
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(tail)
}

// GetProjectConnCount returns number of connections subscribed for a given tenant/project
func (h *Hub) GetProjectConnCount(tenantID, projectID string) int {
	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()
	if pm, ok := h.projConns[tenantID]; ok {
		if set, ok2 := pm[projectID]; ok2 {
			return len(set)
		}
	}
	return 0
}

func (h *Hub) getConnID(c *websocket.Conn) string {
	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()
	if id, ok := h.connIDs[c]; ok {
		return id
	}
	return ""
}

// BroadcastVerified sends payload to clients subscribed to a specific verified code
func (h *Hub) BroadcastVerified(verifiedCode string, v interface{}) {
	h.mu.RLock()
	set := h.verifiedConns[verifiedCode]
	h.mu.RUnlock()
	if len(set) == 0 {
		return
	}
	for c := range set {
		if err := c.WriteJSON(v); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("ws write error (verified broadcast): %v", err)
			// Find tenant for this connection to remove it properly
			h.mu.Lock()
			for tid, connSet := range h.conns {
				if _, ok := connSet[c]; ok {
					h.mu.Unlock()
					h.removeConn(tid, c)
					_ = c.Close()
					break
				}
			}
			h.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}
}

// GetConnectedClients returns the count of connected WS clients per tenantID (for debugging)
func (h *Hub) GetConnectedClients() map[string]int {
	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()
	res := make(map[string]int)
	for tid, set := range h.conns {
		res[tid] = len(set)
	}
	return res
}

package http

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/agents"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/realtime"
)

// AgentsHandler обрабатывает HTTP запросы для агентов
type AgentsHandler struct {
	registry  *agents.Registry
	publisher *realtime.Publisher
	logger    *log.Logger
}

// NewAgentsHandler создает новый AgentsHandler
func NewAgentsHandler(
	registry *agents.Registry,
	publisher *realtime.Publisher,
	logger *log.Logger,
) *AgentsHandler {
	return &AgentsHandler{
		registry:  registry,
		publisher: publisher,
		logger:    logger,
	}
}

// ListAgents обрабатывает GET /api/v1/agents - список доступных агентов
func (h *AgentsHandler) ListAgents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	
	list := h.registry.List()
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]interface{}{
		"agents": list,
	})
}

// ExecuteAgent обрабатывает POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/agents/{agentId}/execute
func (h *AgentsHandler) ExecuteAgent(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	
	// Извлекаем projectId и agentId из пути
	// Формат: /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/agents/{agentId}/execute
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 6 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID and Agent ID required")
		return
	}
	
	var projectID, agentID string
	for i, part := range parts {
		if part == "projects" && i+1 < len(parts) {
			projectID = parts[i+1]
		}
		if part == "agents" && i+1 < len(parts) {
			agentID = parts[i+1]
		}
	}
	
	if projectID == "" || agentID == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID and Agent ID required")
		return
	}
	
	// Проверяем существование проекта
	// TODO: добавить проверку через projectsRepo если нужно
	
	// Получаем агента
	agent, ok := h.registry.Get(agentID)
	if !ok {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Agent not found")
		return
	}
	
	// Парсим тело запроса
	var body map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}
	
	// Добавляем/обновляем контекст из аутентификации
	if body["context"] == nil {
		body["context"] = make(map[string]interface{})
	}
	contextMap := body["context"].(map[string]interface{})
	contextMap["tenantId"] = auth.TenantID
	contextMap["projectId"] = projectID // Обязательно устанавливаем projectId
	contextMap["userId"] = auth.UID
	
	// Валидация что projectId в контексте соответствует пути
	if ctxProjectID, ok := contextMap["projectId"].(string); !ok || ctxProjectID != projectID {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_CONTEXT", "projectId in context must match path")
		return
	}
	
	// Проверяем что projectId не пустой
	if projectID == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_CONTEXT", "projectId is required")
		return
	}
	
	taskJSON, err := json.Marshal(body)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to marshal task")
		return
	}
	
	// Выполняем агента со стримингом
	resultJSON, err := h.registry.ExecuteAgentWithStream(
		r.Context(),
		agentID,
		taskJSON,
		auth.TenantID,
		projectID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("agent execution failed: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Agent execution failed: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	
	// Парсим результат для ответа
	var result map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resultJSON, &result); err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to parse agent result")
		return
	}
	
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]interface{}{
		"result":    result,
		"agentId":   agentID,
		"agentName": agent.DisplayName(),
	})
}

package http

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/ai"
)

// AIExecHandler exposes universal structured-task execution via ModelManager + TaskExecutor
type AIExecHandler struct {
	exec *ai.AITaskExecutor
}

func NewAIExecHandler(exec *ai.AITaskExecutor) *AIExecHandler { return &AIExecHandler{exec: exec} }

type structuredRequest struct {
	Prompt             string `json:"prompt"`
	MinCapabilityScore int    `json:"minCapabilityScore"`
	MaxOutputSize      int    `json:"maxOutputSize"`
}

type structuredResponse struct {
	OK     bool        `json:"ok"`
	Result interface{} `json:"result"`
}

// Structured executes a prompt through the standard executor with JSON-only verification
// POST /api/v1/ai/structured
func (h *AIExecHandler) Structured(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		_ = WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Method not allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	// Auth required
	if GetAuthInfo(r.Context()) == nil {
		_ = WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	var req structuredRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil || len(req.Prompt) == 0 {
		_ = WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "prompt is required")
		return
	}

	minScore := req.MinCapabilityScore
	if minScore <= 0 {
		minScore = 6
	}
	maxOutput := req.MaxOutputSize
	if maxOutput <= 0 {
		maxOutput = 1024
	}

	// Compose instruction to force JSON-only output
	composed := req.Prompt + "\n\nReturn strictly JSON only. Do not include markdown code fences or extra text."

	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	task := &ai.AITask{
		TaskType:     ai.TaskTypeContentAnalysis,
		InputContent: composed,
		AIRequirements: ai.AIRequirements{
			MinContextWindow:         4000,
			MaxOutputSize:            maxOutput,
			MinCapabilityScore:       minScore,
			TextGenerationCapability: true,
		},
		Verifier:        ai.NewSimpleJSONVerifier(),
		EnableTelemetry: true,
		TenantID:        func() string { if auth != nil { return auth.TenantID }; return "" }(),
		UserID:          func() string { if auth != nil { return auth.UID }; return "" }(),
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	parsed, err := h.exec.ExecuteStructuredTask(ctx, task)
	if err != nil {
		_ = WriteError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "STRUCTURED_TASK_ERROR", err.Error(), nil)
		return
	}
	_ = WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, structuredResponse{OK: true, Result: parsed})
}

package http

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/services"
)

// ArtifactGenerationHandler handles artifact generation endpoints
type ArtifactGenerationHandler struct {
	orchestrator *services.ArtifactOrchestratorService
}

// NewArtifactGenerationHandler creates a new handler
func NewArtifactGenerationHandler(orchestrator *services.ArtifactOrchestratorService) *ArtifactGenerationHandler {
	return &ArtifactGenerationHandler{orchestrator: orchestrator}
}

// StartGeneration starts artifact generation
// POST /api/v1/artifacts/:id/generate
func (h *ArtifactGenerationHandler) StartGeneration(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Extract artifact ID from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Artifact ID is required")
		return
	}
	artifactID := pathParts[3]

	// Parse request body
	var req struct {
		Mode      string `json:"mode"`      // "auto" | "interactive"
		ProjectID string `json:"projectId"` // Required for context gathering
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate mode
	if req.Mode != "auto" && req.Mode != "interactive" {
		req.Mode = "interactive" // Default
	}

	// Start generation
	session, err := h.orchestrator.StartGeneration(r.Context(), services.StartGenerationRequest{
		ArtifactID: artifactID,
		Mode:       req.Mode,
		TenantID:   auth.TenantID,
		ProjectID:  req.ProjectID,
	})

	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to start generation")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, session)
}

// GenerateSection generates a specific section
// POST /api/v1/artifacts/:id/sections/:sectionId/generate
func (h *ArtifactGenerationHandler) GenerateSection(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Extract IDs from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 6 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Artifact ID and section ID are required")
		return
	}
	// artifactID := pathParts[3]
	sectionID := pathParts[5]

	// Parse request body
	var req struct {
		SessionID      string  `json:"sessionId"`
		ProjectID      string  `json:"projectId"`
		PromptOverride *string `json:"promptOverride,omitempty"`
		ModelOverride  *string `json:"modelOverride,omitempty"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.SessionID == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "MISSING_FIELD", "Session ID is required")
		return
	}

	// Generate section
	result, err := h.orchestrator.GenerateSection(r.Context(), services.GenerateSectionRequest{
		SessionID:      req.SessionID,
		SectionID:      sectionID,
		TenantID:       auth.TenantID,
		ProjectID:      req.ProjectID,
		UserID:         auth.UID,
		PromptOverride: req.PromptOverride,
		ModelOverride:  req.ModelOverride,
	})

	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to generate section")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

// RegenerateSection regenerates a section with new prompt
// POST /api/v1/artifacts/:id/sections/:sectionId/regenerate
func (h *ArtifactGenerationHandler) RegenerateSection(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// Same as GenerateSection but with required promptOverride
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 6 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Artifact ID and section ID are required")
		return
	}
	sectionID := pathParts[5]

	var req struct {
		SessionID string  `json:"sessionId"`
		ProjectID string  `json:"projectId"`
		NewPrompt string  `json:"newPrompt"`
		Model     *string `json:"model,omitempty"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.SessionID == "" || req.NewPrompt == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "MISSING_FIELD", "Session ID and new prompt are required")
		return
	}

	result, err := h.orchestrator.GenerateSection(r.Context(), services.GenerateSectionRequest{
		SessionID:      req.SessionID,
		SectionID:      sectionID,
		TenantID:       auth.TenantID,
		ProjectID:      req.ProjectID,
		UserID:         auth.UID,
		PromptOverride: &req.NewPrompt,
		ModelOverride:  req.Model,
	})

	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to regenerate section")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)

// AssembleDocument assembles final document from sections
// POST /api/v1/artifacts/:id/assemble
func (h *ArtifactGenerationHandler) AssembleDocument(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req struct {
		SessionID string `json:"sessionId"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")

	}

	if req.SessionID == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "MISSING_FIELD", "Session ID is required")

// SaveVersion saves current state as a new version
// POST /api/v1/artifacts/:id/versions
func (h *ArtifactGenerationHandler) SaveVersion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req struct {
		SessionID string `json:"sessionId"`
		Trigger   string `json:"trigger"` // "manual" | "auto" | "scheduled"
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.SessionID == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "MISSING_FIELD", "Session ID is required")
		return
	}

	if req.Trigger == "" {
		req.Trigger = "manual"
	}

	version, err := h.orchestrator.SaveVersion(r.Context(), req.SessionID, req.Trigger)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to save version")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, version)
}

// GetSession retrieves generation session status

// CancelGeneration cancels an in-progress generation
// POST /api/v1/generation-sessions/:sessionId/cancel
func (h *ArtifactGenerationHandler) CancelGeneration(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Session ID is required")
		return
	}
	sessionID := pathParts[3]

	err := h.orchestrator.CancelGeneration(r.Context(), sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to cancel generation")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]bool{"success": true})
}

// RestoreVersion restores an old version
// POST /api/v1/artifacts/:id/versions/:versionId/restore

	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 6 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Artifact ID and version ID are required")
		return
	}
	// artifactID := pathParts[3]
	// versionID := pathParts[5]

	artifactID := pathParts[3]
	versionID := pathParts[5]

		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to restore version")
		return

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]bool{"success": true})
}

package http

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// ArtifactsHandler manages CRUD for artifacts (CoreDoc with docType = dynamic_artifact)
type ArtifactsHandler struct {
	coreDocs *repo.CoreDocsRepo
}

func NewArtifactsHandler(core *repo.CoreDocsRepo) *ArtifactsHandler {
	return &ArtifactsHandler{coreDocs: core}
}

// CreateArtifact creates a new artifact in a project
// POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/artifacts
func (h *ArtifactsHandler) CreateArtifact(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	path := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(path) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID required")
		return
	}
	projectID := path[3]

	var req models.CoreDoc
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Force required identifiers
	req.TenantID = auth.TenantID
	req.ProjectID = projectID
	// Ensure it's an artifact
	dt := "dynamic_artifact"
	req.DocType = &dt
	if req.ArtifactConfig == nil {
		req.ArtifactConfig = &models.ArtifactConfig{
			Format:             "text",
			Focus:              "analysis",
			OrchestratorModel:  "gemini-quality",
			DefaultModel:       "gemini-quality",
			ReviewPrompt:       "Review and refine for clarity, consistency, and completeness.",
			Structure:          []models.ArtifactSection{},
			ContextSources:     models.ArtifactContextSources{},
			AutoUpdateEnabled:  false,
			VersionsRetained:   10,
			Versions:           []models.ArtifactVersion{},
			GenerationSettings: models.GenerationSettings{PreferredLanguage: "en", SystemPrompt: "You are a helpful assistant."},
		}
	}

	id, err := h.coreDocs.Create(r.Context(), &req)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create artifact")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]string{"id": id})
}

// ListArtifacts lists artifacts for a project
// GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/artifacts
func (h *ArtifactsHandler) ListArtifacts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	path := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(path) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID required")
		return
	}
	projectID := path[3]
	items, err := h.coreDocs.ListByProject(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, projectID, 0)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to list artifacts")
		return
	}
	// Filter artifacts only
	out := make([]*models.CoreDoc, 0, len(items))
	for _, d := range items {
		if d.DocType != nil && *d.DocType == "dynamic_artifact" {
			out = append(out, d)
		}
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

// GetArtifact returns an artifact by ID
// GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/artifacts/:id
func (h *ArtifactsHandler) GetArtifact(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Artifact ID required")
		return
	}
	id := parts[5]
	d, err := h.coreDocs.Get(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil || d == nil || d.TenantID != auth.TenantID {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Artifact not found")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, d)
}

// UpdateArtifact updates an artifact config (PATCH)
// PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId/artifacts/:id
func (h *ArtifactsHandler) UpdateArtifact(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Artifact ID required")
		return
	}
	id := parts[5]
	existing, err := h.coreDocs.Get(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil || existing == nil || existing.TenantID != auth.TenantID {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Artifact not found")
		return
	}
	var patch models.CoreDoc
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&patch); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}
	// Merge selective fields
	if patch.Description != nil {
		existing.Description = patch.Description
	}
	if patch.ArtifactConfig != nil {
		existing.ArtifactConfig = patch.ArtifactConfig
	}
	if err := h.coreDocs.Upsert(r.Context(), existing); err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to update artifact")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, existing)
}

// DeleteArtifact deletes an artifact
// DELETE /api/v1/projects/:projectId/artifacts/:id
func (h *ArtifactsHandler) DeleteArtifact(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Artifact ID required")
		return
	}
	id := parts[5]
	d, err := h.coreDocs.Get(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil || d == nil || d.TenantID != auth.TenantID {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Artifact not found")
		return
	}
	ok, derr := h.coreDocs.Delete(r.Context(), id)
	if derr != nil || !ok {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to delete artifact")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]bool{"success": true})
}

package http

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"firebase.google.com/go/v4/auth"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/services"
)

// AuthContextKey is the key for storing auth info in request context
type AuthContextKey struct{}

// AuthInfo contains authenticated user information
type AuthInfo struct {
	UID      string
	Email    string
	TenantID string
	IsSystem bool
}

// AuthMiddleware validates Firebase ID tokens and populates context
func AuthMiddleware(authClient *auth.Client) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			authHeader := r.Header.Get("Authorization")

			// Check for system call with function key
			if r.Header.Get("x-functions-key") != "" {
				authInfo := &AuthInfo{
					UID:      "system",
					Email:    "system",
					TenantID: "system",
					IsSystem: true,
				}
				ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), AuthContextKey{}, authInfo)
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
				return
			}

			// Check for Bearer token
			if authHeader == "" {
				http.Error(w, "missing authorization header", http.StatusUnauthorized)
				return
			}

			const prefix = "Bearer "
			if !strings.HasPrefix(authHeader, prefix) {
				http.Error(w, "invalid authorization header format", http.StatusUnauthorized)
				return
			}

			idToken := strings.TrimPrefix(authHeader, prefix)

			// Verify Firebase token
			token, err := authClient.VerifyIDToken(r.Context(), idToken)
			if err != nil {
				http.Error(w, "invalid or expired token", http.StatusUnauthorized)
				return
			}

			// Extract claims
			uid := token.UID
			email, _ := token.Claims["email"].(string)

			// Resolve tenantId via UsersRepository if available in request context
			tenantID := email
			if uraw := r.Context().Value(usersRepoKey{}); uraw != nil {
				if usersRepo, ok := uraw.(*repo.UsersRepository); ok && usersRepo != nil {
					if u, err := usersRepo.GetByUID(r.Context(), uid); err == nil && u != nil {
						if u.TenantID != "" {
							tenantID = u.TenantID
						}
					}
				}
			}

			authInfo := &AuthInfo{
				UID:      uid,
				Email:    email,
				TenantID: tenantID,
				IsSystem: false,
			}

			ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), AuthContextKey{}, authInfo)
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
		})
	}
}

// GetAuthInfo retrieves auth info from request context
func GetAuthInfo(ctx context.Context) *AuthInfo {
	if auth, ok := ctx.Value(AuthContextKey{}).(*AuthInfo); ok {
		return auth
	}
	return nil
}

// RequireAuth wraps a handler and ensures user is authenticated
func RequireAuth(next http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
		if authInfo == nil {
			http.Error(w, "authentication required", http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}
		next(w, r)
	}
}

// usersRepoKey is a private context key used to pass UsersRepository into middleware
type usersRepoKey struct{}

// WithUsersRepo attaches UsersRepository to request context (to resolve tenant)
func WithUsersRepo(users *repo.UsersRepository) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), usersRepoKey{}, users)
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
		})
	}
}

// subscriptionServiceKey is a private context key used to pass SubscriptionService into middleware
type subscriptionServiceKey struct{}

// WithSubscriptionService attaches SubscriptionService to request context
func WithSubscriptionService(service *services.SubscriptionService) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), subscriptionServiceKey{}, service)
			
			// Auto-create Max subscription for admins on first request (async, best-effort)
			// Use r.Context() to get authInfo from AuthMiddleware (which runs before this)
			authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
			if authInfo != nil && !authInfo.IsSystem {
				go func() {
					defer func() { recover() }() // Don't let panics crash the server
					
					// Use background context with timeout for async operation
					bgCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
					defer cancel()
					
					// Get user from database to check if admin
					// Use r.Context() to get usersRepo from WithUsersRepo middleware (which runs before this)
					if uraw := r.Context().Value(usersRepoKey{}); uraw != nil {
						if usersRepo, ok := uraw.(*repo.UsersRepository); ok && usersRepo != nil {
							user, err := usersRepo.GetByIDAndTenant(bgCtx, authInfo.UID, authInfo.TenantID)
							if err == nil && user != nil && user.Role != nil && strings.ToLower(*user.Role) == "admin" {
								// Ensure admin has Max subscription
								_ = service.EnsureAdminMaxSubscription(bgCtx, authInfo.TenantID, authInfo.UID)
								// Errors are logged inside EnsureAdminMaxSubscription, we don't fail the request
							}
						}
					}
				}()
			}
			
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
		})
	}
}

// RequireSubscription creates middleware that requires a minimum subscription tier
func RequireSubscription(requiredTier models.SubscriptionTier) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
			if authInfo == nil {
				WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
				return
			}

			// System calls bypass subscription checks
			if authInfo.IsSystem {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				return
			}

			// Get subscription service from context
			serviceRaw := r.Context().Value(subscriptionServiceKey{})
			if serviceRaw == nil {
				WriteInternalError(w, "Subscription service not available")
				return
			}

			service, ok := serviceRaw.(*services.SubscriptionService)
			if !ok {
				WriteInternalError(w, "Invalid subscription service")
				return
			}

			// Check subscription
			_, valid, err := service.CheckSubscription(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, authInfo.UID, requiredTier)
			if err != nil {
				WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to check subscription")
				return
			}

			if !valid {
				WriteError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED", 
					fmt.Sprintf("This feature requires %s subscription or higher", requiredTier), nil)
				return
			}

			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}
