package http

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/ai"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/discovery"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/realtime"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// DiscoveryHandler handles discovery-related HTTP requests
type DiscoveryHandler struct {
	projectsRepo     *repo.ProjectsRepository
	dataSourcesRepo  *repo.DataSourcesRepository
	interactionsRepo *repo.InteractionsRepository
	profilesRepo     *repo.SourceProfilesRepository
	logger           *log.Logger
	orchestrator     *discovery.Orchestrator
	// rag deps
	docsRepo           *repo.DocumentsRepository
	searchRepo         *repo.SearchEventsRepository
	sourceProjectsRepo *repo.SourceProjectsRepository
	chunksRepo         *repo.ChunksRepository
	firestoreClient    *firestore.Client
	// Vertex AI Search client
	vertexSearchClient *ai.VertexAISearchClient
}

// NewDiscoveryHandler creates a new DiscoveryHandler
func NewDiscoveryHandler(
	projectsRepo *repo.ProjectsRepository,
	dataSourcesRepo *repo.DataSourcesRepository,
	logger *log.Logger,
) *DiscoveryHandler {
	return &DiscoveryHandler{
		projectsRepo:    projectsRepo,
		dataSourcesRepo: dataSourcesRepo,
		logger:          logger,
	}
}

// WithOrchestrator wires orchestrator instance for execution
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithOrchestrator(o *discovery.Orchestrator) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.orchestrator = o
	return h
}

// WithDocuments wires documents repo for future endpoints
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithDocuments(d *repo.DocumentsRepository) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.docsRepo = d
	return h
}

// WithSearchEvents wires search events repository
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithSearchEvents(sr *repo.SearchEventsRepository) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.searchRepo = sr
	return h
}

// WithSourceProjects wires source-project links repository
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithSourceProjects(sp *repo.SourceProjectsRepository) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.sourceProjectsRepo = sp
	return h
}

// WithChunks wires chunks repository for vector search
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithChunks(cr *repo.ChunksRepository) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.chunksRepo = cr
	return h
}

// WithFirestoreClient wires Firestore client for native vector search
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithFirestoreClient(client *firestore.Client) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.firestoreClient = client
	return h
}

// WithVertexSearch wires Vertex AI Search client
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithVertexSearch(client *ai.VertexAISearchClient) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.vertexSearchClient = client
	return h
}

// WithInteractions wires interactions repo
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithInteractions(ir *repo.InteractionsRepository) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.interactionsRepo = ir
	return h
}

// SearchDocuments handles GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/search?language=&documentType=&limit=
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) SearchDocuments(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	if _, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID); err != nil {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Project not found")
		return
	}
	var sourceIDs []string
	weightsBySource := map[string]float64{}
	if h.sourceProjectsRepo != nil {
		status := "active"
		if sps, err := h.sourceProjectsRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, projectID, &status); err == nil {
			for _, sp := range sps {
				sourceIDs = append(sourceIDs, sp.SourceID)
				if sp.Weights != nil {
					if wv, ok := sp.Weights["default"]; ok {
						weightsBySource[sp.SourceID] = wv
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(sourceIDs) == 0 {
		// fallback to legacy linkage
		sources, err := h.dataSourcesRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, projectID)
		if err != nil || len(sources) == 0 {
			// If no sources, include virtual project source for CoreDocs
			virtualSourceID := fmt.Sprintf("project:%s", projectID)
			sourceIDs = append(sourceIDs, virtualSourceID)
		} else {
			for _, s := range sources {
				sourceIDs = append(sourceIDs, s.ID)
			}
		}
	}
	// Also include virtual project source for CoreDocs if not already present
	virtualSourceID := fmt.Sprintf("project:%s", projectID)
	hasVirtual := false
	for _, sid := range sourceIDs {
		if sid == virtualSourceID {
			hasVirtual = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !hasVirtual {
		sourceIDs = append(sourceIDs, virtualSourceID)
	}
	if len(sourceIDs) == 0 {
		WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []any{})
		return
	}

	q := r.URL.Query()
	var language *string
	if v := q.Get("language"); v != "" {
		language = &v
	}
	var docType *string
	if v := q.Get("documentType"); v != "" {
		docType = &v
	}
	limit := 50
	if v := q.Get("limit"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil && n > 0 {
			limit = n
		}
	}

	items, err := h.docsRepo.ListBySources(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, sourceIDs, limit, language, docType)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Search failed")
		return
	}
	// optional time window filters
	if v := q.Get("since"); v != "" {
		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, v); err == nil {
			filtered := items[:0]
			for _, d := range items {
				if d.OriginPublishedAt == nil || d.OriginPublishedAt.After(t) {
					filtered = append(filtered, d)
				}
			}
			items = filtered
		}
	}
	if v := q.Get("until"); v != "" {
		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, v); err == nil {
			filtered := items[:0]
			for _, d := range items {
				if d.OriginPublishedAt == nil || d.OriginPublishedAt.Before(t) {
					filtered = append(filtered, d)
				}
			}
			items = filtered
		}
	}
	// optional categories filter: comma-separated labels in ?categories=label1,label2
	if v := q.Get("categories"); strings.TrimSpace(v) != "" {
		wanted := map[string]struct{}{}
		for _, lab := range strings.Split(v, ",") {
			lab = strings.TrimSpace(lab)
			if lab != "" {
				wanted[strings.ToLower(lab)] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
		if len(wanted) > 0 {
			filtered := items[:0]
			for _, d := range items {
				match := false
				for _, c := range d.Categories {
					if c == nil {
						continue
					}
					if lblAny, ok := c["label"]; ok {
						if lbl, ok2 := lblAny.(string); ok2 {
							if _, ok3 := wanted[strings.ToLower(lbl)]; ok3 {
								match = true
								break
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if match {
					filtered = append(filtered, d)
				}
			}
			items = filtered
		}
	}
	// record search event (best-effort)
	if h.searchRepo != nil {
		filters := map[string]any{}
		if language != nil {
			filters["language"] = *language
		}
		if docType != nil {
			filters["documentType"] = *docType
		}
		var ids []string
		for _, it := range items {
			ids = append(ids, it.ID)
		}
		_, _ = h.searchRepo.Create(r.Context(), &models.SearchEvent{TenantID: auth.TenantID, ProjectID: projectID, Query: "documents.search", Filters: filters, ResultsDocIDs: ids})
	}
	// recency + per-source weight boost ordering
	type scored struct {
		d     *models.Document
		score float64
	}
	scoredItems := make([]scored, 0, len(items))
	nowT := time.Now().UTC()
	for _, d := range items {
		ageDays := 365.0
		if d.OriginPublishedAt != nil {
			ageDays = nowT.Sub(*d.OriginPublishedAt).Hours() / 24.0
			if ageDays < 0 {
				ageDays = 0
			}
		}
		base := 1.0 / (1.0 + ageDays)
		wv := weightsBySource[d.SourceID]
		scoredItems = append(scoredItems, scored{d: d, score: base + wv})
	}
	sort.Slice(scoredItems, func(i, j int) bool { return scoredItems[i].score > scoredItems[j].score })
	out := make([]*models.Document, 0, len(scoredItems))
	for _, s := range scoredItems {
		out = append(out, s.d)
	}
	if limit > 0 && len(out) > limit {
		out = out[:limit]
	}
	// publish ground.refresh for top 5
	top := 5
	if len(out) < top {
		top = len(out)
	}
	for i := 0; i < top; i++ {
		if h.orchestrator != nil && h.orchestrator.Publish() != nil {
			_ = h.orchestrator.Publish().PublishJSON(r.Context(), realtime.EventGroundRefresh, auth.TenantID, map[string]any{"tenantId": auth.TenantID, "sourceId": out[i].SourceID, "documentId": out[i].ID})
		}
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": out})
}

// WithProfiles wires SourceProfiles repository (optional)
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) WithProfiles(sp *repo.SourceProfilesRepository) *DiscoveryHandler {
	h.profilesRepo = sp
	return h
}

// IngestProject handles POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/ingest
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) IngestProject(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	project, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	if h.orchestrator == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Ingest not configured")
		return
	}
	go func() { _ = h.orchestrator.IngestProjectSources(context.Background(), authInfo.TenantID, projectID) }()
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, map[string]any{"queued": true})
}

// VectorSearchRequest for POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/vector-search
type VectorSearchRequest struct {
	Query        string  `json:"query"`
	TopK         int     `json:"topK"`
	Language     *string `json:"language,omitempty"`
	DocumentType *string `json:"documentType,omitempty"`
	Since        *string `json:"since,omitempty"`
	Until        *string `json:"until,omitempty"`
}

// VectorSearch performs KNN over chunks using the configured VectorIndex
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) VectorSearch(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	if _, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID); err != nil {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Project not found")
		return
	}
	var body VectorSearchRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(body.Query) == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "query is required")
		return
	}
	if body.TopK <= 0 {
		body.TopK = 10
	}

	// resolve sources and weights
	status := "active"
	var sourceIDs []string
	weightsBySource := map[string]float64{}
	if h.sourceProjectsRepo != nil {
		if sps, err := h.sourceProjectsRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, projectID, &status); err == nil {
			for _, sp := range sps {
				sourceIDs = append(sourceIDs, sp.SourceID)
				if sp.Weights != nil {
					if wv, ok := sp.Weights["default"]; ok {
						weightsBySource[sp.SourceID] = wv
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(sourceIDs) == 0 {
		if ds, err := h.dataSourcesRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, projectID); err == nil {
			for _, s := range ds {
				sourceIDs = append(sourceIDs, s.ID)
			}
		}
	}
	// If still no sources, include virtual project source for CoreDocs
	if len(sourceIDs) == 0 {
		virtualSourceID := fmt.Sprintf("project:%s", projectID)
		sourceIDs = append(sourceIDs, virtualSourceID)
	}
	if len(sourceIDs) == 0 {
		WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": []any{}})
		return
	}

	// embed query
	exec := h.orchestrator.Exec()
	if exec == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Embedding executor not configured")
		return
	}
	emb := ai.NewOpenAIEmbedding(exec, "text-embedding-3-small")
	qvecs, err := emb.EmbedTexts(r.Context(), []string{body.Query})
	if err != nil || len(qvecs) == 0 {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Embedding failed")
		return
	}
	qv := qvecs[0]

	// vector index query (using FirestoreVectorIndex adapter)
	if h.chunksRepo == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Chunks repository not available")
		return
	}
	index := ai.NewFirestoreVectorIndex(h.chunksRepo)
	if h.firestoreClient != nil {
		index = index.WithClient(h.firestoreClient)
	}
	ids, err := index.Query(r.Context(), qv, body.TopK, map[string]any{"tenantId": auth.TenantID, "sourceIds": sourceIDs})
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Vector query failed")
		return
	}
	chunks, err := h.chunksRepo.GetByIDs(r.Context(), ids)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to load chunks")
		return
	}
	var sinceT, untilT *time.Time
	if body.Since != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*body.Since) != "" {
		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, *body.Since); err == nil {
			sinceT = &t
		}
	}
	if body.Until != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*body.Until) != "" {
		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, *body.Until); err == nil {
			untilT = &t
		}
	}
	type scored struct {
		c     *models.Chunk
		score float64
		doc   *models.Document
	}
	var scoredItems []scored
	nowT := time.Now().UTC()
	for _, c := range chunks {
		if body.DocumentType != nil && c.Attrs != nil {
			if v, ok := c.Attrs["documentType"].(string); ok {
				if strings.TrimSpace(v) != strings.TrimSpace(*body.DocumentType) {
					continue
				}
			}
		}
		doc, _ := h.docsRepo.GetByID(r.Context(), c.DocID)
		if body.Language != nil && doc != nil && strings.TrimSpace(doc.Language) != "" {
			if !strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(doc.Language), strings.TrimSpace(*body.Language)) {
				continue
			}
		}
		if body.DocumentType != nil && doc != nil && strings.TrimSpace(doc.DocumentType) != "" {
			if strings.TrimSpace(doc.DocumentType) != strings.TrimSpace(*body.DocumentType) {
				continue
			}
		}
		if (sinceT != nil || untilT != nil) && doc != nil && doc.OriginPublishedAt != nil {
			if sinceT != nil && doc.OriginPublishedAt.Before(*sinceT) {
				continue
			}
			if untilT != nil && doc.OriginPublishedAt.After(*untilT) {
				continue
			}
		}
		// similarity + recency + per-source weight boost
		sim := 0.0
		if len(c.Embedding) > 0 {
			sim = ai.CosineSimilarity(qv, c.Embedding)
		}
		ageDays := 365.0
		if doc != nil && doc.OriginPublishedAt != nil {
			ageDays = nowT.Sub(*doc.OriginPublishedAt).Hours() / 24.0
			if ageDays < 0 {
				ageDays = 0
			}
		}
		recency := 1.0 / (1.0 + ageDays)
		weight := 0.0
		// weightsBySource computed earlier in handler
		if wv, ok := weightsBySource[c.SourceID]; ok {
			weight = wv
		}
		scoredItems = append(scoredItems, scored{c: c, doc: doc, score: sim + recency + weight})
	}
	sort.Slice(scoredItems, func(i, j int) bool { return scoredItems[i].score > scoredItems[j].score })
	if body.TopK > 0 && len(scoredItems) > body.TopK {
		scoredItems = scoredItems[:body.TopK]
	}
	out := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(scoredItems))
	for _, s := range scoredItems {
		out = append(out, map[string]any{"docId": s.c.DocID, "sourceId": s.c.SourceID, "position": s.c.Position, "score": s.score, "text": s.c.Text})
	}
	// publish ground.refresh for top 3
	top := 3
	if len(out) < top {
		top = len(out)
	}
	for i := 0; i < top; i++ {
		if h.orchestrator != nil && h.orchestrator.Publish() != nil {
			_ = h.orchestrator.Publish().PublishJSON(r.Context(), realtime.EventGroundRefresh, auth.TenantID, map[string]any{"tenantId": auth.TenantID, "sourceId": out[i]["sourceId"], "documentId": out[i]["docId"]})
		}
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": out})
}

// ExecuteDiscoveryRequest represents the request body for discovery execution
type ExecuteDiscoveryRequest struct {
	ProjectID string  `json:"projectId"`
	QueryText string  `json:"queryText"`
	Language  *string `json:"language,omitempty"`
	Sources   struct {
		Web      []string `json:"web"`
		Telegram []string `json:"telegram"`
	} `json:"sources"`
	CorrelationID *string `json:"correlationId,omitempty"`
}

// ExecuteDiscovery handles POST /api/v1/sources-discovery/execute
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) ExecuteDiscovery(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req ExecuteDiscoveryRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}

	// If projectID is provided, verify it exists and belongs to user's tenant
	if req.ProjectID != "" {
		project, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), req.ProjectID)
		if err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Project not found: %s", req.ProjectID)
			WriteNotFound(w, "Project not found")
			return
		}

		if project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
			WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
			return
		}

		// Update project's lastInteractionAt
		if err := h.projectsRepo.UpdateLastInteraction(r.Context(), req.ProjectID); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Failed to update project interaction time: %v", err)
			// Non-fatal, continue
		}

		// Persist user query as an interaction for chat history (when project is known)
		if h.interactionsRepo != nil && strings.TrimSpace(req.QueryText) != "" {
			_, _ = h.interactionsRepo.Create(r.Context(), &repo.Interaction{
				TenantID:  authInfo.TenantID,
				ProjectID: req.ProjectID,
				Kind:      "discovery.query",
				Content:   req.QueryText,
			})
		}
	}

	// Generate correlation ID if not provided
	correlationID := ""
	if req.CorrelationID != nil {
		correlationID = *req.CorrelationID
	} else {
		// Generate a simple ID (in production, use UUID)
		correlationID = generateCorrelationID()
	}

	// Parse and canonicalize sources
	var webSources []string
	var telegramSources []string

	for _, url := range req.Sources.Web {
		// URL canonicalization would happen here
		canonical := strings.TrimSpace(url)
		if canonical != "" {
			webSources = append(webSources, canonical)
		}
	}

	for _, handle := range req.Sources.Telegram {
		// Normalize telegram handles (remove @ if present)
		canonical := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(handle, "@"))
		if canonical != "" {
			telegramSources = append(telegramSources, canonical)
		}
	}

	if len(webSources) == 0 && len(telegramSources) == 0 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "At least one source (web or telegram) is required")
		return
	}

	// Execute orchestrator (fire-and-forget go routine) using independent timeout-bound context
	if h.orchestrator != nil {
		go func() {
			lang := "en"
			if req.Language != nil && *req.Language != "" {
				lang = *req.Language
			}
			// Important: decouple from r.Context() so work continues after HTTP returns
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Minute)
			defer cancel()
			_ = h.orchestrator.Execute(ctx, discovery.ExecuteInput{
				TenantID:    authInfo.TenantID,
				ProjectID:   req.ProjectID,
				QueryText:   req.QueryText,
				Language:    lang,
				WebSources:  webSources,
				TgHandles:   telegramSources,
				Correlation: correlationID,
				OwnerUID:    authInfo.UID,
			})
		}()
	}

	response := map[string]interface{}{
		"success":       true,
		"correlationId": correlationID,
		"message":       "Discovery task queued",
		"sourcesCount": map[string]int{
			"web":      len(webSources),
			"telegram": len(telegramSources),
		},
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, response)
}

// ListProjectSources handles GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/datasources
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) ListProjectSources(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Extract projectId from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := pathParts[3]

	// Verify project exists and belongs to user's tenant
	project, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Project not found: %s", projectID)
		WriteNotFound(w, "Project not found")
		return
	}

	if project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Resolve via rag_source_projects (new linkage) exclusively
	if h.sourceProjectsRepo == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Source-project linking not configured")
		return
	}
	var out []map[string]any
	status := "active"
	links, err := h.sourceProjectsRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, projectID, &status)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("ListByProject (sourceProjects) error: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to list sources")
		return
	}

	// Optionally prefetch profiles and index by dataSourceId
	profilesBySource := map[string]any{}
	if h.profilesRepo != nil {
		if profs, err := h.profilesRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, projectID, h.dataSourcesRepo); err == nil {
			for _, sp := range profs {
				if sp == nil || strings.TrimSpace(sp.DataSourceID) == "" {
					continue
				}
				// Frontend expects `source.profile` to be the inner profile payload (not wrapper)
				profilesBySource[sp.DataSourceID] = sp.Profile
			}
		}
	}
	for _, link := range links {
		if link == nil || strings.TrimSpace(link.SourceID) == "" {
			continue
		}
		ds, err := h.dataSourcesRepo.Get(r.Context(), link.SourceID)
		if err != nil || ds == nil {
			continue
		}
		m := map[string]interface{}{
			"id":            ds.ID,
			"tenantId":      ds.TenantID,
			"pk":            ds.Pk,
			"displayName":   ds.DisplayName,
			"kind":          ds.Kind,
			"status":        ds.Status,
			"researchId":    ds.ResearchID,
			"sessionId":     ds.SessionID,
			"ownerUserId":   ds.OwnerUserID,
			"sourceDetails": ds.Details,
			"lastPolledAt":  ds.LastPolledAt,
			"lastFoundAt":   ds.LastFoundAt,
			"errorCount":    ds.ErrorCount,
			"createdAt":     ds.CreatedAt,
			"updatedAt":     ds.UpdatedAt,
			"trustLevel":    ds.TrustLevel,
			"firstSeenAt":   ds.FirstSeen,
			"lastSeenAt":    ds.LastSeen,
			"link": map[string]any{
				"id":         link.ID,
				"projectId":  link.ProjectID,
				"sourceId":   link.SourceID,
				"status":     link.Status,
				"weights":    link.Weights,
				"syncConfig": link.SyncConfig,
				"createdAt":  link.CreatedAt,
				"updatedAt":  link.UpdatedAt,
			},
		}
		if p, ok := profilesBySource[ds.ID]; ok {
			m["profile"] = p
		}
		out = append(out, m)
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

// PublishDue exposes POST /api/v1/admin/sources/publish-due (secured via auth middleware)
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) PublishDue(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	if h.orchestrator == nil || h.orchestrator.Publish() == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Poller not configured")
		return
	}
	// Use the poller via webhooks handler; here we simply publish a signal event for due polling
	// In this minimal implementation, we just return OK; background ticker handles due work.
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}

// ListProjectInteractions handles GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/interactions
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) ListProjectInteractions(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := pathParts[3]

	project, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Project not found")
		return
	}
	if project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	if h.interactionsRepo == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Interactions not configured")
		return
	}
	items, err := h.interactionsRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil {
		// If Firestore index not ready or other transient failures, return empty list instead of 500 to avoid UX flash
		// Common Firestore error for missing composite index: FailedPrecondition
		// We cannot import status package here; fallback to string check
		em := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
		if strings.Contains(em, "failedprecondition") || strings.Contains(em, "index") || strings.Contains(em, "unavailable") {
			WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": []any{}})
			return
		}
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to list interactions")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": items})
}

// CreateProjectInteraction handles POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/interactions
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) CreateProjectInteraction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if h.interactionsRepo == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Interactions repo not configured")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	project, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	var body struct {
		Kind    string          `json:"kind"`
		Content string          `json:"content"`
		Summary *string         `json:"summary,omitempty"`
		Model   *string         `json:"model,omitempty"`
		Usage   *repo.UsageMeta `json:"usage,omitempty"`
		// Optional extended fields (safe defaults if missing)
		Subkind          *string                    `json:"subkind,omitempty"`
		ContentSanitized *string                    `json:"contentSanitized,omitempty"`
		Author           *repo.ParticipantRef       `json:"author,omitempty"`
		Recipients       []string                   `json:"recipients,omitempty"`
		ReplyTo          *string                    `json:"replyTo,omitempty"`
		AgentProfile     *repo.AgentProfileSnapshot `json:"agentProfile,omitempty"`
		Evaluations      map[string]any             `json:"evaluations,omitempty"`
		Metadata         *repo.InteractionMetadata  `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
		Relations        []struct {
			Type     string `json:"type" firestore:"type"`
			TargetID string `json:"targetId" firestore:"targetId"`
		} `json:"relations,omitempty"`
		Language                 *string `json:"language,omitempty"`
		SystemInstructionApplied *string `json:"systemInstructionApplied,omitempty"`
		GenerationParams         *struct {
			Temperature      *float64 `json:"temperature,omitempty" firestore:"temperature,omitempty"`
			MaxOutputTokens  *int     `json:"maxOutputTokens,omitempty" firestore:"maxOutputTokens,omitempty"`
			GroundingEnabled *bool    `json:"groundingEnabled,omitempty" firestore:"groundingEnabled,omitempty"`
		} `json:"generationParams,omitempty"`
		HighRisk *struct {
			Level     string   `json:"level" firestore:"level"`
			Score     float64  `json:"score" firestore:"score"`
			Rationale *string  `json:"rationale,omitempty" firestore:"rationale,omitempty"`
			Triggers  []string `json:"triggers,omitempty" firestore:"triggers,omitempty"`
		} `json:"highRisk,omitempty"`
		DiscussionFacts *struct {
			Dependencies       *string `json:"dependencies,omitempty" firestore:"dependencies,omitempty"`
			Prerequisites      *string `json:"prerequisites,omitempty" firestore:"prerequisites,omitempty"`
			Participants       *string `json:"participants,omitempty" firestore:"participants,omitempty"`
			ParticipantRoles   *string `json:"participantRoles,omitempty" firestore:"participantRoles,omitempty"`
			AvailableResources *string `json:"availableResources,omitempty" firestore:"availableResources,omitempty"`
			PreviousAttempts   *string `json:"previousAttempts,omitempty" firestore:"previousAttempts,omitempty"`
			ResultFormat       *string `json:"resultFormat,omitempty" firestore:"resultFormat,omitempty"`
		} `json:"discussionFacts,omitempty"`
		OriginalMessageID *string  `json:"originalMessageId,omitempty"`
		CoreDocIDs        []string `json:"coreDocIds,omitempty"`
		SearchQueries     []string `json:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
		Sources           []string `json:"sources,omitempty"`
		// Sections (optional client-provided for future-proofing; server derives when missing)
		SectionID *string `json:"sectionId,omitempty"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse body")
		return
	}
	// normalize kind
	k := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(body.Kind))
	switch k {
	case "user", "assistant", "system", "note", "section_start", "section_end", "action":
	default:
		k = "note"
	}
	// validate content presence only for non-section kinds
	if k != "section_start" && k != "section_end" {
		if strings.TrimSpace(body.Content) == "" {
			WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "kind and content are required")
			return
		}
	}
	// Helper: compute currently open sectionId (last start not yet ended)
	resolveOpenSection := func(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
		items, err := h.interactionsRepo.ListByProject(ctx, projectID)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		current := ""
		for _, it := range items {
			if it == nil {
				continue
			}
			if strings.EqualFold(it.Kind, "section_start") {
				current = it.ID
			} else if strings.EqualFold(it.Kind, "section_end") {
				// end applies to explicit sectionId if present, else close current
				sid := ""
				if it.SectionID != nil {
					sid = strings.TrimSpace(*it.SectionID)
				}
				if sid == "" || sid == current {
					current = ""
				}
			}
		}
		return current, nil
	}

	// Special handling for sections
	if k == "section_start" {
		// Auto-close previous open section if exists
		if openID, err := resolveOpenSection(r.Context()); err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(openID) != "" {
			// Insert section_end referencing the open section
			_, _ = h.interactionsRepo.Create(r.Context(), &repo.Interaction{
				TenantID:  authInfo.TenantID,
				ProjectID: projectID,
				Kind:      "section_end",
				Content:   "",
				SectionID: &openID,
			})
		}
		// Create the new section_start (title in Content)
		startID, err := h.interactionsRepo.Create(r.Context(), &repo.Interaction{
			TenantID:  authInfo.TenantID,
			ProjectID: projectID,
			Kind:      "section_start",
			Content:   body.Content,
		})
		if err != nil {
			WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create interaction")
			return
		}
		// Update its sectionId to self for easier grouping
		_ = h.interactionsRepo.Update(r.Context(), startID, map[string]interface{}{"sectionId": startID})
		WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{"id": startID})
		return
	}
	if k == "section_end" {
		// Close current section if any
		openID, _ := resolveOpenSection(r.Context())
		if body.SectionID != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*body.SectionID) != "" {
			openID = strings.TrimSpace(*body.SectionID)
		}
		var sidPtr *string
		if strings.TrimSpace(openID) != "" {
			sid := openID
			sidPtr = &sid
		}
		endID, err := h.interactionsRepo.Create(r.Context(), &repo.Interaction{
			TenantID:  authInfo.TenantID,
			ProjectID: projectID,
			Kind:      "section_end",
			Content:   "",
			SectionID: sidPtr,
		})
		if err != nil {
			WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create interaction")
			return
		}
		WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{"id": endID})
		return
	}

	// For normal interactions, attach current sectionId if any
	var sectionPtr *string
	if strings.TrimSpace(k) != "section_start" && strings.TrimSpace(k) != "section_end" {
		// Prefer client-provided sectionId, else resolve
		if body.SectionID != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*body.SectionID) != "" {
			sid := strings.TrimSpace(*body.SectionID)
			sectionPtr = &sid
		} else if openID, err := resolveOpenSection(r.Context()); err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(openID) != "" {
			sid := openID
			sectionPtr = &sid
		}
	}

	id, err := h.interactionsRepo.Create(r.Context(), &repo.Interaction{
		TenantID:                 authInfo.TenantID,
		ProjectID:                projectID,
		Kind:                     k,
		Content:                  body.Content,
		Summary:                  body.Summary,
		Model:                    body.Model,
		Usage:                    body.Usage,
		Subkind:                  body.Subkind,
		ContentSanitized:         body.ContentSanitized,
		Author:                   body.Author,
		Recipients:               body.Recipients,
		ReplyTo:                  body.ReplyTo,
		AgentProfile:             body.AgentProfile,
		Evaluations:              body.Evaluations,
		Metadata:                 body.Metadata,
		Relations:                body.Relations,
		Language:                 body.Language,
		SystemInstructionApplied: body.SystemInstructionApplied,
		GenerationParams:         body.GenerationParams,
		HighRisk:                 body.HighRisk,
		DiscussionFacts:          body.DiscussionFacts,
		OriginalMessageID:        body.OriginalMessageID,
		CoreDocIDs:               body.CoreDocIDs,
		SearchQueries:            body.SearchQueries,
		Sources:                  body.Sources,
		SectionID:                sectionPtr,
	})
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create interaction")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, map[string]any{"id": id})
}

// DeleteProjectInteraction handles DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}/interactions/{interactionId}
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) DeleteProjectInteraction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodDelete {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only DELETE is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if h.interactionsRepo == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Interactions repo not configured")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 6 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project and Interaction IDs are required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	interactionID := parts[5]
	project, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	// optional: verify interaction belongs to project
	if it, err := h.interactionsRepo.Get(r.Context(), interactionID); err == nil {
		if it.ProjectID != projectID || it.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
			WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
			return
		}
	}
	if err := h.interactionsRepo.DeleteByID(r.Context(), interactionID); err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to delete interaction")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"success": true})
}

// UpdateProjectInteraction handles PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}/interactions/{interactionId}
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) UpdateProjectInteraction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPatch {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only PATCH is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if h.interactionsRepo == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Interactions repo not configured")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 6 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project and Interaction IDs are required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	interactionID := parts[5]
	project, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	// verify interaction belongs to project and tenant
	it, err := h.interactionsRepo.Get(r.Context(), interactionID)
	if err != nil || it == nil || it.ProjectID != projectID || it.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	var payload map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse body")
		return
	}
	if len(payload) == 0 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "No fields to update")
		return
	}
	// Whitelist fields allowed for update
	allowed := map[string]struct{}{
		"kind": {}, "subkind": {}, "content": {}, "contentSanitized": {}, "summary": {},
		"model": {}, "usage": {}, "author": {}, "recipients": {}, "replyTo": {},
		"agentProfile": {}, "evaluations": {}, "metadata": {}, "relations": {}, "language": {},
		"systemInstructionApplied": {}, "generationParams": {}, "highRisk": {},
		"originalMessageId": {}, "coreDocIds": {}, "searchQueries": {}, "sources": {},
	}
	updates := map[string]interface{}{}
	for k, v := range payload {
		if _, ok := allowed[k]; ok {
			updates[k] = v
		}
	}
	if len(updates) == 0 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "No updatable fields provided")
		return
	}
	if err := h.interactionsRepo.Update(r.Context(), interactionID, updates); err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to update interaction")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"success": true})
}

// ChatMessage handles POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/chat
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) ChatMessage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := pathParts[3]

	project, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Project not found")
		return
	}
	if project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	var body struct {
		Message  string  `json:"message"`
		Language *string `json:"language,omitempty"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse body")
		return
	}
	lang := "en"
	if body.Language != nil && *body.Language != "" {
		lang = *body.Language
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(body.Message) == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message is required")
		return
	}
	if h.orchestrator == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Chat is not configured")
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	answer, err := h.orchestrator.Chat(ctx, authInfo.TenantID, projectID, body.Message, lang)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to process chat message")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"answer": answer})
}

// generateCorrelationID generates a simple correlation ID
// In production, use UUID
func generateCorrelationID() string {
	// Simple implementation for now
	return fmt.Sprintf("disc_%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
}

// VertexAISearchRequest for POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/vertex-search
type VertexAISearchRequest struct {
	Query     string `json:"query"`
	PageSize  int    `json:"pageSize,omitempty"`
	PageToken string `json:"pageToken,omitempty"`
	Filter    string `json:"filter,omitempty"`
}

// VertexAISearch performs search using Vertex AI Search API
func (h *DiscoveryHandler) VertexAISearch(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	if _, err := h.projectsRepo.Get(r.Context(), projectID); err != nil {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Project not found")
		return
	}
	if h.vertexSearchClient == nil || !h.vertexSearchClient.IsConfigured() {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Vertex AI Search is not configured")
		return
	}
	var body VertexAISearchRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(body.Query) == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "query is required")
		return
	}
	if body.PageSize <= 0 {
		body.PageSize = 10
	}
	searchReq := &ai.SearchRequest{
		Query:    body.Query,
		PageSize: body.PageSize,
	}
	if body.PageToken != "" {
		searchReq.PageToken = body.PageToken
	}
	if body.Filter != "" {
		searchReq.Filter = body.Filter
	}
	searchResp, err := h.vertexSearchClient.Search(r.Context(), searchReq)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Vertex AI Search error: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Search failed")
		return
	}
	// Log search event if repository is available
	if h.searchRepo != nil {
		var docIDs []string
		for _, result := range searchResp.Results {
			if result.Document.ID != "" {
				docIDs = append(docIDs, result.Document.ID)
			}
		}
		_, _ = h.searchRepo.Create(r.Context(), &models.SearchEvent{
			TenantID:     auth.TenantID,
			ProjectID:    projectID,
			Query:        body.Query,
			ResultsDocIDs: docIDs,
		})
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, searchResp)
}

package http

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// parseByContentType extracts text and best-effort page count from raw bytes using content type.
// For pdf/docx we use external libraries via temp files to avoid complex reader plumbing.
func parseByContentType(contentType string, data []byte) (text string, pages *int, err error) {
	ct := strings.ToLower(contentType)
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(ct, "application/pdf"):
		t, p, e := parsePDFBytes(data)
		return t, p, e
	case strings.Contains(ct, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document") || strings.Contains(ct, "application/msword"):
		t, p, e := parseDOCXBytes(data)
		return t, p, e
	case strings.Contains(ct, "text/markdown"), strings.Contains(ct, "text/plain"), strings.HasPrefix(ct, "text/"):
		s := string(data)
		return s, nil, nil
	default:
		s := string(data)
		return s, nil, nil
	}
}

// parsePDFBytes uses ledongthuc/pdf to get plain text.
func parsePDFBytes(data []byte) (string, *int, error) {
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "sx-pdf-*.pdf")
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = os.Remove(tmp.Name()) }()
	if _, err = tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return "", nil, err
	}
	_ = tmp.Close()

	// ledongthuc/pdf API via Open(path)
	// import at compile time; noop here
	// actual implementation in separate helper to avoid unused import when tests stub
	return parsePDFFile(tmp.Name())
}

// parseDOCXBytes uses baliance/gooxml to extract text from docx.
func parseDOCXBytes(data []byte) (string, *int, error) {
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "sx-docx-*.docx")
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = os.Remove(tmp.Name()) }()
	if _, err = tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return "", nil, err
	}
	_ = tmp.Close()
	return parseDOCXFile(tmp.Name())
}

package http

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/csv"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

// parseCSVBytes parses CSV/TSV data, detects delimiter (unless forced by isTSV),
// builds readable text (TSV-like), returns ParseMeta and a normalized UTF-8 CSV copy.
// Normalized CSV uses comma delimiter, LF newlines, and RFC4180 quoting.
func parseCSVBytes(data []byte, isTSV bool) (text string, meta map[string]any, normalized []byte, err error) {
	cleaned := stripUTF8BOM(data)

	// Detect delimiter
	delim := ','
	delimName := ","
	if isTSV {
		delim = '\t'
		delimName = "\t"
	} else {
		if d, name := sniffDelimiter(cleaned); d != 0 {
			delim, delimName = d, name
		}
	}

	r := csv.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(cleaned))
	r.Comma = delim
	r.FieldsPerRecord = -1 // allow ragged rows
	r.LazyQuotes = true
	r.TrimLeadingSpace = false

	rows, err := r.ReadAll()
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, nil, err
	}

	// Determine columns and header
	colCount := 0
	for _, row := range rows {
		if len(row) > colCount {
			colCount = len(row)
		}
	}
	hasHeader := false
	var header []string
	if len(rows) > 0 {
		hasHeader = looksLikeHeader(rows[0], rows)
		if hasHeader {
			header = padRow(rows[0], colCount)
		} else {
			header = make([]string, colCount)
			for i := 0; i < colCount; i++ {
				header[i] = fmt.Sprintf("col_%d", i+1)
			}
		}
	}

	// Build normalized CSV (comma delimiter)
	var normBuf bytes.Buffer
	w := csv.NewWriter(&normBuf)
	w.Comma = ','
	// Write header then rows
	if colCount > 0 {
		if err := w.Write(header); err != nil {
			return "", nil, nil, err
		}
		start := 0
		if hasHeader {
			start = 1
		}
		for i := start; i < len(rows); i++ {
			if err := w.Write(padRow(rows[i], colCount)); err != nil {
				return "", nil, nil, err
			}
		}
	}
	w.Flush()
	if err := w.Error(); err != nil {
		return "", nil, nil, err
	}

	// Build human-readable TSV text (for ExtractedText)
	var textBuf strings.Builder
	if colCount > 0 {
		textBuf.WriteString(strings.Join(escapeTabs(header), "\t"))
		textBuf.WriteByte('\n')
		start := 0
		if hasHeader {
			start = 1
		}
		for i := start; i < len(rows); i++ {
			textBuf.WriteString(strings.Join(escapeTabs(padRow(rows[i], colCount)), "\t"))
			textBuf.WriteByte('\n')
		}
	}

	// Columns metadata (names + simple type hint)
	cols := make([]map[string]any, colCount)
	for i := 0; i < colCount; i++ {
		name := header[i]
		typ := inferColumnType(rows, hasHeader, i)
		cols[i] = map[string]any{"name": name, "type": typ}
	}

	// Preview: up to 50 rows as array of maps
	preview := make([]map[string]any, 0, minInt(50, maxInt(0, len(rows)-(btoi(hasHeader)))))
	limit := 50
	start := 0
	if hasHeader {
		start = 1
	}
	for i := start; i < len(rows) && len(preview) < limit; i++ {
		row := padRow(rows[i], colCount)
		item := make(map[string]any, colCount)
		for c := 0; c < colCount; c++ {
			item[header[c]] = row[c]
		}
		preview = append(preview, item)
	}

	meta = map[string]any{
		"dataKind":  "tabular",
		"delimiter": delimName,
		"hasHeader": hasHeader,
		"rowCount":  maxInt(0, len(rows)-(btoi(hasHeader))),
		"colCount":  colCount,
		"columns":   cols,
		"charset":   "utf-8",
		"preview":   preview,
	}

	return textBuf.String(), meta, normBuf.Bytes(), nil
}

func sniffDelimiter(data []byte) (rune, string) {
	// Look at first few lines up to 64KB and count occurrences of candidate delimiters
	sample := firstNLines(data, 8, 64*1024)
	candidates := []rune{',', ';', '\t'}
	counts := make(map[rune]int)
	firstLineSep := make(map[rune]int)
	firstLine := firstLineOf(sample)
	for _, c := range candidates {
		counts[c] = strings.Count(sample, string(c))
		firstLineSep[c] = strings.Count(firstLine, string(c))
	}
	// Prefer delimiter that appears in the first line with highest distinct column count
	type cand struct {
		r     rune
		first int
		total int
	}
	arr := make([]cand, 0, len(candidates))
	for _, c := range candidates {
		arr = append(arr, cand{r: c, first: firstLineSep[c], total: counts[c]})
	}
	sort.Slice(arr, func(i, j int) bool {
		if arr[i].first == arr[j].first {
			return arr[i].total > arr[j].total
		}
		return arr[i].first > arr[j].first
	})
	if len(arr) == 0 || (arr[0].first == 0 && arr[0].total == 0) {
		return ',', ","
	}
	top := arr[0].r
	switch top {
	case ',':
		return ',', ","
	case ';':
		return ';', ";"
	case '\t':
		return '\t', "\t"
	}
	return ',', ","
}

func looksLikeHeader(first []string, rows [][]string) bool {
	// Heuristic: header cells are mostly non-numeric and unique; compare to next non-empty row
	if len(rows) < 2 {
		return true
	}
	next := rows[1]
	// expand rows to same length for comparison
	n := len(first)
	if len(next) < n {
		n = len(next)
	}
	uniq := map[string]struct{}{}
	nonNumeric := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		v := strings.TrimSpace(first[i])
		if v == "" {
			continue
		}
		if !isMostlyNumeric(v) {
			nonNumeric++
		}
		uniq[v] = struct{}{}
	}
	// if most cells are non-numeric and unique, treat as header
	return nonNumeric >= n/2 && len(uniq) >= n/2
}

func isMostlyNumeric(s string) bool {
	// consider numeric if digits and separators constitute majority
	digits := 0
	for _, r := range s {
		if (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '+' || r == '-' || r == '.' || r == ',' || r == ' ' {
			digits++
		}
	}
	return digits*2 >= utf8.RuneCountInString(s)
}

func padRow(row []string, n int) []string {
	if len(row) >= n {
		return row
	}
	out := make([]string, n)
	copy(out, row)
	for i := len(row); i < n; i++ {
		out[i] = ""
	}
	return out
}

func escapeTabs(row []string) []string {
	out := make([]string, len(row))
	for i := range row {
		out[i] = strings.ReplaceAll(row[i], "\t", " ")
	}
	return out
}

func firstNLines(data []byte, lines int, max int) string {
	// return up to 'lines' lines as string, capped to 'max' bytes
	if max > 0 && len(data) > max {
		data = data[:max]
	}
	r := bytes.NewReader(data)
	var b strings.Builder
	readLines := 0
	buf := make([]byte, 1024)
	for {
		if readLines >= lines {
			break
		}
		n, err := r.Read(buf)
		if n > 0 {
			for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
				ch := buf[i]
				b.WriteByte(ch)
				if ch == '\n' {
					readLines++
					if readLines >= lines {
						break
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
	}
	return b.String()
}

func firstLineOf(s string) string {
	if idx := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); idx >= 0 {
		return s[:idx]
	}
	return s
}

func stripUTF8BOM(b []byte) []byte {
	if len(b) >= 3 && b[0] == 0xEF && b[1] == 0xBB && b[2] == 0xBF {
		return b[3:]
	}
	return b
}

func inferColumnType(rows [][]string, hasHeader bool, col int) string {
	// sample up to 100 rows
	start := 0
	if hasHeader {
		start = 1
	}
	end := start + 100
	if end > len(rows) {
		end = len(rows)
	}
	numeric := 0
	nonEmpty := 0
	for i := start; i < end; i++ {
		if col >= len(rows[i]) {
			continue
		}
		v := strings.TrimSpace(rows[i][col])
		if v == "" {
			continue
		}
		nonEmpty++
		if isMostlyNumeric(v) {
			numeric++
		}
	}
	if nonEmpty == 0 {
		return "string"
	}
	if numeric*2 >= nonEmpty {
		return "number"
	}
	return "string"
}

func btoi(b bool) int {
	if b {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func minInt(a, b int) int {
	if a < b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func maxInt(a, b int) int {
	if a > b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

package http

import (
	"strings"

	"baliance.com/gooxml/document"
)

func parseDOCXFile(path string) (string, *int, error) {
	doc, err := document.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, p := range doc.Paragraphs() {
		for _, r := range p.Runs() {
			b.WriteString(r.Text())
		}
		b.WriteString("\n")
	}
	return b.String(), nil, nil
}

package http

import (
	"io"

	pdf "github.com/ledongthuc/pdf"
)

func parsePDFFile(path string) (string, *int, error) {
	f, r, err := pdf.Open(path)
	if f != nil {
		defer f.Close()
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	var total int
	if r != nil {
		total = r.NumPage()
	}
	reader, err := r.GetPlainText()
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	buf, err := io.ReadAll(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, err
	}
	var pages *int
	if total > 0 {
		pages = &total
	}
	return string(buf), pages, nil
}

package http

type GenAIHandler struct {
	client           *gen_combined.Client
	publisher        Publisher
	usageMetricsRepo *repo.UsageMetricsRepository
	modelManager     *ai.AIModelManager
}

// Publisher is a small interface for realtime publisher used here
type Publisher interface {
	PublishJSON(ctx context.Context, et interface{}, tenantID string, payload interface{}) error
}

func NewGenAIHandler() *GenAIHandler {
	apiKey := os.Getenv("VERTEX_API_KEY")
	projectID := os.Getenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID")
	if projectID == "" {
		projectID = os.Getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
	}
	location := os.Getenv("VERTEX_LOCATION")
	if location == "" {
		location = "us-central1"
	}
	fast := os.Getenv("GENAI_FAST_MODEL")
	quality := os.Getenv("GENAI_QUALITY_MODEL")
	gem := gen_gemini.NewClient(apiKey, projectID, location, fast, quality)
	oaiKey := os.Getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
	comb := gen_combined.NewClient(gem, oaiKey)
	return &GenAIHandler{client: comb}
}

// WithUsageMetrics wires usage metrics repository
func (h *GenAIHandler) WithUsageMetrics(repo *repo.UsageMetricsRepository) *GenAIHandler {
	h.usageMetricsRepo = repo
	return h
}

// WithModelManager wires AI model manager for cost calculation
func (h *GenAIHandler) WithModelManager(mm *ai.AIModelManager) *GenAIHandler {
	h.modelManager = mm
	return h
}

// GenerateDirect performs direct GenAI generation without HTTP layer (for internal use)
func (h *GenAIHandler) GenerateDirect(ctx context.Context, req gen_combined.GenAIRequest) (*gen_combined.GenAIResponse, error) {
	return h.client.GenAIGenerate(ctx, req)
}

// GenAIGenerate: unified generation endpoint
func (h *GenAIHandler) GenAIGenerate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		_ = WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Method not allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	var req gen_combined.GenAIRequest
	bodyBytes, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	r.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewBuffer(bodyBytes)) // Restore the body for decoding
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		log.Printf("GenAIGenerate: INVALID_JSON. Body: %s, Error: %v", string(bodyBytes), err)
		_ = WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid JSON body")
		return
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(req.Model) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(req.Prompt) == "" {
		log.Printf("GenAIGenerate: INVALID_PARAMS. Model: '%s', Prompt: '%s'", req.Model, req.Prompt)
		_ = WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PARAMS", "model and prompt are required")
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 240*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	started := time.Now()
	resp, err := h.client.GenAIGenerate(ctx, req)
	if err != nil {
		// Log upstream error body for diagnostics (e.g., Gemini 400 with details)
		log.Printf("GenAIGenerate upstream error: %v", err)
		status, code, msg, details := parseUpstreamError(err)
		_ = WriteError(w, status, code, msg, details)
		return
	}
	// Emit telemetry (best-effort)
	go func() {
		if auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context()); auth != nil {
			_ = persistGenAITelemetry(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
				"kind":      "genAI_telemetry",
				"mode":      "single",
				"model":     resp.Model,
				"ts":        time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
				"elapsedMs": time.Since(started).Milliseconds(),
				"usage":     resp.Usage,
				"params": map[string]any{
					"temperature":        req.Temperature,
					"maxOutputTokens":    req.MaxOutputTokens,
					"webSearchEnabled":   req.WebSearchEnabled,
					"toolCallingEnabled": req.ToolCallingEnabled,
					"strictJSONEnabled":  req.StrictJSONEnabled,
				},
			})

			// Save usage metrics asynchronously with a new context
			if h.usageMetricsRepo != nil && h.modelManager != nil {
				go func() {
					metricCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
					defer cancel()
					durationMs := int(time.Since(started).Milliseconds())
					_ = h.saveUsageMetric(metricCtx, auth, req, *resp, nil, nil, &durationMs)
				}()
			}
		}
	}()
	_ = WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

type genaiCompleteRequest struct {
	Prompt     string                 `json:"prompt"`
	Tools      []gen_gemini.Tool      `json:"tools"`
	Options    gen_gemini.Options     `json:"options"`
	JSONSchema map[string]interface{} `json:"jsonSchema,omitempty"`
	Messages   []struct {
		Role string `json:"role"`
		Text string `json:"text"`
	} `json:"messages,omitempty"`
	// Streaming context
	ProjectID string `json:"projectId,omitempty"`
	StreamID  string `json:"streamId,omitempty"`
}

func (h *GenAIHandler) Complete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		_ = WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Method not allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	var req genaiCompleteRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		_ = WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid JSON body")
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 120*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	started := time.Now()
	resp, err := h.client.Generate(ctx, req.Prompt, req.Tools, req.Options)
	if err != nil {
		status, code, msg, details := parseUpstreamError(err)
		_ = WriteError(w, status, code, msg, details)
		return
	}
	// Save usage metrics
	go func() {
		if auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context()); auth != nil && h.usageMetricsRepo != nil && h.modelManager != nil {
			genaiResp := gen_combined.GenAIResponse(*resp)
			genaiReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{Model: req.Options.ModelOverride}
			var projID *string
			if req.ProjectID != "" {
				projID = &req.ProjectID
			}
			metricCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			durationMs := int(time.Since(started).Milliseconds())
			_ = h.saveUsageMetric(metricCtx, auth, genaiReq, genaiResp, projID, nil, &durationMs)
		}
	}()
	_ = WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

// CompleteWithTools executes tool loop using a simple registry.

		_ = WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid JSON body")

		status, code, msg, details := parseUpstreamError(err)

}

// AdhocJSON: temporary endpoint for FE to test arbitrary prompts with model selection and grounding, returning JSON
func (h *GenAIHandler) AdhocJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		_ = WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Method not allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	var req genaiCompleteRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		_ = WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid JSON body")
		return
	}
	req.Options.ResponseFormat = "json"
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 120*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	started := time.Now()
	resp, err := h.client.GenerateJSON(ctx, req.Prompt, nil, nil, req.Options)
	if err != nil {
		_ = WriteError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "GENAI_ERROR", err.Error(), nil)
		return
	}
	// Save usage metrics
	go func() {
		if auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context()); auth != nil && h.usageMetricsRepo != nil && h.modelManager != nil {
			genaiResp := gen_combined.GenAIResponse(*resp)
			genaiReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{Model: req.Options.ModelOverride}
			var projID *string
			if req.ProjectID != "" {
				projID = &req.ProjectID
			}
			metricCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			durationMs := int(time.Since(started).Milliseconds())
			_ = h.saveUsageMetric(metricCtx, auth, genaiReq, genaiResp, projID, nil, &durationMs)
		}
	}()
	var parsed interface{}
	valid := true
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(resp.Content), &parsed); err != nil {
		valid = false
	}
	_ = WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"ok":        true,
		"model":     resp.Model,
		"usage":     resp.Usage,
		"validJson": valid,
		"json":      parsed,
		"raw":       resp.Content,
	})
}

// WithPublisher allows wiring realtime Publisher for streaming events
func (h *GenAIHandler) WithPublisher(p *realtime.Publisher) *GenAIHandler {
	if p != nil {
		h.publisher = rtPublisherAdapter{p: p}
	}
	return h
}

// rtPublisherAdapter adapts realtime.Publisher to local Publisher interface
type rtPublisherAdapter struct{ p *realtime.Publisher }

func (a rtPublisherAdapter) PublishJSON(ctx context.Context, et interface{}, tenantID string, payload interface{}) error {
	var eventType realtime.EventType
	switch v := et.(type) {
	case string:
		eventType = realtime.EventType(v)
	case realtime.EventType:
		eventType = v
	default:
		// This should not happen. Log an error and return.
		log.Printf("rtPublisherAdapter: unexpected event type %T", et)
		return nil
	}
	return a.p.PublishJSON(ctx, eventType, tenantID, payload)
}

// Stream publishes incremental events to Pub/Sub for the tenant; front receives via WS
func (h *GenAIHandler) Stream(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		_ = WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Method not allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil || auth.TenantID == "" {
		_ = WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	if h.publisher == nil {
		_ = WriteInternalError(w, "Realtime publisher is not configured")
		return
	}
	var req genaiCompleteRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		_ = WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid JSON body")
		return
	}

	// Determine routing context
	projectID := strings.TrimSpace(req.ProjectID)
	streamID := strings.TrimSpace(req.StreamID)
	// Diagnostics: log model override and key options to verify routing
	log.Printf("genai.stream: options modelOverride=%q grounding=%v temp=%.2f maxTok=%d", strings.TrimSpace(req.Options.ModelOverride), req.Options.GroundingEnabled, req.Options.Temperature, req.Options.MaxOutputTokens)
	if streamID == "" {
		streamID = uuid.NewString()
	}

	// DEBUG: log planned stream start with routing context before publishing
	log.Printf("genai.stream: preparing start tenantId=%s projectId=%s streamId=%s", auth.TenantID, projectID, streamID)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 180*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	started := time.Now()
	_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "genai.stream.start", auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
		"ts":        time.Now().UnixMilli(),
		"projectId": projectID,
		"streamId":  streamID,
	})
	// Optionally enrich system instruction with provided messages (conversation context)
	if len(req.Messages) > 0 {
		// Build compact transcript using provided summaries/texts
		ctxLines := make([]string, 0, len(req.Messages))
		for _, m := range req.Messages {
			role := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m.Role))
			if role == "" {
				role = "user"
			}
			text := strings.TrimSpace(m.Text)
			if text == "" {
				continue
			}
			// keep line shortish (best-effort)
			ctxLines = append(ctxLines, "- "+role+": "+text)
		}
		if len(ctxLines) > 0 {
			pre := "You are given the full chat context below. Respond ONLY to the latest user message, taking the prior context into account. Do not restate or summarize the transcript itself."
			ctx := "\nConversation context (most recent last):\n" + strings.Join(ctxLines, "\n")
			if strings.TrimSpace(req.Options.SystemInstruction) == "" {
				req.Options.SystemInstruction = pre + ctx
			} else {
				req.Options.SystemInstruction = strings.TrimSpace(req.Options.SystemInstruction) + "\n\n" + pre + ctx
			}
		}
	}

	// Track per-stream chunk count for diagnostics
	chunks := 0
	onEvt := func(e gen_gemini.StreamEvent) error {
		switch e.Type {
		case "chunk":
			// increment local chunk counter
			chunks++
			return h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "genai.stream.chunk", auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
				"projectId": projectID,
				"streamId":  streamID,
				"text":      e.Text,
			})
		case "tool_call":
			return h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "genai.stream.tool_call", auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
				"projectId": projectID,
				"streamId":  streamID,
				"toolCalls": e.ToolCalls,
			})
		case "tool_result":
			return h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "genai.stream.tool_result", auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
				"projectId": projectID,
				"streamId":  streamID,
				"toolCalls": e.ToolCalls,
			})
		case "error":
			return h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "genai.stream.error", auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
				"projectId": projectID,
				"streamId":  streamID,
				"error":     e.Error,
			})
		case "done":
			// include usage/attributions/searchQueries/sources if accumulated
			payload := map[string]any{
				"ts":        time.Now().UnixMilli(),
				"projectId": projectID,
				"streamId":  streamID,
			}
			// Diagnostics: log grounded counts for visibility
			log.Printf("genai.stream: grounded counts queries=%d sources=%d", len(e.SearchQueries), len(e.Sources))
			// Always include usage, even if zero (for tracking purposes)
			// Log usage for debugging (especially for counterpoint agents)
			log.Printf("genai.stream: usage model=%s promptTokens=%d outputTokens=%d totalTokens=%d", e.Model, e.Usage.PromptTokens, e.Usage.OutputTokens, e.Usage.TotalTokens)
			payload["usage"] = e.Usage
			if len(e.Attributions) > 0 {
				payload["attributions"] = e.Attributions
			}
			if len(e.SearchQueries) > 0 {
				payload["searchQueries"] = e.SearchQueries
			}
			if len(e.Sources) > 0 {
				payload["sources"] = e.Sources
			}
			// Best-effort fallback: if Gemini with grounding requested returned no sources, do a quick grounded pass to fetch sources
			if (len(e.Sources) == 0) && req.Options.GroundingEnabled {
				mo := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.Options.ModelOverride))
				if strings.HasPrefix(mo, "gemini_") {
					go func(prompt string, model string) {
						defer func() { recover() }()
						gopts := gen_gemini.Options{ModelOverride: model, GroundingEnabled: true, MaxOutputTokens: 64}
						if gr, gerr := h.client.Generate(ctx, prompt, nil, gopts); gerr == nil {
							if len(gr.Sources) > 0 {
								// Publish an extra meta event with discovered sources
								_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "genai.stream.done", auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
									"ts":        time.Now().UnixMilli(),
									"projectId": projectID,
									"streamId":  streamID,
									"sources":   gr.Sources,
								})
							}
						}
					}(req.Prompt, req.Options.ModelOverride)
				}
			}
			// Log per-stream diagnostics: chunks and latency
			log.Printf("genai.stream: completed tenantId=%s projectId=%s streamId=%s chunks=%d elapsedMs=%d", auth.TenantID, projectID, streamID, chunks, time.Since(started).Milliseconds())
			// Fire telemetry (best-effort)
			go func() {
				_ = persistGenAITelemetry(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
					"kind":      "genAI_telemetry",
					"mode":      "stream",
					"model":     e.Model,
					"ts":        time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
					"elapsedMs": time.Since(started).Milliseconds(),
					"usage":     e.Usage,
					"params": map[string]any{
						"temperature":      req.Options.Temperature,
						"maxOutputTokens":  req.Options.MaxOutputTokens,
						"webSearchEnabled": req.Options.GroundingEnabled,
					},
				})

				// Save usage metrics asynchronously with a new context
				// Always save metrics, even if usage is zero (for tracking purposes)
				if h.usageMetricsRepo != nil && h.modelManager != nil {
					// Convert StreamEvent Usage to GenerateResponse format
					genaiResp := gen_combined.GenAIResponse(gen_gemini.GenerateResponse{
						Model: e.Model,
						Usage: e.Usage,
					})
					genaiReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{
						Model: req.Options.ModelOverride,
					}
					var projID *string
					if projectID != "" {
						projID = &projectID
					}
					go func() {
						metricCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
						defer cancel()
						durationMs := int(time.Since(started).Milliseconds())
						if err := h.saveUsageMetric(metricCtx, auth, genaiReq, genaiResp, projID, nil, &durationMs); err != nil {
							log.Printf("[GenAI Stream] Failed to save usage metric: %v (model=%s, promptTokens=%d, outputTokens=%d)", err, e.Model, e.Usage.PromptTokens, e.Usage.OutputTokens)
						} else {
							log.Printf("[GenAI Stream] Saved usage metric (model=%s, promptTokens=%d, outputTokens=%d, totalTokens=%d)", e.Model, e.Usage.PromptTokens, e.Usage.OutputTokens, e.Usage.TotalTokens)
						}
					}()
				} else {
					log.Printf("[GenAI Stream] Usage metrics not saved: repo=%v manager=%v", h.usageMetricsRepo != nil, h.modelManager != nil)
				}
			}()
			if err := h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "genai.stream.done", auth.TenantID, payload); err != nil {
				log.Printf("[GenAI Stream] Failed to publish genai.stream.done event: %v (projectId=%s streamId=%s)", err, projectID, streamID)
			} else {
				log.Printf("[GenAI Stream] Published genai.stream.done event (projectId=%s streamId=%s)", projectID, streamID)
			}
			return nil
		case "start":
			return nil
		default:
			return nil
		}
	}
	var err error
	if len(req.Tools) > 0 {
		reg := gen_gemini.NewSimpleRegistry()
		err = h.client.StreamWithTools(ctx, req.Prompt, req.Tools, reg, req.Options, onEvt)
	} else {
		err = h.client.Stream(ctx, req.Prompt, req.Tools, req.Options, onEvt)
	}
	if err != nil {
		status, code, msg, details := parseUpstreamError(err)
		_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "genai.stream.error", auth.TenantID, map[string]any{
			"projectId": projectID,
			"streamId":  streamID,
			"error":     msg,
		})
		_ = WriteError(w, status, code, msg, details)
		return
	}
	_ = WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}

// parseUpstreamError extracts provider/status/body from error string
func parseUpstreamError(err error) (int, string, string, interface{}) {
	if err == nil {
		return http.StatusBadGateway, "GENAI_ERROR", "Upstream error", nil
	}
	s := err.Error()
	re := regexp.MustCompile(`^(openai|gemini)[^\d]*(\d{3}):\s*([\s\S]+)$`)
	if m := re.FindStringSubmatch(s); len(m) == 4 {
		prov := m[1]
		codeStr := m[2]
		body := strings.TrimSpace(m[3])
		status, _ := strconv.Atoi(codeStr)
		if status < 400 || status > 599 {
			status = http.StatusBadGateway
		}
		code := strings.ToUpper(prov) + "_UPSTREAM_ERROR"
		details := map[string]any{"provider": prov, "raw": body}
		return status, code, s, details
	}
	return http.StatusBadGateway, "GENAI_ERROR", s, map[string]any{"raw": s}
}

// saveUsageMetric saves a usage metric record
// durationMs is optional (can be nil if timing not available)
func (h *GenAIHandler) saveUsageMetric(ctx context.Context, auth *AuthInfo, req gen_combined.GenAIRequest, resp gen_combined.GenAIResponse, projectID *string, interactionID *string, durationMs *int) error {
	if h.usageMetricsRepo == nil || h.modelManager == nil {
		return nil
	}

	// Determine provider from model name
	provider := h.determineProvider(resp.Model)

	// Calculate cost using modelManager (which handles tiered pricing for Gemini)
	cost, err := h.modelManager.CalculateProcessingCost(resp.Model, resp.Usage.PromptTokens, resp.Usage.OutputTokens)
	if err != nil {
		// If model not found in manager, fallback to simple calculation
		log.Printf("[saveUsageMetric] Model %s not found in modelManager, using fallback pricing", resp.Model)
		cost = h.calculateFallbackCost(provider, resp.Model, resp.Usage.PromptTokens, resp.Usage.OutputTokens)
	}

	// Determine model alias if available
	modelAlias := &req.Model
	if req.Model == "" {
		modelAlias = nil
	}

	metric := &repo.UsageMetric{
		TenantID:      auth.TenantID,
		UserID:        auth.UID,
		ProjectID:     projectID,
		InteractionID: interactionID,
		Provider:      provider,
		Model:         resp.Model,
		ModelAlias:    modelAlias,
		InputTokens:   resp.Usage.PromptTokens,
		OutputTokens:  resp.Usage.OutputTokens,
		TotalTokens:   resp.Usage.TotalTokens,
		CostUSD:       cost,
		DurationMs:    durationMs,
		TaskType:      nil,        // Can be set from context if needed
		Kind:          "included", // Default to included, can be changed based on plan
	}

	_, err = h.usageMetricsRepo.Create(ctx, metric)
	return err
}

// calculateFallbackCost calculates cost when model is not in modelManager
// Uses approximate pricing based on provider
func (h *GenAIHandler) calculateFallbackCost(provider, modelName string, inputTokens, outputTokens int) float64 {
	modelLower := strings.ToLower(modelName)

	switch provider {
	case "gemini":
		// Gemini tiered pricing: first 128K at one rate, after at 50% discount
		// Prices match model_manager.go (max prices for first tier)
		const threshold = 128000
		var inputPriceTier1, inputPriceTier2, outputPriceTier1, outputPriceTier2 float64

		// Check more specific models first (flash-lite before flash)
		if strings.Contains(modelLower, "flash-lite") {
			inputPriceTier1 = 0.00000010   // $0.10 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
			inputPriceTier2 = 0.00000005   // $0.05 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
			outputPriceTier1 = 0.00000041  // $0.41 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
			outputPriceTier2 = 0.000000205 // $0.205 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
		} else if strings.Contains(modelLower, "pro") {
			inputPriceTier1 = 0.00000250  // $2.50 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
			inputPriceTier2 = 0.00000125  // $1.25 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
			outputPriceTier1 = 0.00001500 // $15.00 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
			outputPriceTier2 = 0.00000750 // $7.50 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
		} else { // flash (default)
			inputPriceTier1 = 0.00000030  // $0.30 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
			inputPriceTier2 = 0.00000015  // $0.15 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
			outputPriceTier1 = 0.00000250 // $2.50 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
			outputPriceTier2 = 0.00000125 // $1.25 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
		}

		var inputCost float64
		if inputTokens <= threshold {
			inputCost = float64(inputTokens) * inputPriceTier1
		} else {
			inputCost = float64(threshold)*inputPriceTier1 + float64(inputTokens-threshold)*inputPriceTier2
		}

		var outputCost float64
		if outputTokens <= threshold {
			outputCost = float64(outputTokens) * outputPriceTier1
		} else {
			outputCost = float64(threshold)*outputPriceTier1 + float64(outputTokens-threshold)*outputPriceTier2
		}

		return inputCost + outputCost
	case "openai":
		// OpenAI pricing - check specific models first
		var inputPrice, outputPrice float64
		switch {
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "gpt-5-nano"):
			inputPrice = 0.00000005  // $0.05 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000040 // $0.40 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "gpt-5-mini"):
			inputPrice = 0.00000025  // $0.25 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000200 // $2.00 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "gpt-5"):
			inputPrice = 0.00000100  // $1.00 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000800 // $8.00 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "gpt-4.1-mini"):
			inputPrice = 0.0000004  // $0.40 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.0000016 // $1.60 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "gpt-4o-mini"):
			inputPrice = 0.00000060  // $0.60 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000240 // $2.40 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "gpt-4o-search"):
			inputPrice = 0.0000050  // $5 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.0000200 // $20 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "gpt-4"):
			// Generic GPT-4 models (fallback for older models)
			inputPrice = 0.00003  // $30 / 1M (approximate)
			outputPrice = 0.00006 // $60 / 1M (approximate)
		default:
			// Default to gpt-5-nano pricing for unknown OpenAI models
			inputPrice = 0.00000005
			outputPrice = 0.00000040
		}
		return float64(inputTokens)*inputPrice + float64(outputTokens)*outputPrice
	case "anthropic":
		// Anthropic Claude pricing - check specific models first
		var inputPrice, outputPrice float64
		switch {
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "claude-opus"):
			inputPrice = 0.000015  // $15 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.000075 // $75 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "claude-haiku"):
			inputPrice = 0.00000025  // $0.25 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000125 // $1.25 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "claude-sonnet") || strings.Contains(modelLower, "claude"):
			// Default Claude Sonnet pricing
			inputPrice = 0.000003  // $3 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.000015 // $15 / 1M
		default:
			// Fallback to Sonnet pricing
			inputPrice = 0.000003
			outputPrice = 0.000015
		}
		return float64(inputTokens)*inputPrice + float64(outputTokens)*outputPrice
	case "grok":
		// Grok pricing - check specific models first
		var inputPrice, outputPrice float64
		switch {
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "grok-3-mini"):
			inputPrice = 0.00000030  // $0.30 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000050 // $0.50 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "grok-4-fast-non-reasoning"):
			inputPrice = 0.00000020  // $0.20 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000050 // $0.50 / 1M
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "grok-4-fast-reasoning"):
			inputPrice = 0.00000020  // $0.20 / 1M (<128K), $0.40 / 1M (>=128K) - using base price
			outputPrice = 0.00000050 // $0.50 / 1M (<128K), $1.00 / 1M (>=128K) - using base price
		case strings.Contains(modelLower, "grok-4") || strings.Contains(modelLower, "grok-3"):
			// Grok 4 and Grok 3 (premium models)
			inputPrice = 0.000003  // $3 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.000015 // $15 / 1M
		default:
			// Default to fast model pricing
			inputPrice = 0.00000020
			outputPrice = 0.00000050
		}
		return float64(inputTokens)*inputPrice + float64(outputTokens)*outputPrice
	case "deepseek":
		// DeepSeek pricing - use chat/reasoner pricing
		var inputPrice, outputPrice float64
		if strings.Contains(modelLower, "reasoner") {
			// Reasoner models might have different pricing, use chat pricing for now
			inputPrice = 0.00000027  // $0.27 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000110 // $1.10 / 1M
		} else {
			// Default DeepSeek Chat pricing
			inputPrice = 0.00000027  // $0.27 / 1M
			outputPrice = 0.00000110 // $1.10 / 1M
		}
		return float64(inputTokens)*inputPrice + float64(outputTokens)*outputPrice
	default:
		// Very rough estimate: $1 per 1M tokens
		return float64(inputTokens+outputTokens) * 0.000001
	}
}

// determineProvider determines provider from model name
func (h *GenAIHandler) determineProvider(modelName string) string {
	modelLower := strings.ToLower(modelName)
	if strings.HasPrefix(modelLower, "gpt-") || strings.HasPrefix(modelLower, "o1-") || strings.HasPrefix(modelLower, "o3-") {
		return "openai"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(modelLower, "claude-") {
		return "anthropic"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(modelLower, "grok-") {
		return "grok"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(modelLower, "deepseek-") {
		return "deepseek"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(modelLower, "gemini-") {
		return "gemini"
	}
	return "unknown"
}

// persistGenAITelemetry stores a single telemetry record into core_telemetry collection
func persistGenAITelemetry(ctx context.Context, tenantID string, data map[string]any) error {
	if tenantID == "" {
		return nil
	}
	// Best-effort new client per call; for higher perf wire a shared client via handler state
	projectID := os.Getenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID")
	if projectID == "" {
		projectID = os.Getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
	}
	if projectID == "" {
		return nil
	}
	c, err := firestore.NewClient(ctx, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	defer c.Close()
	data["tenantId"] = tenantID
	data["createdAt"] = time.Now().UTC()
	_, _, _ = c.Collection("core_telemetry").Add(ctx, data)
	return nil
}
