package http

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/ai"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// MetaHandler handles meta-analysis endpoints
type MetaHandler struct {
	projects     *repo.ProjectsRepository
	interactions *repo.InteractionsRepository
	eventsRepo   *repo.MetaAnalysesRepository
	aggProj      *repo.MetaAggregateProjectsRepository
	aggUser      *repo.MetaAggregateUsersRepository
	exec         *ai.AITaskExecutor
	logger       *log.Logger
}

func NewMetaHandler(projects *repo.ProjectsRepository, interactions *repo.InteractionsRepository, events *repo.MetaAnalysesRepository, aggProj *repo.MetaAggregateProjectsRepository, aggUser *repo.MetaAggregateUsersRepository, exec *ai.AITaskExecutor, logger *log.Logger) *MetaHandler {
	return &MetaHandler{projects: projects, interactions: interactions, eventsRepo: events, aggProj: aggProj, aggUser: aggUser, exec: exec, logger: logger}
}

// Analyze request/response
type AnalyzeInteractionRef struct {
	RefID  *string        `json:"refId,omitempty"`
	Inline *InlineMessage `json:"inline,omitempty"`
	// Sentinel compatibility: id=="0" means inline
	ID   *string `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Role *string `json:"role,omitempty"`
	Text *string `json:"text,omitempty"`
	Ts   *string `json:"timestamp,omitempty"`
}

type InlineMessage struct {
	Role      string  `json:"role"`
	Text      string  `json:"text"`
	Timestamp *string `json:"timestamp,omitempty"`
}

type AnalyzeRequest struct {
	Analyzers    []string                `json:"analyzers"`
	Interactions []AnalyzeInteractionRef `json:"interactions"`
	// Optional: previous aggregate to enable incremental update mode
	PreviousAggregate map[string]any `json:"previousAggregate,omitempty"`
}

type AnalyzeResult struct {
	Analyzer string         `json:"analyzer"`
	Result   map[string]any `json:"result"`
}

type AnalyzeResponse struct {
	Results         []AnalyzeResult `json:"results"`
	WhoLeads        string          `json:"whoLeads"`
	LeadershipIndex float64         `json:"leadershipIndex"`
	FocusRetention  float64         `json:"focusRetention"`
	StructureScore  float64         `json:"structureScore"`
	Version         string          `json:"version"`
	EventID         string          `json:"eventId"`
}

// POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/meta:analyze
func (h *MetaHandler) Analyze(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 { // /api/v1/projects/{id}/meta:analyze
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	project, err := h.projects.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project == nil || project.TenantID != auth.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	var req AnalyzeRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}
	if len(req.Analyzers) == 0 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "analyzers is required")
		return
	}
	msgs, err := h.resolveWindow(r.Context(), projectID, req.Interactions)
	if err != nil {
		if h.logger != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("meta: resolveWindow error: %v (project=%s, analyzers=%v)", err, projectID, req.Analyzers)
		}
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_INTERACTIONS", err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Build analysis window:
	// If PreviousAggregate provided, switch to incremental mode:
	// - include PREVIOUS_AGGREGATE JSON block
	// - include only the last user/assistant pair as NEW_EXCHANGE
	var window string
	if req.PreviousAggregate != nil {
		// Serialize previous aggregate to JSON
		b, _ := json.Marshal(req.PreviousAggregate)
		// Take last 2 messages if available
		pair := msgs
		if len(msgs) >= 2 {
			pair = msgs[len(msgs)-2:]
		}
		var pb strings.Builder
		pb.WriteString("PREVIOUS_AGGREGATE:\n")
		pb.Write(b)
		pb.WriteString("\n\nNEW_EXCHANGE:\n")
		for _, m := range pair {
			// Preserve role prefixes for analyzers
			pb.WriteString(strings.ToUpper(m.Role))
			pb.WriteString(": ")
			pb.WriteString(m.Text)
			pb.WriteString("\n\n")
		}
		window = pb.String()
	} else {
		// Full recompute mode: include provided window as-is
		window = buildWindowText(msgs)
	}

	// Log window size for monitoring
	if h.logger != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("meta: analyze request (messageCount=%d, windowChars=%d, windowTokensEst=%d)",
			len(msgs), len(window), len(window)/4)
		if len(window) > 100000 {
			h.logger.Printf("WARNING: meta: large window detected (>100KB). Consider limiting message count.")
		}
	}

	// 1) Dialog control classification (common)
	who, leadIdx, focus, structure, err := h.classifyDialogControl(r.Context(), window, auth.TenantID, auth.UID, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		if h.logger != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("meta: classify dialog error: %v (windowChars=%d)", err, len(window))
		}
		WriteInternalError(w, fmt.Sprintf("Dialog control classification failed: %v", err))
		return
	}

	// 2) Run requested analyzers
	results := make([]AnalyzeResult, 0, len(req.Analyzers))
	for _, a := range req.Analyzers {
		resMap, runErr := h.runAnalyzer(r.Context(), a, window, auth.TenantID, auth.UID, projectID)
		if runErr != nil {
			if h.logger != nil {
				// Common place to catch JSON decode/validation mismatches
				h.logger.Printf("meta: analyzer %s failed: %v (windowChars=%d)", a, runErr, len(window))
			}
			WriteInternalError(w, fmt.Sprintf("Analyzer %s failed: %v", a, runErr))
			return
		}
		results = append(results, AnalyzeResult{Analyzer: a, Result: resMap})
	}

	// 3) Persist event
	evt := &models.MetaAnalysisEvent{
		TenantID:   auth.TenantID,
		ProjectID:  projectID,
		UserID:     auth.UID,
		Analyzer:   models.MetaAnalyzer("batch"),
		Version:    "coach.v1",
		Model:      "auto",
		TokensUsed: len(window) / 4,
		Window:     models.MetaWindow{Mode: "ad-hoc", MessageCount: len(msgs)},
		Common:     models.MetaCommon{WhoLeads: who, LeadershipIndex: leadIdx, FocusRetention: focus, StructureScore: structure},
		Result:     map[string]any{"results": results},
		CreatedAt:  time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	id, err := h.eventsRepo.Create(r.Context(), evt)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to persist meta analysis event")
		return
	}

	// 4) Update aggregates
	_ = h.updateProjectAggregate(r.Context(), project, evt)
	_ = h.updateUserAggregate(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, auth.UID, evt)

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, AnalyzeResponse{
		Results:         results,
		WhoLeads:        who,
		LeadershipIndex: leadIdx,
		FocusRetention:  focus,
		StructureScore:  structure,
		Version:         "coach.v1",
		EventID:         id,
	})
}

// resolveWindow merges refId and inline messages
func (h *MetaHandler) resolveWindow(ctx context.Context, projectID string, items []AnalyzeInteractionRef) ([]InlineMessage, error) {
	var out []InlineMessage
	for _, it := range items {
		if it.RefID != nil && *it.RefID != "" {
			inter, err := h.interactions.Get(ctx, *it.RefID)
			if err != nil || inter == nil || inter.ProjectID != projectID {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid refId: %s", *it.RefID)
			}
			role := "assistant"
			if inter.Author != nil {
				switch strings.ToLower(inter.Author.Kind) {
				case "human":
					role = "user"
				case "system":
					role = "system"
				case "tool":
					role = "tool"
				}
			}
			out = append(out, InlineMessage{Role: role, Text: inter.Content})
			continue
		}
		if it.Inline != nil {
			out = append(out, *it.Inline)
			continue
		}
		// Sentinel: id=="0" treated as inline
		if it.ID != nil && *it.ID == "0" && it.Role != nil && it.Text != nil {
			out = append(out, InlineMessage{Role: *it.Role, Text: *it.Text, Timestamp: it.Ts})
			continue
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid interaction element: must provide refId or inline")
	}
	return out, nil
}

func buildWindowText(msgs []InlineMessage) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, m := range msgs {
		b.WriteString(strings.ToUpper(m.Role))
		b.WriteString(": ")
		b.WriteString(m.Text)
		b.WriteString("\n\n")
	}
	return b.String()
}

// Dialog control classification using structured LLM
type dialogControlJSON struct {
	WhoLeads        string  `json:"whoLeads"`
	LeadershipIndex float64 `json:"leadershipIndex"`
	FocusRetention  float64 `json:"focusRetention"`
	StructureScore  float64 `json:"structureScore"`
}

func (h *MetaHandler) classifyDialogControl(_ context.Context, window, tenantID, userID, projectID string) (string, float64, float64, float64, error) {
	// Create a context with timeout for AI task execution
	taskCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 120*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	schema := `{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"whoLeads":{"type":"string","enum":["User","AI","Mixed"]},"leadershipIndex":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},"focusRetention":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},"structureScore":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}},"required":["whoLeads","leadershipIndex","focusRetention","structureScore"]}`
	prompt := fmt.Sprintf("Analyze USER behavior and dialog dynamics. Return ONLY JSON strictly matching the schema.\nIf a PREVIOUS_AGGREGATE block is present, you MUST update the previous values based ONLY on the NEW_EXCHANGE; otherwise compute from scratch using USER lines (ASSISTANT lines are context only).\n\nSchema:%s\n\nWINDOW:\n%s", schema, window)
	task := &ai.AITask{
		TaskType:       ai.TaskTypeTextProcessing,
		InputContent:   prompt,
		AIRequirements: ai.AIRequirements{MinContextWindow: intMax(4096, len(prompt)/4), TextGenerationCapability: true, MinCapabilityScore: 6},
		Verifier:       ai.NewGenericVerifier(func(dc dialogControlJSON) error { return nil }),
		TenantID:       tenantID,
		UserID:         userID,
		Project:        projectID,
	}
	if h.logger != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("meta: classifyDialogControl starting (windowChars=%d, promptChars=%d, tokensEst=%d)",
			len(window), len(prompt), len(prompt)/4)
	}
	res, err := h.exec.ExecuteStructuredTask(taskCtx, task)
	if err != nil {
		if h.logger != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("ERROR: meta: classifyDialogControl failed: %v", err)
		}
		return "", 0, 0, 0, err
	}
	dc := res.(dialogControlJSON)
	return dc.WhoLeads, dc.LeadershipIndex, dc.FocusRetention, dc.StructureScore, nil
}

func (h *MetaHandler) runAnalyzer(ctx context.Context, analyzer string, window, tenantID, userID, projectID string) (map[string]any, error) {
	switch analyzer {
	case string(models.MetaAnalyzerThinking):
		return h.runThinking(ctx, window, tenantID, userID, projectID)
	case string(models.MetaAnalyzerBiases):
		return h.runBiases(ctx, window, tenantID, userID, projectID)
	case string(models.MetaAnalyzerDecisions):
		return h.runDecisions(ctx, window, tenantID, userID, projectID)
	case string(models.MetaAnalyzerComm):
		return h.runComm(ctx, window, tenantID, userID, projectID)
	case string(models.MetaAnalyzerLearning):
		return h.runLearning(ctx, window, tenantID, userID, projectID)
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown analyzer: %s", analyzer)
	}
}

func (h *MetaHandler) runThinking(_ context.Context, window, tenantID, userID, projectID string) (map[string]any, error) {
	// Enum dictionaries
	depth := []string{"Surface", "Analytical", "Systemic"}
	uncertainty := []string{"Avoids", "Acknowledges", "WorksWithIt"}
	horizon := []string{"Reactive", "Tactical", "Strategic"}
	ttype := []string{"Convergent", "Divergent", "Integrative"}
	schema := map[string]any{
		"type":                 "object",
		"additionalProperties": false,
		"properties": map[string]any{
			"depth":        map[string]any{"type": "object", "properties": map[string]any{"label": map[string]any{"type": "string", "enum": depth}, "intensity": map[string]any{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1}, "confidence": map[string]any{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1}}, "required": []string{"label", "intensity"}},
			"timeHorizon":  map[string]any{"type": "array", "items": map[string]any{"type": "object", "properties": map[string]any{"label": map[string]any{"type": "string", "enum": horizon}, "intensity": map[string]any{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1}}, "required": []string{"label", "intensity"}}},
			"uncertainty":  map[string]any{"type": "object", "properties": map[string]any{"label": map[string]any{"type": "string", "enum": uncertainty}, "intensity": map[string]any{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1}}, "required": []string{"label", "intensity"}},
			"thinkingType": map[string]any{"type": "array", "items": map[string]any{"type": "object", "properties": map[string]any{"label": map[string]any{"type": "string", "enum": ttype}, "intensity": map[string]any{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1}}, "required": []string{"label", "intensity"}}},
		},
		"required": []string{"depth", "timeHorizon", "uncertainty", "thinkingType"},
	}
	schemaJSON, _ := json.Marshal(schema)
	prompt := fmt.Sprintf("Analyze USER thinking patterns. Return ONLY JSON strictly matching the schema.\nIf a PREVIOUS_AGGREGATE block is present, update the previous assessment based ONLY on the NEW_EXCHANGE; otherwise compute from scratch using USER lines (ASSISTANT lines are context only).\n\nSchema:%s\n\nWINDOW:\n%s", string(schemaJSON), window)
	verifier := ai.NewGenericVerifier(func(v models.ThinkingPatternsResult) error { return nil })
	task := &ai.AITask{
		TaskType:       ai.TaskTypeTextProcessing,
		InputContent:   prompt,
		AIRequirements: ai.AIRequirements{MinContextWindow: len(prompt) / 4, TextGenerationCapability: true, MinCapabilityScore: 6},
		Verifier:       verifier,
		TenantID:       tenantID,
		UserID:         userID,
		Project:        projectID,
	}

	// Create a context with timeout for AI task execution
	taskCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 120*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if h.logger != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("meta: runThinking starting (windowChars=%d, promptChars=%d, tokensEst=%d)",
			len(window), len(prompt), len(prompt)/4)
	}
	res, err := h.exec.ExecuteStructuredTask(taskCtx, task)
	if err != nil {
		if h.logger != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("ERROR: meta: runThinking failed: %v", err)
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return toMap(res)
}

func enumScoreSchema(options []string) map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": map[string]any{
			"label":      map[string]any{"type": "string", "enum": options},
			"intensity":  map[string]any{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1},
			"confidence": map[string]any{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1},
			"rationale":  map[string]any{"type": "string"},
			"evidence":   map[string]any{"type": "array", "items": map[string]any{"type": "string"}},
		},
		"required": []string{"label", "intensity"},
	}
}

func toMap(v interface{}) (map[string]any, error) {
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var m map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &m); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return m, nil
}

func intMax(a, b int) int {
	if a > b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func (h *MetaHandler) updateProjectAggregate(ctx context.Context, p *models.Project, evt *models.MetaAnalysisEvent) error {
	a, _ := h.aggProj.Get(ctx, p.ID)
	if a == nil {
		a = &models.MetaAggregateProject{ID: p.ID, TenantID: p.TenantID, ProjectID: p.ID, OwnerUserID: p.OwnerUserID, Version: "coach.v1", Samples: 0}
	}
	// Incremental average
	n := float64(a.Samples)
	a.Samples++
	a.LeadershipIndex = (a.LeadershipIndex*n + evt.Common.LeadershipIndex) / float64(a.Samples)
	a.FocusRetention = (a.FocusRetention*n + evt.Common.FocusRetention) / float64(a.Samples)
	a.StructureScore = (a.StructureScore*n + evt.Common.StructureScore) / float64(a.Samples)
	a.WhoLeads = evt.Common.WhoLeads
	a.Effectiveness = 0.5*a.LeadershipIndex + 0.25*a.FocusRetention + 0.25*a.StructureScore
	a.LastResults = evt.Result
	a.LastAnalyzedMessageCount = evt.Window.MessageCount
	a.LastAnalyzedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	a.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	return h.aggProj.Upsert(ctx, a)
}

func (h *MetaHandler) updateUserAggregate(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, evt *models.MetaAnalysisEvent) error {
	u, _ := h.aggUser.Get(ctx, tenantID, userID)
	if u == nil {
		u = &models.MetaAggregateUser{TenantID: tenantID, UserID: userID, Version: "coach.v1", Samples: 0}
	}
	n := float64(u.Samples)
	u.Samples++
	u.LeadershipIndex = (u.LeadershipIndex*n + evt.Common.LeadershipIndex) / float64(u.Samples)
	u.FocusRetention = (u.FocusRetention*n + evt.Common.FocusRetention) / float64(u.Samples)
	u.StructureScore = (u.StructureScore*n + evt.Common.StructureScore) / float64(u.Samples)
	u.Effectiveness = 0.5*u.LeadershipIndex + 0.25*u.FocusRetention + 0.25*u.StructureScore
	return h.aggUser.Upsert(ctx, u)
}

// List events: GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/meta/events
func (h *MetaHandler) ListEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 6 { // /api/v1/projects/{id}/meta/events
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	project, err := h.projects.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project == nil || project.TenantID != auth.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	events, err := h.eventsRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), projectID, 100)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to list meta events")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, events)
}

// Get aggregate: GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/meta/aggregate
func (h *MetaHandler) GetAggregate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 6 { // /api/v1/projects/{id}/meta/aggregate
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := parts[3]
	project, err := h.projects.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project == nil || project.TenantID != auth.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	agg, err := h.aggProj.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || agg == nil {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Aggregate not found")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, agg)
}

// PayPalHandler handles PayPal-related HTTP requests

	paypalClient        *paypal.Client

// NewPayPalHandler creates a new PayPalHandler

	paypalClient *paypal.Client,
	subscriptionService *services.SubscriptionService,
	subsRepo *repo.SubscriptionsRepository,
	logger *log.Logger,
) *PayPalHandler {

// CreateSubscriptionRequest represents request to create PayPal subscription
type CreateSubscriptionRequest struct {
	Tier string `json:"tier"` // "pro" or "max"
}

// CreateSubscription handles POST /api/v1/paypal/subscription
// Creates a PayPal subscription plan and subscription for the user
func (h *PayPalHandler) CreateSubscription(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateSubscriptionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}

	tier := models.SubscriptionTier(strings.ToLower(req.Tier))
	if tier != models.SubscriptionTierPro && tier != models.SubscriptionTierMax {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_TIER", "Tier must be 'pro' or 'max'")
		return
	}

	// Define pricing (USD)
	currency := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_CURRENCY")
	if currency == "" {
		currency = "USD" // Default
	}

	var price string
	switch tier {
	case models.SubscriptionTierPro:
		price = "29.00"
	case models.SubscriptionTierMax:
		price = "99.00"
	}

	// Get or create product ID (should be done once, stored in env/config)
	productID := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_PRODUCT_ID")
	if productID == "" {
		// For now, use a default product ID - in production, create product separately
		productID = "PROD_" + strings.ToUpper(string(tier))
	}

	// Create subscription plan
	plan, err := h.paypalClient.CreateSubscriptionPlan(r.Context(), string(tier), price, currency, productID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to create PayPal plan: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create subscription plan")
		return
	}

	// Create subscription with return/cancel URLs
	returnURL := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_RETURN_URL")
	cancelURL := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_CANCEL_URL")
	if returnURL == "" {
		returnURL = "https://hatl.one/subscription/success"
	}
	if cancelURL == "" {
		cancelURL = "https://hatl.one/subscription/cancel"
	}

	subscription, err := h.paypalClient.CreateSubscription(r.Context(), plan.ID, returnURL, cancelURL)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to create PayPal subscription: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create subscription")
		return
	}

	// Find approval URL in links
	var approvalURL string
	for _, link := range subscription.Links {
		if link.Rel == "approve" {
			approvalURL = link.Href
			break
		}
	}

	if approvalURL == "" {
		h.logger.Printf("No approval URL found in subscription links")
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to get approval URL")
		return
	}

	// Return approval URL to frontend
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]interface{}{
		"approvalUrl":    approvalURL,
		"subscriptionId": subscription.ID,
		"planId":         plan.ID,
	})
}

// ExecuteSubscriptionRequest represents request to execute PayPal subscription
type ExecuteSubscriptionRequest struct {
	SubscriptionID string `json:"subscriptionId"`
}

// ExecuteSubscription handles POST /api/v1/paypal/subscription/execute
// Confirms subscription after user approval (subscription is auto-activated by PayPal)
func (h *PayPalHandler) ExecuteSubscription(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req ExecuteSubscriptionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}

	// Get subscription details from PayPal
	subscription, err := h.paypalClient.GetSubscription(r.Context(), req.SubscriptionID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get PayPal subscription: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to get subscription details")
		return
	}

	// Get plan details to determine tier
	plan, err := h.paypalClient.GetClient().GetSubscriptionPlan(r.Context(), subscription.PlanID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get PayPal plan: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to get plan details")
		return
	}

	// Determine tier from plan name or description
	var tier models.SubscriptionTier
	planName := strings.ToLower(plan.Name)
	planDesc := strings.ToLower(plan.Description)
	if strings.Contains(planName, "pro") || strings.Contains(planDesc, "pro") {
		tier = models.SubscriptionTierPro
	} else if strings.Contains(planName, "max") || strings.Contains(planDesc, "max") {
		tier = models.SubscriptionTierMax
	} else {
		h.logger.Printf("Unknown plan tier: %s (name: %s)", planDesc, planName)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Unknown subscription tier")
		return
	}

	// Create or update subscription in our system
	provider := "paypal"
	sub, err := h.subscriptionService.GetOrCreateSubscription(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, authInfo.UID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get/create subscription: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create subscription")
		return
	}

	// Update subscription with PayPal info
	sub.Tier = tier
	sub.Status = "active"
	sub.PaymentProvider = &provider
	sub.PayPalPlanID = &plan.ID
	sub.PayPalSubscriptionID = &subscription.ID
	sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd = false // Reset cancellation flag when resuming

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	sub.CurrentPeriodStart = now
	sub.CurrentPeriodEnd = now.AddDate(0, 1, 0) // 1 month
	nextBilling := now.AddDate(0, 1, 0)
	sub.NextBillingDate = &nextBilling
	sub.UpdatedAt = now

	if err := h.subsRepo.Upsert(r.Context(), sub); err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to update subscription: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to save subscription")
		return
	}

	h.logger.Printf("User %s subscribed to %s tier via PayPal (subscription: %s)", authInfo.UID, tier, subscription.ID)

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, sub)
}

// CancelSubscription handles POST /api/v1/paypal/subscription/cancel
// Cancels subscription at the end of current billing period
func (h *PayPalHandler) CancelSubscription(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Get current subscription
	sub, err := h.subscriptionService.GetOrCreateSubscription(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, authInfo.UID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get subscription: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to get subscription")
		return
	}

	// Can only cancel paid subscriptions
	if sub.Tier == models.SubscriptionTierFree {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_TIER", "Cannot cancel free subscription")
		return
	}

	// If PayPal subscription exists, cancel it in PayPal
	if sub.PayPalSubscriptionID != nil && *sub.PayPalSubscriptionID != "" {
		// Cancel subscription in PayPal (at period end, not immediately)
		// PayPal subscriptions are cancelled at period end by default when we call CancelSubscription
		if err := h.paypalClient.CancelSubscription(r.Context(), *sub.PayPalSubscriptionID, "User requested cancellation"); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Failed to cancel PayPal subscription %s: %v", *sub.PayPalSubscriptionID, err)
			// Continue anyway - we'll mark it for cancellation in our system
		} else {
			h.logger.Printf("Cancelled PayPal subscription %s", *sub.PayPalSubscriptionID)
		}
	}

	// Mark subscription for cancellation at period end
	cancelledSub, err := h.subscriptionService.CancelSubscriptionAtPeriodEnd(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, authInfo.UID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to cancel subscription: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to cancel subscription")
		return
	}

	h.logger.Printf("User %s cancelled subscription (will expire at %s)", authInfo.UID, cancelledSub.CurrentPeriodEnd.Format(time.RFC3339))

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, cancelledSub)
}

// Webhook handles POST /api/v1/paypal/webhook
// Processes PayPal webhook events
func (h *PayPalHandler) Webhook(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	webhookID := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID")
	if webhookID == "" {
		h.logger.Printf("PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID not set, skipping verification")
	} else {
		// Collect headers for verification
		headers := make(map[string]string)
		for k, v := range r.Header {
			if len(v) > 0 {
				headers[k] = v[0]
			}
		}

		// Read body
		body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		if err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Failed to read webhook body: %v", err)
			WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_BODY", "Failed to read request body")
			return
		}

		// Verify webhook signature
		if err := h.paypalClient.VerifyWebhookSignature(r.Context(), webhookID, headers, body); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Webhook verification failed: %v", err)
			WriteUnauthorized(w, "Invalid webhook signature")
			return
		}

		// Parse webhook event
		var event struct {
			ID           string          `json:"id"`
			EventType    string          `json:"event_type"`
			ResourceType string          `json:"resource_type"`
			Resource     json.RawMessage `json:"resource"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &event); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Failed to parse webhook event: %v", err)
			WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse webhook event")
			return
		}

		h.logger.Printf("Received PayPal webhook: %s (type: %s)", event.ID, event.EventType)

		// Process webhook event
		if err := h.processWebhookEvent(r.Context(), event.EventType, event.Resource); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Failed to process webhook event: %v", err)
			WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to process webhook")
			return
		}
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
}

func (h *PayPalHandler) processWebhookEvent(ctx context.Context, eventType string, resource json.RawMessage) error {
	switch eventType {
	case "PAYMENT.SALE.COMPLETED", "BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.PAYMENT.SUCCEEDED":
		// Payment completed - subscription renewed
		var sale struct {
			BillingAgreementID string `json:"billing_agreement_id"`
			SubscriptionID     string `json:"subscription_id"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(resource, &sale); err == nil {
			subscriptionID := sale.SubscriptionID
			if subscriptionID == "" {
				subscriptionID = sale.BillingAgreementID
			}
			if subscriptionID != "" {
				return h.handlePaymentCompleted(ctx, subscriptionID)
			}
		}

	case "BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.CANCELLED", "BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.EXPIRED":
		// Subscription cancelled or expired
		var subscription struct {
			ID string `json:"id"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(resource, &subscription); err == nil && subscription.ID != "" {
			return h.handleSubscriptionCancelled(ctx, subscription.ID)
		}

	case "BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.REACTIVATED":
		// Subscription reactivated (user resumed cancelled subscription)
		var subscription struct {
			ID string `json:"id"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(resource, &subscription); err == nil && subscription.ID != "" {
			return h.handleSubscriptionReactivated(ctx, subscription.ID)
		}

	case "BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.PAYMENT.FAILED":
		// Payment failed - mark subscription as past_due
		var subscription struct {
			ID string `json:"id"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(resource, &subscription); err == nil && subscription.ID != "" {
			return h.handlePaymentFailed(ctx, subscription.ID)
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func (h *PayPalHandler) handlePaymentCompleted(ctx context.Context, subscriptionID string) error {
	// Find subscription by PayPal subscription ID
	subs, err := h.subsRepo.ListByPayPalSubscriptionID(ctx, subscriptionID)
	if err != nil || len(subs) == 0 {
		h.logger.Printf("Subscription not found for PayPal subscription %s", subscriptionID)
		return nil // Not an error - subscription might not exist yet
	}

	sub := subs[0]
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	sub.Status = "active"
	sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd = false // Reset cancellation flag on successful payment (subscription resumed)
	sub.CurrentPeriodStart = now
	sub.CurrentPeriodEnd = now.AddDate(0, 1, 0)
	nextBilling := now.AddDate(0, 1, 0)
	sub.NextBillingDate = &nextBilling
	sub.UpdatedAt = now

	return h.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub)
}

func (h *PayPalHandler) handleSubscriptionCancelled(ctx context.Context, subscriptionID string) error {
	subs, err := h.subsRepo.ListByPayPalSubscriptionID(ctx, subscriptionID)
	if err != nil || len(subs) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	sub := subs[0]
	sub.Status = "cancelled"
	sub.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

	return h.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub)
}

func (h *PayPalHandler) handlePaymentFailed(ctx context.Context, subscriptionID string) error {
	subs, err := h.subsRepo.ListByPayPalSubscriptionID(ctx, subscriptionID)
	if err != nil || len(subs) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	sub := subs[0]
	sub.Status = "past_due"
	sub.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

	return h.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub)
}

func (h *PayPalHandler) handleSubscriptionReactivated(ctx context.Context, subscriptionID string) error {
	subs, err := h.subsRepo.ListByPayPalSubscriptionID(ctx, subscriptionID)
	if err != nil || len(subs) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	sub := subs[0]
	// Resume subscription - reset cancellation flag
	sub.Status = "active"
	sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd = false
	sub.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

	// Also update via subscription service to ensure consistency
	if _, err := h.subscriptionService.ResumeSubscription(ctx, sub.TenantID, sub.UserID); err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to resume subscription via service: %v", err)
		// Continue with direct update
	}

	return h.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub)
}

// CreateProjectRequest represents the request body for creating a project
type CreateProjectRequest struct {
	DisplayName string  `json:"displayName"`
	Description *string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	View        *string `json:"view,omitempty"` // "discovery", "workspace", etc.
}

// CreateProject handles POST /api/v1/projects
func (h *ProjectsHandler) CreateProject(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateProjectRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}

	if req.DisplayName == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "displayName is required")
		return
	}

	// Create project
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	status := "active"

	project := &models.Project{
		TenantID:    authInfo.TenantID,
		Pk:          authInfo.TenantID,
		DisplayName: req.DisplayName,
		Description: req.Description,
		Status:      status,
		View:        req.View,
		OwnerUserID: authInfo.UID,
		CreatedAt:   now,
		UpdatedAt:   now,
	}

	// Save to Firestore
	projectID, err := h.repo.Create(r.Context(), project)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to create project: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create project")
		return
	}

	project.ID = projectID
	h.logger.Printf("Successfully created project %s for user %s", projectID, authInfo.UID)

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, project)
}

// DeleteProject handles DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}
func (h *ProjectsHandler) DeleteProject(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodDelete {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only DELETE is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Extract projectId from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := pathParts[3]

	// Fetch project to check ownership
	project, err := h.repo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Project not found: %s", projectID)
		WriteNotFound(w, "Project not found")
		return
	}

	// Check access
	if project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Delete project
	if err := h.repo.Delete(r.Context(), projectID); err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to delete project %s: %v", projectID, err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to delete project")
		return
	}

	// Cascade for datasources: delete primary, unlink related
	if h.dataSources != nil {
		if err := h.dataSources.DeleteByProject(r.Context(), projectID); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Warning: cascade delete for project %s encountered errors: %v", projectID, err)
		}
	}

	// Cascade: delete source profiles for sources tied to this project
	if h.profiles != nil && h.dataSources != nil {
		if err := h.profiles.DeleteByProject(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, projectID, h.dataSources); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Warning: cascade delete profiles for project %s: %v", projectID, err)
		}
	}

	// Cascade: delete interactions for this project
	if h.interactions != nil {
		if err := h.interactions.DeleteByProject(r.Context(), projectID); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Warning: cascade delete interactions for project %s: %v", projectID, err)
		}
	}
	// Cascade: delete documents and chunks for sources tied to this project
	if h.docsRepo != nil && h.dataSources != nil {
		sources, err := h.dataSources.ListByProject(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, projectID)
		if err == nil {
			for _, source := range sources {
				// List documents first to delete chunks
				docs, _ := h.docsRepo.ListBySource(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, source.ID, 0)
				// Delete chunks for each document
				if h.chunksRepo != nil {
					for _, doc := range docs {
						_ = h.chunksRepo.DeleteByDoc(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, doc.ID)
					}
				}
				// Delete all documents for this source (which will also delete from GCS)
				if err := h.docsRepo.DeleteBySource(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, source.ID); err != nil {
					h.logger.Printf("Warning: cascade delete documents for source %s: %v", source.ID, err)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	// Cascade: delete meta analysis events and project aggregates, recompute user aggregate
	if h.metaEvents != nil {
		if err := h.metaEvents.DeleteByProject(r.Context(), projectID); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Warning: cascade delete meta events for project %s: %v", projectID, err)
		}
	}
	if h.metaAggProj != nil {
		if err := h.metaAggProj.Delete(r.Context(), projectID); err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Warning: delete meta aggregate project %s: %v", projectID, err)
		}
	}
	// Best-effort: recompute user aggregate by scanning remaining events
	if h.metaAggUser != nil && h.metaEvents != nil {
		go func(tenantID, userID string) {
			ctx := context.Background()
			events, err := h.metaEvents.ListByUser(ctx, tenantID, userID, 500)
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			if len(events) == 0 {
				_ = h.metaAggUser.Delete(ctx, tenantID, userID)
				return
			}
			var s int
			var lead, focus, structure float64
			for _, e := range events {
				s++
				lead += e.Common.LeadershipIndex
				focus += e.Common.FocusRetention
				structure += e.Common.StructureScore
			}
			if s == 0 {
				return
			}
			ua := &models.MetaAggregateUser{
				TenantID:        tenantID,
				UserID:          userID,
				Version:         "coach.v1",
				Samples:         s,
				LeadershipIndex: lead / float64(s),
				FocusRetention:  focus / float64(s),
				StructureScore:  structure / float64(s),
			}
			ua.Effectiveness = 0.5*ua.LeadershipIndex + 0.25*ua.FocusRetention + 0.25*ua.StructureScore
			_ = h.metaAggUser.Upsert(ctx, ua)
		}(project.TenantID, project.OwnerUserID)
	}
	// Cascade: delete core docs for this project (best-effort)
	if h.coreDocs != nil {
		if docs, err := h.coreDocs.ListByProject(r.Context(), authInfo.TenantID, projectID, 0); err == nil {
			for _, d := range docs {
				_, _ = h.coreDocs.Delete(r.Context(), d.ID)
			}
		}
	}

	h.logger.Printf("Successfully deleted project %s", projectID)
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]interface{}{
		"success": true,
		"message": "Project deleted successfully",
	})
}

// CreateCoreDocRequest is minimal metadata; upload flow handled separately (Storage signed URL or multipart in future)

	Filename    string                 `json:"filename"`
	ContentType string                 `json:"contentType"`
	Description *string                `json:"description,omitempty"`
	SizeBytes   *int64                 `json:"sizeBytes,omitempty"`
	StoragePath *string                `json:"storagePath,omitempty"`
	External    *models.ExternalDocRef `json:"external,omitempty"`
}

// CreateProjectDoc handles POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/docs
func (h *ProjectsHandler) CreateProjectDoc(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	if h.coreDocs == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Core docs repository is not configured")
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	// Extract projectId from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 5 { // /api/v1/projects/{id}/docs
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := pathParts[3]

	// Validate project ownership
	project, err := h.repo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project == nil || project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	var req CreateCoreDocRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}
	if req.Filename == "" || req.ContentType == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "filename and contentType are required")
		return
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	doc := &models.CoreDoc{
		TenantID:    authInfo.TenantID,
		ProjectID:   projectID,
		Filename:    req.Filename,
		ContentType: req.ContentType,
		Description: req.Description,
		SizeBytes:   req.SizeBytes,
		StoragePath: req.StoragePath,
		External:    req.External,
		CreatedBy:   &authInfo.UID,
		CreatedAt:   now,
		UpdatedAt:   now,
	}
	id, err := h.coreDocs.Create(r.Context(), doc)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("CreateProjectDoc error: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create document")
		return
	}
	doc.ID = id
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, doc)
}

// CreateProjectDocFromText handles POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/docs/from-text
// Allows creating a CoreDoc directly from provided text content (e.g., LLM export),
// without a separate upload step.
func (h *ProjectsHandler) CreateProjectDocFromText(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	if h.coreDocs == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Core docs repository is not configured")
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	// Extract projectId from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 6 { // /api/v1/projects/{id}/docs/from-text
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project ID is required")
		return
	}
	projectID := pathParts[3]
	// Validate project ownership
	project, err := h.repo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project == nil || project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	var req struct {
		Filename    string  `json:"filename"`
		ContentType string  `json:"contentType"`
		Description *string `json:"description,omitempty"`
		Text        string  `json:"text"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}
	if req.Filename == "" || req.ContentType == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "filename and contentType are required")
		return
	}

	// Persist the text payload optionally to storage, to enable downloads
	var storagePath *string
	if h.storage != nil && h.bucket != "" {
		objectPath := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%d-%s", authInfo.TenantID, projectID, time.Now().UnixNano(), sanitizeFilename(req.Filename))
		if err := h.storage.UploadBytes(r.Context(), h.bucket, objectPath, []byte(req.Text), req.ContentType, map[string]string{
			"tenantId":  authInfo.TenantID,
			"projectId": projectID,
			"filename":  req.Filename,
		}); err == nil {
			p := fmt.Sprintf("gs://%s/%s", h.bucket, objectPath)
			storagePath = &p
		}
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	size := int64(len([]byte(req.Text)))
	status := "parsed"
	doc := &models.CoreDoc{
		TenantID:      authInfo.TenantID,
		ProjectID:     projectID,
		Filename:      req.Filename,
		ContentType:   req.ContentType,
		Description:   req.Description,
		SizeBytes:     &size,
		StoragePath:   storagePath,
		ExtractedText: &req.Text,
		ParseStatus:   &status,
		ParseMeta:     map[string]any{"createdFrom": "from-text", "updatedAt": now.Format(time.RFC3339)},
		CreatedBy:     &authInfo.UID,
		CreatedAt:     now,
		UpdatedAt:     now,
	}
	id, err := h.coreDocs.Create(r.Context(), doc)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create document")
		return
	}
	doc.ID = id
	if h.pub != nil {
		// Notify UI about new document
		_ = h.pub.PublishJSON(r.Context(), realtime.EventDocProcess, authInfo.TenantID, map[string]any{
			"projectId": projectID,
			"docId":     doc.ID,
			"status":    "uploaded",
			"ts":        time.Now().UnixMilli(),
		})
		_ = h.pub.PublishJSON(r.Context(), realtime.EventDocProcess, authInfo.TenantID, map[string]any{
			"projectId": projectID,
			"docId":     doc.ID,
			"status":    "parsed",
			"chars":     len(req.Text),
			"ts":        time.Now().UnixMilli(),
		})
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, doc)
}

// UpdateProjectDoc handles PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}/docs/{docId}
// Allows renaming and updating description of a CoreDoc.
func (h *ProjectsHandler) UpdateProjectDoc(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPatch {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only PATCH is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	if h.coreDocs == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Core docs repository is not configured")
		return
	}
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(parts) < 7 { // /api/v1/projects/{id}/docs/{docId}
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Project and document ID are required")
		return
	}
	projectID, docID := parts[3], parts[5]
	// Access check via project
	project, err := h.repo.Get(r.Context(), projectID)
	if err != nil || project == nil || project.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Access denied")
		return
	}
	cd, err := h.coreDocs.Get(r.Context(), docID)
	if err != nil || cd == nil || cd.ProjectID != projectID || cd.TenantID != authInfo.TenantID {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Document not found")
		return
	}
	var patch struct {
		Filename    *string `json:"filename,omitempty"`
		Description *string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&patch); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}
	if patch.Filename != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*patch.Filename) != "" {
		cd.Filename = *patch.Filename
	}
	if patch.Description != nil {
		cd.Description = patch.Description
	}
	cd.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	if err := h.coreDocs.Upsert(r.Context(), cd); err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to update document")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, cd)
}
