package http

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// UsageHandler handles usage metrics requests
type UsageHandler struct {
	repo   *repo.UsageMetricsRepository
	logger *log.Logger
}

// NewUsageHandler creates a new UsageHandler
func NewUsageHandler(repo *repo.UsageMetricsRepository, logger *log.Logger) *UsageHandler {
	return &UsageHandler{
		repo:   repo,
		logger: logger,
	}
}

// GetUsage handles GET /api/v1/usage
func (h *UsageHandler) GetUsage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Parse query parameters
	q := r.URL.Query()
	startDate := q.Get("startDate")
	endDate := q.Get("endDate")
	_ = q.Get("granularity") // "1d", "7d", "30d" - reserved for future use

	// Default to last 7 days
	if startDate == "" || endDate == "" {
		endTime := time.Now().UTC()
		startTime := endTime.AddDate(0, 0, -7)
		startDate = startTime.Format("2006-01-02")
		endDate = endTime.Format("2006-01-02")
	}

	startTime, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", startDate)
	if err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_DATE", "Invalid startDate format (use YYYY-MM-DD)")
		return
	}
	endTime, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", endDate)
	if err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_DATE", "Invalid endDate format (use YYYY-MM-DD)")
		return
	}
	endTime = endTime.Add(24 * time.Hour).Add(-1 * time.Second) // End of day

	// Check if events are requested (for backward compatibility)
	includeEvents := q.Get("includeEvents") == "true"

	// Get all aggregates in a single pass (loads metrics once, computes all aggregations)
	aggregates, err := h.repo.GetAllAggregates(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, auth.UID, startTime, endTime)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get usage aggregates: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to retrieve usage metrics")
		return
	}

	h.logger.Printf("[GetUsage] Aggregates: byModel=%d entries, dailyTotals=%d entries, totals.count=%d", len(aggregates.ByModel), len(aggregates.DailyTotals), aggregates.Totals.Count)

	// Format response
	response := map[string]interface{}{
		"byModel":         aggregates.ByModel,
		"dailyTotals":     aggregates.DailyTotals,
		"tokenCategories": aggregates.TokenCategories,
		"totals":          aggregates.Totals,
		"period": map[string]string{
			"startDate": startDate,
			"endDate":   endDate,
		},
	}

	// Only include events if explicitly requested (for backward compatibility)
	if includeEvents {
		metrics, _, err := h.repo.ListByUser(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, auth.UID, startTime, endTime, 0, 0)
		if err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("Failed to list usage metrics: %v", err)
			// Don't fail the request, just omit events
		} else {
			response["events"] = metrics
		}
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, response)
}

// GetEvents handles GET /api/v1/usage/events
// Query params: startDate, endDate, page (default 1), limit (default 200, minimum 200)
// Returns paginated events with total count for efficient grouping
func (h *UsageHandler) GetEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Parse query parameters
	q := r.URL.Query()
	startDate := q.Get("startDate")
	endDate := q.Get("endDate")
	pageStr := q.Get("page")
	limitStr := q.Get("limit")

	// Parse dates (required)
	if startDate == "" || endDate == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "MISSING_PARAMS", "startDate and endDate are required")
		return
	}

	startTime, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", startDate)
	if err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_DATE", "Invalid startDate format (use YYYY-MM-DD)")
		return
	}
	endTime, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", endDate)
	if err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_DATE", "Invalid endDate format (use YYYY-MM-DD)")
		return
	}
	endTime = endTime.Add(24 * time.Hour).Add(-1 * time.Second) // End of day

	// Parse pagination parameters
	page := 1
	if pageStr != "" {
		page, err = strconv.Atoi(pageStr)
		if err != nil || page < 1 {
			WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PARAM", "page must be a positive integer")
			return
		}
	}

	limit := 200 // Default and minimum limit
	if limitStr != "" {
		limit, err = strconv.Atoi(limitStr)
		if err != nil || limit < 200 {
			WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PARAM", "limit must be at least 200")
			return
		}
	}

	// Get paginated events
	events, total, err := h.repo.ListByUserPaginated(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, auth.UID, startTime, endTime, page, limit)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get paginated events: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to retrieve events")
		return
	}

	h.logger.Printf("[GetEvents] Loaded %d events (page %d, limit %d, total %d) for user %s", len(events), page, limit, total, auth.UID)

	// Calculate pagination metadata
	totalPages := (total + limit - 1) / limit
	if totalPages == 0 {
		totalPages = 1
	}

	response := map[string]interface{}{
		"events": events,
		"pagination": map[string]interface{}{
			"page":       page,
			"limit":      limit,
			"total":      total,
			"totalPages": totalPages,
		},
		"period": map[string]string{
			"startDate": startDate,
			"endDate":   endDate,
		},
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, response)
}

// GetAverageTiming handles GET /api/v1/usage/avg-timing
// Query params: provider, model
func (h *UsageHandler) GetAverageTiming(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Parse query parameters
	q := r.URL.Query()
	provider := q.Get("provider")
	model := q.Get("model")

	if provider == "" || model == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "MISSING_PARAMS", "provider and model are required")
		return
	}

	avgTiming, err := h.repo.GetAverageTiming(r.Context(), auth.TenantID, auth.UID, provider, model)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get average timing: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to retrieve average timing")
		return
	}

	response := map[string]interface{}{
		"estimatedSeconds": avgTiming,
		"provider":         provider,
		"model":            model,
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, response)
}

package http

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/services"
)

// UsersHandler handles user-related HTTP requests
type UsersHandler struct {
	repo               *repo.UsersRepository
	subscriptionService *services.SubscriptionService
	logger             *log.Logger
}

// NewUsersHandler creates a new UsersHandler
func NewUsersHandler(repo *repo.UsersRepository, logger *log.Logger) *UsersHandler {
	return &UsersHandler{
		repo:   repo,
		logger: logger,
	}
}

// WithSubscriptionService sets the subscription service (optional, for auto-creating subscriptions)
func (h *UsersHandler) WithSubscriptionService(service *services.SubscriptionService) *UsersHandler {
	h.subscriptionService = service
	return h
}

// CreateUserRequest represents the request body for creating a user
type CreateUserRequest struct {
	FirebaseUID       string  `json:"firebaseUid"`
	Email             string  `json:"email"`
	AccountType       string  `json:"accountType"` // "personal" or "corporate"
	DisplayName       *string `json:"displayName,omitempty"`
	PreferredLanguage *string `json:"preferredLanguage,omitempty"`
}

// CreateUserResponse represents the response for user creation
type CreateUserResponse struct {
	User    *models.User `json:"user"`
	Success bool         `json:"success"`
	Message string       `json:"message"`
}

// ComputeTenantID calculates tenantId based on email and account type
func ComputeTenantID(email, accountType string) string {
	if accountType == "corporate" {
		parts := strings.Split(email, "@")
		if len(parts) == 2 {
			return parts[1] // domain
		}
	}
	return email // personal account: tenantId = email
}

// CreateUser handles POST /api/v1/users
func (h *UsersHandler) CreateUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateUserRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate required fields
	if req.FirebaseUID == "" || req.Email == "" || req.AccountType == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "firebaseUid, email, and accountType are required")
		return
	}

	if req.AccountType != "personal" && req.AccountType != "corporate" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "accountType must be 'personal' or 'corporate'")
		return
	}

	// Verify that the authenticated user is creating their own account
	if authInfo.UID != req.FirebaseUID && !authInfo.IsSystem {
		WriteForbidden(w, "You can only create your own user account")
		return
	}

	// Compute tenantId
	tenantID := ComputeTenantID(req.Email, req.AccountType)

	// Check if user already exists
	existingUser, err := h.repo.GetByIDAndTenant(r.Context(), req.FirebaseUID, tenantID)
	if err == nil && existingUser != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("User already exists: %s in tenant %s", req.FirebaseUID, tenantID)
		WriteConflict(w, "USER_ALREADY_EXISTS", "User with this Firebase UID already exists in this tenant", map[string]string{
			"firebaseUid": req.FirebaseUID,
		})
		return
	}

	// Enforce waitlist: user must be approved
	// Best-effort: if waitlist repo accessible from context
	if uraw := r.Context().Value(waitlistRepoKey{}); uraw != nil {
		if wl, ok := uraw.(*repo.WaitlistRepository); ok && wl != nil {
			if e, err := wl.Get(r.Context(), strings.ToLower(req.Email)); err == nil && e != nil {
				if e.Status != "approved" {
					WriteForbidden(w, "User not approved for beta")
					return
				}
			} else {
				WriteForbidden(w, "User not found in waitlist")
				return
			}
		}
	}

	// Create user
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	role := "user"
	status := "active"
	schemaVersion := "1.0"

	// Default preferredLanguage to EN if not provided or invalid length
	pl := "EN"
	if req.PreferredLanguage != nil {
		v := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(*req.PreferredLanguage))
		if len(v) == 2 {
			pl = v
		}
	}

	user := &models.User{
		ID:                req.FirebaseUID,
		TenantID:          tenantID,
		Email:             req.Email,
		DisplayName:       req.DisplayName,
		AuthType:          &req.AccountType,
		Role:              &role,
		Status:            &status,
		CreatedAt:         now,
		UpdatedAt:         now,
		SchemaVersion:     schemaVersion,
		PreferredLanguage: &pl,
	}

	// Save to Firestore
	if err := h.repo.Upsert(r.Context(), user); err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to save user %s: %v", user.ID, err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create user")
		return
	}

	h.logger.Printf("Successfully created user %s in tenant %s", user.ID, user.TenantID)

	// Create free subscription for new user (async, best-effort)
	if h.subscriptionService != nil {
		go func() {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			if _, err := h.subscriptionService.GetOrCreateSubscription(ctx, user.TenantID, user.ID); err != nil {
				h.logger.Printf("Failed to create subscription for user %s: %v", user.ID, err)
			}
		}()
	}

	response := CreateUserResponse{
		User:    user,
		Success: true,
		Message: "User created successfully",
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, response)
}

// GetUser handles GET /api/v1/users/{userId}
func (h *UsersHandler) GetUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Extract userId from path
	// Expecting /api/v1/users/{userId}
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "User ID is required")
		return
	}
	userID := pathParts[3]

	// Check access: user can only get their own data, or admin can get any
	// For now, simplified: user can only get their own data
	if authInfo.UID != userID && !authInfo.IsSystem {
		WriteForbidden(w, "You do not have permission to access this resource")
		return
	}

	// Fetch user
	user, err := h.repo.GetByIDAndTenant(r.Context(), userID, authInfo.TenantID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to fetch user %s: %v", userID, err)
		WriteNotFound(w, "User not found")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, user)
}

// UpdateUser handles PUT /api/v1/users/{userId}
func (h *UsersHandler) UpdateUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPut {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only PUT is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Extract userId from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "User ID is required")
		return
	}
	userID := pathParts[3]

	// Check access
	if authInfo.UID != userID && !authInfo.IsSystem {
		WriteForbidden(w, "You do not have permission to update this resource")
		return
	}

	// Fetch existing user
	userToUpdate, err := h.repo.GetByIDAndTenant(r.Context(), userID, authInfo.TenantID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("User not found: %s", userID)
		WriteNotFound(w, "User not found")
		return
	}

	// Parse update request
	var updates models.User
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&updates); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}

	// Update allowed fields
	if updates.DisplayName != nil {
		userToUpdate.DisplayName = updates.DisplayName
	}
	if updates.CompanyRef != nil {
		userToUpdate.CompanyRef = updates.CompanyRef
	}
	if updates.JobTitle != nil {
		userToUpdate.JobTitle = updates.JobTitle
	}
	if updates.Department != nil {
		userToUpdate.Department = updates.Department
	}
	if updates.DefaultProjectID != nil {
		userToUpdate.DefaultProjectID = updates.DefaultProjectID
	}
	if updates.ProjectRoles != nil {
		userToUpdate.ProjectRoles = updates.ProjectRoles
	}
	if updates.AssignedGoalIDs != nil {
		userToUpdate.AssignedGoalIDs = updates.AssignedGoalIDs
	}
	if updates.AssignedInitiativeIDs != nil {
		userToUpdate.AssignedInitiativeIDs = updates.AssignedInitiativeIDs
	}
	if updates.Metadata != nil {
		userToUpdate.Metadata = updates.Metadata
	}
	if updates.PreferredLanguage != nil {
		v := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(*updates.PreferredLanguage))
		if len(v) == 2 {
			userToUpdate.PreferredLanguage = &v
		}
	}
	if updates.CountryOfResidence != nil {
		v := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(*updates.CountryOfResidence))
		if len(v) == 2 {
			userToUpdate.CountryOfResidence = &v
		}
	}
	// Parent-child link and demographics
	if updates.ParentUserID != nil {
		userToUpdate.ParentUserID = updates.ParentUserID
	}
	if updates.Gender != nil {
		userToUpdate.Gender = updates.Gender
	}
	if updates.Age != nil {
		userToUpdate.Age = updates.Age
	}

	// Admin can update role and status (for now, simplified - no admin check)
	// if authInfo.IsSystem {
	// 	if updates.Role != nil {
	// 		userToUpdate.Role = updates.Role
	// 	}
	// 	if updates.Status != nil {
	// 		userToUpdate.Status = updates.Status
	// 	}
	// }

	userToUpdate.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

	// Save
	if err := h.repo.Upsert(r.Context(), userToUpdate); err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to update user %s: %v", userID, err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to update user")
		return
	}

	h.logger.Printf("Successfully updated user %s", userID)
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, userToUpdate)
}


================================================================================

package http

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"math/rand"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/crawler"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/discovery"
	gen_combined "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/combined"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/realtime"
)

type VerifiedHandler struct {
	projectsRepo  *repo.ProjectsRepository
	sharesRepo    *repo.ShareTokensRepository
	interRepo     *repo.InteractionsRepository
	sourcesRepo   *repo.DataSourcesRepository
	docsRepo      *repo.DocumentsRepository
	orchestrator  *discovery.Orchestrator
	genaiHandler  *GenAIHandler
	publisher     *realtime.Publisher
	logger        *log.Logger
}

func NewVerifiedHandler(
	projectsRepo *repo.ProjectsRepository,
	sharesRepo *repo.ShareTokensRepository,
	interRepo *repo.InteractionsRepository,
	sourcesRepo *repo.DataSourcesRepository,
	docsRepo *repo.DocumentsRepository,
	orchestrator *discovery.Orchestrator,
	genaiHandler *GenAIHandler,
	publisher *realtime.Publisher,
	logger *log.Logger,
) *VerifiedHandler {
	return &VerifiedHandler{
		projectsRepo: projectsRepo,
		sharesRepo:   sharesRepo,
		interRepo:    interRepo,
		sourcesRepo:  sourcesRepo,
		docsRepo:     docsRepo,
		orchestrator: orchestrator,
		genaiHandler: genaiHandler,
		publisher:    publisher,
		logger:       logger,
	}
}

type createVerifiedRequest struct {
	URL   string `json:"url"`
	Model string `json:"model,omitempty"` // Optional: gemini_fast, gemini_quality, grok_fast, grok_quality, gpt_fast, gpt_quality, claude_fast, claude_balanced
}

type createVerifiedResponse struct {
	Code   string `json:"code"`
	URL    string `json:"url"`
	Status string `json:"status"`
}

func randomCode(n int) string {
	const letters = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
	b := make([]byte, n)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = letters[rand.Intn(len(letters))]
	}
	return string(b)
}

// generateUniqueCode generates a unique code for verified project
func (h *VerifiedHandler) generateUniqueCode(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		code := randomCode(10)
		_, err := h.projectsRepo.GetByVerifiedCode(ctx, code)
		if err != nil {
			// Code doesn't exist, we can use it
			return code, nil
		}
	}
	return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to generate unique code after 10 attempts")
}

// POST /api/v1/verified
func (h *VerifiedHandler) CreateVerified(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	// Verify system authentication
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil || !auth.IsSystem {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "System authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req createVerifiedRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_REQUEST", "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.URL == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_URL", "URL is required")
		return
	}

	// Validate model if provided
	if req.Model != "" {
		validModels := map[string]bool{
			"gemini_fast":      true,
			"gemini_quality":   true,
			"grok_fast":        true,
			"grok_quality":     true,
			"gpt_fast":         true,
			"gpt_quality":      true,
			"claude_fast":      true,
			"claude_balanced":  true,
		}
		if !validModels[req.Model] {
			WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_MODEL", "Invalid model. Allowed: gemini_fast, gemini_quality, grok_fast, grok_quality, gpt_fast, gpt_quality, claude_fast, claude_balanced")
			return
		}
	}

	ctx := r.Context()

	// Normalize URL
	canonicalURL := crawler.CanonicalizeURL(req.URL)

	// Check if verified project already exists for this URL
	existingProjects, err := h.projectsRepo.List(ctx, "system", nil)
	if err == nil {
		for _, p := range existingProjects {
			if p.VerifiedCode != nil {
				// Check interactions for this project to find URL
				interactions, err := h.interRepo.ListByProject(ctx, p.ID)
				if err == nil && len(interactions) > 0 {
					// First interaction should contain URL metadata
					for _, it := range interactions {
						if it.Kind == "system" && it.Subkind != nil && *it.Subkind == "verified.metadata" {
							// Parse metadata from content (stored as JSON)
							var metadata map[string]interface{}
							if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(it.Content), &metadata); err == nil {
								if cu, ok := metadata["canonicalUrl"].(string); ok && cu == canonicalURL {
									// Found existing verified project
									status := "completed"
									if s, ok := metadata["status"].(string); ok {
										status = s
									}
									resp := createVerifiedResponse{
										Code:   *p.VerifiedCode,
										URL:    req.URL,
										Status: status,
									}
									WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
									return
								}
							}
							break
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Generate unique code
	code, err := h.generateUniqueCode(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to generate code: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to generate code")
		return
	}

	// Create verified project
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	selectedModel := req.Model
	if selectedModel == "" {
		selectedModel = "gemini_fast" // default model
	}

	project := &models.Project{
		TenantID:    "system",
		DisplayName: fmt.Sprintf("Verified: %s", req.URL),
		Status:      "active",
		OwnerUserID: "system",
		VerifiedCode: &code,
		CreatedAt:   now,
		UpdatedAt:   now,
	}

	projectID, err := h.projectsRepo.Create(ctx, project)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to create project: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create project")
		return
	}
	project.ID = projectID

	// Create ShareToken for public access
	exp := time.Now().UTC().Add(365 * 24 * time.Hour) // 1 year expiration for verified
	shareToken := &repo.ShareToken{
		ProjectID: projectID,
		Token:     code, // Use same code as token for simplicity
		ExpiresAt: exp,
		CreatedBy: "system",
	}
	_, err = h.sharesRepo.Create(ctx, shareToken)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to create share token: %v", err)
		// Continue anyway, token creation is not critical
	}

	// Create metadata interaction
	metadataContent := fmt.Sprintf(`{"url":"%s","canonicalUrl":"%s","model":"%s","status":"pending"}`, req.URL, canonicalURL, selectedModel)
	metadataInteraction := &repo.Interaction{
		TenantID:  "system",
		ProjectID: projectID,
		Kind:      "system",
		Subkind:   stringPtr("verified.metadata"),
		Content:   metadataContent,
		Author: &repo.ParticipantRef{
			ParticipantID: "system",
			Kind:          "system",
		},
	}
	_, err = h.interRepo.Create(ctx, metadataInteraction)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to create metadata interaction: %v", err)
		// Continue anyway
	}

	// Publish fetch_start event
	if h.publisher != nil {
		_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "verified.stream.fetch_start", "system", map[string]interface{}{
			"code": code,
			"url":  req.URL,
		})
	}

	// Process asynchronously
	go h.processVerifiedAnalysis(context.Background(), projectID, code, req.URL, canonicalURL, selectedModel)

	// Return immediate response
	resp := createVerifiedResponse{
		Code:   code,
		URL:    req.URL,
		Status: "pending",
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, resp)
}

// processVerifiedAnalysis processes the URL analysis asynchronously
func (h *VerifiedHandler) processVerifiedAnalysis(ctx context.Context, projectID, code, url, canonicalURL, model string) {
	// Update metadata interaction status to processing
	interactions, _ := h.interRepo.ListByProject(ctx, projectID)
	var metadataInteractionID string
	for _, it := range interactions {
		if it.Kind == "system" && it.Subkind != nil && *it.Subkind == "verified.metadata" {
			metadataInteractionID = it.ID
			break
		}
	}
	if metadataInteractionID != "" {
		_ = h.interRepo.Update(ctx, metadataInteractionID, map[string]interface{}{
			"content": fmt.Sprintf(`{"url":"%s","canonicalUrl":"%s","model":"%s","status":"processing"}`, url, canonicalURL, model),
		})
	}

	// Step 1: Find or create data source
	existingSource, err := h.sourcesRepo.FindByCanonicalSource(ctx, "", canonicalURL)
	var sourceID string
	if err == nil && existingSource != nil {
		sourceID = existingSource.ID
		h.logger.Printf("verified: using existing source %s for %s", sourceID, canonicalURL)
	} else {
		// Create new public source
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		ds := &models.DataSource{
			TenantID:    "", // Empty for public sources
			Pk:          "global",
			Kind:        "web",
			DisplayName: canonicalURL,
			Status:      "active",
			OwnerUserID: "system",
			Details: models.SourceDetails{
				URI: &canonicalURL,
			},
			CreatedAt: now,
			UpdatedAt: now,
			FirstSeen:  now,
			LastSeen:   now,
		}
		sourceID, err = h.sourcesRepo.Create(ctx, ds)
		if err != nil {
			h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to create source: %v", err)
			// Update status to failed
			if metadataInteractionID != "" {
				errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Failed to create source: %v", err)
				_ = h.interRepo.Update(ctx, metadataInteractionID, map[string]interface{}{
					"content": fmt.Sprintf(`{"url":"%s","canonicalUrl":"%s","model":"%s","status":"failed","error":"%s"}`, url, canonicalURL, model, errMsg),
				})
			}
			// Publish fetch_failed event
			if h.publisher != nil {
				_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "verified.stream.fetch_failed", "system", map[string]interface{}{
					"code":  code,
					"url":   url,
					"error": fmt.Sprintf("Failed to create source: %v", err),
				})
			}
			return
		}
		h.logger.Printf("verified: created new source %s for %s", sourceID, canonicalURL)
	}

	// Step 2: Ingest web content (creates/updates document and chunks)
	err = h.orchestrator.IngestWeb(ctx, "system", sourceID, canonicalURL)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to ingest web content: %v", err)
		// Update status to failed
		if metadataInteractionID != "" {
			errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Failed to ingest content: %v", err)
			_ = h.interRepo.Update(ctx, metadataInteractionID, map[string]interface{}{
				"content": fmt.Sprintf(`{"url":"%s","canonicalUrl":"%s","model":"%s","status":"failed","error":"%s"}`, url, canonicalURL, model, errMsg),
			})
		}
		// Publish fetch_failed event
		if h.publisher != nil {
			_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "verified.stream.fetch_failed", "system", map[string]interface{}{
				"code":  code,
				"url":   url,
				"error": fmt.Sprintf("Failed to ingest content: %v", err),
			})
		}
		return
	}

	// Publish fetch_success event
	if h.publisher != nil {
		_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "verified.stream.fetch_success", "system", map[string]interface{}{
			"code":     code,
			"url":      url,
			"sourceId": sourceID,
		})
	}

	// Step 3: Get document ID
	doc, err := h.docsRepo.GetByExternalID(ctx, "system", sourceID, canonicalURL)
	if err != nil || doc == nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to get document: %v", err)
		// Update status to failed
		if metadataInteractionID != "" {
			errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Failed to get document: %v", err)
			_ = h.interRepo.Update(ctx, metadataInteractionID, map[string]interface{}{
				"content": fmt.Sprintf(`{"url":"%s","canonicalUrl":"%s","model":"%s","status":"failed","error":"%s"}`, url, canonicalURL, model, errMsg),
			})
		}
		// Publish analysis_failed event
		if h.publisher != nil {
			_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "verified.stream.analysis_failed", "system", map[string]interface{}{
				"code":  code,
				"url":   url,
				"error": fmt.Sprintf("Failed to get document: %v", err),
			})
		}
		return
	}

	// Update metadata with source and document IDs
	if metadataInteractionID != "" {
		_ = h.interRepo.Update(ctx, metadataInteractionID, map[string]interface{}{
			"content": fmt.Sprintf(`{"url":"%s","canonicalUrl":"%s","model":"%s","status":"processing","sourceId":"%s","documentId":"%s"}`, url, canonicalURL, model, sourceID, doc.ID),
		})
	}

	// Publish analysis_start event
	if h.publisher != nil {
		_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "verified.stream.analysis_start", "system", map[string]interface{}{
			"code":       code,
			"url":        url,
			"documentId": doc.ID,
		})
	}

	// Step 4: Perform AI analysis with search grounding
	analysisPrompt := fmt.Sprintf(`Analyze the following web page content and provide an alternative perspective or critical evaluation.

The content is from: %s

YOUR TASK:
Evaluate the content and provide a well-reasoned contribution that adds value through critical analysis or an alternative angle.
If the content has limitations, biases, or missing viewpoints, articulate them constructively.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR TONE AND STYLE:
1) Write for educated non-specialists, not for policy analysts or academics. Avoid bureaucratic jargon and acronyms without explanation.
2) Ground your analysis in real human context: who is affected? What are the practical consequences for people, communities, or organizations?
3) Use narrative and concrete examples alongside data. Tell a story, not a spreadsheet. Weave ideas into coherent prose rather than bullet-only lists.
4) Express uncertainty both qualitatively ("likely", "possibly", "unclear") AND quantitatively when logically justified. If you provide metrics (probabilities, confidence ranges, pro/con weights), wrap them in human-readable explanations:
   - Good: "This scenario is more likely to fail than succeed (roughly 60%% risk vs 40%% benefit), primarily because..."
   - Good: "The evidence base is fairly strong (about 78%% of key claims have direct sources), though some projections rely on analogies..."
   - Bad: "Balance: pro 40%%, con 60%%" (naked numbers without context)
   Always explain the reasoning behind your numbers: what base rates, analogies, or models inform them.
5) Acknowledge trade-offs and moral/values dimensions where relevant. Recognize that decisions affect real people's lives.
6) Structure your response for readability: use section headings, short paragraphs, and strategic use of lists—but avoid purely mechanical formatting.
7) When citing sources or data from web search, integrate them naturally into your narrative with brief inline explanations. Avoid dense citation blocks that interrupt flow.
8) FORMALIZATION OPTION: If the topic requires rigorous policy analysis, quantitative risk assessment, or regulatory evaluation, you may use structured analytical frameworks (pro/con weights, evidence quality metrics, probability ranges, scenario trees). However, you MUST:
   - Introduce each framework in plain language first (e.g., "To weigh the arguments systematically, I'll score the strength of evidence...")
   - Explain your methodology and assumptions explicitly
   - Connect metrics back to real-world consequences for people/organizations
   - Close with a human-readable synthesis, not just raw numbers

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT:
Respond in the same language as the source content. Use English or other languages inline only if you use well-known and accepted terms in the target language.

Do not ask clarifying questions or request additional input; rely only on the provided content.
Do not restate the prompt or context; respond directly with your analysis.

Content:
%s

Your analysis:`, url, doc.FullText)

	// Use selected model with mandatory web search grounding
	genaiReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{
		Model:              model,
		Prompt:             analysisPrompt,
		WebSearchEnabled:   true,
		MaxOutputTokens:    2048,
		Temperature:        0.7,
		SystemInstruction:  "You are a critical analyst. Provide thorough, evidence-based analysis with web search verification.",
	}

	result, err := h.genaiHandler.GenerateDirect(ctx, genaiReq)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to execute AI analysis: %v", err)
		// Update status to failed
		if metadataInteractionID != "" {
			errMsg := fmt.Sprintf("Failed to analyze: %v", err)
			_ = h.interRepo.Update(ctx, metadataInteractionID, map[string]interface{}{
				"content": fmt.Sprintf(`{"url":"%s","canonicalUrl":"%s","model":"%s","status":"failed","error":"%s"}`, url, canonicalURL, model, errMsg),
			})
		}
		// Publish analysis_failed event
		if h.publisher != nil {
			_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "verified.stream.analysis_failed", "system", map[string]interface{}{
				"code":  code,
				"url":   url,
				"error": fmt.Sprintf("Failed to analyze: %v", err),
			})
		}
		return
	}

	// Step 5: Create analysis interaction
	analysisInteraction := &repo.Interaction{
		TenantID:  "system",
		ProjectID: projectID,
		Kind:      "assistant",
		Subkind:   stringPtr("verified.analysis"),
		Content:   result.Content,
		Model:     &result.Model,
		Author: &repo.ParticipantRef{
			ParticipantID: "system",
			Kind:          "ai",
		},
		Usage: &repo.UsageMeta{
			PromptTokens:    result.Usage.PromptTokens,
			OutputTokens:    result.Usage.OutputTokens,
			TotalTokens:     result.Usage.TotalTokens,
			ReasoningTokens: result.Usage.ReasoningTokens,
		},
		Sources: []string{sourceID},
		CoreDocIDs: []string{doc.ID},
	}
	_, err = h.interRepo.Create(ctx, analysisInteraction)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to create analysis interaction: %v", err)
		// Continue anyway
	}

	// Update metadata interaction status to completed
	if metadataInteractionID != "" {
		_ = h.interRepo.Update(ctx, metadataInteractionID, map[string]interface{}{
			"content": fmt.Sprintf(`{"url":"%s","canonicalUrl":"%s","model":"%s","status":"completed","sourceId":"%s","documentId":"%s"}`, url, canonicalURL, result.Model, sourceID, doc.ID),
		})
	}

	// Publish analysis_complete event
	if h.publisher != nil {
		_ = h.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, "verified.stream.analysis_complete", "system", map[string]interface{}{
			"code":  code,
			"url":   url,
			"model": result.Model,
		})
	}

	h.logger.Printf("verified: successfully completed analysis for %s (code: %s)", canonicalURL, code)
}

// Helper function to create string pointer
func stringPtr(s string) *string {
	return &s
}

// GET /api/v1/public/verified/{code}
func (h *VerifiedHandler) GetPublicVerified(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	path := strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/")
	parts := strings.Split(path, "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Missing code")
		return
	}
	code := parts[4]

	// Get project by verified code
	project, err := h.projectsRepo.GetByVerifiedCode(r.Context(), code)
	if err != nil {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Analysis not found")
		return
	}

	// Get share token to check expiration
	shareToken, _, err := h.sharesRepo.GetByToken(r.Context(), code)
	if err != nil || shareToken == nil {
		WriteNotFound(w, "Share token not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if expired
	if !shareToken.IsActive || time.Now().UTC().After(shareToken.ExpiresAt) {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusGone, "EXPIRED", "Analysis has expired", nil)
		return
	}

	// Touch access
	_ = h.sharesRepo.TouchAccess(r.Context(), shareToken.ID)

	// Load interactions
	interactions, err := h.interRepo.ListByProject(r.Context(), project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("verified: failed to load interactions: %v", err)
		interactions = []*repo.Interaction{}
	}

	// Extract metadata and analysis from interactions
	var metadataInteraction *repo.Interaction
	var analysisInteraction *repo.Interaction
	for _, it := range interactions {
		if it.Kind == "system" && it.Subkind != nil && *it.Subkind == "verified.metadata" {
			metadataInteraction = it
		} else if it.Kind == "assistant" && it.Subkind != nil && *it.Subkind == "verified.analysis" {
			analysisInteraction = it
		}
	}

	// Parse metadata
	var url, canonicalURL, status, model string
	var errorMsg *string
	if metadataInteraction != nil {
		// Parse JSON from content
		var metadata map[string]interface{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(metadataInteraction.Content), &metadata); err == nil {
			if u, ok := metadata["url"].(string); ok {
				url = u
			}
			if cu, ok := metadata["canonicalUrl"].(string); ok {
				canonicalURL = cu
			}
			if s, ok := metadata["status"].(string); ok {
				status = s
			}
			if m, ok := metadata["model"].(string); ok {
				model = m
			}
			if e, ok := metadata["error"].(string); ok {
				errorMsg = &e
			}
		}
	}

	// Return public format
	type PublicVerified struct {
		ID           string    `json:"id"`
		Code         string    `json:"code"`
		URL          string    `json:"url"`
		CanonicalURL string    `json:"canonicalUrl"`
		Analysis     string    `json:"analysis"`
		Model        string    `json:"model"`
		Status       string    `json:"status"`
		Error        *string   `json:"error,omitempty"`
		CreatedAt    time.Time `json:"createdAt"`
		UpdatedAt    time.Time `json:"updatedAt"`
	}

	pub := PublicVerified{
		ID:           project.ID,
		Code:         code,
		URL:          url,
		CanonicalURL: canonicalURL,
		Model:        model,
		Status:       status,
		Error:        errorMsg,
		CreatedAt:    project.CreatedAt,
		UpdatedAt:    project.UpdatedAt,
	}

	if analysisInteraction != nil {
		pub.Analysis = analysisInteraction.Content
		if analysisInteraction.Model != nil {
			pub.Model = *analysisInteraction.Model
		}
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, pub)
}

// GET /api/v1/public/documents/{id}
// Public endpoint to retrieve system documents (tenantId = "system" only)
func (h *VerifiedHandler) GetPublicDocument(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	path := strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/")
	parts := strings.Split(path, "/")
	if len(parts) < 5 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Missing document ID")
		return
	}
	documentID := parts[4]

	if documentID == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_ID", "Document ID is required")
		return
	}

	ctx := r.Context()

	// Get document by ID
	doc, err := h.docsRepo.GetByID(ctx, documentID)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("public document: failed to get document %s: %v", documentID, err)
		WriteNotFound(w, "Document not found")
		return
	}

	// SECURITY: Only allow access to system tenant documents
	if doc.TenantID != "system" {
		h.logger.Printf("public document: access denied to non-system document %s (tenant: %s)", documentID, doc.TenantID)
		WriteNotFound(w, "Document not found")
		return
	}

	// Return public document format
	type PublicDocument struct {
		ID              string    `json:"id"`
		Title           string    `json:"title,omitempty"`
		URL             string    `json:"url,omitempty"`
		FullText        string    `json:"fullText"`
		ContentType     string    `json:"contentType,omitempty"`
		DocumentType    string    `json:"documentType,omitempty"`
		Language        string    `json:"language,omitempty"`
		IngestedAt      time.Time `json:"ingestedAt"`
	}

	pubDoc := PublicDocument{
		ID:              doc.ID,
		Title:           doc.Title,
		URL:             doc.URL,
		FullText:        doc.FullText,
		ContentType:     doc.ContentType,
		DocumentType:    doc.DocumentType,
		Language:        doc.Language,
		IngestedAt:      doc.IngestedAt,
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, pubDoc)
}

package http

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"math/big"
	"net/http"

	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// VouchersHandler handles voucher-related HTTP requests (admin only)
type VouchersHandler struct {
	repo      *repo.VouchersRepository
	usersRepo *repo.UsersRepository
	logger    *log.Logger
}

// NewVouchersHandler creates a new VouchersHandler
func NewVouchersHandler(vouchersRepo *repo.VouchersRepository, usersRepo *repo.UsersRepository, logger *log.Logger) *VouchersHandler {
	return &VouchersHandler{
		repo:      vouchersRepo,
		usersRepo: usersRepo,
		logger:    logger,
	}
}

// requireAdmin checks if the current user is an admin
func (h *VouchersHandler) requireAdmin(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if authInfo == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "Authentication required")
		return false
	}

	user, err := h.usersRepo.GetByIDAndTenant(r.Context(), authInfo.UID, authInfo.TenantID)
	if err != nil || user == nil || user.Role == nil || strings.ToLower(*user.Role) != "admin" {
		WriteForbidden(w, "Admin access required")
		return false
	}

	return true
}

// CreateVoucherRequest represents the request body for creating a voucher
type CreateVoucherRequest struct {
	Code           string                  `json:"code"`
	Tier           models.SubscriptionTier `json:"tier"` // pro or max
	DurationMonths int                     `json:"durationMonths"`
	ValidFrom      *time.Time              `json:"validFrom,omitempty"`
	ValidTo        *time.Time              `json:"validTo,omitempty"`
	MaxUses        *int                    `json:"maxUses,omitempty"`
	Note           *string                 `json:"note,omitempty"`
}

// CreateVoucher handles POST /api/v1/vouchers
func (h *VouchersHandler) CreateVoucher(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	if !h.requireAdmin(w, r) {
		return
	}

	authInfo := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())

	var req CreateVoucherRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}

	// Generate code if not provided
	voucherCode := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(req.Code))
	if voucherCode == "" {
		voucherCode = generateVoucherCode()
	}
	if req.Tier != models.SubscriptionTierPro && req.Tier != models.SubscriptionTierMax {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "tier must be 'pro' or 'max'")
		return
	}
	if req.DurationMonths <= 0 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "VALIDATION_ERROR", "durationMonths must be positive")
		return
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	voucher := &models.Voucher{
		Code:           voucherCode,
		Tier:           req.Tier,
		DurationMonths: req.DurationMonths,
		ValidFrom:      now,
		ValidTo:        req.ValidTo,
		MaxUses:        req.MaxUses,
		UsedCount:      0,
		IsActive:       true,
		CreatedBy:      authInfo.UID,
		Note:           req.Note,
		CreatedAt:      now,
		UpdatedAt:      now,
	}

	if req.ValidFrom != nil {
		voucher.ValidFrom = *req.ValidFrom
	}

	if err := h.repo.Create(r.Context(), voucher); err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to create voucher: %v", err)
		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "already exists") {
			WriteConflict(w, "VOUCHER_EXISTS", "Voucher code already exists", nil)
			return
		}
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to create voucher")
		return
	}

	h.logger.Printf("Admin %s created voucher %s (tier: %s, duration: %d months)", authInfo.UID, voucher.Code, voucher.Tier, voucher.DurationMonths)

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, voucher)
}

// ListVouchers handles GET /api/v1/vouchers
func (h *VouchersHandler) ListVouchers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	if !h.requireAdmin(w, r) {
		return
	}

	// Parse query parameters
	tierStr := r.URL.Query().Get("tier")

	// Support both "activeOnly" (legacy) and "isActive" (new) parameters
	var activeOnly *bool // nil = show all, true = active only, false = inactive only
	if isActiveStr := r.URL.Query().Get("isActive"); isActiveStr != "" {
		// If isActive is provided, use it (true = active only, false = inactive only)
		val := isActiveStr == "true"
		activeOnly = &val
	} else if activeOnlyStr := r.URL.Query().Get("activeOnly"); activeOnlyStr != "" {
		// Legacy support for activeOnly parameter
		val := activeOnlyStr == "true"
		activeOnly = &val
	}
	// else: activeOnly remains nil = show all

	var tier *models.SubscriptionTier
	if tierStr != "" {
		t := models.SubscriptionTier(strings.ToLower(tierStr))
		if t == models.SubscriptionTierPro || t == models.SubscriptionTierMax {
			tier = &t
		}
	}

	vouchers, err := h.repo.List(r.Context(), tier, activeOnly)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to list vouchers: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to list vouchers")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, vouchers)
}

// GetVoucher handles GET /api/v1/vouchers/{voucherId}
func (h *VouchersHandler) GetVoucher(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	if !h.requireAdmin(w, r) {
		return
	}

	// Extract voucher ID from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Voucher ID is required")
		return
	}
	voucherID := pathParts[3]

	voucher, err := h.repo.Get(r.Context(), voucherID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == repo.ErrVoucherNotFound {
			WriteNotFound(w, "Voucher not found")
			return
		}
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get voucher: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to get voucher")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, voucher)
}

// UpdateVoucherRequest represents the request body for updating a voucher
type UpdateVoucherRequest struct {
	IsActive *bool      `json:"isActive,omitempty"`
	ValidTo  *time.Time `json:"validTo,omitempty"`
	MaxUses  *int       `json:"maxUses,omitempty"`
	Note     *string    `json:"note,omitempty"`
}

// UpdateVoucher handles PATCH /api/v1/vouchers/{voucherId}
func (h *VouchersHandler) UpdateVoucher(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPatch && r.Method != http.MethodPut {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only PATCH or PUT is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	if !h.requireAdmin(w, r) {
		return
	}

	// Extract voucher ID from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Voucher ID is required")
		return
	}
	voucherID := pathParts[3]

	voucher, err := h.repo.Get(r.Context(), voucherID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == repo.ErrVoucherNotFound {
			WriteNotFound(w, "Voucher not found")
			return
		}
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to get voucher: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to get voucher")
		return
	}

	var req UpdateVoucherRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "Failed to parse request body")
		return
	}

	// Update fields
	if req.IsActive != nil {
		voucher.IsActive = *req.IsActive
	}
	if req.ValidTo != nil {
		voucher.ValidTo = req.ValidTo
	}
	if req.MaxUses != nil {
		voucher.MaxUses = req.MaxUses
	}
	if req.Note != nil {
		voucher.Note = req.Note
	}

	voucher.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

	if err := h.repo.Update(r.Context(), voucher); err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to update voucher: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to update voucher")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, voucher)
}

// DeleteVoucher handles DELETE /api/v1/vouchers/{voucherId}
func (h *VouchersHandler) DeleteVoucher(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodDelete {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only DELETE is allowed", nil)
		return
	}

	if !h.requireAdmin(w, r) {
		return
	}

	// Extract voucher ID from path
	pathParts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
	if len(pathParts) < 4 {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_PATH", "Voucher ID is required")
		return
	}
	voucherID := pathParts[3]

	if err := h.repo.Delete(r.Context(), voucherID); err != nil {
		if err == repo.ErrVoucherNotFound {
			WriteNotFound(w, "Voucher not found")
			return
		}
		h.logger.Printf("Failed to delete voucher: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to delete voucher")
		return
	}

	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"message": "Voucher deleted successfully"})
}

// generateVoucherCode generates a random voucher code using uppercase Latin letters
// Format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX (12 characters total, 3 groups of 4)
func generateVoucherCode() string {
	const letters = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
	const codeLength = 12
	const groupSize = 4

	b := make([]byte, codeLength)
	for i := range b {
		num, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(letters))))
		b[i] = letters[num.Int64()]
	}

	// Format as XXXX-XXXX-XXXX
	result := make([]byte, codeLength+2) // +2 for dashes
	idx := 0
	for i := 0; i < codeLength; i++ {
		if i > 0 && i%groupSize == 0 {
			result[idx] = '-'
			idx++
		}
		result[idx] = b[i]
		idx++
	}

	return string(result)
}

package http

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// waitlistRepoKey is a context key for waitlist repository
type waitlistRepoKey struct{}

// WithWaitlistRepo attaches WaitlistRepository into request context
func WithWaitlistRepo(wl *repo.WaitlistRepository) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), waitlistRepoKey{}, wl)
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
		})
	}
}

// WaitlistHandler manages waitlist operations
type WaitlistHandler struct {
	wl     *repo.WaitlistRepository
	users  *repo.UsersRepository
	logger *log.Logger
}

func NewWaitlistHandler(wl *repo.WaitlistRepository, users *repo.UsersRepository, logger *log.Logger) *WaitlistHandler {
	return &WaitlistHandler{wl: wl, users: users, logger: logger}
}

type waitlistJoinReq struct {
	Email string `json:"email"`
	Note  string `json:"note,omitempty"`
}

// Join POST /api/v1/waitlist
func (h *WaitlistHandler) Join(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req waitlistJoinReq
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil || req.Email == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "email is required")
		return
	}
	email := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.Email))
	note := strings.TrimSpace(req.Note)
	var notePtr *string
	if note != "" {
		notePtr = &note
	}
	// If already exists and approved, do not overwrite; return ok silently
	if existing, err := h.wl.Get(r.Context(), email); err == nil && existing != nil {
		if strings.ToLower(existing.Status) == "approved" {
			WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
			return
		}
		// keep existing status; update note if provided
		if notePtr != nil {
			existing.Note = notePtr
		}
		if err := h.wl.Upsert(r.Context(), existing); err != nil {
			WriteInternalError(w, "failed to save waitlist entry")
			return
		}
		WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
		return
	}
	// Not exists: create pending
	entry := &models.WaitlistEntry{Email: email, Note: notePtr, Status: "pending"}
	if err := h.wl.Upsert(r.Context(), entry); err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "failed to save waitlist entry")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}

// Check GET /api/v1/waitlist/check?email=
func (h *WaitlistHandler) Check(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	email := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("email")))
	if email == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "MISSING_EMAIL", "email required")
		return
	}
	e, err := h.wl.Get(r.Context(), email)
	if err != nil || e == nil {
		WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"found": false})
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"found": true, "status": e.Status})
}

// List GET /api/v1/waitlist (admin only)
func (h *WaitlistHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if !h.requireAdmin(w, r) {
		return
	}
	status := r.URL.Query().Get("status")
	var st *string
	if status != "" {
		st = &status
	}
	items, err := h.wl.List(r.Context(), st)
	if err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "failed to list waitlist")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": items})
}

// Approve POST /api/v1/waitlist/approve { email }
func (h *WaitlistHandler) Approve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if !h.requireAdmin(w, r) {
		return
	}
	var req waitlistJoinReq
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil || req.Email == "" {
		WriteBadRequest(w, "INVALID_JSON", "email is required")
		return
	}
	email := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.Email))
	e := &models.WaitlistEntry{Email: email, Status: "approved"}
	if err := h.wl.Upsert(r.Context(), e); err != nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "failed to approve")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}

func (h *WaitlistHandler) requireAdmin(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
	auth := GetAuthInfo(r.Context())
	if auth == nil {
		WriteUnauthorized(w, "auth required")
		return false
	}
	if h.users == nil {
		WriteForbidden(w, "no users repo")
		return false
	}
	u, err := h.users.GetByIDAndTenant(r.Context(), auth.UID, auth.TenantID)
	if err != nil || u == nil || u.Role == nil || strings.ToLower(*u.Role) != "admin" {
		WriteForbidden(w, "admin required")
		return false
	}
	return true
}

package http

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/discovery"
)

// WebhooksHandler routes provider webhooks (e.g., RSS WebSub, Telegram if needed)
type WebhooksHandler struct {
	logger *log.Logger
	poller *discovery.SourcePoller
}

func NewWebhooksHandler(logger *log.Logger) *WebhooksHandler { return &WebhooksHandler{logger: logger} }

// WithPoller wires poller for due publishing (optional)
func (h *WebhooksHandler) WithPoller(p *discovery.SourcePoller) *WebhooksHandler {
	h.poller = p
	return h
}

func (h *WebhooksHandler) Handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// For now, accept and log; provider-specific handling can be wired later
	b, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	var m map[string]any
	_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &m)
	h.logger.Printf("webhook: %s %v", r.URL.Path, m)
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}

// PublishDueHandler triggers polling due selection (for Cloud Scheduler -> HTTP best practice)
func (h *WebhooksHandler) PublishDueHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost && r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		WriteError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "Only GET/POST is allowed", nil)
		return
	}
	if h.poller == nil {
		WriteInternalError(w, "Poller not configured")
		return
	}
	if err := h.poller.PublishDue(r.Context()); err != nil {
		h.logger.Printf("publish-due error: %v", err)
		WriteInternalError(w, "Failed to publish due sources")
		return
	}
	WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}

# AI Module - Универсальный модуль для работы с AI моделями

## Обзор

Этот модуль предоставляет полнофункциональную систему для работы с различными AI провайдерами (OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI/Gemini) с автоматическим выбором моделей, фоллбэк механизмом при ошибках, и системой верификации результатов.

## Основные компоненты

### 1. AIModelManager
Управляет реестром доступных AI-моделей с их характеристиками:
- Автоматический выбор оптимальной модели на основе требований
- Поддержка фильтров (context window, capability score, специальные возможности)
- Расчет стоимости выполнения задач
- Фоллбэк на резервные модели

### 2. AITaskExecutor
Центральный оркестратор для выполнения AI-задач:
- Автоматический retry с переключением на другие модели при ошибках
- Поддержка структурированного вывода с верификацией
- Tool-calling (function calling) поддержка
- Встроенный веб-поиск
- Анализ изображений
- Генерация эмбеддингов

### 3. AI Services (Провайдеры)
Реализации для различных провайдеров:
- **OpenAIService**: GPT-4, GPT-4o, embeddings, vision, search
- **ClaudeService**: Claude Sonnet, Opus
- **VertexAIService**: Gemini 2.0 Flash, Pro

### 4. Система верификаторов
Мощная система проверки и исправления результатов:
- Автоматическое исправление JSON (trailing commas, comments, и т.д.)
- Валидация по схеме
- Кастомные правила валидации
- Возможность автоматического исправления данных

## Архитектура

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    AITaskExecutor                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  1. Выбирает модель через AIModelManager       │   │
│  │  2. Получает провайдера для модели             │   │
│  │  3. Выполняет задачу через провайдер           │   │
│  │  4. Применяет верификатор (если есть)          │   │
│  │  5. При ошибке - fallback на другую модель     │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                          ↓
┌────────────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────────┐
│   OpenAIService    │  ClaudeService   │ VertexAIService  │
└────────────────────┴──────────────────┴──────────────────┘
                          ↓
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   AIModelManager                        │
│  • 25+ моделей с полными характеристиками              │
│  • Автоматический выбор по требованиям                 │
│  • Фильтрация по capabilities                          │
│  • Оптимизация по цене                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Основные возможности

### ✅ Автоматический выбор модели
Система автоматически выбирает оптимальную модель на основе:
- Размера контекстного окна
- Требуемых capabilities (text generation, embeddings, vision, search)
- Минимального capability score
- Preference для быстрых моделей (nearly real-time)
- Стоимости (выбирается самая дешевая подходящая модель)

### ✅ Фоллбэк при ошибках
При ошибке выполнения автоматически:
- Выбирается следующая подходящая модель
- Повторяется попытка выполнения
- Поддерживается до 4 fallback попыток
- Логируются все попытки

### ✅ Верификация результатов
Система верификации поддерживает:
- Автоматическую очистку и исправление JSON
- Валидацию структуры данных
- Проверку обязательных полей
- Кастомные правила валидации
- Автоматическое исправление данных (repairable verifiers)

### ✅ Tool-calling (Function calling)
Полная поддержка вызова функций:
- OpenAI function calling
- Anthropic tool use
- Gemini function declarations
- Автоматический цикл вызовов
- Safeguard против бесконечных циклов

### ✅ Специальные возможности
- **Web Search**: встроенный поиск (OpenAI search-preview, Grok)
- **Vision**: анализ изображений (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini)
- **Embeddings**: генерация векторных представлений (OpenAI embeddings)

## Поддерживаемые модели

### OpenAI
- gpt-4o-mini (128K context, fast, cheap)
- gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 (1M context!)
- gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano (400K context)
- gpt-4o-search-preview, gpt-4o-mini-search-preview (с веб-поиском)
- text-embedding-3-large, text-embedding-3-small
- gpt-image-1

### Claude (Anthropic)
- claude-sonnet-4-20250514 (200K context, vision)
- claude-opus-4-1-20250805 (200K context, highest quality)

### Gemini (Vertex AI)
- gemini-2.0-flash (1M context, fast)
- gemini-2.0-flash-lite (1M context, very cheap)
- gemini-2.0-pro (2M context, vision)

### Другие
- deepseek-chat (64K context, very cheap)
- grok-4-0709, grok-3, grok-3-mini (с Live Search)

## Примеры использования

См. файл `example_usage.go` для полных примеров:
- Базовое использование
- Структурированный вывод с верификацией
- Tool-calling
- Кастомные верификаторы
- Выбор моделей с различными требованиями
- Fallback behavior

## Быстрый старт

```go
package main

import (
    "context"
    "log"
    "your-project/internal/ai"
)

func main() {
    // 1. Создаем model manager
    modelManager := ai.NewAIModelManager()
    
    // 2. Создаем AI services
    openAI := ai.NewOpenAIService("your-api-key", modelManager)
    claude := ai.NewClaudeService("your-api-key", modelManager)
    
    // 3. Создаем executor
    executor := ai.NewAITaskExecutor(
        []ai.AIService{openAI, claude},
        modelManager,
    )
    
    // 4. Создаем и выполняем задачу
    task := &ai.AITask{
        TaskType:     ai.TaskTypeSummarization,
        InputContent: "Your text here...",
        AIRequirements: ai.AIRequirements{
            MinContextWindow:         4000,
            MaxOutputSize:            500,
            MinCapabilityScore:       7,
            TextGenerationCapability: true,
        },
    }
    
    result, err := executor.ExecuteTask(context.Background(), task)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    
    log.Printf("Result: %s\nModel: %s\nCost: $%.6f\n", 
        result.Content, result.Model, result.ProcessingCost)
}
```

## Расширение

### Добавление нового провайдера

1. Создайте новый тип, реализующий интерфейс `AIService`:
```go
type MyAIService struct {
    *BaseAIService
    // ваши поля
}

func (s *MyAIService) Provider() AIProvider {
    return AIProvider("MyProvider")
}

func (s *MyAIService) ExecuteTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
    // ваша реализация
}

// ... остальные методы интерфейса
```

2. Добавьте модели в `AIModelManager.initializeModels()`

### Создание кастомного верификатора

```go
type MyVerifier struct {
    ai.GenericVerifier[MyResultType]
}

func NewMyVerifier() *MyVerifier {
    return &MyVerifier{
        GenericVerifier: ai.GenericVerifier[MyResultType]{
            ValidateFunc: func(result MyResultType) error {
                // ваша логика валидации
                return nil
            },
        },
    }
}
```

## Лучшие практики

1. **Используйте верификаторы** для структурированного вывода - это обеспечит автоматический retry при некорректном JSON
2. **Указывайте MinCapabilityScore** чтобы избежать использования слабых моделей для сложных задач
3. **Используйте MaxOutputSize** для контроля стоимости
4. **Для embedding задач** явно указывайте `EmbeddingGenerationCapability: true`
5. **Для vision задач** используйте `ImageAnalysisCapability: true`
6. **Для поиска** используйте `BuiltInSearchCapability: true`

## Телеметрия

Модуль готов к интеграции с системой телеметрии (в текущей версии телеметрия заглушена, как и было запрошено). 
Для включения телеметрии добавьте реализацию `ITelemetryService`.

## Безопасность

- API ключи передаются в конструкторы сервисов - используйте переменные окружения
- Все HTTP запросы используют context для таймаутов
- Safeguard механизмы предотвращают бесконечные циклы tool-calling

## Производительность

- Все HTTP клиенты используют пулы соединений
- Таймауты настроены на 120 секунд
- Automatic retry с exponential backoff (можно добавить при необходимости)
- Кэширование результатов можно добавить через inputHash

package ai

import (
	"context"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/prompts"
)

// Integration tests that call real OpenAI when OPENAI_API_KEY is set.

func TestOpenAI_SummarizationIntegration(t *testing.T) {
	apiKey := os.Getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
	if apiKey == "" {
		t.Skip("OPENAI_API_KEY not set; skipping LLM integration test")
	}

	svc := NewOpenAIService(apiKey, NewAIModelManager())
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	task := &AITask{
		TaskType:     TaskTypeSummarization,
		InputContent: "Summarize in 1-2 sentences:\n\nOpenAI provides powerful models for text generation and understanding.",
		AIRequirements: AIRequirements{
			TextGenerationCapability: true,
			MinCapabilityScore:       5,
			MinContextWindow:         2000,
		},
	}

	// Use a concrete, commonly available model to avoid selection ambiguity
	res, err := svc.ExecuteTask(ctx, task, "gpt-4o-mini")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("openai execute summarization err: %v", err)
	}
	if len(res.Content) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected non-empty summary, got empty")
	}
}

func TestOpenAI_DocumentExtractionIntegration(t *testing.T) {
	apiKey := os.Getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
	if apiKey == "" {
		t.Skip("OPENAI_API_KEY not set; skipping LLM integration test")
	}

	svc := NewOpenAIService(apiKey, NewAIModelManager())
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	sample := "Apple unveiled new Mac devices at its event. The products ship next month."
	prompt := prompts.Format(prompts.DocumentExtractionPrompt, map[string]string{
		"language": "en",
		"text":     sample,
	})
	task := &AITask{
		TaskType:     TaskTypeContentGeneration,
		InputContent: prompt,
		AIRequirements: AIRequirements{
			TextGenerationCapability: true,
			MinCapabilityScore:       6,
			MaxOutputSize:            2000,
		},
	}

	res, err := svc.ExecuteTask(ctx, task, "gpt-4o-mini")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("openai execute extraction err: %v", err)
	}
	if len(res.Content) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected non-empty model output")
	}

	// Extract JSON from response using executor's helper
	exec := NewAITaskExecutor([]AIService{svc}, NewAIModelManager())
	jsonStr, err := exec.extractValidJSON(res.Content)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to extract JSON: %v\nraw: %s", err, res.Content)
	}

	// Validate minimal required fields via MapVerifier
	ver := NewMapVerifier([]string{"language", "documentType"}, nil)
	if _, err := ver.VerifyAndParse(jsonStr); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("verification failed: %v\njson: %s", err, jsonStr)
	}
}

package ai

// BaseAIService базовый абстрактный сервис для работы с разными AI-провайдерами
// Конкретные реализации (OpenAIService, VertexAIService и т.д.) встраивают эту структуру
type BaseAIService struct {
	// ModelManager менеджер моделей, содержащий их характеристики и цены
	ModelManager *AIModelManager
}

// NewBaseAIService создает новый экземпляр базового AI-сервиса
func NewBaseAIService(modelManager *AIModelManager) *BaseAIService {
	return &BaseAIService{
		ModelManager: modelManager,
	}
}

package ai

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// ClaudeService реализация IAIService для работы с моделями от Anthropic (Claude)
type ClaudeService struct {
	*BaseAIService
	apiKey     string
	httpClient *http.Client
}

// NewClaudeService создает новый экземпляр ClaudeService
func NewClaudeService(apiKey string, modelManager *AIModelManager) *ClaudeService {
	// Sanitize API key to avoid invalid header values
	sanitizedKey := strings.TrimSpace(apiKey)
	sanitizedKey = strings.Trim(sanitizedKey, "\"'")
	return &ClaudeService{
		BaseAIService: NewBaseAIService(modelManager),
		apiKey:        sanitizedKey,
		httpClient: &http.Client{
			Timeout: 120 * time.Second,
		},
	}
}

// Provider возвращает идентификатор провайдера
func (s *ClaudeService) Provider() AIProvider {
	return AIProviderClaude
}

// ExecuteTask выполняет задачу (чат/генерация текста) для Claude
func (s *ClaudeService) ExecuteTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	log.Printf("[Claude] ExecuteTask started with task type: %s and model: %s", task.TaskType, model)

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": model,
		"messages": []map[string]string{
			{"role": "user", "content": task.InputContent},
		},
		"max_tokens":  task.AIRequirements.MaxOutputSize,
		"temperature": 0.7,
	}

	if task.AIRequirements.MaxOutputSize <= 0 {
		requestBody["max_tokens"] = 4096
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("x-api-key", s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	log.Printf("[Claude] sending request to Claude API...")
	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	log.Printf("[Claude] received response. Status: %d", resp.StatusCode)

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		log.Printf("[Claude] API error response: %s", string(body))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("claude API request failed with status code %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var response struct {
		Content []struct {
			Text string `json:"text"`
		} `json:"content"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &response); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	if len(response.Content) == 0 || response.Content[0].Text == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("received null or empty response from Claude API")
	}

	content := response.Content[0].Text
	log.Printf("[Claude] AI response content length: %d", len(content))

	return &AITaskResult{
		Content:  content,
		Model:    model,
		TaskType: task.TaskType,
		Status:   AITaskStatusCompleted,
	}, nil
}

// ExecuteEmbeddingTask генерация эмбеддингов не поддерживается API Claude
func (s *ClaudeService) ExecuteEmbeddingTask(ctx context.Context, inputText string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("claude does not support embedding generation")
}

// ExecuteImageAnalysisByLinkTask анализ изображений не поддерживается в данной реализации
func (s *ClaudeService) ExecuteImageAnalysisByLinkTask(ctx context.Context, inputText string, imageLink string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("claude does not support image analysis in this implementation")
}

// ExecuteSearch встроенный веб-поиск не поддерживается API Claude
func (s *ClaudeService) ExecuteSearch(ctx context.Context, query string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("claude does not support built-in web search")
}

// BeginChatWithTools начинает диалог с поддержкой tool-calling (Anthropic Messages API)
func (s *ClaudeService) BeginChatWithTools(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string, tools []ToolSchema) (*ToolChatStep, error) {
	anthTools := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
	for _, t := range tools {
		anthTools = append(anthTools, map[string]interface{}{
			"name":         t.Name,
			"description":  t.Description,
			"input_schema": t.ParametersJSONSchema,
		})
	}

	maxTokens := task.AIRequirements.MaxOutputSize
	if maxTokens <= 0 {
		maxTokens = 512
	}

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": model,
		"messages": []map[string]string{
			{"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant with access to tools."},
			{"role": "user", "content": task.InputContent},
		},
		"tools":       anthTools,
		"tool_choice": "auto",
		"max_tokens":  maxTokens,
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("x-api-key", s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		log.Printf("[Claude] BeginChatWithTools failed: %d %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("claude tool chat error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var parsed struct {
		Content []struct {
			Type    string `json:"type"`
			Text    string `json:"text"`
			ToolUse struct {
				ID    string                 `json:"id"`
				Name  string                 `json:"name"`
				Input map[string]interface{} `json:"input"`
			} `json:"tool_use"`
		} `json:"content"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &parsed); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	step := &ToolChatStep{
		SessionID: fmt.Sprintf("claude-session-%d", time.Now().UnixNano()),
		Content:   "",
		ToolCalls: []ToolCallRequest{},
		IsFinal:   true,
	}

	for _, c := range parsed.Content {
		if c.Type == "tool_use" && c.ToolUse.Name != "" {
			step.IsFinal = false
			argsJSON, _ := json.Marshal(c.ToolUse.Input)
			step.ToolCalls = append(step.ToolCalls, ToolCallRequest{
				CallID:        c.ToolUse.ID,
				ToolName:      c.ToolUse.Name,
				ArgumentsJSON: string(argsJSON),
			})
		} else if c.Type == "text" {
			step.Content += c.Text
		}
	}

	return step, nil
}

// ContinueWithToolResults продолжает диалог с результатами выполнения инструментов
func (s *ClaudeService) ContinueWithToolResults(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, model string, toolResults []ToolExecutionResult) (*ToolChatStep, error) {
	toolMsgs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(toolResults))
	for _, r := range toolResults {
		toolMsgs = append(toolMsgs, map[string]interface{}{
			"role":        "tool",
			"content":     r.ResultJSON,
			"tool_use_id": r.CallID,
		})
	}

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model":      model,
		"messages":   toolMsgs,
		"max_tokens": 512,
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("x-api-key", s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		log.Printf("[Claude] ContinueWithToolResults failed: %d %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("claude tool continue error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var parsed struct {
		Content []struct {
			Type    string `json:"type"`
			Text    string `json:"text"`
			ToolUse struct {
				ID    string                 `json:"id"`
				Name  string                 `json:"name"`
				Input map[string]interface{} `json:"input"`
			} `json:"tool_use"`
		} `json:"content"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &parsed); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	step := &ToolChatStep{
		SessionID: sessionID,
		Content:   "",
		ToolCalls: []ToolCallRequest{},
		IsFinal:   true,
	}

	for _, c := range parsed.Content {
		if c.Type == "tool_use" && c.ToolUse.Name != "" {
			step.IsFinal = false
			argsJSON, _ := json.Marshal(c.ToolUse.Input)
			step.ToolCalls = append(step.ToolCalls, ToolCallRequest{
				CallID:        c.ToolUse.ID,
				ToolName:      c.ToolUse.Name,
				ArgumentsJSON: string(argsJSON),
			})
		} else if c.Type == "text" {
			step.Content += c.Text
		}
	}

	return step, nil
}

package ai

import (
	"context"
)

// EmbeddingProvider abstracts embedding generation
type EmbeddingProvider interface {
	// ModelID returns current embedding model identifier
	ModelID() string
	// EmbedTexts returns embeddings for input texts (same dimension for all)
	EmbedTexts(ctx context.Context, texts []string) ([][]float64, error)
}

// OpenAIEmbedding wraps AITaskExecutor to generate embeddings using a configured OpenAI model
type OpenAIEmbedding struct {
	exec    *AITaskExecutor
	modelID string
}

func NewOpenAIEmbedding(exec *AITaskExecutor, modelID string) *OpenAIEmbedding {
	if modelID == "" {
		modelID = "text-embedding-3-small"
	}
	return &OpenAIEmbedding{exec: exec, modelID: modelID}
}

func (p *OpenAIEmbedding) ModelID() string { return p.modelID }

func (p *OpenAIEmbedding) EmbedTexts(ctx context.Context, texts []string) ([][]float64, error) {
	out := make([][]float64, 0, len(texts))
	for _, t := range texts {
		task := &AITask{TaskType: TaskTypeEmbeddingCalculation, InputContent: t, AIRequirements: AIRequirements{EmbeddingGenerationCapability: true, MinCapabilityScore: 1}}
		res, err := p.exec.ExecuteEmbeddingCalculationTask(ctx, task)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out = append(out, res.Embedding)
	}
	return out, nil
}

package ai

import (
	"context"

	"log"
	"strings"
