// Этот файл содержит примеры использования AI модуля

// ExampleBasicUsage демонстрирует базовое использование AI executor
func ExampleBasicUsage() {
	// Создаем model manager
	modelManager := NewAIModelManager()

	// Создаем сервисы для различных провайдеров
	openAIService := NewOpenAIService("your-openai-api-key", modelManager)
	claudeService := NewClaudeService("your-claude-api-key", modelManager)
	vertexService := NewVertexAIService("your-vertex-api-key", modelManager)

	// Создаем executor с доступными сервисами
	executor := NewAITaskExecutor(
		[]AIService{openAIService, claudeService, vertexService},
		modelManager,
	)

	// Создаем задачу
	task := &AITask{
		TaskType:     TaskTypeSummarization,
		InputContent: "Your long text to summarize here...",
		AIRequirements: AIRequirements{
			MinContextWindow:         4000,
			MaxOutputSize:            1000,
			MinCapabilityScore:       5,
			TextGenerationCapability: true,
		},
		EnableTelemetry: true,
	}

	// Выполняем задачу
	ctx := context.Background()
	result, err := executor.ExecuteTask(ctx, task)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Error executing task: %v", err)
	}

	fmt.Printf("Result from model %s:\n%s\n", result.Model, result.Content)
	fmt.Printf("Cost: $%.6f, Tokens: %d in + %d out\n",
		result.ProcessingCost, result.InputTokens, result.OutputTokens)
}

// ExampleStructuredOutput демонстрирует использование с верификатором для структурированного вывода
func ExampleStructuredOutput() {
	modelManager := NewAIModelManager()
	openAIService := NewOpenAIService("your-openai-api-key", modelManager)
	executor := NewAITaskExecutor([]AIService{openAIService}, modelManager)

	// Создаем верификатор для извлечения сущностей
	verifier := NewEntityExtractionVerifier()

	task := &AITask{
		TaskType: TaskTypeEntityExtraction,
		InputContent: `Extract entities from: "Apple Inc. announced a new iPhone in San Francisco 
		              on September 15, 2023, with CEO Tim Cook presenting."`,
		AIRequirements: AIRequirements{
			MinContextWindow:         2000,
			MaxOutputSize:            500,
			MinCapabilityScore:       7,
			TextGenerationCapability: true,
		},
		Verifier: verifier,
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	result, err := executor.ExecuteStructuredTask(ctx, task)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Error executing structured task: %v", err)
	}

	// Приводим к нужному типу
	if entities, ok := result.(EntityExtractionResult); ok {
		fmt.Printf("Extracted %d entities:\n", len(entities.Entities))
		for _, entity := range entities.Entities {
			fmt.Printf("- %s: %s (confidence: %.2f)\n",
				entity.Type, entity.Value, entity.Confidence)
		}
	}
}

// ExampleWithToolCalling демонстрирует использование с tool-calling
func ExampleWithToolCalling() {
	modelManager := NewAIModelManager()
	openAIService := NewOpenAIService("your-openai-api-key", modelManager)
	executor := NewAITaskExecutor([]AIService{openAIService}, modelManager)

	// Определяем доступные инструменты
	tools := []ToolSchema{
		{
			Name:        "get_weather",
			Description: "Get current weather for a location",
			ParametersJSONSchema: map[string]interface{}{
				"type": "object",
				"properties": map[string]interface{}{
					"location": map[string]interface{}{
						"type":        "string",
						"description": "City name",
					},
				},
				"required": []string{"location"},
			},
		},
		{
			Name:        "search_web",
			Description: "Search the web for information",
			ParametersJSONSchema: map[string]interface{}{
				"type": "object",
				"properties": map[string]interface{}{
					"query": map[string]interface{}{
						"type":        "string",
						"description": "Search query",
					},
				},
				"required": []string{"query"},
			},
		},
	}

	task := &AITask{
		TaskType:     TaskTypeContentAnalysis,
		InputContent: "What's the weather in London and find recent news about AI?",
		AIRequirements: AIRequirements{
			MinContextWindow:         4000,
			MaxOutputSize:            2000,
			MinCapabilityScore:       7,
			TextGenerationCapability: true,
		},
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	result, err := executor.ExecuteTaskWithTools(ctx, task, tools)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Error executing task with tools: %v", err)
	}

	fmt.Printf("Result: %s\n", result.Content)
	fmt.Printf("Used %d tool calls in %d iterations\n",
		len(result.ToolCalls), result.ToolCallIterations)
	for _, toolCall := range result.ToolCalls {
		fmt.Printf("- Called %s (took %dms, success: %v)\n",
			toolCall.ToolName, toolCall.DurationMs, toolCall.Success)
	}
}

// ExampleCustomVerifier демонстрирует создание кастомного верификатора
func ExampleCustomVerifier() {
	// Создаем кастомный верификатор с функцией исправления
	repairFunc := func(data map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
		// Исправляем распространенные ошибки
		if title, ok := data["title"].(string); ok {
			// Убираем лишние пробелы
			data["title"] = strings.TrimSpace(title)
		}

		// Добавляем значения по умолчанию для отсутствующих полей
		if _, ok := data["confidence"]; !ok {
			data["confidence"] = 0.5
		}

		return data, nil
	}

	validateFunc := func(data map[string]interface{}) error {
		// Проверяем обязательные поля
		if _, ok := data["title"]; !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("title is required")
		}

		// Проверяем диапазоны
		if conf, ok := data["confidence"].(float64); ok {
			if conf < 0 || conf > 1 {
				return fmt.Errorf("confidence must be between 0 and 1")
			}
		}

		return nil
	}

	verifier := NewRepairableVerifier(repairFunc, validateFunc)

	modelManager := NewAIModelManager()
	openAIService := NewOpenAIService("your-openai-api-key", modelManager)
	executor := NewAITaskExecutor([]AIService{openAIService}, modelManager)

	task := &AITask{
		TaskType:     TaskTypeContentAnalysis,
		InputContent: "Analyze this content...",
		AIRequirements: AIRequirements{
			MinContextWindow:         2000,
			MaxOutputSize:            500,
			TextGenerationCapability: true,
		},
		Verifier: verifier,
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	result, err := executor.ExecuteStructuredTask(ctx, task)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Error: %v", err)
	}

	fmt.Printf("Result: %+v\n", result)
}

			TextGenerationCapability: true,
		},

	ctx := context.Background()
	result, err := executor.ExecuteTask(ctx, task)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("Error: %v", err)
		return
	}

	// Executor автоматически попробует следующую модель при ошибке
	fmt.Printf("Successfully completed with model: %s\n", result.Model)
}

package ai

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// GrokService implements AIService for xAI Grok models (OpenAI-compatible style)
type GrokService struct {
	*BaseAIService
	apiKey     string
	httpClient *http.Client
}

func NewGrokService(apiKey string, modelManager *AIModelManager) *GrokService {
	// Sanitize API key to avoid invalid header values
	sanitizedKey := strings.TrimSpace(apiKey)
	sanitizedKey = strings.Trim(sanitizedKey, "\"'")
	return &GrokService{
		BaseAIService: NewBaseAIService(modelManager),
		apiKey:        sanitizedKey,
		httpClient:    &http.Client{Timeout: 180 * time.Second},
	}
}

func (s *GrokService) Provider() AIProvider { return AIProviderGrok }

func (s *GrokService) ExecuteTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	if task == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("task cannot be nil")
	}
	log.Printf("[Grok] ExecuteTask: %s, model=%s", task.TaskType, model)

	reqBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model":    model,
		"messages": []map[string]string{{"role": "user", "content": task.InputContent}},
	}
	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Grok uses OpenAI-compatible endpoint
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	b, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("grok API error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(b))
	}

	var parsed struct {
		Choices []struct {
			Message struct {
				Content string `json:"content"`
			} `json:"message"`
		} `json:"choices"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &parsed); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(parsed.Choices) == 0 || parsed.Choices[0].Message.Content == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty response from Grok")
	}

	return &AITaskResult{Content: parsed.Choices[0].Message.Content, Model: model, TaskType: task.TaskType, Status: AITaskStatusCompleted}, nil
}

func (s *GrokService) ExecuteEmbeddingTask(ctx context.Context, inputText string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("grok embeddings not supported")
}

func (s *GrokService) ExecuteImageAnalysisByLinkTask(ctx context.Context, inputText string, imageLink string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("grok image analysis not supported")
}

func (s *GrokService) ExecuteSearch(ctx context.Context, query string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	if query == "" || modelName == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query and modelName are required")
	}

	// Many Grok deployments expose OpenAI-compatible chat completions with live search
	reqBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": modelName,
		// xAI Grok supports live search; request it explicitly using search parameter
		"search": map[string]interface{}{
			"enable":  true,
			"sources": []map[string]string{{"type": "web"}},
		},
		"messages": []map[string]string{{"role": "user", "content": query}},
	}
	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	b, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("grok search error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(b))
	}

	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Extract content
	content := ""
	if choices, ok := root["choices"].([]interface{}); ok && len(choices) > 0 {
		if choice, ok := choices[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if message, ok := choice["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if ctoken, ok := message["content"]; ok {
					switch v := ctoken.(type) {
					case string:
						content = v
					case []interface{}:
						// concatenate text parts if content is array
						parts := make([]string, 0, len(v))
						for _, p := range v {
							if mp, ok := p.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								if t, ok := mp["text"].(string); ok && t != "" {
									parts = append(parts, t)
								}
							}
						}
						if len(parts) > 0 {
							content = strings.Join(parts, "\n")
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if content == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty content in Grok Search response")
	}

	// Normalize citations
	var citations []WebCitation
	if choices, ok := root["choices"].([]interface{}); ok && len(choices) > 0 {
		if choice, ok := choices[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if message, ok := choice["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				// annotations.url_citation-like structure
				if anns, ok := message["annotations"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, a := range anns {
						if am, ok := a.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							if am["type"] == "url_citation" {
								if uc, ok := am["url_citation"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									url, _ := uc["url"].(string)
									title, _ := uc["title"].(string)
									si := -1
									if v, ok := uc["start_index"].(float64); ok {
										si = int(v)
									}
									ei := -1
									if v, ok := uc["end_index"].(float64); ok {
										ei = int(v)
									}
									citations = append(citations, WebCitation{URL: url, Title: title, StartIndex: si, EndIndex: ei})
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				// fallback generic references array
				if refs, ok := message["references"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, r := range refs {
						if rm, ok := r.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							url := ""
							if u, ok := rm["url"].(string); ok {
								url = u
							} else if u, ok := rm["href"].(string); ok {
								url = u
							}
							title, _ := rm["title"].(string)
							citations = append(citations, WebCitation{URL: url, Title: title, StartIndex: -1, EndIndex: -1})
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return &AITaskResult{Content: content, Model: modelName, TaskType: TaskTypeSearch, Status: AITaskStatusCompleted, Citations: citations}, nil
}

// Package ai defines interfaces for AI services.
package ai

import "context"

// AITaskResultVerifier базовый интерфейс для верификатора результатов AI-задач
type AITaskResultVerifier interface {
	// VerifyAndParse проверяет и парсит сырой JSON-ответ от AI
	// Возвращает распарсенный объект или ошибку, если верификация/парсинг не удались
	VerifyAndParse(rawJSON string) (interface{}, error)
}

// AITaskResultVerifierTyped generic-интерфейс для верификатора с строгой типизацией
type AITaskResultVerifierTyped[T any] interface {
	AITaskResultVerifier
	// VerifyAndParseTyped проверяет и парсит сырой JSON-ответ от AI в строго типизированный объект
	VerifyAndParseTyped(rawJSON string) (T, error)
}

// AIService представляет универсальный интерфейс для сервисов AI
type AIService interface {
	// Provider возвращает идентификатор провайдера (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini и т.д.)
	Provider() AIProvider

	// ExecuteTask выполняет основную задачу по обработке текста (генерация, анализ, чат)
	ExecuteTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string) (*AITaskResult, error)

	// ExecuteEmbeddingTask выполняет задачу по вычислению векторного представления
	ExecuteEmbeddingTask(ctx context.Context, inputText string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error)

	// ExecuteImageAnalysisByLinkTask выполняет задачу по анализу изображения по ссылке
	ExecuteImageAnalysisByLinkTask(ctx context.Context, inputText string, imageLink string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error)

	// ExecuteSearch выполняет поисковый запрос с помощью встроенных возможностей модели
	ExecuteSearch(ctx context.Context, query string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error)
}

// ToolCallingAIService расширенный интерфейс для сервисов с поддержкой tool-calling
type ToolCallingAIService interface {
	AIService

	// BeginChatWithTools начинает диалог с поддержкой tool-calling
	BeginChatWithTools(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string, tools []ToolSchema) (*ToolChatStep, error)

	// ContinueWithToolResults продолжает диалог с результатами выполнения инструментов
	ContinueWithToolResults(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, model string, toolResults []ToolExecutionResult) (*ToolChatStep, error)
}

package ai

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

// AIModelManager управляет реестром доступных AI-моделей, их характеристиками и ценами.
// Предоставляет логику для выбора оптимальной модели на основе требований задачи.
type AIModelManager struct {
	models map[string]AIModelCapabilities
}

// NewAIModelManager создает новый экземпляр AIModelManager с предустановленным реестром моделей
func NewAIModelManager() *AIModelManager {
	mm := &AIModelManager{
		models: make(map[string]AIModelCapabilities),
	}
	mm.initializeModels()
	log.Printf("Initialized AIModelManager with %d models", len(mm.models))
	return mm
}

// initializeModels инициализирует реестр моделей с их характеристиками
func (mm *AIModelManager) initializeModels() {

// SelectModel выбирает оптимальную модель на основе требований
func (mm *AIModelManager) SelectModel(requirements AIRequirements, inputTokens int, excludeModels []string, preferNearlyRealTime bool) string {
	// Нормализация взаимоисключающих флагов
	mm.normalizeCapabilities(&requirements)

	log.Printf("AIModelManager SelectModel called with requirements: MinContextWindow=%d, InputTokens=%d, PreferNearlyRealTime=%v, MinCapabilityScore=%d",
		requirements.MinContextWindow, inputTokens, preferNearlyRealTime, requirements.MinCapabilityScore)

	if excludeModels == nil {
		excludeModels = []string{}
	}

	// Минимально необходимый размер контекстного окна
	requiredContextWindow := max(requirements.MinContextWindow, inputTokens)

	// Если поиск не требуется, исключаем модели со встроенным поиском
	searchRequired := requirements.BuiltInSearchCapability
	// Требование на Search Grounding (Vertex/Gemini)
	groundingRequired := requirements.SearchGroundingCapability

	// Фильтруем модели по всем критериям
	type modelCandidate struct {
		name  string
		model AIModelCapabilities
	}

	var capableModels []modelCandidate

	for name, m := range mm.models {
		// Проверка всех критериев
		if m.ContextWindow < requiredContextWindow {
			continue
		}
		if contains(excludeModels, name) {
			continue
		}
		if preferNearlyRealTime && !m.NearlyRealTime {
			continue
		}
		if m.CapabilityScore < requirements.MinCapabilityScore {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.TextGenerationCapability && !m.TextGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.ImageGenerationCapability && !m.ImageGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability && !m.EmbeddingGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.ImageAnalysisCapability && !m.ImageAnalysisCapability {
			continue
		}
		// Логика для классического веб-поиска: либо требуется и модель поддерживает, либо не требуется и модель не поддерживает
		if (searchRequired && !m.BuiltInSearchCapability) || (!searchRequired && m.BuiltInSearchCapability) {
			continue
		}
		// Если требуется Grounding, отбираем только модели с поддержкой Grounding
		if groundingRequired && !m.SearchGroundingCapability {
			continue
		}

		capableModels = append(capableModels, modelCandidate{name: name, model: m})
	}

	// Отдаём приоритет более дешёвым моделям
	sort.Slice(capableModels, func(i, j int) bool {
		return capableModels[i].model.PricePerOutputToken < capableModels[j].model.PricePerOutputToken
	})

	if len(capableModels) > 0 {
		selected := capableModels[0].name
		log.Printf("AIModelManager selected model: %s", selected)
		return selected
	}

	// Если ничего не найдено, пробуем найти модель с самым большим окном, игнорируя размер входа
	var largestModel *modelCandidate
	maxContextWindow := 0

	for name, m := range mm.models {
		if contains(excludeModels, name) {
			continue
		}
		if preferNearlyRealTime && !m.NearlyRealTime {
			continue
		}
		if m.CapabilityScore < requirements.MinCapabilityScore {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.TextGenerationCapability && !m.TextGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.ImageGenerationCapability && !m.ImageGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability && !m.EmbeddingGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.ImageAnalysisCapability && !m.ImageAnalysisCapability {
			continue
		}
		if (searchRequired && !m.BuiltInSearchCapability) || (!searchRequired && m.BuiltInSearchCapability) {
			continue
		}
		if groundingRequired && !m.SearchGroundingCapability {
			continue
		}

		if m.ContextWindow > maxContextWindow {
			maxContextWindow = m.ContextWindow
			largestModel = &modelCandidate{name: name, model: m}
		}
	}

	if largestModel != nil {
		log.Printf("No model can handle full input. Selected largest model: %s", largestModel.name)
		return largestModel.name
	}

	log.Printf("AIModelManager: No suitable AI model found after applying all filters.")
	return ""
}

// SelectFallbackModel выбирает резервную модель. Логика идентична основному выбору, но с учётом уже опробованных моделей
func (mm *AIModelManager) SelectFallbackModel(requirements AIRequirements, inputTokens int, excludeModels []string) string {
	const MaxFallbacks = 4 // allow initial try + up to 4 fallbacks
	if len(excludeModels) >= MaxFallbacks {
		log.Printf("AIModelManager: fallback limit reached (%d). Returning empty string to stop further attempts.", MaxFallbacks)
		return ""
	}

	return mm.SelectModel(requirements, inputTokens, excludeModels, false)
}

// SelectToolCallingModel выбирает оптимальную модель с поддержкой tool-calling
func (mm *AIModelManager) SelectToolCallingModel(requirements AIRequirements, inputTokens int, excludeModels []string, preferNearlyRealTime bool) string {
	// Нормализация флагов
	mm.normalizeCapabilities(&requirements)

	if excludeModels == nil {
		excludeModels = []string{}
	}
	requiredContextWindow := max(requirements.MinContextWindow, inputTokens)
	searchRequired := requirements.BuiltInSearchCapability

	type modelCandidate struct {
		name  string
		model AIModelCapabilities
	}

	var capableModels []modelCandidate

	for name, m := range mm.models {
		if m.ContextWindow < requiredContextWindow {
			continue
		}
		if contains(excludeModels, name) {
			continue
		}
		if preferNearlyRealTime && !m.NearlyRealTime {
			continue
		}
		if m.CapabilityScore < requirements.MinCapabilityScore {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.TextGenerationCapability && !m.TextGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.ImageGenerationCapability && !m.ImageGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability && !m.EmbeddingGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.ImageAnalysisCapability && !m.ImageAnalysisCapability {
			continue
		}
		if searchRequired && !m.BuiltInSearchCapability {
			continue
		}
		if !m.SupportsToolCalling {
			continue
		}

		capableModels = append(capableModels, modelCandidate{name: name, model: m})
	}

	sort.Slice(capableModels, func(i, j int) bool {
		return capableModels[i].model.PricePerOutputToken < capableModels[j].model.PricePerOutputToken
	})

	if len(capableModels) > 0 {
		selected := capableModels[0].name
		log.Printf("AIModelManager selected tool-calling model: %s", selected)
		return selected
	}

	// Fallback к наибольшей модели с tool-calling
	var largestModel *modelCandidate
	maxContextWindow := 0

	for name, m := range mm.models {
		if contains(excludeModels, name) {
			continue
		}
		if preferNearlyRealTime && !m.NearlyRealTime {
			continue
		}
		if m.CapabilityScore < requirements.MinCapabilityScore {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.TextGenerationCapability && !m.TextGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.ImageGenerationCapability && !m.ImageGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability && !m.EmbeddingGenerationCapability {
			continue
		}
		if requirements.ImageAnalysisCapability && !m.ImageAnalysisCapability {
			continue
		}
		if searchRequired && !m.BuiltInSearchCapability {
			continue
		}
		if !m.SupportsToolCalling {
			continue
		}

		if m.ContextWindow > maxContextWindow {
			maxContextWindow = m.ContextWindow
			largestModel = &modelCandidate{name: name, model: m}
		}
	}

	if largestModel != nil {
		log.Printf("No tool-calling model can handle full input. Selected largest tool-calling model: %s", largestModel.name)
		return largestModel.name
	}

	log.Printf("AIModelManager: No suitable tool-calling AI model found after applying all filters.")
	return ""
}

// SelectFallbackToolCallingModel резервный выбор для tool-calling с учётом уже опробованных моделей
func (mm *AIModelManager) SelectFallbackToolCallingModel(requirements AIRequirements, inputTokens int, excludeModels []string) string {
	const MaxFallbacks = 4
	if len(excludeModels) >= MaxFallbacks {
		log.Printf("AIModelManager: tool-calling fallback limit reached (%d). Returning empty string.", MaxFallbacks)
		return ""
	}
	return mm.SelectToolCallingModel(requirements, inputTokens, excludeModels, false)
}

// CalculateProcessingCost рассчитывает примерную стоимость выполнения задачи
func (mm *AIModelManager) CalculateProcessingCost(modelName string, inputTokens int, outputTokens int) (float64, error) {
	if capabilities, ok := mm.models[modelName]; ok {
		// For Gemini models, apply tiered pricing based on token thresholds
		if capabilities.Provider == AIProviderGemini {
			return mm.calculateGeminiCost(modelName, inputTokens, outputTokens, capabilities)
		}
		inputCost := float64(inputTokens) * capabilities.PricePerInputToken
		outputCost := float64(outputTokens) * capabilities.PricePerOutputToken
		return inputCost + outputCost, nil
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("model %s not found", modelName)
}

// calculateGeminiCost calculates cost for Gemini models with tiered pricing
// Gemini pricing typically has tiers: first 128K tokens at one rate, after 128K at a different rate
func (mm *AIModelManager) calculateGeminiCost(modelName string, inputTokens int, outputTokens int, capabilities AIModelCapabilities) (float64, error) {
	const geminiTierThreshold = 128000 // 128K tokens threshold

	// Base prices (first tier, up to 128K tokens)
	// Gemini pricing has tiers: first 128K tokens at full price, after 128K at 50% discount
	// Prices from model_manager.go (these are max prices for first tier)
	// For Gemini 2.5 Flash: $0.30/$2.50 per 1M tokens (input/output) for first 128K
	// For Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite: $0.10/$0.41 per 1M tokens (input/output) for first 128K
	// For Gemini 2.5 Pro: $2.50/$15.00 per 1M tokens (input/output) for first 128K

	// After 128K threshold: 50% discount
	var inputPriceTier1, inputPriceTier2, outputPriceTier1, outputPriceTier2 float64

	// Check more specific models first (flash-lite before flash, pro before other)
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(modelName, "gemini-2.5-flash-lite"):
		// Most specific: flash-lite (cheapest)
		inputPriceTier1 = 0.00000010   // $0.10 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
		inputPriceTier2 = 0.00000005   // $0.05 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
		outputPriceTier1 = 0.00000041  // $0.41 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
		outputPriceTier2 = 0.000000205 // $0.205 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
	case strings.Contains(modelName, "gemini-2.5-pro"):
		// Pro model (most expensive)
		inputPriceTier1 = 0.00000250  // $2.50 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
		inputPriceTier2 = 0.00000125  // $1.25 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
		outputPriceTier1 = 0.00001500 // $15.00 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
		outputPriceTier2 = 0.00000750 // $7.50 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
	case strings.Contains(modelName, "gemini-2.5-flash"):
		// Flash (default/middle tier)
		inputPriceTier1 = 0.00000030  // $0.30 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
		inputPriceTier2 = 0.00000015  // $0.15 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
		outputPriceTier1 = 0.00000250 // $2.50 / 1M (from model_manager.go)
		outputPriceTier2 = 0.00000125 // $1.25 / 1M (50% discount after threshold)
	default:
		// Fallback to capabilities prices if model not specifically matched
		inputPriceTier1 = capabilities.PricePerInputToken
		inputPriceTier2 = capabilities.PricePerInputToken * 0.5
		outputPriceTier1 = capabilities.PricePerOutputToken
		outputPriceTier2 = capabilities.PricePerOutputToken * 0.5
	}

	// Calculate input cost with tiered pricing
	var inputCost float64
	if inputTokens <= geminiTierThreshold {
		inputCost = float64(inputTokens) * inputPriceTier1
	} else {
		inputCost = float64(geminiTierThreshold)*inputPriceTier1 + float64(inputTokens-geminiTierThreshold)*inputPriceTier2
	}

	// Calculate output cost with tiered pricing
	var outputCost float64
	if outputTokens <= geminiTierThreshold {
		outputCost = float64(outputTokens) * outputPriceTier1
	} else {
		outputCost = float64(geminiTierThreshold)*outputPriceTier1 + float64(outputTokens-geminiTierThreshold)*outputPriceTier2
	}

	return inputCost + outputCost, nil
}

// GetModelCapabilities возвращает характеристики указанной модели
func (mm *AIModelManager) GetModelCapabilities(modelName string) (AIModelCapabilities, error) {
	if capabilities, ok := mm.models[modelName]; ok {
		return capabilities, nil
	}
	return AIModelCapabilities{}, fmt.Errorf("model %s not found", modelName)
}

// normalizeCapabilities приводит флаги требуемых возможностей в консистентное состояние
func (mm *AIModelManager) normalizeCapabilities(requirements *AIRequirements) {
	// Поиск может сочетаться с генерацией текста
	if requirements.BuiltInSearchCapability {
		if !requirements.ImageAnalysisCapability &&
			!requirements.TextGenerationCapability &&
			!requirements.ImageGenerationCapability &&
			!requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability {
			requirements.TextGenerationCapability = true
		}
	}

	// Обработка взаимоисключающих флагов
	if requirements.ImageAnalysisCapability {
		requirements.TextGenerationCapability = false
		requirements.ImageGenerationCapability = false
		requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability = false
	} else if requirements.TextGenerationCapability {
		requirements.ImageGenerationCapability = false
		requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability = false
	} else if requirements.ImageGenerationCapability {
		requirements.TextGenerationCapability = false
		requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability = false
	} else if requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability {
		requirements.TextGenerationCapability = false
		requirements.ImageGenerationCapability = false
	} else if !requirements.BuiltInSearchCapability {
		// Если ничего не выбрано (и поиск не нужен), по умолчанию ставим генерацию текста
		requirements.TextGenerationCapability = true
		requirements.ImageGenerationCapability = false
		requirements.EmbeddingGenerationCapability = false
		requirements.ImageAnalysisCapability = false
	}
}

// Вспомогательные функции
func max(a, b int) int {
	if a > b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func contains(slice []string, item string) bool {
	for _, s := range slice {
		if s == item {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

	ToolUseProtocolNone      ToolUseProtocol = "None"

// AIRequirements определяет требования к AI-модели для выполнения конкретной задачи
type AIRequirements struct {
	// PreferredModel предпочтительная модель для выполнения задачи
	PreferredModel string `json:"preferredModel,omitempty"`

	// FallbackModels список резервных моделей, если предпочтительная недоступна
	FallbackModels []string `json:"fallbackModels,omitempty"`

	// MinContextWindow минимально требуемый размер контекстного окна в токенах
	MinContextWindow int `json:"minContextWindow"`

	// MaxOutputSize максимальный желаемый размер ответа в токенах
	MaxOutputSize int `json:"maxOutputSize"`

	// MinCapabilityScore минимальная условная оценка возможностей модели
	MinCapabilityScore int `json:"minCapabilityScore"`

	// TextGenerationCapability требуется возможность генерации текста
	TextGenerationCapability bool `json:"textGenerationCapability"`

	// ImageGenerationCapability требуется возможность генерации изображений
	ImageGenerationCapability bool `json:"imageGenerationCapability"`

	// EmbeddingGenerationCapability требуется возможность вычисления эмбеддингов
	EmbeddingGenerationCapability bool `json:"embeddingGenerationCapability"`

	// ImageAnalysisCapability требуется возможность анализа изображений
	ImageAnalysisCapability bool `json:"imageAnalysisCapability"`

	// BuiltInSearchCapability требуется модель со встроенной функцией веб-поиска
	BuiltInSearchCapability bool `json:"builtInSearchCapability"`

	// SearchGroundingCapability требуется модель с поддержкой Google Search Grounding (Vertex/Gemini)
	SearchGroundingCapability bool `json:"searchGroundingCapability"`
}

// AIModelCapabilities описывает технические и коммерческие характеристики конкретной AI-модели
type AIModelCapabilities struct {
	// Name имя модели, используемое в API-запросах
	Name string

	// ContextWindow максимальный размер контекстного окна в токенах
	ContextWindow int

	// OutputTokens максимальный размер генерируемого ответа в токенах
	OutputTokens int

	// PricePerInputToken стоимость одного входного токена в USD
	PricePerInputToken float64

	// PricePerOutputToken стоимость одного выходного токена в USD
	PricePerOutputToken float64

	// Provider провайдер, предоставляющий данную модель
	Provider AIProvider

	// MaxTokensPerMinute ограничение на количество токенов в минуту
	MaxTokensPerMinute int

	// MaxTokensPerDay ограничение на количество токенов в день
	MaxTokensPerDay int

	// NearlyRealTime флаг, указывающий, что модель работает с низкой задержкой
	NearlyRealTime bool

	// CapabilityScore условная оценка общих возможностей модели (например, по шкале от 1 до 10)
	CapabilityScore int

	// TextGenerationCapability поддерживает ли модель генерацию текста
	TextGenerationCapability bool

	// ImageGenerationCapability поддерживает ли модель генерацию изображений
	ImageGenerationCapability bool

	// EmbeddingGenerationCapability поддерживает ли модель вычисление векторных представлений
	EmbeddingGenerationCapability bool

	// ImageAnalysisCapability поддерживает ли модель анализ изображений
	ImageAnalysisCapability bool

	// BuiltInSearchCapability поддерживает ли модель встроенную функцию веб-поиска
	BuiltInSearchCapability bool

	// SearchGroundingCapability поддерживает ли модель Search Grounding (Gemini/Vertex)
	SearchGroundingCapability bool

	// SupportsToolCalling поддерживает ли модель function/tool-calling
	SupportsToolCalling bool

	// SupportsMcp предполагается ли использование MCP при tool-calling
	SupportsMcp bool

	// ToolUseProtocol какой протокол tool-use должен применяться при обращении к этой модели
	ToolUseProtocol ToolUseProtocol
}

// AITask представляет собой инкапсулированную задачу для выполнения AI-сервисом
type AITask struct {
	// TaskType тип выполняемой задачи
	TaskType TaskType `json:"taskType"`

	// InputContent входные данные для задачи в виде строки
	InputContent string `json:"inputContent"`

	// AIRequirements требования к AI-модели для выполнения этой задачи
	AIRequirements AIRequirements `json:"aiRequirements"`

	// Verifier опциональный верификатор, который определяет, является ли ответ от AI валидным
	Verifier AITaskResultVerifier `json:"-"`

	// EnableTelemetry включает автоматическую отправку телеметрии (по умолчанию true)
	EnableTelemetry bool `json:"enableTelemetry"`

	// TenantID мультиарендность для телеметрии
	TenantID string `json:"tenantId,omitempty"`

	// UserID идентификатор пользователя для телеметрии и usage tracking
	UserID string `json:"userId,omitempty"`

	// Environment окружение для телеметрии
	Environment string `json:"environment,omitempty"`

	// Project проект для телеметрии и usage tracking
	Project string `json:"project,omitempty"`

	// SessionID идентификатор сессии для телеметрии
	SessionID string `json:"sessionId,omitempty"`

	// TraceID идентификатор трассировки для телеметрии
	TraceID string `json:"traceId,omitempty"`

	// SpanID идентификатор спана для телеметрии
	SpanID string `json:"spanId,omitempty"`
}

// WebCitation представляет ссылку на веб-источник
type WebCitation struct {
	URL        string `json:"url"`
	Title      string `json:"title"`
	StartIndex int    `json:"startIndex"`
	EndIndex   int    `json:"endIndex"`
}

// ToolCallRecord журнал вызова инструмента
type ToolCallRecord struct {
	CallID        string `json:"callId"`
	ToolName      string `json:"toolName"`
	ArgumentsJSON string `json:"argumentsJson"`
	ResultJSON    string `json:"resultJson,omitempty"`
	DurationMs    int    `json:"durationMs"`
	Success       bool   `json:"success"`
	ErrorMessage  string `json:"errorMessage,omitempty"`
}

// AITaskResult представляет стандартизированный результат выполнения задачи AI
type AITaskResult struct {
	// Content основной текстовый результат, сгенерированный моделью
	Content string `json:"content"`

	// Model имя модели, которая выполнила задачу
	Model string `json:"model"`

	// TaskType тип выполненной задачи
	TaskType TaskType `json:"taskType"`

	// Status статус выполнения (успех или ошибка)
	Status AITaskStatus `json:"status"`

	// InputTokens количество токенов во входном запросе
	InputTokens int `json:"inputTokens"`

	// OutputTokens количество токенов в сгенерированном ответе
	OutputTokens int `json:"outputTokens"`

	// ProcessingCost расчетная стоимость выполнения задачи в USD
	ProcessingCost float64 `json:"processingCost"`

	// ProcessingTime время, затраченное на выполнение задачи
	ProcessingTime time.Duration `json:"processingTime"`

	// Embedding векторное представление (эмбеддинг), если задачей было его вычисление
	Embedding []float64 `json:"embedding,omitempty"`

	// Citations список ссылок на веб-источники, использованных моделью при поиске
	Citations []WebCitation `json:"citations,omitempty"`

	// UsedToolCalling был ли использован режим tool/function-calling
	UsedToolCalling bool `json:"usedToolCalling"`

	// ToolUseProtocol протокол tool-use, применённый провайдером
	ToolUseProtocol ToolUseProtocol `json:"toolUseProtocol"`

	// ToolCallIterations количество итераций цикла tool-calls
	ToolCallIterations int `json:"toolCallIterations"`

	// ToolCalls журнал вызовов инструментов
	ToolCalls []ToolCallRecord `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`

	// FinishReason причина завершения
	FinishReason string `json:"finishReason,omitempty"`
}

package ai

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// OpenAIService реализация IAIService для работы с моделями от OpenAI
// Поддерживает чат, эмбеддинги, анализ изображений и встроенный поиск
type OpenAIService struct {
	*BaseAIService
	apiKey     string
	httpClient *http.Client
}

// NewOpenAIService создает новый экземпляр OpenAIService
func NewOpenAIService(apiKey string, modelManager *AIModelManager) *OpenAIService {
	// Sanitize API key to avoid invalid header values (e.g., trailing newlines/quotes)
	sanitizedKey := strings.TrimSpace(apiKey)
	sanitizedKey = strings.Trim(sanitizedKey, "\"'")
	return &OpenAIService{
		BaseAIService: NewBaseAIService(modelManager),
		apiKey:        sanitizedKey,
		httpClient: &http.Client{
			Timeout: 120 * time.Second,
		},
	}
}

// Provider возвращает идентификатор провайдера
func (s *OpenAIService) Provider() AIProvider {
	return AIProviderOpenAI
}

// ExecuteTask выполняет текстовую задачу с помощью Chat Completions API
func (s *OpenAIService) ExecuteTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	if task == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("task cannot be nil")
	}

	log.Printf("[OpenAI] ExecuteTask: type=%s, model=%s", task.TaskType, model)

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": model,
		"messages": []map[string]string{
			{"role": "user", "content": task.InputContent},
		},
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("OpenAI API error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var response struct {
		Choices []struct {
			Message struct {
				Content string `json:"content"`
			} `json:"message"`
		} `json:"choices"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &response); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	if len(response.Choices) == 0 || response.Choices[0].Message.Content == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty response from OpenAI Chat API")
	}

	content := response.Choices[0].Message.Content

	return &AITaskResult{
		Content:  content,
		Model:    model,
		TaskType: task.TaskType,
		Status:   AITaskStatusCompleted,
	}, nil
}

// ExecuteEmbeddingTask генерирует векторное представление (эмбеддинг) для текста
func (s *OpenAIService) ExecuteEmbeddingTask(ctx context.Context, inputText string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	log.Printf("[OpenAI] ExecuteEmbeddingTask called. model=%s, length=%d", modelName, len(inputText))

	caps, err := s.ModelManager.GetModelCapabilities(modelName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !caps.EmbeddingGenerationCapability {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("model %s does not support embedding generation", modelName)
	}

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": modelName,
		"input": inputText,
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("OpenAI API error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var response struct {
		Data []struct {
			Embedding []float64 `json:"embedding"`
		} `json:"data"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &response); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	if len(response.Data) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty embedding response from OpenAI Embeddings API")
	}

	embeddingVector := response.Data[0].Embedding

	inputT := len(inputText) / 4
	outputT := 0
	cost, _ := s.ModelManager.CalculateProcessingCost(modelName, inputT, outputT)

	return &AITaskResult{
		Model:          modelName,
		TaskType:       TaskTypeEmbeddingCalculation,
		Status:         AITaskStatusCompleted,
		InputTokens:    inputT,
		OutputTokens:   outputT,
		ProcessingCost: cost,
		Embedding:      embeddingVector,
	}, nil
}

// ExecuteSearch выполняет веб-поиск с помощью встроенных возможностей модели
func (s *OpenAIService) ExecuteSearch(ctx context.Context, query string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	if query == "" || modelName == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query and modelName are required")
	}

	caps, err := s.ModelManager.GetModelCapabilities(modelName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !caps.BuiltInSearchCapability {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("model %s does not support built-in web search", modelName)
	}

	log.Printf("[OpenAI] ExecuteSearch. model=%s, q=\"%s\"", modelName, query)

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model":              modelName,
		"web_search_options": map[string]interface{}{},
		"messages": []map[string]string{
			{"role": "user", "content": query},
		},
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	log.Printf("[OpenAI] Search HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("OpenAI Search API error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	// Extract content
	content := ""
	if choices, ok := root["choices"].([]interface{}); ok && len(choices) > 0 {
		if choice, ok := choices[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if message, ok := choice["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if contentToken, ok := message["content"]; ok {
					// content может быть строкой или массивом
					switch v := contentToken.(type) {
					case string:
						content = v
					case []interface{}:
						var parts []string
						for _, p := range v {
							if pMap, ok := p.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								if text, ok := pMap["text"].(string); ok && text != "" {
									parts = append(parts, text)
								}
							}
						}
						content = strings.Join(parts, "\n")
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	if content == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty content in Search response")
	}

	// Extract citations
	var citations []WebCitation
	if choices, ok := root["choices"].([]interface{}); ok && len(choices) > 0 {
		if choice, ok := choices[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if message, ok := choice["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				// annotations.url_citation
				if annotations, ok := message["annotations"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, ann := range annotations {
						if annMap, ok := ann.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							if annType, ok := annMap["type"].(string); ok && annType == "url_citation" {
								if urlCitation, ok := annMap["url_citation"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									url := ""
									title := ""
									startIndex := -1
									endIndex := -1
									if u, ok := urlCitation["url"].(string); ok {
										url = u
									}
									if t, ok := urlCitation["title"].(string); ok {
										title = t
									}
									if si, ok := urlCitation["start_index"].(float64); ok {
										startIndex = int(si)
									}
									if ei, ok := urlCitation["end_index"].(float64); ok {
										endIndex = int(ei)
									}
									citations = append(citations, WebCitation{
										URL:        url,
										Title:      title,
										StartIndex: startIndex,
										EndIndex:   endIndex,
									})
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			// fallback: citations/references at choice level
			if cits, ok := choice["citations"].([]interface{}); ok {
				for _, c := range cits {
					if cMap, ok := c.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						url := ""
						title := ""
						if u, ok := cMap["url"].(string); ok {
							url = u
						} else if u, ok := cMap["href"].(string); ok {
							url = u
						}
						if t, ok := cMap["title"].(string); ok {
							title = t
						}
						citations = append(citations, WebCitation{
							URL:        url,
							Title:      title,
							StartIndex: -1,
							EndIndex:   -1,
						})
					}
				}
			}

			if refs, ok := choice["references"].([]interface{}); ok {
				for _, r := range refs {
					if rMap, ok := r.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						url := ""
						title := ""
						if u, ok := rMap["url"].(string); ok {
							url = u
						} else if u, ok := rMap["href"].(string); ok {
							url = u
						}
						if t, ok := rMap["title"].(string); ok {
							title = t
						}
						citations = append(citations, WebCitation{
							URL:        url,
							Title:      title,
							StartIndex: -1,
							EndIndex:   -1,
						})
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return &AITaskResult{
		Content:   content,
		Model:     modelName,
		TaskType:  TaskTypeSearch,
		Status:    AITaskStatusCompleted,
		Citations: citations,
	}, nil
}

// BeginChatWithTools начинает диалог с поддержкой tool-calling
func (s *OpenAIService) BeginChatWithTools(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string, tools []ToolSchema) (*ToolChatStep, error) {
	openAITools := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
	for _, t := range tools {
		openAITools = append(openAITools, map[string]interface{}{
			"type": "function",
			"function": map[string]interface{}{
				"name":        t.Name,
				"description": t.Description,
				"parameters":  t.ParametersJSONSchema,
			},
		})
	}

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": model,
		"messages": []map[string]string{
			{"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant with access to tools."},
			{"role": "user", "content": task.InputContent},
		},
		"tools":       openAITools,
		"tool_choice": "auto",
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		log.Printf("[OpenAI] BeginChatWithTools failed: %d %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("OpenAI tool chat error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var completion struct {
		Choices []struct {
			Message struct {
				Role      string `json:"role"`
				Content   string `json:"content"`
				ToolCalls []struct {
					ID       string `json:"id"`
					Type     string `json:"type"`
					Function struct {
						Name      string `json:"name"`
						Arguments string `json:"arguments"`
					} `json:"function"`
				} `json:"tool_calls"`
			} `json:"message"`
		} `json:"choices"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &completion); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	step := &ToolChatStep{
		SessionID: fmt.Sprintf("openai-session-%d", time.Now().UnixNano()),
		Content:   "",
		ToolCalls: []ToolCallRequest{},
		IsFinal:   true,
	}

	if len(completion.Choices) > 0 {
		msg := completion.Choices[0].Message
		step.Content = msg.Content
		if len(msg.ToolCalls) > 0 {
			step.IsFinal = false
			for _, call := range msg.ToolCalls {
				if call.Function.Name == "" {
					continue
				}
				step.ToolCalls = append(step.ToolCalls, ToolCallRequest{
					CallID:        call.ID,
					ToolName:      call.Function.Name,
					ArgumentsJSON: call.Function.Arguments,
				})
			}
		}
	}

	return step, nil
}

// ContinueWithToolResults продолжает диалог с результатами выполнения инструментов
func (s *OpenAIService) ContinueWithToolResults(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, model string, toolResults []ToolExecutionResult) (*ToolChatStep, error) {
	// Reconstruct prior assistant tool_calls and append tool results
	assistantToolCalls := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(toolResults))
	for _, r := range toolResults {
		args := r.RequestedArgumentsJSON
		if args == "" {
			args = "{}"
		}
		assistantToolCalls = append(assistantToolCalls, map[string]interface{}{
			"id":   r.CallID,
			"type": "function",
			"function": map[string]interface{}{
				"name":      r.ToolName,
				"arguments": args,
			},
		})
	}

	messages := []map[string]interface{}{
		{
			"role":       "assistant",
			"content":    nil,
			"tool_calls": assistantToolCalls,
		},
	}

	for _, r := range toolResults {
		messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
			"role":         "tool",
			"tool_call_id": r.CallID,
			"content":      r.ResultJSON,
		})
	}

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model":    model,
		"messages": messages,
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		log.Printf("[OpenAI] ContinueWithToolResults failed: %d %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("OpenAI tool continue error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var completion struct {
		Choices []struct {
			Message struct {
				Role      string `json:"role"`
				Content   string `json:"content"`
				ToolCalls []struct {
					ID       string `json:"id"`
					Type     string `json:"type"`
					Function struct {
						Name      string `json:"name"`
						Arguments string `json:"arguments"`
					} `json:"function"`
				} `json:"tool_calls"`
			} `json:"message"`
		} `json:"choices"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &completion); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	step := &ToolChatStep{
		SessionID: sessionID,
		Content:   "",
		ToolCalls: []ToolCallRequest{},
		IsFinal:   true,
	}

	if len(completion.Choices) > 0 {
		msg := completion.Choices[0].Message
		step.Content = msg.Content
		if len(msg.ToolCalls) > 0 {
			step.IsFinal = false
			for _, call := range msg.ToolCalls {
				if call.Function.Name == "" {
					continue
				}
				step.ToolCalls = append(step.ToolCalls, ToolCallRequest{
					CallID:        call.ID,
					ToolName:      call.Function.Name,
					ArgumentsJSON: call.Function.Arguments,
				})
			}
		}
	}

	return step, nil
}


================================================================================
Файл: similarity.go
Путь: internal/ai/similarity.go

package ai

import "math"

func CosineSimilarity(a, b []float64) float64 {
	if len(a) == 0 || len(b) == 0 || len(a) != len(b) {
		return 0
	}
	var dot, na, nb float64
	for i := 0; i < len(a); i++ {
		dot += a[i] * b[i]
		na += a[i] * a[i]
		nb += b[i] * b[i]
	}
	denom := math.Sqrt(na) * math.Sqrt(nb)
	if denom == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return dot / denom
}

package ai

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// AITaskExecutor центральный оркестратор для выполнения AI-задач.
// Выбирает подходящего провайдера и модель, обрабатывает ошибки,
// управляет кэшированием и обеспечивает отказоустойчивость.
type AITaskExecutor struct {
	aiServices       map[AIProvider]AIService
	modelManager     *AIModelManager
	usageMetricsRepo interface {
		CreateMetric(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID, provider, model string, inputTokens, outputTokens int, cost float64, taskType, projectID *string, durationMs *int) (string, error)
	} // Wrapper to avoid circular import
}

// NewAITaskExecutor создает новый экземпляр AITaskExecutor
func NewAITaskExecutor(aiServices []AIService, modelManager *AIModelManager) *AITaskExecutor {
	log.Printf("Initializing AITaskExecutor")

	if len(aiServices) == 0 {
		log.Printf("WARNING: aiServices is empty in AITaskExecutor constructor")
	}

	servicesMap := make(map[AIProvider]AIService)
	for _, svc := range aiServices {
		servicesMap[svc.Provider()] = svc
	}

	log.Printf("AITaskExecutor initialized successfully with %d AI services", len(servicesMap))

	return &AITaskExecutor{
		aiServices:       servicesMap,
		modelManager:     modelManager,
		usageMetricsRepo: nil,
	}
}

// WithUsageMetrics sets the usage metrics repository for tracking AI usage
// repo should be *repo.UsageMetricsRepository but we use interface to avoid circular import
func (e *AITaskExecutor) WithUsageMetrics(repo interface {
	CreateMetric(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID, provider, model string, inputTokens, outputTokens int, cost float64, taskType, projectID *string, durationMs *int) (string, error)
}) *AITaskExecutor {
	e.usageMetricsRepo = repo
	return e
}

// ExecuteTask выполняет общую текстовую задачу с автоматическим выбором модели и отказоустойчивостью
func (e *AITaskExecutor) ExecuteTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	log.Printf("ExecuteTask called with task type: %s", task.TaskType)
	inputTokens := len(task.InputContent) / 4

	inputHash := e.computeInputHash(task)
	_ = inputHash // для будущего кэширования

	triedModels := []string{}
	startedAt := time.Now()

	for {
		currentModel := e.modelManager.SelectFallbackModel(task.AIRequirements, inputTokens, triedModels)
		if currentModel == "" {
			log.Printf("All models have been tried or are unavailable. Unable to complete the task.")
			return &AITaskResult{
				Content:  "Task could not be completed due to unavailability of suitable AI models.",
				Model:    "None",
				TaskType: task.TaskType,
				Status:   AITaskStatusFailed,
			}, nil
		}

		modelCapabilities, err := e.modelManager.GetModelCapabilities(currentModel)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("Error getting model capabilities: %v", err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		aiService, ok := e.aiServices[modelCapabilities.Provider]
		if !ok {
			log.Printf("Provider %s not registered", modelCapabilities.Provider)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		log.Printf("Executing task using %s with model %s", modelCapabilities.Provider, currentModel)
		result, err := aiService.ExecuteTask(ctx, task, currentModel)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("Error executing task with model %s. Message: %v. Attempting fallback.", currentModel, err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		result.Status = AITaskStatusCompleted
		result.InputTokens = inputTokens
		result.OutputTokens = len(result.Content) / 4
		cost, _ := e.modelManager.CalculateProcessingCost(currentModel, result.InputTokens, result.OutputTokens)
		result.ProcessingCost = cost
		result.ProcessingTime = time.Since(startedAt)

		// Save usage metrics if repository is available
		durationMs := int(result.ProcessingTime.Milliseconds())
		e.saveUsageMetric(ctx, task, currentModel, result.InputTokens, result.OutputTokens, cost, &durationMs)

		return result, nil
	}
}

// ExecuteStructuredTask выполняет задачу, которая должна вернуть строго типизированный ответ,
// и использует для его проверки верификатор из объекта AITask
func (e *AITaskExecutor) ExecuteStructuredTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask) (interface{}, error) {
	log.Printf("ExecuteStructuredTask called with task type: %s", task.TaskType)
	inputChars := len(task.InputContent)
	inputTokens := inputChars / 4 // Approximate token count (4 chars per token)
	startedAt := time.Now()

	if task.Verifier == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("ExecuteStructuredTask requires a Verifier in the AITask object, but it was nil")
	}

	triedModels := []string{}

	for {
		currentModel := e.modelManager.SelectFallbackModel(task.AIRequirements, inputTokens, triedModels)
		if currentModel == "" {
			log.Printf("ERROR: All models tried or unavailable for structured task '%s'. Total models tried: %d, Input size: %d chars (%d tokens est)",
				task.TaskType, len(triedModels), inputChars, inputTokens)
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to complete structured task '%s': No suitable AI models available after all fallbacks (windowChars=%d)", task.TaskType, inputChars)
		}

		modelCapabilities, err := e.modelManager.GetModelCapabilities(currentModel)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("Error getting model capabilities: %v", err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		aiService, ok := e.aiServices[modelCapabilities.Provider]
		if !ok {
			log.Printf("Provider %s not registered", modelCapabilities.Provider)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		log.Printf("[%s] Executing structured task with model %s (input: %d chars, %d tokens est)",
			modelCapabilities.Provider, currentModel, inputChars, inputTokens)

		result, err := aiService.ExecuteTask(ctx, task, currentModel)
		if err != nil {
			// Log detailed information about the request when it fails
			log.Printf("WARNING: Task failed with model %s. Error: %v", currentModel, err)
			log.Printf("WARNING: Request details: TaskType=%s, InputSize=%d chars (%d tokens est), Provider=%s",
				task.TaskType, inputChars, inputTokens, modelCapabilities.Provider)

			// If context was canceled, log a specific message
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				log.Printf("WARNING: Context error detected: %v. This usually means timeout or cancellation.", ctx.Err())
			}

			log.Printf("WARNING: Error executing task with model %s. Message: %v. Attempting fallback.", currentModel, err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		if result.Status != AITaskStatusCompleted {
			log.Printf("WARNING: Task with model %s did not complete successfully (Status: %s). Trying fallback.", currentModel, result.Status)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		// Extract strict JSON in case provider wrapped it (markdown/code fences, preambles)
		cleanJSON, err := e.extractValidJSON(result.Content)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("WARNING: [Raw LLM Response that failed JSON extraction BEGIN]\n%s\n[Raw LLM Response that failed JSON extraction END]", result.Content)
			log.Printf("WARNING: Failed to extract JSON from response with model %s. Message: %v. Attempting fallback.", currentModel, err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		parsedResult, err := task.Verifier.VerifyAndParse(cleanJSON)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("WARNING: [Raw LLM Response that failed verification BEGIN]\n%s\n[Raw LLM Response that failed verification END]", result.Content)
			log.Printf("WARNING: Failed to verify result with model %s. Message: %v. Attempting fallback.", currentModel, err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		// Calculate and save usage metrics
		if result != nil && result.Status == AITaskStatusCompleted {
			inputToks := inputChars / 4
			outputToks := len(result.Content) / 4
			cost, _ := e.modelManager.CalculateProcessingCost(currentModel, inputToks, outputToks)
			durationMs := int(time.Since(startedAt).Milliseconds())
			e.saveUsageMetric(ctx, task, currentModel, inputToks, outputToks, cost, &durationMs)
		}

		_ = startedAt // для телеметрии
		return parsedResult, nil
	}
}

// ExecuteEmbeddingCalculationTask выполняет задачу по вычислению эмбеддингов
func (e *AITaskExecutor) ExecuteEmbeddingCalculationTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	inputTokens := len(task.InputContent) / 4

	inputHash := e.computeInputHash(task)
	_ = inputHash // для будущего кэширования

	triedModels := []string{}
	startedAt := time.Now()

	for {
		currentModel := e.modelManager.SelectFallbackModel(task.AIRequirements, inputTokens, triedModels)
		if currentModel == "" {
			log.Printf("All models tried or unavailable for embedding calculation.")

				Status:  AITaskStatusFailed,
				Content: "No suitable model found.",
			}, nil
		}

		modelCapabilities, err := e.modelManager.GetModelCapabilities(currentModel)
		if err != nil {

			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue

			continue
		}

			log.Printf("Error executing embedding task with model %s. Message: %v. Attempting fallback.", currentModel, err)

		return result, nil
	}
}

// ExecuteImageAnalysisTask выполняет задачу по анализу изображения
func (e *AITaskExecutor) ExecuteImageAnalysisTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	log.Printf("ExecuteImageAnalysisTask called")
	if task.TaskType != TaskTypeImageAnalysis {
		log.Printf("TaskType is not ImageAnalysis. This may not work as expected.")
	}

	var inputData ImageAnalysisInput
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(task.InputContent), &inputData); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse ImageAnalysisInput from task.InputContent: %w", err)
	}

	if inputData.UserQuery == "" || inputData.ImageLink == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid or missing fields in InputContent for image analysis")
	}

	inputTokens := (len(inputData.UserQuery) + len(inputData.ImageLink)) / 4

	inputHash := e.computeInputHash(task)
	_ = inputHash // для будущего кэширования

	triedModels := []string{}
	task.AIRequirements.ImageAnalysisCapability = true
	startedAt := time.Now()

	for {
		currentModel := e.modelManager.SelectFallbackModel(task.AIRequirements, inputTokens, triedModels)
		if currentModel == "" {
			log.Printf("No suitable model found for image analysis.")
			return &AITaskResult{
				Status:  AITaskStatusFailed,
				Content: "No suitable model for image analysis.",
			}, nil
		}

		modelCapabilities, err := e.modelManager.GetModelCapabilities(currentModel)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("Error getting model capabilities: %v", err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		if !modelCapabilities.ImageAnalysisCapability {
			log.Printf("Model %s does not support image analysis. Skipping.", currentModel)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		aiService, ok := e.aiServices[modelCapabilities.Provider]
		if !ok {
			log.Printf("Provider %s not registered", modelCapabilities.Provider)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		log.Printf("Executing image analysis using %s with model %s", modelCapabilities.Provider, currentModel)
		result, err := aiService.ExecuteImageAnalysisByLinkTask(ctx, inputData.UserQuery, inputData.ImageLink, currentModel)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("Error executing image analysis with model %s. Message: %v. Attempting fallback.", currentModel, err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		result.ProcessingTime = time.Since(startedAt)
		return result, nil
	}
}

// ExecuteTaskWithTools выполняет задачу с поддержкой MCP/tool-calling
func (e *AITaskExecutor) ExecuteTaskWithTools(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, tools []ToolSchema) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	inputTokens := len(task.InputContent) / 4
	triedModels := []string{}
	startedAt := time.Now()

	for {
		currentModel := e.modelManager.SelectFallbackToolCallingModel(task.AIRequirements, inputTokens, triedModels)
		if currentModel == "" {
			log.Printf("All models tried or unavailable for ExecuteTaskWithTools.")
			return &AITaskResult{
				Status:  AITaskStatusFailed,
				Content: "No suitable models for tool-calling.",
			}, nil
		}

		caps, err := e.modelManager.GetModelCapabilities(currentModel)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("Error getting model capabilities: %v", err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		if !caps.SupportsToolCalling {
			log.Printf("Model %s does not support tool-calling. Trying fallback.", currentModel)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		baseSvc, ok := e.aiServices[caps.Provider]
		if !ok {
			log.Printf("Provider %s not registered.", caps.Provider)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		svc, ok := baseSvc.(ToolCallingAIService)
		if !ok {
			log.Printf("Provider %s not registered as tool-calling service.", caps.Provider)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		step, err := svc.BeginChatWithTools(ctx, task, currentModel, tools)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("Error beginning chat with tools with model %s. Message: %v. Attempting fallback.", currentModel, err)
			triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
			continue
		}

		safeguard := 0
		iteration := 0
		var callLogs []ToolCallRecord

		for step != nil && !step.IsFinal && safeguard < 8 {
			safeguard++
			if len(step.ToolCalls) == 0 {
				log.Printf("Tool-calling loop: no toolCalls returned, breaking.")
				break
			}

			iteration++
			var execResults []ToolExecutionResult
			for _, call := range step.ToolCalls {
				started := time.Now()
				// Здесь должен быть вызов MCP брокера, но пока заглушка
				resultJSON := fmt.Sprintf(`{"result":"tool %s executed successfully"}`, call.ToolName)
				execResults = append(execResults, ToolExecutionResult{
					ToolName:               call.ToolName,
					CallID:                 call.CallID,
					ResultJSON:             resultJSON,
					RequestedArgumentsJSON: call.ArgumentsJSON,
				})
				callLogs = append(callLogs, ToolCallRecord{
					CallID:        call.CallID,
					ToolName:      call.ToolName,
					ArgumentsJSON: call.ArgumentsJSON,
					ResultJSON:    resultJSON,
					DurationMs:    int(time.Since(started).Milliseconds()),
					Success:       true,
				})
			}

			step, err = svc.ContinueWithToolResults(ctx, step.SessionID, currentModel, execResults)
			if err != nil {
				log.Printf("Error continuing with tool results with model %s. Message: %v. Attempting fallback.", currentModel, err)
				triedModels = append(triedModels, currentModel)
				break
			}
		}

		if err != nil {
			continue
		}

		content := ""
		if step != nil {
			content = step.Content
		}

		result := &AITaskResult{
			Content:            content,
			Model:              currentModel,
			TaskType:           task.TaskType,
			Status:             AITaskStatusCompleted,
			InputTokens:        inputTokens,
			OutputTokens:       max(1, len(content)/4),
			UsedToolCalling:    true,
			ToolUseProtocol:    caps.ToolUseProtocol,
			ToolCallIterations: iteration,
			ToolCalls:          callLogs,
			ProcessingTime:     time.Since(startedAt),
		}

		cost, _ := e.modelManager.CalculateProcessingCost(currentModel, result.InputTokens, result.OutputTokens)
		result.ProcessingCost = cost

		if step != nil && step.IsFinal {
			result.FinishReason = "final_message"
		} else if safeguard >= 8 {
			result.FinishReason = "max_iterations"
		} else {
			result.FinishReason = "no_tool_calls"
		}

		return result, nil
	}
}

// Вспомогательные методы

func (e *AITaskExecutor) computeInputHash(task *AITask) string {
	// Нормализуем контент (удаляем whitespace) для кэширования
	normalized := strings.Join(strings.Fields(task.InputContent), "")
	normalized = strings.ToLower(normalized)

	reqJSON, _ := json.Marshal(task.AIRequirements)
	inputString := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s", task.TaskType, normalized, string(reqJSON))

	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(inputString))
	return hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
}

func (e *AITaskExecutor) extractValidJSON(responseContent string) (string, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(responseContent) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("response content is null or empty")
	}

	// Try to extract from markdown code fence
	markdownTag := "```json"
	markdownStartIndex := strings.Index(responseContent, markdownTag)
	if markdownStartIndex != -1 {
		effectiveStartIndex := markdownStartIndex + len(markdownTag)
		markdownEndIndex := strings.LastIndex(responseContent, "```")
		if markdownEndIndex > effectiveStartIndex {
			potentialJSON := strings.TrimSpace(responseContent[effectiveStartIndex:markdownEndIndex])
			if json.Valid([]byte(potentialJSON)) {
				return potentialJSON, nil
			}
		}
	}

	// Try to find JSON by braces/brackets
	firstBrace := strings.Index(responseContent, "{")
	firstBracket := strings.Index(responseContent, "[")

	if firstBrace == -1 && firstBracket == -1 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("no opening brace or bracket found in the response")
	}

	startIndex := firstBrace
	endChar := "}"
	if (firstBracket != -1 && firstBrace == -1) || (firstBracket != -1 && firstBracket < firstBrace) {
		startIndex = firstBracket
		endChar = "]"
	}

	endIndex := strings.LastIndex(responseContent, endChar)
	if endIndex == -1 || endIndex < startIndex {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("no matching closing brace or bracket found")
	}

	jsonSubstring := responseContent[startIndex : endIndex+1]

	if json.Valid([]byte(jsonSubstring)) {
		return jsonSubstring, nil
	}

	// Try to fix common JSON issues
	fixed := e.tryFixJSON(jsonSubstring)
	if json.Valid([]byte(fixed)) {
		return fixed, nil
	}

	return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON structure in the response")
}

func (e *AITaskExecutor) tryFixJSON(jsonStr string) string {
	// Remove trailing commas before } or ]
	re := regexp.MustCompile(`,\s*([}\]])`)
	fixed := re.ReplaceAllString(jsonStr, "$1")

	// Remove comments (both // and /* */)
	re = regexp.MustCompile(`//.*?\n`)
	fixed = re.ReplaceAllString(fixed, "\n")
	re = regexp.MustCompile(`/\*.*?\*/`)
	fixed = re.ReplaceAllString(fixed, "")

	return fixed
}

// saveUsageMetric saves usage metrics if repository is available and task has required metadata
// Note: We use interface{} to avoid circular import with repo package
func (e *AITaskExecutor) saveUsageMetric(_ context.Context, task *AITask, modelName string, inputTokens, outputTokens int, cost float64, durationMs *int) {
	if e.usageMetricsRepo == nil {
		return
	}

	// Only save if we have tenantID and userID
	if task.TenantID == "" || task.UserID == "" {
		return
	}

	// Get provider from model name via modelManager
	provider := "unknown"
	if caps, err := e.modelManager.GetModelCapabilities(modelName); err == nil {
		switch caps.Provider {
		case AIProviderGemini:
			provider = "gemini"
		case AIProviderOpenAI:
			provider = "openai"
		case AIProviderClaude:
			provider = "anthropic"
		case AIProviderGrok:
			provider = "grok"
		case AIProviderDeepSeek:
			provider = "deepseek"
		}
	}

	// Prepare taskType and projectID pointers
	var taskTypePtr *string
	taskTypeStr := string(task.TaskType)
	if taskTypeStr != "" {
		taskTypePtr = &taskTypeStr
	}

	var projectIDPtr *string
	if task.Project != "" {
		projectIDPtr = &task.Project
	}

	// Save asynchronously to avoid blocking
	// Use a new context with timeout to avoid cancellation from parent context
	go func() {
		metricCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_, err := e.usageMetricsRepo.CreateMetric(metricCtx, task.TenantID, task.UserID, provider, modelName, inputTokens, outputTokens, cost, taskTypePtr, projectIDPtr, durationMs)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("[AITaskExecutor] Failed to save usage metric: %v", err)
		}
	}()
}

Путь: internal/ai/vector_index.go

package ai

import "context"

// VectorIndex abstracts vector storage and KNN search
type VectorIndex interface {
	// Upsert inserts or replaces a vector for an entity ID with metadata
	Upsert(ctx context.Context, id string, vector []float64, metadata map[string]any) error
	// Query searches topK nearest with optional filters
	Query(ctx context.Context, vector []float64, topK int, filters map[string]any) ([]string, error)
}


================================================================================
Файл: vector_index_firestore.go
Путь: internal/ai/vector_index_firestore.go
================================================================================

package ai

import (
	"context"
	"sort"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// FirestoreVectorIndex provides KNN search abstraction.
// Uses native Firestore vector search when available, falls back to in-app KNN.
type FirestoreVectorIndex struct {
	chunks *repo.ChunksRepository
	client *firestore.Client
}

func NewFirestoreVectorIndex(chunks *repo.ChunksRepository) *FirestoreVectorIndex {
	return &FirestoreVectorIndex{chunks: chunks}
}

// WithClient sets the Firestore client for native vector search
func (i *FirestoreVectorIndex) WithClient(client *firestore.Client) *FirestoreVectorIndex {
	i.client = client
	return i
}

func (i *FirestoreVectorIndex) Upsert(ctx context.Context, id string, vector []float64, metadata map[string]any) error {
	// Embeddings are persisted with chunks; index management is declarative via firestore.indexes.json
	return nil
}

func (i *FirestoreVectorIndex) Query(ctx context.Context, vector []float64, topK int, filters map[string]any) ([]string, error) {
	// Expected filters: tenantId (string), sourceIds ([]string)
	if i.chunks == nil {
		return []string{}, nil
	}
	tenantID, _ := filters["tenantId"].(string)
	var sourceIDs []string
	if v, ok := filters["sourceIds"]; ok {
		switch t := v.(type) {
		case []string:
			sourceIDs = t
		case []any:
			for _, it := range t {
				if s, ok := it.(string); ok {
					sourceIDs = append(sourceIDs, s)
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Try native Firestore vector search first (if client is available)
	if i.client != nil {
		return i.queryNative(ctx, vector, topK, tenantID, sourceIDs)
	}

	// Fallback to in-app KNN search
	return i.queryInApp(ctx, vector, topK, tenantID, sourceIDs)
}

// queryNative uses Firestore's native FindNearest vector search
// Requires Firestore SDK v1.15.0+ and vector field configured in Firestore
func (i *FirestoreVectorIndex) queryNative(ctx context.Context, vector []float64, topK int, tenantID string, sourceIDs []string) ([]string, error) {
	col := i.client.Collection("rag_chunks")

	// Build query with filters
	q := col.Query
	if tenantID != "" {
		q = q.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID)
	}
	if len(sourceIDs) > 0 {
		// Firestore IN supports up to 10 values
		if len(sourceIDs) <= 10 {
			q = q.Where("sourceId", "in", sourceIDs)
		} else {
			// For more than 10, fall back to in-app search
			return i.queryInApp(ctx, vector, topK, tenantID, sourceIDs)
		}
	}

	// Use FindNearest for native vector search
	// FindNearest returns VectorQuery, which we execute to get documents
	vectorQuery := q.FindNearest("embedding", vector, topK, firestore.DistanceMeasureCosine, nil)

	// Execute the vector query
	docs, err := vectorQuery.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		// If native search fails (e.g., vector field not configured), fall back to in-app
		return i.queryInApp(ctx, vector, topK, tenantID, sourceIDs)
	}

	ids := make([]string, 0, len(docs))
	for _, doc := range docs {
		ids = append(ids, doc.Ref.ID)
	}
	return ids, nil
}

// queryInApp performs KNN search in application memory (fallback)
func (i *FirestoreVectorIndex) queryInApp(ctx context.Context, vector []float64, topK int, tenantID string, sourceIDs []string) ([]string, error) {
	// fetch a reasonable candidate set
	candidates, err := i.chunks.ListBySourcesRecent(ctx, tenantID, sourceIDs, 500)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	type scored struct {
		id    string
		score float64
	}
	var items []scored
	for _, c := range candidates {
		if len(c.Embedding) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		s := CosineSimilarity(vector, c.Embedding)
		items = append(items, scored{id: c.ID, score: s})
	}
	// Sort by score descending
	sort.Slice(items, func(a, b int) bool {
		return items[a].score > items[b].score
	})
	if topK > 0 && len(items) > topK {
		items = items[:topK]
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(items))
	for _, it := range items {
		out = append(out, it.id)
	}
	return out, nil
}
