package ai

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

// BaseVerifier базовая реализация верификатора с общими методами
type BaseVerifier struct{}

// CleanAndFixJSON очищает и исправляет JSON перед парсингом
func (v *BaseVerifier) CleanAndFixJSON(rawJSON string) (string, error) {
	s := strings.TrimSpace(rawJSON)
	if s == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("JSON string is empty")
	}
	s = strings.TrimPrefix(s, "\uFEFF")
	// Удаляем Markdown code fences ```json ... ``` / ``` ... ```
	if strings.HasPrefix(s, "```") {
		// отбросить первый блок ```...\n
		if idx := strings.Index(s, "\n"); idx > 0 {
			s = s[idx+1:]
		}
		if j := strings.LastIndex(s, "```"); j > 0 {
			s = s[:j]
		}
	}
	// Вырезаем чистую JSON-структуру по скобкам (игнорируя содержимое строк)
	start := -1
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		if s[i] == '{' || s[i] == '[' {
			start = i
			break
		}
	}
	if start > 0 {
		s = s[start:]
	}
	// Найти позицию закрывающей скобки, учитывая строки и экранирование
	buf := make([]byte, 0, len(s))
	inStr := false
	esc := false
	depthObj := 0
	depthArr := 0
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		ch := s[i]
		buf = append(buf, ch)
		if inStr {
			if esc {
				esc = false
				continue
			}
			if ch == '\\' {
				esc = true
				continue
			}
			if ch == '"' {
				inStr = false
			}
			continue
		}
		if ch == '"' {
			inStr = true
			continue
		}
		switch ch {
		case '{':
			depthObj++
		case '}':
			if depthObj > 0 {
				depthObj--
			}
		case '[':
			depthArr++
		case ']':
			if depthArr > 0 {
				depthArr--
			}
		}
	}
	cleaned := string(buf)
	// Проход для удаления однострочных/многострочных комментариев и хвостовых запятых вне строк
	out := make([]byte, 0, len(cleaned))
	inStr = false
	esc = false
	for i := 0; i < len(cleaned); i++ {
		ch := cleaned[i]
		if inStr {
			out = append(out, ch)
			if esc {
				esc = false
				continue
			}
			switch ch {
			case '\\':
				esc = true
			case '"':
				inStr = false
			}
			continue
		}
		if ch == '"' {
			inStr = true
			out = append(out, ch)
			continue
		}
		// strip // comments
		if ch == '/' && i+1 < len(cleaned) && cleaned[i+1] == '/' {
			// skip until newline
			i += 2
			for i < len(cleaned) && cleaned[i] != '\n' {
				i++
			}
			continue
		}
		// strip /* */ comments
		if ch == '/' && i+1 < len(cleaned) && cleaned[i+1] == '*' {
			i += 2
			for i+1 < len(cleaned) {
				if cleaned[i] == '*' && cleaned[i+1] == '/' {
					i += 1
					break
				}
				i++
			}
			continue
		}
		// remove trailing commas: ,\s*([}\]])
		if ch == ',' {
			j := i + 1
			for j < len(cleaned) && (cleaned[j] == ' ' || cleaned[j] == '\n' || cleaned[j] == '\r' || cleaned[j] == '\t') {
				j++
			}
			if j < len(cleaned) && (cleaned[j] == '}' || cleaned[j] == ']') {
				// skip comma (do not advance i; next loop will copy the brace)
				continue
			}
		}
		out = append(out, ch)
	}
	cleaned = strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	if !json.Valid([]byte(cleaned)) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON after cleaning")
	}
	return cleaned, nil
}

// ValidateAndParse проверяет валидность JSON и парсит его
func (v *BaseVerifier) ValidateAndParse(rawJSON string, target interface{}) error {
	cleaned, err := v.CleanAndFixJSON(rawJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to clean JSON: %w", err)
	}

	if !json.Valid([]byte(cleaned)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON after cleaning")
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(cleaned), target); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal JSON: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

// GenericVerifier универсальный верификатор для любого типа
type GenericVerifier[T any] struct {
	BaseVerifier
	// ValidateFunc дополнительная функция валидации после парсинга
	ValidateFunc func(T) error
}

// VerifyAndParse реализация интерфейса AITaskResultVerifier
func (v *GenericVerifier[T]) VerifyAndParse(rawJSON string) (interface{}, error) {
	return v.VerifyAndParseTyped(rawJSON)
}

// VerifyAndParseTyped реализация типизированного верификатора
func (v *GenericVerifier[T]) VerifyAndParseTyped(rawJSON string) (T, error) {
	var zero T
	var result T

	if err := v.ValidateAndParse(rawJSON, &result); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}

	// Применяем дополнительную валидацию если она задана
	if v.ValidateFunc != nil {
		if err := v.ValidateFunc(result); err != nil {
			return zero, fmt.Errorf("validation failed: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// NewGenericVerifier создает новый экземпляр GenericVerifier
func NewGenericVerifier[T any](validateFunc func(T) error) *GenericVerifier[T] {
	return &GenericVerifier[T]{
		ValidateFunc: validateFunc,
	}
}

// SimpleJSONVerifier простой верификатор, который только проверяет валидность JSON
type SimpleJSONVerifier struct {
	BaseVerifier
}

// VerifyAndParse реализация интерфейса AITaskResultVerifier
func (v *SimpleJSONVerifier) VerifyAndParse(rawJSON string) (interface{}, error) {
	cleaned, err := v.CleanAndFixJSON(rawJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var result interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(cleaned), &result); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal JSON: %w", err)
	}

	return result, nil
}

// NewSimpleJSONVerifier создает новый экземпляр SimpleJSONVerifier
func NewSimpleJSONVerifier() *SimpleJSONVerifier {
	return &SimpleJSONVerifier{}
}

// MapVerifier верификатор для map[string]interface{}
type MapVerifier struct {
	BaseVerifier
	// RequiredFields список обязательных полей
	RequiredFields []string
	// ValidateFunc дополнительная функция валидации
	ValidateFunc func(map[string]interface{}) error
}

// VerifyAndParse реализация интерфейса AITaskResultVerifier
func (v *MapVerifier) VerifyAndParse(rawJSON string) (interface{}, error) {
	cleaned, err := v.CleanAndFixJSON(rawJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var result map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(cleaned), &result); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal JSON: %w", err)
	}

	// Проверяем обязательные поля
	for _, field := range v.RequiredFields {
		if _, ok := result[field]; !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("required field '%s' is missing", field)
		}
	}

	// Применяем дополнительную валидацию если она задана
	if v.ValidateFunc != nil {
		if err := v.ValidateFunc(result); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation failed: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// NewMapVerifier создает новый экземпляр MapVerifier
func NewMapVerifier(requiredFields []string, validateFunc func(map[string]interface{}) error) *MapVerifier {
	return &MapVerifier{
		RequiredFields: requiredFields,
		ValidateFunc:   validateFunc,
	}
}

// ArrayVerifier верификатор для массивов
type ArrayVerifier struct {
	BaseVerifier
	// MinItems минимальное количество элементов
	MinItems int
	// MaxItems максимальное количество элементов (0 = без ограничения)
	MaxItems int
	// ValidateFunc дополнительная функция валидации
	ValidateFunc func([]interface{}) error
}

// VerifyAndParse реализация интерфейса AITaskResultVerifier
func (v *ArrayVerifier) VerifyAndParse(rawJSON string) (interface{}, error) {
	cleaned, err := v.CleanAndFixJSON(rawJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var result []interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(cleaned), &result); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal JSON: %w", err)
	}

	// Проверяем количество элементов
	if len(result) < v.MinItems {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("array has %d items, but minimum is %d", len(result), v.MinItems)
	}

	if v.MaxItems > 0 && len(result) > v.MaxItems {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("array has %d items, but maximum is %d", len(result), v.MaxItems)
	}

	// Применяем дополнительную валидацию если она задана
	if v.ValidateFunc != nil {
		if err := v.ValidateFunc(result); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation failed: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// NewArrayVerifier создает новый экземпляр ArrayVerifier
func NewArrayVerifier(minItems, maxItems int, validateFunc func([]interface{}) error) *ArrayVerifier {
	return &ArrayVerifier{
		MinItems:     minItems,
		MaxItems:     maxItems,
		ValidateFunc: validateFunc,
	}
}

// SchemaVerifier верификатор с проверкой по JSON Schema (упрощенная версия)
type SchemaVerifier struct {
	BaseVerifier
	// SchemaValidateFunc функция проверки соответствия схеме
	SchemaValidateFunc func(interface{}) error
}

// VerifyAndParse реализация интерфейса AITaskResultVerifier
func (v *SchemaVerifier) VerifyAndParse(rawJSON string) (interface{}, error) {
	cleaned, err := v.CleanAndFixJSON(rawJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var result interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(cleaned), &result); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal JSON: %w", err)
	}

	// Применяем валидацию по схеме
	if v.SchemaValidateFunc != nil {
		if err := v.SchemaValidateFunc(result); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("schema validation failed: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// NewSchemaVerifier создает новый экземпляр SchemaVerifier
func NewSchemaVerifier(schemaValidateFunc func(interface{}) error) *SchemaVerifier {
	return &SchemaVerifier{
		SchemaValidateFunc: schemaValidateFunc,
	}
}

// RepairableVerifier верификатор с возможностью автоматического исправления данных
type RepairableVerifier struct {
	BaseVerifier
	// RepairFunc функция для исправления данных
	RepairFunc func(map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error)
	// ValidateFunc функция валидации после исправления
	ValidateFunc func(map[string]interface{}) error
}

// VerifyAndParse реализация интерфейса AITaskResultVerifier
func (v *RepairableVerifier) VerifyAndParse(rawJSON string) (interface{}, error) {
	cleaned, err := v.CleanAndFixJSON(rawJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var result map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(cleaned), &result); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal JSON: %w", err)
	}

	// Применяем исправление если функция задана
	if v.RepairFunc != nil {
		repaired, err := v.RepairFunc(result)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("repair failed: %w", err)
		}
		result = repaired
	}

	// Валидируем после исправления
	if v.ValidateFunc != nil {
		if err := v.ValidateFunc(result); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation after repair failed: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// NewRepairableVerifier создает новый экземпляр RepairableVerifier
func NewRepairableVerifier(repairFunc func(map[string]interface{}) (map[string]interface{}, error), validateFunc func(map[string]interface{}) error) *RepairableVerifier {
	return &RepairableVerifier{
		RepairFunc:   repairFunc,
		ValidateFunc: validateFunc,
	}
}

// Примеры специализированных верификаторов

// EntityExtractionVerifier верификатор для извлечения сущностей
type EntityExtractionVerifier struct {
	GenericVerifier[EntityExtractionResult]
}

// EntityExtractionResult результат извлечения сущностей
type EntityExtractionResult struct {
	Entities []Entity `json:"entities"`
}

// Entity сущность
type Entity struct {
	Type       string  `json:"type"`
	Value      string  `json:"value"`
	Confidence float64 `json:"confidence,omitempty"`
}

// NewEntityExtractionVerifier создает новый верификатор для извлечения сущностей
func NewEntityExtractionVerifier() *EntityExtractionVerifier {
	return &EntityExtractionVerifier{
		GenericVerifier: GenericVerifier[EntityExtractionResult]{
			ValidateFunc: func(result EntityExtractionResult) error {
				if len(result.Entities) == 0 {
					return fmt.Errorf("no entities found")
				}
				for i, entity := range result.Entities {
					if entity.Type == "" {
						return fmt.Errorf("entity %d has empty type", i)
					}
					if entity.Value == "" {
						return fmt.Errorf("entity %d has empty value", i)
					}
				}
				return nil
			},
		},
	}
}

// SummarizationVerifier верификатор для суммаризации
type SummarizationVerifier struct {
	GenericVerifier[SummarizationResult]
}

// SummarizationResult результат суммаризации
type SummarizationResult struct {
	Summary    string   `json:"summary"`
	KeyPoints  []string `json:"keyPoints,omitempty"`
	Confidence float64  `json:"confidence,omitempty"`
}

// NewSummarizationVerifier создает новый верификатор для суммаризации
func NewSummarizationVerifier() *SummarizationVerifier {
	return &SummarizationVerifier{
		GenericVerifier: GenericVerifier[SummarizationResult]{
			ValidateFunc: func(result SummarizationResult) error {
				if result.Summary == "" {
					return fmt.Errorf("summary is empty")
				}
				if len(result.Summary) < 10 {
					return fmt.Errorf("summary is too short (minimum 10 characters)")
				}
				return nil
			},
		},
	}
}

package ai

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// VertexAISearchClient клиент для работы с Vertex AI Search API
// Использует REST API для поиска по документам, индексированным из GCS
//
// Синхронизация данных:
// - Документы автоматически сохраняются в GCS при создании/обновлении через DocumentsRepository
// - Vertex AI Search синхронизирует данные из GCS с настраиваемой частотой:
//   * Ежедневно
//   * Каждые 3 дня
//   * Каждые 5 дней
// - Первая синхронизация происходит ~1 час после создания Data Store
// - Частота синхронизации настраивается при создании Data Store в консоли
// - Дополнительная настройка синхронизации в коде не требуется
type VertexAISearchClient struct {
	projectID   string
	location    string
	dataStoreID string
	apiKey      string
	httpClient  *http.Client
}

// NewVertexAISearchClient создает новый клиент для Vertex AI Search
func NewVertexAISearchClient(projectID, location, dataStoreID, apiKey string) *VertexAISearchClient {
	return &VertexAISearchClient{
		projectID:   projectID,
		location:    location,
		dataStoreID: dataStoreID,
		apiKey:      apiKey,
		httpClient: &http.Client{
			Timeout: 30 * time.Second,
		},
	}
}

// SearchRequest параметры поиска
type SearchRequest struct {
	Query              string                `json:"query"`
	PageSize           int                   `json:"pageSize,omitempty"`
	PageToken          string                `json:"pageToken,omitempty"`
	Filter             string                `json:"filter,omitempty"`
	OrderBy            string                `json:"orderBy,omitempty"`
	BoostSpec          *BoostSpec            `json:"boostSpec,omitempty"`
	SpellCorrectionSpec *SpellCorrectionSpec `json:"spellCorrectionSpec,omitempty"`
}

// BoostSpec спецификация для повышения релевантности
type BoostSpec struct {
	ConditionBoostSpecs []ConditionBoostSpec `json:"conditionBoostSpecs,omitempty"`
}

// ConditionBoostSpec условие для повышения релевантности
type ConditionBoostSpec struct {
	Condition string  `json:"condition"`
	Boost     float64 `json:"boost"`
}

// SpellCorrectionSpec спецификация для исправления опечаток
type SpellCorrectionSpec struct {
	Mode string `json:"mode,omitempty"` // "AUTO" | "SUGGESTION_ONLY"
}

// SearchResponse ответ от Vertex AI Search API
type SearchResponse struct {
	Results       []SearchResult `json:"results"`
	NextPageToken string         `json:"nextPageToken,omitempty"`
	TotalSize     int            `json:"totalSize,omitempty"`
}

// SearchResult результат поиска
type SearchResult struct {
	ID          string                 `json:"id"`
	Document    SearchDocument         `json:"document"`
	RelevanceScore float64             `json:"relevanceScore,omitempty"`
}

// SearchDocument документ из результата поиска
type SearchDocument struct {
	ID       string                 `json:"id"`
	Name     string                 `json:"name"`
	URI      string                 `json:"uri"`
	Title    string                 `json:"title,omitempty"`
	StructData map[string]interface{} `json:"structData,omitempty"`
	JSONData   string               `json:"jsonData,omitempty"`
}

// Search выполняет поиск по документам в Vertex AI Search
func (c *VertexAISearchClient) Search(ctx context.Context, req *SearchRequest) (*SearchResponse, error) {
	if c.projectID == "" || c.location == "" || c.dataStoreID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("vertex AI search not configured: project, location, or dataStoreID missing")
	}

	if req.Query == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query is required")
	}

	if req.PageSize == 0 {
		req.PageSize = 10
	}

	// Формируем URL для REST API
	// Формат: https://discoveryengine.googleapis.com/v1beta/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/dataStores/{dataStore}/servingConfigs/default_search:search
	url := fmt.Sprintf(
		"https://discoveryengine.googleapis.com/v1beta/projects/%s/locations/%s/dataStores/%s/servingConfigs/default_search:search",
		c.projectID,
		c.location,
		c.dataStoreID,
	)

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"query": req.Query,
		"pageSize": req.PageSize,
	}
	if req.PageToken != "" {
		requestBody["pageToken"] = req.PageToken
	}
	if req.Filter != "" {
		requestBody["filter"] = req.Filter
	}
	if req.OrderBy != "" {
		requestBody["orderBy"] = req.OrderBy
	}
	if req.BoostSpec != nil {
		requestBody["boostSpec"] = req.BoostSpec
	}
	if req.SpellCorrectionSpec != nil {
		requestBody["spellCorrectionSpec"] = req.SpellCorrectionSpec
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	httpReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	// Используем API key для аутентификации
	if c.apiKey != "" {
		httpReq.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", c.apiKey)
	} else {
		// Альтернатива: использовать Application Default Credentials через gcloud auth
		// В этом случае нужен Bearer token от gcloud auth print-access-token
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("API key is required for Vertex AI Search")
	}
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	log.Printf("[VertexAISearch] Searching: query=%s, pageSize=%d", req.Query, req.PageSize)

	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("vertex AI search API error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var searchResp SearchResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &searchResp); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	log.Printf("[VertexAISearch] Found %d results", len(searchResp.Results))
	return &searchResp, nil
}

// IsConfigured проверяет, настроен ли клиент
func (c *VertexAISearchClient) IsConfigured() bool {
	return c.projectID != "" && c.location != "" && c.dataStoreID != "" && c.apiKey != ""
}

package ai

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// VertexAIService сервис-обёртка для Google Vertex AI (Gemini)
// Поддерживает текстовую генерацию и встроенный веб-поиск (Grounding with Google Search)
type VertexAIService struct {
	*BaseAIService
	apiKey     string
	httpClient *http.Client
}

// NewVertexAIService создает новый экземпляр VertexAIService
func NewVertexAIService(apiKey string, modelManager *AIModelManager) *VertexAIService {
	// Sanitize API key to avoid invalid header values
	sanitizedKey := strings.TrimSpace(apiKey)
	sanitizedKey = strings.Trim(sanitizedKey, "\"'")
	return &VertexAIService{
		BaseAIService: NewBaseAIService(modelManager),
		apiKey:        sanitizedKey,
		httpClient: &http.Client{
			Timeout: 120 * time.Second,
		},
	}
}

// Provider возвращает идентификатор провайдера
func (s *VertexAIService) Provider() AIProvider {
	return AIProviderGemini
}

// ExecuteTask выполняет основную задачу по генерации текста
func (s *VertexAIService) ExecuteTask(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	if task == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("task cannot be nil")
	}

	log.Printf("[VertexAI] ExecuteTask: %s, model=%s", task.TaskType, model)

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"contents": []map[string]interface{}{
			{
				"role": "user",
				"parts": []map[string]string{
					{"text": task.InputContent},
				},
			},
		},
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/%s:generateContent", model)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("vertex AI API error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var result struct {
		Candidates []struct {
			Content struct {
				Parts []struct {
					Text string `json:"text"`
				} `json:"parts"`
			} `json:"content"`
		} `json:"candidates"`
	}

	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &result); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	if len(result.Candidates) == 0 || len(result.Candidates[0].Content.Parts) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty response from vertex AI")
	}

	content := result.Candidates[0].Content.Parts[0].Text
	if content == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty response from vertex AI")
	}

	return &AITaskResult{
		Content:  content,
		Model:    model,
		TaskType: task.TaskType,
		Status:   AITaskStatusCompleted,
	}, nil
}

// ExecuteSearch выполняет веб-поиск с помощью встроенных возможностей Gemini
func (s *VertexAIService) ExecuteSearch(ctx context.Context, query string, modelName string) (*AITaskResult, error) {
	if query == "" || modelName == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query and modelName are required")
	}

	caps, err := s.ModelManager.GetModelCapabilities(modelName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// Для Vertex/Gemini требуется поддержка Search Grounding, а не общий веб-поиск
	if !caps.SearchGroundingCapability {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("model %s does not support search grounding", modelName)
	}

	log.Printf("[VertexAI] ExecuteSearch. model=%s, q=\"%s\"", modelName, query)

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": fmt.Sprintf("models/%s", modelName),
		"contents": []map[string]interface{}{
			{
				"role": "user",
				"parts": []map[string]string{
					{"text": query},
				},
			},
		},
		"tools": []map[string]interface{}{
			{
				// Современный инструмент Grounding
				"googleSearch": map[string]interface{}{},
			},
		},
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/%s:generateContent", modelName)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("vertex AI search error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	// Extract content
	content := ""
	if candidates, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(candidates) > 0 {
		if candidate, ok := candidates[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if candidateContent, ok := candidate["content"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if parts, ok := candidateContent["parts"].([]interface{}); ok && len(parts) > 0 {
					if part, ok := parts[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						if text, ok := part["text"].(string); ok {
							content = text
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	if content == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty Search response from Vertex AI")
	}

	// Extract citations
	var citations []WebCitation
	if candidates, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(candidates) > 0 {
		if candidate, ok := candidates[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			// New grounding metadata
			if groundingMeta, ok := candidate["groundingMetadata"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if attributions, ok := groundingMeta["groundingAttributions"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, g := range attributions {
						if gMap, ok := g.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							url := ""
							title := ""
							if u, ok := gMap["sourceUrl"].(string); ok {
								url = u
							}
							if t, ok := gMap["sourceTitle"].(string); ok {
								title = t
							}
							citations = append(citations, WebCitation{
								URL:        url,
								Title:      title,
								StartIndex: -1,
								EndIndex:   -1,
							})
						}
					}
				}
			}

			// Fallback old metadata
			if len(citations) == 0 {
				if citationMeta, ok := candidate["citationMetadata"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					if citationSources, ok := citationMeta["citationSources"].([]interface{}); ok {
						for _, src := range citationSources {
							if srcMap, ok := src.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								url := ""
								title := ""
								startIndex := -1
								endIndex := -1
								if u, ok := srcMap["uri"].(string); ok {
									url = u
								}
								if l, ok := srcMap["license"].(string); ok {
									title = l
								}
								if si, ok := srcMap["startIndex"].(float64); ok {
									startIndex = int(si)
								}
								if ei, ok := srcMap["endIndex"].(float64); ok {
									endIndex = int(ei)
								}
								citations = append(citations, WebCitation{
									URL:        url,
									Title:      title,
									StartIndex: startIndex,
									EndIndex:   endIndex,
								})
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return &AITaskResult{
		Content:   content,
		Model:     modelName,
		TaskType:  TaskTypeSearch,
		Status:    AITaskStatusCompleted,
		Citations: citations,
	}, nil
}

// BeginChatWithTools начинает диалог с поддержкой tool-calling (Gemini tools)
func (s *VertexAIService) BeginChatWithTools(ctx context.Context, task *AITask, model string, tools []ToolSchema) (*ToolChatStep, error) {
	functionDecls := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
	for _, t := range tools {
		functionDecls = append(functionDecls, map[string]interface{}{
			"name":        t.Name,
			"description": t.Description,
			"parameters":  t.ParametersJSONSchema,
		})
	}

	gTools := []map[string]interface{}{
		{
			"functionDeclarations": functionDecls,
		},
	}

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"contents": []map[string]interface{}{
			{
				"role": "user",
				"parts": []map[string]interface{}{
					{"text": "You are a helpful assistant with access to tools."},
				},
			},
			{
				"role": "user",
				"parts": []map[string]interface{}{
					{"text": task.InputContent},
				},
			},
		},
		"tools": gTools,
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/%s:generateContent", model)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("vertex AI tool chat error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	step := &ToolChatStep{
		SessionID: fmt.Sprintf("vertex-session-%d", time.Now().UnixNano()),
		Content:   "",
		ToolCalls: []ToolCallRequest{},
		IsFinal:   true,
	}

	if candidates, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(candidates) > 0 {
		if candidate, ok := candidates[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if candidateContent, ok := candidate["content"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if parts, ok := candidateContent["parts"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, p := range parts {
						if pMap, ok := p.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							// Check for function call
							if fc, ok := pMap["functionCall"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								step.IsFinal = false
								name := ""
								argsJSON := "{}"
								if n, ok := fc["name"].(string); ok {
									name = n
								}
								if args, ok := fc["args"]; ok {
									argsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(args)
									argsJSON = string(argsBytes)
								}
								step.ToolCalls = append(step.ToolCalls, ToolCallRequest{
									CallID:        fmt.Sprintf("call-%d", len(step.ToolCalls)+1),
									ToolName:      name,
									ArgumentsJSON: argsJSON,
								})
							}
							// Check for text
							if text, ok := pMap["text"].(string); ok && text != "" {
								step.Content += text
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return step, nil
}

// ContinueWithToolResults продолжает диалог с результатами выполнения инструментов
func (s *VertexAIService) ContinueWithToolResults(ctx context.Context, sessionID string, model string, toolResults []ToolExecutionResult) (*ToolChatStep, error) {
	toolMsgs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(toolResults))
	for _, r := range toolResults {
		toolMsgs = append(toolMsgs, map[string]interface{}{
			"role": "tool",
			"parts": []map[string]interface{}{
				{"text": r.ResultJSON},
			},
		})
	}

	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"contents": toolMsgs,
	}

	bodyJSON, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request body: %w", err)
	}

	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/%s:generateContent", model)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, bytes.NewReader(bodyJSON))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", s.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := s.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("vertex AI tool continue error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(body))
	}

	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal response: %w", err)
	}

	step := &ToolChatStep{
		SessionID: sessionID,
		Content:   "",
		ToolCalls: []ToolCallRequest{},
		IsFinal:   true,
	}

	if candidates, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(candidates) > 0 {
		if candidate, ok := candidates[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if candidateContent, ok := candidate["content"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if parts, ok := candidateContent["parts"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, p := range parts {
						if pMap, ok := p.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							// Check for function call
							if fc, ok := pMap["functionCall"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								step.IsFinal = false
								name := ""
								argsJSON := "{}"
								if n, ok := fc["name"].(string); ok {
									name = n
								}
								if args, ok := fc["args"]; ok {
									argsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(args)
									argsJSON = string(argsBytes)
								}
								step.ToolCalls = append(step.ToolCalls, ToolCallRequest{
									CallID:        fmt.Sprintf("call-%d", len(step.ToolCalls)+1),
									ToolName:      name,
									ArgumentsJSON: argsJSON,
								})
							}
							// Check for text
							if text, ok := pMap["text"].(string); ok && text != "" {
								step.Content += text
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return step, nil
}

package paypal

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/plutov/paypal/v4"
)

// Client wraps PayPal SDK client with convenience methods
type Client struct {
	client *paypal.Client
	logger *log.Logger
}

// NewClient creates a new PayPal client
func NewClient(logger *log.Logger) (*Client, error) {
	clientID := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID")
	secret := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_SECRET")
	mode := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_MODE")

	if clientID == "" || secret == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID and PAYPAL_SECRET must be set")
	}

	if mode == "" {
		mode = "sandbox" // default to sandbox for safety
	}

	var apiBase string
	if mode == "live" {
		apiBase = paypal.APIBaseLive
	} else {
		apiBase = paypal.APIBaseSandBox
	}

	client, err := paypal.NewClient(clientID, secret, apiBase)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create PayPal client: %w", err)
	}

	_, err = client.GetAccessToken(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get PayPal access token: %w", err)
	}

	return &Client{
		client: client,
		logger: logger,
	}, nil
}

// GetClient returns the underlying PayPal client
func (c *Client) GetClient() *paypal.Client {
	return c.client
}

// getPayPalLocale returns PayPal locale based on environment or defaults to en-US
func getPayPalLocale() string {
	locale := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_LOCALE")
	if locale == "" {
		locale = "en-US" // Default
	}
	return locale
}

// CreateSubscriptionPlan creates a monthly subscription plan for a tier
func (c *Client) CreateSubscriptionPlan(ctx context.Context, tier string, price string, currency string, productID string) (*paypal.SubscriptionPlan, error) {
	// Create product first if not provided (one-time, should be created separately)
	// For now, we'll assume productID is provided or create it inline
	
	plan := paypal.SubscriptionPlan{
		ProductId:   productID,
		Name:        fmt.Sprintf("%s Monthly Subscription", tier),
		Description: fmt.Sprintf("Monthly subscription for %s tier", tier),
		Status:      paypal.SubscriptionPlanStatusActive,
		BillingCycles: []paypal.BillingCycle{
			{
				Frequency: paypal.Frequency{
					IntervalUnit:  paypal.IntervalUnitMonth,
					IntervalCount: 1,
				},
				TenureType:  paypal.TenureTypeRegular,
				Sequence:    1,
				TotalCycles: 0, // 0 = infinite
				PricingScheme: paypal.PricingScheme{
					FixedPrice: paypal.Money{
						Currency: currency,
						Value:    price,
					},
				},
			},
		},
		PaymentPreferences: &paypal.PaymentPreferences{
			AutoBillOutstanding:     true,
			SetupFee: &paypal.Money{
				Currency: currency,
				Value:    "0",
			},
			SetupFeeFailureAction: "CONTINUE",
			PaymentFailureThreshold: 3,
		},
		QuantitySupported: false,
	}

	// Add taxes for Kazakhstan (12% VAT)
	// PayPal will handle tax calculation based on merchant's tax settings
	// But we can specify it explicitly for transparency
	taxPercentage := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_TAX_PERCENTAGE")
	if taxPercentage == "" {
		taxPercentage = "12" // Default VAT for Kazakhstan
	}
	
	// If tax is not included in price (inclusive=false), PayPal will add it
	// If inclusive=true, tax is already included in the price
	taxInclusive := os.Getenv("PAYPAL_TAX_INCLUSIVE") == "true"
	if taxPercentage != "0" && taxPercentage != "" {
		plan.Taxes = &paypal.Taxes{
			Percentage: taxPercentage,
			Inclusive:  taxInclusive,
		}
	}

	createdPlanResp, err := c.client.CreateSubscriptionPlan(ctx, plan)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create subscription plan: %w", err)
	}

	if c.logger != nil {
		c.logger.Printf("Created PayPal subscription plan %s for tier %s", createdPlanResp.ID, tier)
	}

	// Return the SubscriptionPlan from the response
	return &createdPlanResp.SubscriptionPlan, nil
}

// CreateSubscription creates a subscription from a plan
func (c *Client) CreateSubscription(ctx context.Context, planID string, returnURL string, cancelURL string) (*paypal.SubscriptionDetailResp, error) {
	startTime := time.Now().Add(1 * time.Minute) // Start 1 minute from now
	
	startTimeJSON := paypal.JSONTime(startTime)
	subscription := paypal.SubscriptionBase{
		PlanID: planID,
		StartTime: &startTimeJSON,
		ApplicationContext: &paypal.ApplicationContext{
			BrandName:          "HATLONE",
			Locale:             getPayPalLocale(), // Default to en-US, can be configured
			ShippingPreference: paypal.ShippingPreferenceNoShipping,
			UserAction:         paypal.UserActionSubscribeNow,
			ReturnURL:           returnURL,
			CancelURL:           cancelURL,
		},
		AutoRenewal: true,
	}

	createdSubscription, err := c.client.CreateSubscription(ctx, subscription)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create subscription: %w", err)
	}

	if c.logger != nil {
		c.logger.Printf("Created PayPal subscription %s for plan %s", createdSubscription.ID, planID)
	}

	return createdSubscription, nil
}

// GetSubscription retrieves subscription details
func (c *Client) GetSubscription(ctx context.Context, subscriptionID string) (*paypal.SubscriptionDetailResp, error) {
	subscription, err := c.client.GetSubscriptionDetails(ctx, subscriptionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get subscription: %w", err)
	}

	return subscription, nil
}

// CancelSubscription cancels a subscription
func (c *Client) CancelSubscription(ctx context.Context, subscriptionID string, reason string) error {
	err := c.client.CancelSubscription(ctx, subscriptionID, reason)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to cancel subscription: %w", err)
	}

	if c.logger != nil {
		c.logger.Printf("Cancelled PayPal subscription %s", subscriptionID)
	}

	return nil
}

// VerifyWebhookSignature verifies webhook signature from PayPal
func (c *Client) VerifyWebhookSignature(ctx context.Context, webhookID string, headers map[string]string, body []byte) error {
	// PayPal webhook verification
	// Note: This requires the webhook ID from PayPal dashboard
	webhookAuthAlgo := headers["PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO"]
	webhookTransmissionID := headers["PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID"]
	webhookCertURL := headers["PAYPAL-CERT-URL"]
	webhookTransmissionSig := headers["PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG"]
	webhookTransmissionTime := headers["PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME"]

	if webhookAuthAlgo == "" || webhookTransmissionID == "" || webhookCertURL == "" || webhookTransmissionSig == "" || webhookTransmissionTime == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("missing required PayPal webhook headers")
	}

	// For now, we'll do basic validation
	// Full signature verification would require downloading the certificate from webhookCertURL
	// and verifying the signature using webhookAuthAlgo
	// This is a simplified version - in production, implement full verification

	if c.logger != nil {
		c.logger.Printf("Webhook verification headers present for webhook %s", webhookID)
	}

	return nil
}

package telegram

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// Client handles communication with the Telegram service
type Client struct {
	baseURL string
	client  *http.Client
}

// NewClient creates a new Telegram service client
func NewClient(baseURL string) *Client {
	return &Client{
		baseURL: baseURL,
		client: &http.Client{
			Timeout: 30 * time.Second,
		},
	}
}

// TelegramMessage represents a Telegram message
type TelegramMessage struct {
	ID   int    `json:"id"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
	Date string `json:"date"`
	Link string `json:"link"`
}

// FetchUpdatesRequest represents the request body for fetching updates
type FetchUpdatesRequest struct {
	Channel string `json:"channel"`
	LastID  int    `json:"last_id"`
}

// FetchUpdates fetches new messages from a Telegram channel
func (c *Client) FetchUpdates(ctx context.Context, channelUsername string, lastMessageID int) ([]TelegramMessage, error) {
	reqBody := FetchUpdatesRequest{
		Channel: channelUsername,
		LastID:  lastMessageID,
	}

	bodyBytes, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal request: %w", err)
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, c.baseURL+"/api/v1/telegram/updates", bytes.NewReader(bodyBytes))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute request: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("telegram service returned status %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	var messages []TelegramMessage
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&messages); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode response: %w", err)
	}

	return messages, nil
}

// adapter for discovery.TelegramFetcher expected type
// Note: orchestrator uses a compatible subset (ID, Text, Date, Link)

// Ensure interface compatibility with discovery.TelegramFetcher
// This method signature already matches; the orchestrator expects a slice of structs {ID,Text,Date,Link}

// HealthCheck checks if the Telegram service is available
func (c *Client) HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, c.baseURL+"/healthz", nil)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
	}

	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("health check failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return fmt.Errorf("health check returned status %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	return nil
}

// SourceProfilingPrompt defines a STRICT JSON contract aligned with the legacy
// SourceProfileDataDto (see temp-repos/etigram-backend/web/src/types/dto.ts lines ~784+).
// The model MUST return exactly one JSON object that conforms to this schema.
const SourceProfilingPrompt = `You are an expert media analyst. Analyze this source content and produce a STRICT JSON object following the schema below. Do NOT include any explanations or markdown. Output ONE JSON object only.

SOURCE: {sourceId}
LANGUAGE: {language}

CONTENT:
{extractedText}

TASK:
- Build a structured source profile for Discovery. Use ONLY the provided CONTENT (no external knowledge or links fetching).
- If CONTENT is in a different language, still produce textual fields in {language} while preserving meaning.
- When evidence is insufficient, set fields to null or omit them; never invent facts.
- All ratio-like numeric values MUST be normalized to [0,1]. Topic/method shares across arrays SHOULD sum to ≤ 1.0.
- Keep numbers with 2 decimal digits where applicable.
- For targetAudienceCountries, output ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in UPPERCASE (e.g., RU, US, DE). Do not use full country names.

REQUIRED JSON SCHEMA (keys and types MUST match exactly; omit unknown fields or use nulls where appropriate):
{
  "editorialStance": {
    "political": "string",
    "confidence": 0.0,
    "evidence": ["string"]
  },
  "agenda": {

  "behaviorPatterns": {
    "publishingCadence": "string",
    "eventResponsiveness": 0.0,

      "neutral": 0.0,

    },

      { "entityName": "string", "mentionCount": 0, "averageSentiment": 0.0 }
    ]
  },
  "topics": [ { "name": "string", "share": 0.0, "trend": "up|down|flat" } ],
  "editorialMethods": [ { "method": "string", "share": 0.0 } ],
  "goals": [ { "goal": "string", "confidence": 0.0 } ],

  },
  "targetAudienceCountries": ["ISO_3166-1_alpha-2"],
  "redFlags": [ { "code": "string", "score": 0.0, "rationale": "string" } ],
  "coordinatedSources": [ { "sourceId": "string", "coordinationScore": 0.0 } ],
  "flags": ["string"]
}

TOPIC EXTRACTION GUIDELINES:
- Return 3-8 topics that reflect distinct, recurring themes observed in CONTENT (not generic labels).
- Topic names must be concise noun phrases (≤ 4 words), human-readable, and specific; avoid generic terms like "news", "politics", "economy".
- Merge synonyms/variants into a single canonical topic (e.g., "AI" and "artificial intelligence" → "Artificial Intelligence").
- For each topic, set share ∈ [0,1] proportional to its relative prominence; the sum of all topic shares MUST be ≤ 1.0.
- Drop very minor topics (< 0.02 share) before normalization; deduplicate strictly (no duplicate names).
- Set trend to one of {up,down,flat} based on relative prominence changes implied by the text; if unclear, use "flat".

STRICT RULES:
- Output MUST be valid JSON matching the schema (no extra top-level keys).
- Numeric values MUST be within [0..1] when applicable.
- Use null or omit fields if data cannot be inferred.
- Do NOT wrap in code fences; return raw JSON only.
`

// AnswerSynthesisPrompt instructs the model to generate a concise, well-grounded
// textual answer that directly addresses the user's query based on multiple
// previously extracted source profiles.
const AnswerSynthesisPrompt = `You are an expert analyst synthesizing information from multiple sources.

USER QUERY: {queryText}

SOURCE PROFILES (JSON array):
{profilesJson}

Generate a comprehensive, clear answer that:
1) Directly addresses the user's query in {language} language
2) Summarizes key findings from analyzed sources
3) Highlights patterns and insights discovered across sources
4) Notes source reliability if relevant concerns exist
5) Provides necessary context for understanding the information

ANSWER REQUIREMENTS:
- Write in {language}
- Be concise but informative (3-5 paragraphs)
- Use clear, accessible language

CRITICAL:

// Format replaces placeholders in a template with provided values.
// Placeholders are in the form {key}. Missing keys will remain unchanged.
func Format(template string, params map[string]string) string {
	result := template
	for k, v := range params {
		result = strings.ReplaceAll(result, "{"+k+"}", v)
	}
	return result
}

package gemini

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// Profile enumerates supported model profiles
type Profile string

const (
	ProfileFast    Profile = "fast"
	ProfileQuality Profile = "quality"
)

// Options configures a single generate call
type Options struct {
	Profile           Profile `json:"profile"`
	ModelOverride     string  `json:"modelOverride"`
	Temperature       float64 `json:"temperature"`
	MaxOutputTokens   int     `json:"maxOutputTokens"`
	GroundingEnabled  bool    `json:"groundingEnabled"`
	SystemInstruction string  `json:"systemInstruction"`
	ResponseFormat    string  `json:"responseFormat"` // "text" | "json"
}

// Tool represents a function declaration for tool calling
type Tool struct {
	Name        string                 `json:"name"`
	Description string                 `json:"description"`
	Parameters  map[string]interface{} `json:"parameters"` // JSON Schema
}

// sanitizeSchema removes fields unsupported by Gemini's function_declarations schema
// such as additionalProperties, recursively.
func sanitizeSchema(v interface{}) interface{} {
	switch m := v.(type) {
	case map[string]interface{}:
		// Drop unsupported key
		delete(m, "additionalProperties")
		for k, val := range m {
			m[k] = sanitizeSchema(val)
		}
		return m
	case []interface{}:
		for i, el := range m {
			m[i] = sanitizeSchema(el)
		}
		return m
	default:
		return v
	}
}

// ToolCall returned by the model
type ToolCall struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	// JSON-encoded arguments as provided by the model
	Arguments string `json:"arguments"`
	CallID    string `json:"callId,omitempty"`
}

// Usage captures token accounting where available
type Usage struct {
	PromptTokens int `json:"promptTokens"`
	OutputTokens int `json:"outputTokens"`
	TotalTokens  int `json:"totalTokens"`
	// Additional metrics when available
	ReasoningTokens     int `json:"reasoningTokens,omitempty"`
	ToolUsePromptTokens int `json:"toolUsePromptTokens,omitempty"`
}

// Attribution represents grounding sources (when enabled)
type Attribution struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
	URL   string `json:"url"`
}

// GenerateResponse is a unified response shape
type GenerateResponse struct {
	Content       string        `json:"content"`
	ToolCalls     []ToolCall    `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
	IsToolStep    bool          `json:"isToolStep"`
	Usage         Usage         `json:"usage"`
	Attributions  []Attribution `json:"attributions,omitempty"`
	SearchQueries []string      `json:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
	Sources       []string      `json:"sources,omitempty"`
	Model         string        `json:"model"`
	// For OpenAI-backed flows we propagate raw output items to support follow-up function_call_output linkage
	OutputRaw []map[string]interface{} `json:"-"`
	// RawJSON contains the unmodified JSON body returned by the provider
	RawJSON string `json:"-"`
}

// Client is an isolated Gemini client that does not depend on task executor/model manager
type Client struct {
	apiKey       string
	httpClient   *http.Client
	streamClient *http.Client
	projectID    string
	location     string
	// configured model names; overridable per-call via Options.ModelOverride
	fastModel    string
	qualityModel string
}

// NewClient creates a new Gemini client
func NewClient(apiKey, projectID, location string, fastModel, qualityModel string) *Client {
	key := strings.TrimSpace(apiKey)
	key = strings.Trim(key, "\"'")
	if fastModel == "" {
		fastModel = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite"
	}
	if qualityModel == "" {
		qualityModel = "gemini-2.5-pro"
	}
	return &Client{
		apiKey:       key,
		httpClient:   &http.Client{Timeout: 240 * time.Second},
		streamClient: &http.Client{},
		projectID:    projectID,
		location:     location,
		fastModel:    fastModel,
		qualityModel: qualityModel,
	}
}

func (c *Client) modelFrom(opts Options) string {
	if opts.ModelOverride != "" {
		return opts.ModelOverride
	}
	if opts.Profile == ProfileQuality {
		return c.qualityModel
	}
	return c.fastModel
}

// Generate executes a single-shot generation, with optional grounding and tools.
func (c *Client) Generate(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)

	reqBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"contents": []map[string]interface{}{
			{
				"role":  "user",
				"parts": []map[string]interface{}{{"text": prompt}},
			},
		},
	}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		reqBody["system_instruction"] = map[string]interface{}{
			"parts": []map[string]interface{}{{"text": opts.SystemInstruction}},
		}
	}
	if opts.Temperature > 0 || opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 || opts.ResponseFormat != "" {
		gc := map[string]interface{}{}
		if opts.Temperature > 0 {
			gc["temperature"] = opts.Temperature
		}
		if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
			gc["max_output_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
		}
		// Do not set response_mime_type when tools are present (function calling is incompatible)
		if opts.ResponseFormat != "" && len(tools) == 0 {
			if opts.ResponseFormat == "json" {
				gc["response_mime_type"] = "application/json"
			} else {
				gc["response_mime_type"] = "text/plain"
			}
		}
		if len(gc) > 0 {
			reqBody["generationConfig"] = gc
		}
	}

	// Tools: function_declarations and google_search grounding (v1beta)
	toolsPayload := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0)
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		fdecls := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
		for _, t := range tools {
			fdecls = append(fdecls, map[string]interface{}{
				"name":        t.Name,
				"description": t.Description,
				"parameters":  t.Parameters,
			})
		}
		toolsPayload = append(toolsPayload, map[string]interface{}{"function_declarations": fdecls})
	}
	if opts.GroundingEnabled {
		// enable search grounding only when explicitly requested
		toolsPayload = append(toolsPayload, map[string]interface{}{"google_search": map[string]interface{}{}})
	}
	if len(toolsPayload) > 0 {
		reqBody["tools"] = toolsPayload
	}

	body, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Use v1beta for structured outputs compatibility
	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/%s:generateContent", model)
	httpReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, url, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	httpReq.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", c.apiKey)
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	rb, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gemini error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}

	// Parse Gemini response
	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rb, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	out := &GenerateResponse{Model: model}
	out.RawJSON = string(rb)
	// Extract text content and/or tool calls
	if cands, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(cands) > 0 {
		if cand, ok := cands[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			// parts
			if content, ok := cand["content"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if parts, ok := content["parts"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, p := range parts {
						if m, ok := p.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							if txt, ok := m["text"].(string); ok && txt != "" {
								out.Content += txt
							}
							if fc, ok := m["functionCall"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								name, _ := fc["name"].(string)
								// arguments may be object or string depending on API variant
								var argsJSON string
								if rawArgs, ok := fc["args"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									b, _ := json.Marshal(rawArgs)
									argsJSON = string(b)
								} else if s, ok := fc["args"].(string); ok {
									argsJSON = s
								}
								out.ToolCalls = append(out.ToolCalls, ToolCall{Name: name, Arguments: argsJSON})
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	out.IsToolStep = len(out.ToolCalls) > 0 && out.Content == ""

	// Usage (best effort; fields vary by API version)
	if u, ok := root["usageMetadata"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
		if v, ok := u["promptTokenCount"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.PromptTokens = int(v)
		}
		if v, ok := u["candidatesTokenCount"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.OutputTokens = int(v)
		}
		if v, ok := u["thoughtsTokenCount"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.ReasoningTokens = int(v)
		}
		if v, ok := u["toolUsePromptTokenCount"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.ToolUsePromptTokens = int(v)
		}
		out.Usage.TotalTokens = out.Usage.PromptTokens + out.Usage.OutputTokens
	}

	// Grounding attributions and sources (best effort)
	if cmeta, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(cmeta) > 0 {
		if cand0, ok := cmeta[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if meta, ok := cand0["groundingMetadata"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				// collect sources from groundingChunks.web.uri, filtering vertex redirect hosts
				if chs, ok := meta["groundingChunks"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, ch := range chs {
						if m, ok := ch.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							if w, ok := m["web"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								if uri, ok := w["uri"].(string); ok {
									u := strings.TrimSpace(uri)
									if u != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(u), "vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com") {
										// append unique
										exists := false
										for _, ex := range out.Sources {
											if ex == u {
												exists = true
												break
											}
										}
										if !exists {
											out.Sources = append(out.Sources, u)
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if atts, ok := meta["groundingAttributions"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, a := range atts {
						if am, ok := a.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							att := Attribution{}
							if s, ok := am["web"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								att.Title, _ = s["title"].(string)
								att.URL, _ = s["uri"].(string)
							}
							if att.URL != "" || att.Title != "" {
								out.Attributions = append(out.Attributions, att)
								// also collect non-vertex URLs into sources
								if strings.TrimSpace(att.URL) != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(att.URL), "vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com") {
									exists := false
									for _, ex := range out.Sources {
										if ex == att.URL {
											exists = true
											break
										}
									}
									if !exists {
										out.Sources = append(out.Sources, att.URL)
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return out, nil
}

// GenerateJSON enforces JSON output and optionally a response schema
func (c *Client) GenerateJSON(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, jsonSchema map[string]interface{}, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	opts.ResponseFormat = "json"
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	reqBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"contents": []map[string]interface{}{{
			"role":  "user",
			"parts": []map[string]interface{}{{"text": prompt}},
		}},
	}
	// Do NOT set response_mime_type when using function calling (unsupported)
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 || opts.Temperature > 0 {
		gc := map[string]interface{}{}
		if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
			gc["max_output_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
		}
		if opts.Temperature > 0 {
			gc["temperature"] = opts.Temperature
		}
		if len(gc) > 0 {
			reqBody["generationConfig"] = gc
		}
	}
	// response_schema is not supported on this endpoint; enforce JSON via response_mime_type only
	toolsPayload := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0)
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		fdecls := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
		for _, t := range tools {
			fdecls = append(fdecls, map[string]interface{}{
				"name":        t.Name,
				"description": t.Description,
				"parameters":  sanitizeSchema(t.Parameters),
			})
		}
		toolsPayload = append(toolsPayload, map[string]interface{}{"function_declarations": fdecls})
	}
	if opts.GroundingEnabled {
		toolsPayload = append(toolsPayload, map[string]interface{}{"google_search": map[string]interface{}{}})
	}
	if len(toolsPayload) > 0 {
		reqBody["tools"] = toolsPayload
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/%s:generateContent", model)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, url, bytes.NewReader(b))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", c.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := c.streamClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	rb, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gemini error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rb, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	gr, err := c.parseGenerateRoot(root, model)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	gr.RawJSON = string(rb)
	return gr, nil
}

// GenerateJSONStrict uses the v1beta Responses API with generation_config.response_schema
// to enforce structured JSON output. This requires models that support structured output.
func (c *Client) GenerateJSONStrict(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, jsonSchema map[string]interface{}, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	// Enforce strict JSON via public v1beta generateContent using a function tool
	// Strictness is achieved by requiring the model to call our tool with jsonSchema
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	reqBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"contents": []map[string]interface{}{{
			"role":  "user",
			"parts": []map[string]interface{}{{"text": prompt}},
		}},
	}
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 || opts.Temperature > 0 {
		gc := map[string]interface{}{}
		if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
			gc["max_output_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
		}
		if opts.Temperature > 0 {
			gc["temperature"] = opts.Temperature
		}
		if len(gc) > 0 {
			reqBody["generationConfig"] = gc
		}
	}
	// Build a single required function tool carrying the schema
	// Note: grounding + tools together is unsupported on public API; do NOT include search here
	fdecls := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
	for _, t := range tools {
		// If caller passed a schema, prefer it; otherwise use tool.Parameters
		params := t.Parameters
		if jsonSchema != nil {
			params = jsonSchema
		}
		fdecls = append(fdecls, map[string]interface{}{
			"name":        t.Name,
			"description": t.Description,
			"parameters":  sanitizeSchema(params),
		})
	}
	// If no tool was provided, create a default return_structured
	if len(fdecls) == 0 {
		if jsonSchema == nil {
			jsonSchema = map[string]interface{}{"type": "object"}
		}
		fdecls = append(fdecls, map[string]interface{}{
			"name":        "return_structured",
			"description": "Return strictly by schema",
			"parameters":  sanitizeSchema(jsonSchema),
		})
	}
	reqBody["tools"] = []map[string]interface{}{{"function_declarations": fdecls}}

	b, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/%s:generateContent", model)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, url, bytes.NewReader(b))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", c.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	rb, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gemini error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rb, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	gr, err := c.parseGenerateRoot(root, model)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	gr.RawJSON = string(rb)
	return gr, nil
}

func (c *Client) parseGenerateRoot(root map[string]interface{}, model string) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	out := &GenerateResponse{Model: model}
	if cands, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(cands) > 0 {
		if cand, ok := cands[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if content, ok := cand["content"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if parts, ok := content["parts"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, p := range parts {
						if m, ok := p.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							if txt, ok := m["text"].(string); ok && txt != "" {
								out.Content += txt
							}
							if fc, ok := m["functionCall"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								name, _ := fc["name"].(string)
								var argsJSON string
								if rawArgs, ok := fc["args"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									b, _ := json.Marshal(rawArgs)
									argsJSON = string(b)
								} else if s, ok := fc["args"].(string); ok {
									argsJSON = s
								}
								out.ToolCalls = append(out.ToolCalls, ToolCall{Name: name, Arguments: argsJSON})
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	out.IsToolStep = len(out.ToolCalls) > 0 && out.Content == ""
	if u, ok := root["usageMetadata"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
		if v, ok := u["promptTokenCount"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.PromptTokens = int(v)
		}
		if v, ok := u["candidatesTokenCount"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.OutputTokens = int(v)
		}
		out.Usage.TotalTokens = out.Usage.PromptTokens + out.Usage.OutputTokens
	}
	if cmeta, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(cmeta) > 0 {
		if cand0, ok := cmeta[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if meta, ok := cand0["groundingMetadata"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if qs, ok := meta["webSearchQueries"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, q := range qs {
						if s, ok := q.(string); ok && s != "" {
							out.SearchQueries = append(out.SearchQueries, s)
						}
					}
				}
				if atts, ok := meta["groundingAttributions"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, a := range atts {
						if am, ok := a.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							att := Attribution{}
							if s, ok := am["web"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								att.Title, _ = s["title"].(string)
								att.URL, _ = s["uri"].(string)
							}
							if att.URL != "" || att.Title != "" {
								out.Attributions = append(out.Attributions, att)
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

// StreamEvent represents incremental streaming callbacks
type StreamEvent struct {
	Type          string        `json:"type"` // start|chunk|tool_call|done|error
	Text          string        `json:"text,omitempty"`
	ToolCalls     []ToolCall    `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
	Usage         Usage         `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	Attributions  []Attribution `json:"attributions,omitempty"`
	SearchQueries []string      `json:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
	Sources       []string      `json:"sources,omitempty"`
	Model         string        `json:"model,omitempty"`
	Error         string        `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

// StreamConversation streams with arbitrary contents history (for tool follow-ups)
func (c *Client) StreamConversation(ctx context.Context, contents []map[string]interface{}, tools []Tool, opts Options, onEvent func(StreamEvent) error) error {
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	reqBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"contents": contents,
	}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		reqBody["system_instruction"] = map[string]interface{}{
			"parts": []map[string]interface{}{{"text": opts.SystemInstruction}},
		}
	}
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 || opts.ResponseFormat != "" || opts.Temperature > 0 {
		gc := map[string]interface{}{}
		if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
			gc["max_output_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
		}
		if opts.Temperature > 0 {
			gc["temperature"] = opts.Temperature
		}
		if opts.ResponseFormat == "json" {
			gc["response_mime_type"] = "application/json"
		} else if opts.ResponseFormat == "text" {
			gc["response_mime_type"] = "text/plain"
		}
		if len(gc) > 0 {
			reqBody["generationConfig"] = gc
		}
	}
	toolsPayload := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0)
    if len(tools) > 0 {
        fdecls := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
        for _, t := range tools {
            fdecls = append(fdecls, map[string]interface{}{"name": t.Name, "description": t.Description, "parameters": t.Parameters})
        }
        // v1beta expects snake_case function_declarations
        toolsPayload = append(toolsPayload, map[string]interface{}{"function_declarations": fdecls})
    }
    if opts.GroundingEnabled || opts.Profile == ProfileQuality {
        // v1beta expects snake_case google_search tool name
        toolsPayload = append(toolsPayload, map[string]interface{}{"google_search": map[string]interface{}{}})
    }
	if len(toolsPayload) > 0 {
		reqBody["tools"] = toolsPayload
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// Use v1beta for streaming to ensure model/method compatibility across profiles
	apiVersion := "v1beta"
	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/%s/models/%s:streamGenerateContent", apiVersion, model)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, url, bytes.NewReader(b))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	req.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", c.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		return fmt.Errorf("gemini stream error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	if onEvent != nil {
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
	}
	// Parse SSE-style stream: accumulate lines starting with "data: " until a blank line
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
	buf := make([]byte, 0, 1024*64)
	scanner.Buffer(buf, 1024*1024)
	var eventBuf strings.Builder
	var accUsage Usage
	var accAtts []Attribution
	var accSources []string
	var accQueries []string
	flushEvent := func() {
		payload := strings.TrimSpace(eventBuf.String())
		eventBuf.Reset()
		if payload == "" || payload == "[DONE]" {
			return
		}
		processRoot := func(root map[string]interface{}) {
			// extract chunk or tool calls
			evt := StreamEvent{}
			if cands, ok := root["candidates"].([]interface{}); ok && len(cands) > 0 {
				if cand, ok := cands[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					if content, ok := cand["content"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						if parts, ok := content["parts"].([]interface{}); ok {
							for _, p := range parts {
								if m, ok := p.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									if txt, ok := m["text"].(string); ok && txt != "" {
										evt.Type = "chunk"
										evt.Text += txt
									}
									if fc, ok := m["functionCall"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
										name, _ := fc["name"].(string)
										var argsJSON string
										if rawArgs, ok := fc["args"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
											b, _ := json.Marshal(rawArgs)
											argsJSON = string(b)
										} else if s, ok := fc["args"].(string); ok {
											argsJSON = s
										}
										evt.ToolCalls = append(evt.ToolCalls, ToolCall{Name: name, Arguments: argsJSON})
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if gm, ok := cand["groundingMetadata"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						// collect webSearchQueries
						if qs, ok := gm["webSearchQueries"].([]interface{}); ok {
							for _, q := range qs {
								if s, ok := q.(string); ok {
									s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
									if s == "" {
										continue
									}
									// append unique
									exists := false
									for _, ex := range accQueries {
										if ex == s {
											exists = true
											break
										}
									}
									if !exists {
										accQueries = append(accQueries, s)
									}
								}
							}
						}
						// collect sources from groundingChunks.web.uri, filtering vertex redirect hosts
						if chs, ok := gm["groundingChunks"].([]interface{}); ok {
							for _, ch := range chs {
								if m, ok := ch.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									if w, ok := m["web"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
										if uri, ok := w["uri"].(string); ok {
											u := strings.TrimSpace(uri)
											if u != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(u), "vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com") {
												// append unique
												exists := false
												for _, ex := range accSources {
													if ex == u {
														exists = true
														break
													}
												}
												if !exists {
													accSources = append(accSources, u)
												}
											}
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if atts, ok := gm["groundingAttributions"].([]interface{}); ok {
							for _, a := range atts {
								if am, ok := a.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									att := Attribution{}
									if s, ok := am["web"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
										att.Title, _ = s["title"].(string)
										att.URL, _ = s["uri"].(string)
									}
									if att.URL != "" || att.Title != "" {
										accAtts = append(accAtts, att)
										// also collect non-vertex URLs into sources
										if strings.TrimSpace(att.URL) != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(att.URL), "vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com") {
											exists := false
											for _, ex := range accSources {
												if ex == att.URL {
													exists = true
													break
												}
											}
											if !exists {
												accSources = append(accSources, att.URL)
											}
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if evt.Type == "" && len(evt.ToolCalls) > 0 {
				evt.Type = "tool_call"
			}
			if evt.Type == "" {
				evt.Type = "chunk"
			}
			if onEvent != nil {
				if err := onEvent(evt); err != nil {
					_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: err.Error()})
				}
			}
			if u, ok := root["usageMetadata"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if v, ok := u["promptTokenCount"].(float64); ok {
					accUsage.PromptTokens = int(v)
				}
				if v, ok := u["candidatesTokenCount"].(float64); ok {
					accUsage.OutputTokens = int(v)
				}
				accUsage.TotalTokens = accUsage.PromptTokens + accUsage.OutputTokens
			}
		}
		// Try object first
		var root map[string]interface{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &root); err == nil {
			processRoot(root)
			return
		}
		// If array, iterate elements
		var arr []interface{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &arr); err == nil {
			for _, el := range arr {
				if m, ok := el.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					processRoot(m)
				}
			}
			return
		}
		// Unknown payload
		if onEvent != nil {
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: "unrecognized stream payload"})
		}
	}
	for scanner.Scan() {
		line := scanner.Text()
		l := strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
		if l == "" {
			// event boundary
			flushEvent()
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(l, ":") {
			// comment/keep-alive
			continue
		}
		// Ignore SSE control fields that are not part of the JSON payload
		if strings.HasPrefix(l, "event:") || strings.HasPrefix(l, "id:") || strings.HasPrefix(l, "retry:") {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(l, "data:") {
			// strip prefix and leading space
			frag := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(l, "data:"))
			if eventBuf.Len() > 0 {
				eventBuf.WriteString("\n")
			}
			eventBuf.WriteString(frag)
			continue
		}
		// Unknown line type; try to treat as raw JSON fragment
		if eventBuf.Len() > 0 {
			eventBuf.WriteString("\n")
		}
		eventBuf.WriteString(strings.TrimSpace(l))
	}
	// flush any remaining event
	flushEvent()
	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		if onEvent != nil {
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: err.Error()})
		}
		return err
	}
	if onEvent != nil {
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: accUsage, Attributions: accAtts, SearchQueries: accQueries, Sources: accSources, Model: model})
	}
	return nil
}

// Stream is a convenience wrapper for one-turn conversation
func (c *Client) Stream(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options, onEvent func(StreamEvent) error) error {
	contents := []map[string]interface{}{
		{"role": "user", "parts": []map[string]interface{}{{"text": prompt}}},
	}
	return c.StreamConversation(ctx, contents, tools, opts, onEvent)
}
