package gemini

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/telegram"
)

// ToolExecutor executes whitelisted tools with timeouts
type ToolExecutor interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, name string, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
	IsAllowed(name string) bool
}

// SimpleRegistry is a minimal in-memory registry implementation
type SimpleRegistry struct {
	allowed map[string]func(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
	tg      *telegram.Client
}

func NewSimpleRegistry() *SimpleRegistry {
	r := &SimpleRegistry{allowed: map[string]func(context.Context, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error){}}
	// Register a couple of safe built-ins
	r.Register("time_now", func(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
		type Out struct {
			ISO  string `json:"iso"`
			Unix int64  `json:"unix"`
		}
		o := Out{ISO: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), Unix: time.Now().UTC().Unix()}
		b, _ := json.Marshal(o)
		return b, nil
	})
	r.Register("echo", func(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
		// echoes arguments back
		if len(args) == 0 {
			return json.RawMessage([]byte(`{"ok":true}`)), nil
		}
		return args, nil
	})

	// Optional: register Telegram fetch tool if service URL is configured
	if base := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("TELEGRAM_SERVICE_URL")); base != "" {
		r.tg = telegram.NewClient(base)
		r.Register("telegram_fetch_updates", r.telegramFetchUpdates)
	}
	return r
}

func (r *SimpleRegistry) Register(name string, fn func(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)) {
	r.allowed[name] = fn
}

func (r *SimpleRegistry) Execute(ctx context.Context, name string, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	fn, ok := r.allowed[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("tool not allowed: %s", name)
	}
	// default timeout per tool call
	cctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	return fn(cctx, args)
}

func (r *SimpleRegistry) IsAllowed(name string) bool {
	_, ok := r.allowed[name]
	return ok
}

// ExecuteWithTools runs tool-calling loop up to maxDepth
func (c *Client) ExecuteWithTools(ctx context.Context, prompt string, toolDecls []Tool, exec ToolExecutor, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	const maxDepth = 4
	step := 0
	nextPrompt := prompt
	var last *GenerateResponse
	for step < maxDepth {
		step++
		resp, err := c.Generate(ctx, nextPrompt, toolDecls, opts)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		last = resp
		if len(resp.ToolCalls) == 0 {
			return resp, nil
		}
		// gather tool results
		results := make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
		for _, call := range resp.ToolCalls {
			if !exec.IsAllowed(call.Name) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("tool not allowed: %s", call.Name)
			}
			var args json.RawMessage = json.RawMessage(call.Arguments)
			out, err := exec.Execute(ctx, call.Name, args)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			results[call.Name] = out
		}
		// feed results back to model as a structured prompt
		b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{"toolResults": results})
		nextPrompt = string(b)
	}
	return last, errors.New("tool loop exceeded max depth")
}

// StreamWithTools performs real-time streaming with tool-calling support (single turn + one tools round-trip)
func (c *Client) StreamWithTools(ctx context.Context, prompt string, toolDecls []Tool, exec ToolExecutor, opts Options, onEvent func(StreamEvent) error) error {
	var pendingCalls []ToolCall
	// first: stream until we either complete or receive tool calls
	err := c.Stream(ctx, prompt, toolDecls, opts, func(e StreamEvent) error {
		switch e.Type {
		case "chunk":
			return onEvent(e)
		case "tool_call":
			pendingCalls = append(pendingCalls, e.ToolCalls...)
			return onEvent(e)
		case "start", "done":
			return onEvent(e)
		case "error":
			return onEvent(e)
		default:
			return onEvent(e)
		}
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(pendingCalls) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	// Execute tools and continue
	results := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(pendingCalls))
	for _, call := range pendingCalls {
		if !exec.IsAllowed(call.Name) {
			return errors.New("tool not allowed: " + call.Name)
		}
		out, err := exec.Execute(ctx, call.Name, json.RawMessage(call.Arguments))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_result", ToolCalls: []ToolCall{{Name: call.Name, Arguments: string(out)}}})
		results = append(results, map[string]interface{}{"role": "tool", "parts": []map[string]interface{}{{"text": string(out)}}})
	}

	// Continue streaming with tool results appended as contents
	contents := []map[string]interface{}{
		{"role": "user", "parts": []map[string]interface{}{{"text": prompt}}},
	}
	contents = append(contents, results...)
	return c.StreamConversation(ctx, contents, toolDecls, opts, onEvent)
}

// normalizeTelegramChannel converts @name or t.me/name[/...] to username
func normalizeTelegramChannel(input string) (string, error) {
	s := strings.TrimSpace(input)
	if s == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("INVALID_CHANNEL_FORMAT: empty")
	}
	// Handle @username
	s = strings.TrimPrefix(s, "@")
	// URLs: http(s)://t.me/... or t.me/...
	if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(s), "t.me/") {
		// strip scheme
		s = strings.TrimPrefix(s, "https://")
		s = strings.TrimPrefix(s, "http://")
		// remove domain
		if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s), "t.me/") {
			s = s[len("t.me/"):]
		}
		s = strings.TrimLeft(s, "/")
		parts := strings.Split(s, "/")
		if len(parts) == 0 {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("INVALID_CHANNEL_FORMAT: missing path")
		}
		first := parts[0]
		if first == "c" || first == "+" || strings.HasPrefix(first, "+") || first == "joinchat" {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("PRIVATE_OR_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		if first == "s" {
			if len(parts) < 2 {
				return "", fmt.Errorf("INVALID_CHANNEL_FORMAT: missing username")
			}
			s = parts[1]
		} else {
			s = first
		}
	}
	// Basic validation: Telegram usernames are 5..32 chars [A-Za-z0-9_]
	if len(s) < 5 || len(s) > 32 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("INVALID_CHANNEL_FORMAT: bad length")
	}
	for _, ch := range s {
		if !(ch == '_' || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9')) {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("INVALID_CHANNEL_FORMAT: invalid character")
		}
	}
	return s, nil
}

// telegramFetchUpdates is the runtime for tool "telegram_fetch_updates"
func (r *SimpleRegistry) telegramFetchUpdates(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	if r.tg == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: telegram client not configured")
	}
	var in struct {
		Channel string `json:"channel"`
		LastID  int    `json:"lastId"`
		Limit   int    `json:"limit"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(args, &in); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("INVALID_ARGUMENTS: %v", err)
	}
	username, err := normalizeTelegramChannel(in.Channel)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if in.Limit <= 0 {
		in.Limit = 50
	}
	if in.Limit > 100 {
		in.Limit = 100
	}
	msgs, err := r.tg.FetchUpdates(ctx, username, in.LastID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: %v", err)
	}
	// Trim to limit and compute nextLastId
	next := in.LastID
	if len(msgs) > in.Limit {
		msgs = msgs[:in.Limit]
	}
	for _, m := range msgs {
		if m.ID > next {
			next = m.ID
		}
	}
	out := map[string]interface{}{
		"messages":   msgs,
		"nextLastId": next,
		"stats":      map[string]interface{}{"count": len(msgs)},
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(out)
	return b, nil
}

// NewTelegramFetchToolDeclaration returns tool declaration for function-calling
func NewTelegramFetchToolDeclaration() Tool {
	return Tool{
		Name:        "telegram_fetch_updates",
		Description: "Fetch recent messages from a public Telegram channel by username",
		Parameters: map[string]interface{}{
			"type": "object",
			"properties": map[string]interface{}{
				"channel": map[string]interface{}{"type": "string", "description": "Channel reference: @name or t.me/name"},
				"lastId":  map[string]interface{}{"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
				"limit":   map[string]interface{}{"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 100},
			},
			"required":             []string{"channel", "lastId", "limit"},
			"additionalProperties": false,
		},
	}
}

package claude

import (
    "bufio"
    "bytes"
    "context"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "strings"
    "time"
)

type Tool struct {
    Name        string                 `json:"name"`
    Description string                 `json:"description"`
    Parameters  map[string]interface{} `json:"parameters"`
}

type ToolCall struct {
    Name      string `json:"name"`
    Arguments string `json:"arguments"`
    CallID    string `json:"callId,omitempty"`
}

type Usage struct {
    PromptTokens int `json:"promptTokens"`
    OutputTokens int `json:"outputTokens"`
    TotalTokens  int `json:"totalTokens"`
}

type GenerateResponse struct {
    Content       string                   `json:"content"`
    ToolCalls     []ToolCall               `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
    IsToolStep    bool                     `json:"isToolStep"`
    Usage         Usage                    `json:"usage"`
    Model         string                   `json:"model"`
    OutputRaw     []map[string]interface{} `json:"-"`
    RawJSON       string                   `json:"-"`
    SearchQueries []string                 `json:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
    Sources       []string                 `json:"sources,omitempty"`
}

// StreamEvent represents incremental streaming callbacks
type StreamEvent struct {
    Type      string     `json:"type"` // start|chunk|tool_call|done|error
    Text      string     `json:"text,omitempty"`
    ToolCalls []ToolCall `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
    Usage     Usage      `json:"usage,omitempty"`
    Model     string     `json:"model,omitempty"`
    Error     string     `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type Options struct {
    ModelOverride     string  `json:"modelOverride"`
    Temperature       float64 `json:"temperature"`
    MaxOutputTokens   int     `json:"maxOutputTokens"`
    GroundingEnabled  bool    `json:"groundingEnabled"`
    SystemInstruction string  `json:"systemInstruction"`
}

type Client struct {
    apiKey     string
    httpClient *http.Client
}

func NewClient(apiKey string) *Client {
    key := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(apiKey), "\"'")
    return &Client{apiKey: key, httpClient: &http.Client{Timeout: 240 * time.Second}}
}

func (c *Client) modelFrom(opts Options) string {
    if strings.TrimSpace(opts.ModelOverride) != "" {
        return opts.ModelOverride
    }
    return "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"
}

// Generate uses Anthropic Messages API with optional tool use
func (c *Client) Generate(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
    model := c.modelFrom(opts)
    // Build request with top-level system and content blocks
    req := map[string]interface{}{
        "model": model,
        "messages": []map[string]interface{}{
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": []map[string]interface{}{
                    {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
                },
            },
        },
    }
    if s := strings.TrimSpace(opts.SystemInstruction); s != "" {
        req["system"] = s
    }
    if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
        req["max_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
    } else {
        req["max_tokens"] = 1024
    }
    if opts.Temperature > 0 {
        req["temperature"] = opts.Temperature
    }
    // Tools mapping (Anthropic: tools with input_schema)
    if len(tools) > 0 {
        tdefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
        for _, t := range tools {
            schema := t.Parameters
            if schema == nil {
                schema = map[string]interface{}{"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false}
            } else {
                schema["additionalProperties"] = false
            }
            tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{
                "name":         t.Name,
                "description":  t.Description,
                "input_schema": schema,
            })
        }
        req["tools"] = tdefs
        // If a single required tool is provided (e.g., return_structured), force its use
        if len(tools) == 1 && strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(tools[0].Name)) == "return_structured" {
            req["tool_choice"] = map[string]string{"type": "tool", "name": tools[0].Name}
        } else {
            req["tool_choice"] = map[string]string{"type": "auto"}
        }
    }

    body, _ := json.Marshal(req)
    httpReq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", bytes.NewReader(body))
    httpReq.Header.Set("x-api-key", c.apiKey)
    httpReq.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
    httpReq.Header.Set("content-type", "application/json")
    resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(httpReq)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("anthropic error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
    }
    var root map[string]interface{}
    if err := json.Unmarshal(rb, &root); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    out := &GenerateResponse{Model: model, RawJSON: string(rb)}
    // Usage
    if u, ok := root["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
        if v, ok := u["input_tokens"].(float64); ok { out.Usage.PromptTokens = int(v) }
        if v, ok := u["output_tokens"].(float64); ok { out.Usage.OutputTokens = int(v) }
        out.Usage.TotalTokens = out.Usage.PromptTokens + out.Usage.OutputTokens
    }
    // Content and tool calls
    if arr, ok := root["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
        for _, it := range arr {
            if m, ok := it.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                if m["type"] == "text" {
                    if t, _ := m["text"].(string); t != "" {
                        out.Content += t
                        extractURLsFromText(t, &out.Sources)
                    }
                } else if m["type"] == "tool_use" {
                    name, _ := m["name"].(string)
                    id, _ := m["id"].(string)
                    var args string
                    if obj, ok := m["input"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                        if b, err := json.Marshal(obj); err == nil { args = string(b); extractURLsFromMap(obj, &out.Sources) }
                    }
                    out.ToolCalls = append(out.ToolCalls, ToolCall{Name: name, Arguments: args, CallID: id})
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out.IsToolStep = len(out.ToolCalls) > 0 && out.Content == ""
    return out, nil
}

// Stream uses Anthropic Messages SSE to stream text/tool events
func (c *Client) Stream(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options, onEvent func(StreamEvent) error) error {
    model := c.modelFrom(opts)
    req := map[string]interface{}{
        "model": model,
        "messages": []map[string]interface{}{
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": []map[string]interface{}{{"type": "text", "text": prompt}},
            },
        },
        "stream": true,
    }
    if s := strings.TrimSpace(opts.SystemInstruction); s != "" {
        req["system"] = s
    }
    if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 { req["max_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens } else { req["max_tokens"] = 1024 }
    if opts.Temperature > 0 { req["temperature"] = opts.Temperature }
    if len(tools) > 0 {
        tdefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
        for _, t := range tools {
            schema := t.Parameters
            if schema == nil { schema = map[string]interface{}{"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false} } else { schema["additionalProperties"] = false }
            tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{"name": t.Name, "description": t.Description, "input_schema": schema})
        }
        req["tools"] = tdefs
        // Prefer auto; if single 'return_structured' then force
        if len(tools) == 1 && strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(tools[0].Name), "return_structured") {
            req["tool_choice"] = map[string]string{"type": "tool", "name": tools[0].Name}
        } else {
            req["tool_choice"] = map[string]string{"type": "auto"}
        }
    }
    b, _ := json.Marshal(req)
    httpReq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", bytes.NewReader(b))
    httpReq.Header.Set("x-api-key", c.apiKey)
    httpReq.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
    httpReq.Header.Set("content-type", "application/json")
    httpReq.Header.Set("accept", "text/event-stream")
    resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(httpReq)
    if err != nil { return err }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        return fmt.Errorf("anthropic stream error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
    }
    if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start", Model: model}) }
    reader := bufio.NewReader(resp.Body)
    var (
        curEvent string
        dataBuf  strings.Builder
        accUsage Usage
    )
    flush := func() error {
        payload := strings.TrimSpace(dataBuf.String())
        dataBuf.Reset()
        if payload == "" { return nil }
        // Anthropic sends JSON per event
        var m map[string]interface{}
        if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &m); err != nil { return nil }
        switch curEvent {
        case "content_block_delta":
            // {"delta":{"type":"text_delta","text":"..."}}
            if d, ok := m["delta"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                if txt, _ := d["text"].(string); txt != "" {
                    if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: txt}) }
                }
            }
        case "content_block_start":
            // tool_use start
            if cb, ok := m["content_block"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                if t, _ := cb["type"].(string); t == "tool_use" {
                    name, _ := cb["name"].(string)
                    var args string
                    if in, ok := cb["input"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                        if bb, err := json.Marshal(in); err == nil { args = string(bb) }
                    }
                    if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: []ToolCall{{Name: name, Arguments: args}}}) }
                }
            }
        case "message_start":
            // Input tokens are reported in message_start
            if u, ok := m["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                if usage, ok := u["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                    if v, ok := usage["input_tokens"].(float64); ok { accUsage.PromptTokens = int(v) }
                }
            }
        case "message_delta":
            if u, ok := m["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                // Some models may report input_tokens in message_delta as well
                if v, ok := u["input_tokens"].(float64); ok { accUsage.PromptTokens = int(v) }
                if v, ok := u["output_tokens"].(float64); ok { accUsage.OutputTokens = int(v) }
            }
        case "message_stop":
            // Compute TotalTokens before sending done event
            accUsage.TotalTokens = accUsage.PromptTokens + accUsage.OutputTokens
            if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: accUsage, Model: model}) }
            return io.EOF
        case "error":
            if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: payload}) }
        }
        return nil
    }
    for {
        line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
        if err != nil {
            if err == io.EOF {
                _ = flush()
                break
            }
            return err
        }
        l := strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
        if l == "" {
            if err := flush(); err != nil {
                if err == io.EOF { return nil }
                return err
            }
            curEvent = ""
            continue
        }
        if strings.HasPrefix(l, "event:") {
            curEvent = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(l, "event:"))
            continue
        }
        if strings.HasPrefix(l, "data:") {
            if dataBuf.Len() > 0 { dataBuf.WriteByte('\n') }
            dataBuf.WriteString(strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(l, "data:")))
            continue
        }
    }
    return nil
}

// Helpers for extracting URLs into Sources
func appendUnique(dst *[]string, v string) {
    for _, x := range *dst { if x == v { return } }
    *dst = append(*dst, v)
}
func extractURLsFromText(s string, dst *[]string) {
    parts := strings.Fields(s)
    for _, p := range parts {
        if strings.HasPrefix(p, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(p, "https://") {
            u := strings.TrimRight(p, ".,;]\\\"'")
            appendUnique(dst, u)
        }
    }
}
func extractURLsFromMap(m map[string]interface{}, dst *[]string) {
    for _, v := range m {
        switch tv := v.(type) {
        case string:
            extractURLsFromText(tv, dst)
        case map[string]interface{}:
            extractURLsFromMap(tv, dst)
        case []interface{}:
            for _, it := range tv {
                if sm, ok := it.(map[string]interface{}); ok { extractURLsFromMap(sm, dst) } else if ss, ok := it.(string); ok { extractURLsFromText(ss, dst) }
            }
        }
    }
}

package deepseek

import (
    "bufio"
    "bytes"
    "context"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "strings"
    "time"
)

type Tool struct {
    Name        string                 `json:"name"`
    Description string                 `json:"description"`
    Parameters  map[string]interface{} `json:"parameters"`
}

type ToolCall struct {
    Name      string `json:"name"`
    Arguments string `json:"arguments"`
    CallID    string `json:"callId,omitempty"`
}

type Usage struct {
    PromptTokens int `json:"promptTokens"`
    OutputTokens int `json:"outputTokens"`
    TotalTokens  int `json:"totalTokens"`
}

type GenerateResponse struct {
    Content       string                   `json:"content"`
    ToolCalls     []ToolCall               `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
    IsToolStep    bool                     `json:"isToolStep"`
    Usage         Usage                    `json:"usage"`
    Model         string                   `json:"model"`
    OutputRaw     []map[string]interface{} `json:"-"`
    RawJSON       string                   `json:"-"`
    SearchQueries []string                 `json:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
    Sources       []string                 `json:"sources,omitempty"`
}

// StreamEvent represents incremental streaming callbacks
type StreamEvent struct {
    Type      string     `json:"type"` // start|chunk|tool_call|done|error
    Text      string     `json:"text,omitempty"`
    ToolCalls []ToolCall `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
    Usage     Usage      `json:"usage,omitempty"`
    Model     string     `json:"model,omitempty"`
    Error     string     `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type Options struct {
    ModelOverride     string  `json:"modelOverride"`
    Temperature       float64 `json:"temperature"`
    MaxOutputTokens   int     `json:"maxOutputTokens"`
    GroundingEnabled  bool    `json:"groundingEnabled"`
    SystemInstruction string  `json:"systemInstruction"`
}

type Client struct {
    apiKey     string
    httpClient *http.Client
}

func NewClient(apiKey string) *Client {
    key := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(apiKey), "\"'")
    return &Client{apiKey: key, httpClient: &http.Client{Timeout: 240 * time.Second}}
}

func (c *Client) modelFrom(opts Options) string {
    if strings.TrimSpace(opts.ModelOverride) != "" { return opts.ModelOverride }
    return "deepseek-chat"
}

// Generate against DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions
func (c *Client) Generate(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
    model := c.modelFrom(opts)
    msgs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, 2)
    if s := strings.TrimSpace(opts.SystemInstruction); s != "" {
        msgs = append(msgs, map[string]interface{}{"role": "system", "content": s})
    }
    msgs = append(msgs, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})

    p := map[string]interface{}{
        "model":    model,
        "messages": msgs,
    }
    if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 { p["max_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens }
    if opts.Temperature > 0 { p["temperature"] = opts.Temperature }
    // Tools
    if len(tools) > 0 {
        tdefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
        for _, t := range tools {
            params := t.Parameters
            if params == nil { params = map[string]interface{}{"type": "object"} }
            params["additionalProperties"] = false
            tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{
                "type": "function",
                "function": map[string]interface{}{
                    "name":        t.Name,
                    "description": t.Description,
                    "parameters":  params,
                },
            })
        }
        p["tools"] = tdefs
        p["tool_choice"] = "auto"
    }

    b, _ := json.Marshal(p)
    req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(b))
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.apiKey)
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil { return nil, err }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("deepseek error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
    }
    var root map[string]interface{}
    if err := json.Unmarshal(rb, &root); err != nil { return nil, err }
    out := &GenerateResponse{Model: model, RawJSON: string(rb)}
    if usage, ok := root["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
        if v, ok := usage["prompt_tokens"].(float64); ok { out.Usage.PromptTokens = int(v) }
        if v, ok := usage["completion_tokens"].(float64); ok { out.Usage.OutputTokens = int(v) }
        if v, ok := usage["total_tokens"].(float64); ok { out.Usage.TotalTokens = int(v) }
    }
    if choices, ok := root["choices"].([]interface{}); ok && len(choices) > 0 {
        if ch, ok := choices[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
            if msg, ok := ch["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                if content, ok := msg["content"].(string); ok {
                    out.Content = content
                    extractURLsFromText(content, &out.Sources)
                }
                if tcs, ok := msg["tool_calls"].([]interface{}); ok {
                    for _, tc := range tcs {
                        if m, ok := tc.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                            if f, ok := m["function"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                                name, _ := f["name"].(string)
                                args := ""
                                if s, ok := f["arguments"].(string); ok { args = s; extractURLsFromText(s, &out.Sources) } else if obj, ok := f["arguments"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                                    bb, _ := json.Marshal(obj); args = string(bb); extractURLsFromMap(obj, &out.Sources)
                                }
                                id, _ := m["id"].(string)
                                out.ToolCalls = append(out.ToolCalls, ToolCall{Name: name, Arguments: args, CallID: id})
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out.IsToolStep = len(out.ToolCalls) > 0 && out.Content == ""
    return out, nil
}

// Stream uses OpenAI-compatible chat/completions SSE with stream=true
func (c *Client) Stream(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options, onEvent func(StreamEvent) error) error {
    model := c.modelFrom(opts)
    msgs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, 2)
    if s := strings.TrimSpace(opts.SystemInstruction); s != "" {
        msgs = append(msgs, map[string]interface{}{"role": "system", "content": s})
    }
    msgs = append(msgs, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})

    p := map[string]interface{}{
        "model":    model,
        "messages": msgs,
        "stream":   true,
    }
    if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 { p["max_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens }
    if opts.Temperature > 0 { p["temperature"] = opts.Temperature }
    if len(tools) > 0 {
        tdefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
        for _, t := range tools {
            params := t.Parameters
            if params == nil { params = map[string]interface{}{"type": "object"} }
            params["additionalProperties"] = false
            tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{
                "type": "function",
                "function": map[string]interface{}{
                    "name":        t.Name,
                    "description": t.Description,
                    "parameters":  params,
                },
            })
        }
        p["tools"] = tdefs
        p["tool_choice"] = "auto"
    }
    b, _ := json.Marshal(p)
    req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(b))
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.apiKey)
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.Header.Set("Accept", "text/event-stream")
    resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(req)
    if err != nil { return err }
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
        rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        return fmt.Errorf("deepseek stream error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
    }
    if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start", Model: model}) }
    reader := bufio.NewReader(resp.Body)
    var dataBuf strings.Builder
    var acc Usage
    flush := func(payload string) error {
        payload = strings.TrimSpace(payload)
        if payload == "" || payload == "[DONE]" { return nil }
        var root map[string]interface{}
        if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &root); err != nil { return nil }
        if chs, ok := root["choices"].([]interface{}); ok && len(chs) > 0 {
            if ch, ok := chs[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                if d, ok := ch["delta"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                    if txt, _ := d["content"].(string); txt != "" {
                        if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: txt}) }
                    }
                    // Tool call deltas
                    if tcs, ok := d["tool_calls"].([]interface{}); ok {
                        for _, tc := range tcs {
                            if m, ok := tc.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                                if f, ok := m["function"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
                                    name, _ := f["name"].(string)
                                    args := ""
                                    if s, ok := f["arguments"].(string); ok { args = s }
                                    if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: []ToolCall{{Name: name, Arguments: args}}}) }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if u, ok := root["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
            if v, ok := u["prompt_tokens"].(float64); ok { acc.PromptTokens = int(v) }
            if v, ok := u["completion_tokens"].(float64); ok { acc.OutputTokens = int(v) }
            if v, ok := u["total_tokens"].(float64); ok { acc.TotalTokens = int(v) }
        }
        return nil
    }
    for {
        line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
        if err != nil {
            if err == io.EOF { _ = flush(dataBuf.String()); break }
            return err
        }
        l := strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
        if strings.HasPrefix(l, "data:") {
            payload := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(l, "data:"))
            if payload == "[DONE]" {
                break
            }
            _ = flush(payload)
            continue
        }
    }
    if onEvent != nil { _ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: acc, Model: model}) }
    return nil
}

// Helpers
func appendUnique(dst *[]string, v string) {
    for _, x := range *dst {
        if x == v {
            return
        }
    }
    *dst = append(*dst, v)
}
func extractURLsFromText(s string, dst *[]string) {
    parts := strings.Fields(s)
    for _, p := range parts {
        if strings.HasPrefix(p, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(p, "https://") {
            u := strings.TrimRight(p, ".,;]\\\"'")
            appendUnique(dst, u)
        }
    }
}
func extractURLsFromMap(m map[string]interface{}, dst *[]string) {
    for _, v := range m {
        switch tv := v.(type) {
        case string:
            extractURLsFromText(tv, dst)
        case map[string]interface{}:
            extractURLsFromMap(tv, dst)
        case []interface{}:
            for _, it := range tv {
                if sm, ok := it.(map[string]interface{}); ok { extractURLsFromMap(sm, dst) } else if ss, ok := it.(string); ok { extractURLsFromText(ss, dst) }
            }
        }
    }
}




================================================================================

package grok

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

//
// Test outcomes observed (2025-10-19) using unified test runner with 8 scenarios per model:
// Scenarios per model (loose = без схемы, strict = со строгой JSON-схемой):
//  1) loose: Q/A only
//  2) loose: Q/A + tool
//  3) loose: Q/A + search
//  4) loose: Q/A + tool + search
//  5) strict: Q/A only (schema)
//  6) strict: Q/A + tool (schema)
//  7) strict: Q/A + search (schema)
//  8) strict: Q/A + tool + search (schema)
//
// grok_fast (grok-4-fast-reasoning) — all 8 scenarios completed successfully.
// - Tool-calling срабатывает (возвращает function calls) в сценариях с tool.
// - Search источники извлекаются; URL парсятся и попадают в Sources.
//
// grok_quality (grok-4-0709) — частичные таймауты:
// - Успешно: loose Q/A only, loose Q/A + search, strict Q/A only, strict Q/A + tool, strict Q/A + search
// - Таймаут: loose Q/A + tool, loose Q/A + tool + search, strict Q/A + tool + search
// - В некоторых успешных ответах встречались «refusal»-сообщения; Raw JSON сохраняется.
//
// Доп. заметка: В отдельных ответах встречались хвостовые символы у URL (например, кавычка или фигурная скобка). Базовая очистка выполнена
// в extractURLsFromText; при необходимости можно расширить список символов под дополнительные случаи.

type Tool struct {
	Name        string                 `json:"name"`
	Description string                 `json:"description"`
	Parameters  map[string]interface{} `json:"parameters"`
}

type ToolCall struct {
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Arguments string `json:"arguments"`
	CallID    string `json:"callId,omitempty"`
}

type Usage struct {
	PromptTokens    int `json:"promptTokens"`
	OutputTokens    int `json:"outputTokens"`
	TotalTokens     int `json:"totalTokens"`
	ReasoningTokens int `json:"reasoningTokens,omitempty"`
}

type GenerateResponse struct {
	Content       string                   `json:"content"`
	ToolCalls     []ToolCall               `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
	IsToolStep    bool                     `json:"isToolStep"`
	Usage         Usage                    `json:"usage"`
	Model         string                   `json:"model"`
	OutputRaw     []map[string]interface{} `json:"-"`
	RawJSON       string                   `json:"-"`
	SearchQueries []string                 `json:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
	Sources       []string                 `json:"sources,omitempty"`
}

// StreamEvent represents incremental streaming callbacks
type StreamEvent struct {
	Type      string     `json:"type"` // start|chunk|tool_call|done|error
	Text      string     `json:"text,omitempty"`
	ToolCalls []ToolCall `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
	Usage     Usage      `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	Model     string     `json:"model,omitempty"`
	Error     string     `json:"error,omitempty"`
	// Best-effort extras
	SearchQueries []string `json:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
	Sources       []string `json:"sources,omitempty"`
}

type Options struct {
	ModelOverride     string  `json:"modelOverride"`
	Temperature       float64 `json:"temperature"`
	MaxOutputTokens   int     `json:"maxOutputTokens"`
	GroundingEnabled  bool    `json:"groundingEnabled"`
	SystemInstruction string  `json:"systemInstruction"`
}

type Client struct {
	apiKey     string
	httpClient *http.Client
}

func NewClient(apiKey string) *Client {
	key := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(apiKey), "\"'")
	// Disable built-in timeout; rely on caller context deadlines
	return &Client{apiKey: key, httpClient: &http.Client{}}
}

func (c *Client) modelFrom(opts Options) string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(opts.ModelOverride) != "" {
		return opts.ModelOverride
	}
	return "grok-4-0709"
}

// Generate against xAI Chat Completions API with function tools and optional web search tool
func (c *Client) Generate(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	msgs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, 2)
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		msgs = append(msgs, map[string]interface{}{"role": "system", "content": opts.SystemInstruction})
	}
	msgs = append(msgs, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})
	p := map[string]interface{}{
		"model":    model,
		"messages": msgs,
	}
	// Enable live search at request level when requested
	if opts.GroundingEnabled {
		p["search"] = map[string]interface{}{
			"enable":  true,
			"sources": []map[string]string{{"type": "web"}},
		}
	}
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
		p["max_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
	}
	if opts.Temperature > 0 {
		p["temperature"] = opts.Temperature
	}
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		toolDefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools)+1)
		for _, t := range tools {
			toolDefs = append(toolDefs, map[string]interface{}{
				"type": "function",
				"function": map[string]interface{}{
					"name":        t.Name,
					"description": t.Description,
					"parameters":  t.Parameters,
				},
			})
		}
		p["tools"] = toolDefs
		p["tool_choice"] = "auto"
	}
	body, _ := json.Marshal(p)
	req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("grok error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rb, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := &GenerateResponse{Model: model}
	out.RawJSON = string(rb)
	if usage, ok := root["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
		if v, ok := usage["prompt_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.PromptTokens = int(v)
			log.Printf("[Grok Generate] Received prompt_tokens: %d", out.Usage.PromptTokens)
		}
		if v, ok := usage["completion_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.OutputTokens = int(v)
			log.Printf("[Grok Generate] Received completion_tokens: %d", out.Usage.OutputTokens)
		}
		if v, ok := usage["total_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.TotalTokens = int(v)
			log.Printf("[Grok Generate] Received total_tokens: %d", out.Usage.TotalTokens)
		}
		if v, ok := usage["reasoning_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.ReasoningTokens = int(v)
			log.Printf("[Grok Generate] Received reasoning_tokens: %d", out.Usage.ReasoningTokens)
		}
		// If total_tokens wasn't provided, calculate it
		if out.Usage.TotalTokens == 0 && (out.Usage.PromptTokens > 0 || out.Usage.OutputTokens > 0) {
			out.Usage.TotalTokens = out.Usage.PromptTokens + out.Usage.OutputTokens
			log.Printf("[Grok Generate] Calculated total_tokens: %d (prompt: %d + output: %d)", out.Usage.TotalTokens, out.Usage.PromptTokens, out.Usage.OutputTokens)
		}
		log.Printf("[Grok Generate] Final usage: prompt=%d, output=%d, total=%d, reasoning=%d", out.Usage.PromptTokens, out.Usage.OutputTokens, out.Usage.TotalTokens, out.Usage.ReasoningTokens)
	} else {
		log.Printf("[Grok Generate] WARNING: No usage field in response for model %s", model)
	}
	if choices, ok := root["choices"].([]interface{}); ok && len(choices) > 0 {
		if ch, ok := choices[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if msg, ok := ch["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if content, ok := msg["content"].(string); ok {
					out.Content = content
					extractURLsFromText(content, &out.Sources)
				}
				if tcs, ok := msg["tool_calls"].([]interface{}); ok {
					for _, tc := range tcs {
						if m, ok := tc.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
							if f, ok := m["function"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								name, _ := f["name"].(string)
								args := ""
								if s, ok := f["arguments"].(string); ok {
									args = s
									extractURLsFromText(s, &out.Sources)
								} else if obj, ok := f["arguments"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									b, _ := json.Marshal(obj)
									args = string(b)
									extractURLsFromMap(obj, &out.Sources)
								}
								id, _ := m["id"].(string)
								out.ToolCalls = append(out.ToolCalls, ToolCall{Name: name, Arguments: args, CallID: id})
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	out.IsToolStep = len(out.ToolCalls) > 0 && out.Content == ""
	return out, nil
}

// Stream against xAI Chat Completions SSE (OpenAI-compatible)
func (c *Client) Stream(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options, onEvent func(StreamEvent) error) error {
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	msgs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, 2)
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		msgs = append(msgs, map[string]interface{}{"role": "system", "content": opts.SystemInstruction})
	}
	msgs = append(msgs, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})
	p := map[string]interface{}{
		"model":    model,
		"messages": msgs,
		"stream":   true,
	}
	if opts.GroundingEnabled {
		p["search"] = map[string]interface{}{
			"enable":  true,
			"sources": []map[string]string{{"type": "web"}},
		}
	}
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
		p["max_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
	}
	if opts.Temperature > 0 {
		p["temperature"] = opts.Temperature
	}
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		toolDefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
		for _, t := range tools {
			toolDefs = append(toolDefs, map[string]interface{}{
				"type": "function",
				"function": map[string]interface{}{
					"name":        t.Name,
					"description": t.Description,
					"parameters":  t.Parameters,
				},
			})
		}
		p["tools"] = toolDefs
		p["tool_choice"] = "auto"
	}
	body, _ := json.Marshal(p)
	req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.apiKey)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "text/event-stream")
	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		return fmt.Errorf("grok stream error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	if onEvent != nil {
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start", Model: model})
	}
	reader := bufio.NewReader(resp.Body)
	var acc Usage
	srcs := make([]string, 0)
	queries := make([]string, 0)
	var lastUsageMessage map[string]interface{}
	for {
		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
		if err != nil {
			if err == io.EOF {
				break
			}
			return err
		}
		l := strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
		if !strings.HasPrefix(l, "data:") {
			continue
		}
		payload := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(l, "data:"))
		if payload == "[DONE]" {
			break
		}
		var m map[string]interface{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &m); err != nil {
			continue
		}

		// Process usage first - it may come in a message without choices
		if u, ok := m["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			lastUsageMessage = m // Save the message containing usage
			if v, ok := u["prompt_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				acc.PromptTokens = int(v)
				log.Printf("[Grok Stream] Received prompt_tokens: %d", acc.PromptTokens)
			}
			if v, ok := u["completion_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				acc.OutputTokens = int(v)
				log.Printf("[Grok Stream] Received completion_tokens: %d", acc.OutputTokens)
			}
			if v, ok := u["total_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				acc.TotalTokens = int(v)
				log.Printf("[Grok Stream] Received total_tokens: %d", acc.TotalTokens)
			}
			if v, ok := u["reasoning_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				acc.ReasoningTokens = int(v)
				log.Printf("[Grok Stream] Received reasoning_tokens: %d", acc.ReasoningTokens)
			}
		}

		// choices[0].delta.content
		if chs, ok := m["choices"].([]interface{}); ok && len(chs) > 0 {
			if ch, ok := chs[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if d, ok := ch["delta"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					if txt, _ := d["content"].(string); txt != "" {
						// accumulate URLs from free text
						extractURLsFromText(txt, &srcs)
						if onEvent != nil {
							_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: txt})
						}
					}
					if tcs, ok := d["tool_calls"].([]interface{}); ok {
						for _, tc := range tcs {
							if tm, ok := tc.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								if f, ok := tm["function"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
									name, _ := f["name"].(string)
									args := ""
									if s, ok := f["arguments"].(string); ok {
										args = s
										extractURLsFromText(s, &srcs)
									}
									if onEvent != nil {
										_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: []ToolCall{{Name: name, Arguments: args}}})
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if fr, _ := ch["finish_reason"].(string); fr == "stop" {
					// emit done at natural stop; usage may come in same payload
				}
			}
		}
	}
	// If total_tokens wasn't provided, calculate it from prompt + output
	if acc.TotalTokens == 0 && (acc.PromptTokens > 0 || acc.OutputTokens > 0) {
		acc.TotalTokens = acc.PromptTokens + acc.OutputTokens
		log.Printf("[Grok Stream] Calculated total_tokens: %d (prompt: %d + output: %d)", acc.TotalTokens, acc.PromptTokens, acc.OutputTokens)
	}
	log.Printf("[Grok Stream] Final usage before onEvent: prompt=%d, output=%d, total=%d, reasoning=%d", acc.PromptTokens, acc.OutputTokens, acc.TotalTokens, acc.ReasoningTokens)
	if lastUsageMessage != nil {
		log.Printf("[Grok Stream] Last usage message had usage field: %v", lastUsageMessage["usage"])
	}
	if onEvent != nil {
		log.Printf("[Grok Stream] Calling onEvent with done event, Usage: %+v", acc)
		if err := onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: acc, Model: model, Sources: srcs, SearchQueries: queries}); err != nil {
			log.Printf("[Grok Stream] onEvent returned error: %v", err)
			return err
		}
		log.Printf("[Grok Stream] onEvent completed successfully")
	} else {
		log.Printf("[Grok Stream] WARNING: onEvent is nil, cannot send done event")
	}
	return nil
}

// Helpers for extracting URLs into Sources
func appendUnique(dst *[]string, v string) {
	for _, x := range *dst {
		if x == v {
			return
		}
	}
	*dst = append(*dst, v)
}
func extractURLsFromText(s string, dst *[]string) {
	parts := strings.Fields(s)
	for _, p := range parts {
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(p, "https://") {
			// Do not trim ')' to preserve URLs with parentheses in the path (e.g., Wikipedia)
			u := strings.TrimRight(p, ".,;]\\\"'")
			appendUnique(dst, u)
		}
	}
}
func extractURLsFromMap(m map[string]interface{}, dst *[]string) {
	for _, v := range m {
		switch tv := v.(type) {
		case string:
			extractURLsFromText(tv, dst)
		case map[string]interface{}:
			extractURLsFromMap(tv, dst)
		case []interface{}:
			for _, it := range tv {
				if sm, ok := it.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					extractURLsFromMap(sm, dst)
				} else if ss, ok := it.(string); ok {
					extractURLsFromText(ss, dst)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

package combined

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log"
	"os"
	"strings"

	cl "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/claude"
	ds "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/deepseek"
	g "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/gemini"
	gr "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/grok"
	oa "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/openai"
)

// Re-export types so HTTP layer can remain unchanged
type Tool = g.Tool
type Options = g.Options
type StreamEvent = g.StreamEvent
type GenerateResponse = g.GenerateResponse

// GenAIRequest defines unified options for a single-shot generation
type GenAIRequest struct {
	Model              string                 `json:"model"`
	Prompt             string                 `json:"prompt"`
	SystemInstruction  string                 `json:"systemInstruction,omitempty"`
	Temperature        float64                `json:"temperature,omitempty"`
	MaxOutputTokens    int                    `json:"maxOutputTokens,omitempty"`
	WebSearchEnabled   bool                   `json:"webSearchEnabled,omitempty"`
	ToolCallingEnabled bool                   `json:"toolCallingEnabled,omitempty"`
	StrictJSONEnabled  bool                   `json:"strictJSONEnabled,omitempty"`
	JSONSchema         map[string]interface{} `json:"jsonSchema,omitempty"`
	Tools              []Tool                 `json:"tools,omitempty"`
	ToolChoice         string                 `json:"toolChoice,omitempty"` // auto|required
	ParallelToolCalls  bool                   `json:"parallelToolCalls,omitempty"`
}

// GenAIResponse is an alias of unified GenerateResponse
type GenAIResponse = GenerateResponse

type Client struct {
	gem *g.Client
	oa  *oa.Client
	gr  *gr.Client
	cl  *cl.Client
	ds  *ds.Client
}

// getenv wraps os.Getenv for consistency
func getenv(k string) string { return os.Getenv(k) }

func NewClient(geminiClient *g.Client, openaiKey string) *Client {
	openaiKey = strings.TrimSpace(openaiKey)
	var oac *oa.Client
	if openaiKey != "" {
		oac = oa.NewClient(openaiKey)
	}
	// Grok key from env (prod key first, fallback to _TEST)
	var grc *gr.Client
	if k := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(getenv("GROK_API_KEY")), "\"'"); k != "" {
		grc = gr.NewClient(k)
	} else if k := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(getenv("GROK_API_KEY_TEST")), "\"'"); k != "" {
		grc = gr.NewClient(k)
	}
	// Claude key
	var clc *cl.Client
	if k := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")), "\"'"); k != "" {
		clc = cl.NewClient(k)
	} else if k := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_TEST")), "\"'"); k != "" {
		clc = cl.NewClient(k)
	}
	// DeepSeek key
	var dsc *ds.Client
	if k := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(getenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")), "\"'"); k != "" {
		dsc = ds.NewClient(k)
	} else if k := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(getenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_TEST")), "\"'"); k != "" {
		dsc = ds.NewClient(k)
	}
	return &Client{gem: geminiClient, oa: oac, gr: grc, cl: clc, ds: dsc}
}

// route decides provider by model alias (gpt_* -> openai; gemini_* -> gemini; default gemini)
// canonicalizeAlias normalizes model aliases from UI/user input to a stable form.
// Rules:
// - lower-case
// - replace any non [a-z0-9]+ with underscore
// - collapse multiple underscores
// - trim leading/trailing underscores
func canonicalizeAlias(s string) string {
	t := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s))
	// Replace hyphens, spaces, dots and other non-alnum with underscore
	b := make([]rune, 0, len(t))
	for _, r := range t {
		if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
			b = append(b, r)
		} else {
			b = append(b, '_')
		}
	}
	u := string(b)
	// Collapse consecutive underscores
	u = strings.ReplaceAll(u, "__", "_")
	for strings.Contains(u, "__") {
		u = strings.ReplaceAll(u, "__", "_")
	}
	u = strings.Trim(u, "_")
	return u
}

func route(opts Options) string {
	m := canonicalizeAlias(opts.ModelOverride)
	if m == "" {
		return "gemini"
	}
	// Normalize variants for routing
	ml := m
	if strings.HasPrefix(ml, "gpt_") || strings.HasPrefix(ml, "gpt5") {
		return "openai"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(ml, "grok_") || strings.HasPrefix(ml, "grok4") {
		return "grok"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(ml, "claude_") {
		return "claude"
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(ml, "deepseek_") {
		return "deepseek"
	}
	return "gemini"
}

// map alias to concrete provider model id
func (c *Client) normalizeOptionsForGemini(opts Options) Options {
	// Accept underscores, hyphens, spaces, dots and other variants
	switch canonicalizeAlias(opts.ModelOverride) {
	case "gemini_quality":
		opts.ModelOverride = "gemini-2.5-pro"
	case "gemini_fast":
		opts.ModelOverride = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite"
	case "gemini_balanced":
		opts.ModelOverride = "gemini-2.5-flash"
	}
	return opts
}

// ModelContextWindows maps model aliases to their context window sizes (in tokens)
// These values must match MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOWS in web/src/stores/genaiSettingsStore.ts
var ModelContextWindows = map[string]int{
	// Gemini models
	"gemini_fast":     1_000_000, // gemini-2.5-flash-lite
	"gemini_balanced": 1_000_000, // gemini-2.5-flash
	"gemini_quality":  2_000_000, // gemini-2.5-pro

	// OpenAI models
	"gpt_fast":     400_000, // gpt-5-nano
	"gpt_balanced": 400_000, // gpt-5-mini
	"gpt_quality":  400_000, // gpt-5

	// Grok models
	"grok_fast":     2_000_000, // grok-4-fast-non-reasoning
	"grok_balanced": 2_000_000, // grok-4-fast-reasoning
	"grok_quality":  256_000,   // grok-4-0709

	// Claude models
	"claude_fast":     200_000, // claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
	"claude_balanced": 200_000, // claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929
	// claude_quality (Opus) disabled in frontend - too expensive, kept here for backward compatibility only
	"claude_quality": 200_000, // claude-opus-4-1-20250805 (deprecated)

	// DeepSeek models
	"deepseek_fast":    128_000, // deepseek-chat
	"deepseek_quality": 128_000, // deepseek-reasoner
}

// GetModelContextWindow returns the context window size (in tokens) for a given model alias
func GetModelContextWindow(modelAlias string) int {
	canonical := canonicalizeAlias(modelAlias)
	if size, ok := ModelContextWindows[canonical]; ok {
		return size
	}
	return 0
}

func (c *Client) normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts Options) oa.Options {
	out := oa.Options{
		ModelOverride:     canonicalizeAlias(opts.ModelOverride),
		Temperature:       opts.Temperature,
		MaxOutputTokens:   opts.MaxOutputTokens,
		GroundingEnabled:  opts.GroundingEnabled,
		SystemInstruction: opts.SystemInstruction,
	}
	switch out.ModelOverride {
	case "gpt_quality":
		out.ModelOverride = "gpt-5"
	case "gpt_balanced":
		out.ModelOverride = "gpt-5-mini"
	case "gpt_fast":
		out.ModelOverride = "gpt-5-nano"
	}
	return out
}

func (c *Client) normalizeOptionsForGrok(opts Options) gr.Options {
	return gr.Options{
		ModelOverride: map[string]string{
			"grok_quality":  "grok-4-0709",
			"grok_balanced": "grok-4-fast-reasoning",
			"grok_fast":     "grok-4-fast-non-reasoning",
		}[canonicalizeAlias(opts.ModelOverride)],
		Temperature:       opts.Temperature,
		MaxOutputTokens:   opts.MaxOutputTokens,
		GroundingEnabled:  opts.GroundingEnabled,
		SystemInstruction: opts.SystemInstruction,
	}
}

func (c *Client) normalizeOptionsForClaude(opts Options) cl.Options {
	return cl.Options{
		ModelOverride: map[string]string{
			"claude_fast":     "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
			"claude_balanced": "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
			// claude_quality (Opus) disabled in frontend - too expensive, fallback to balanced
			"claude_quality": "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929", // was: claude-opus-4-1-20250805
		}[canonicalizeAlias(opts.ModelOverride)],
		Temperature:       opts.Temperature,
		MaxOutputTokens:   opts.MaxOutputTokens,
		GroundingEnabled:  opts.GroundingEnabled,
		SystemInstruction: opts.SystemInstruction,
	}
}

func (c *Client) normalizeOptionsForDeepSeek(opts Options) ds.Options {
	return ds.Options{
		ModelOverride: map[string]string{
			"deepseek_fast":    "deepseek-chat",
			"deepseek_quality": "deepseek-reasoner",
		}[canonicalizeAlias(opts.ModelOverride)],
		Temperature:       opts.Temperature,
		MaxOutputTokens:   opts.MaxOutputTokens,
		GroundingEnabled:  opts.GroundingEnabled,
		SystemInstruction: opts.SystemInstruction,
	}
}

func (c *Client) Generate(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	switch route(opts) {
	case "openai":
		if c.oa == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("openai not configured")
		}
		oar, err := c.oa.Generate(ctx, prompt, toOATools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		gr := &GenerateResponse{Content: oar.Content, ToolCalls: toGemCalls(oar.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: oar.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsage(oar.Usage), Model: oar.Model}
		gr.RawJSON = oar.RawJSON
		gr.OutputRaw = oar.OutputRaw
		// propagate extras
		gr.SearchQueries = oar.SearchQueries
		gr.Sources = oar.Sources
		return gr, nil
	case "grok":
		if c.gr == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("grok not configured")
		}
		r, err := c.gr.Generate(ctx, prompt, toGrokTools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForGrok(opts))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromGrok(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsageFromGrok(r.Usage), Model: r.Model, RawJSON: r.RawJSON, OutputRaw: r.OutputRaw, SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources}, nil
	case "claude":
		if c.cl == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("claude not configured")
		}
		r, err := c.cl.Generate(ctx, prompt, toClaudeTools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForClaude(opts))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromClaude(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsageFromClaude(r.Usage), Model: r.Model, RawJSON: r.RawJSON, OutputRaw: r.OutputRaw, SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources}, nil
	case "deepseek":
		if c.ds == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("deepseek not configured")
		}
		r, err := c.ds.Generate(ctx, prompt, toDeepSeekTools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForDeepSeek(opts))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromDeepSeek(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsageFromDeepSeek(r.Usage), Model: r.Model, RawJSON: r.RawJSON, OutputRaw: r.OutputRaw, SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources}, nil
	default:
		goOpts := c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(opts)
		return c.gem.Generate(ctx, prompt, tools, goOpts)
	}
}

func (c *Client) GenerateJSON(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, jsonSchema map[string]interface{}, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	if route(opts) == "openai" {
		// Responses API: enforce JSON by setting max tokens + instruction; simplest is to request plain text JSON.
		if c.oa == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("openai not configured")
		}
		// Reuse Generate and rely on system instruction
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts)
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(o.SystemInstruction), "json") {
			o.SystemInstruction = strings.TrimSpace(o.SystemInstruction + "\nRespond strictly in JSON.")
		}
		oar, err := c.oa.Generate(ctx, prompt, toOATools(tools), o)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		gr := &GenerateResponse{Content: oar.Content, ToolCalls: toGemCalls(oar.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: oar.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsage(oar.Usage), Model: oar.Model}
		gr.RawJSON = oar.RawJSON
		gr.OutputRaw = oar.OutputRaw
		gr.SearchQueries = oar.SearchQueries
		gr.Sources = oar.Sources
		return gr, nil
	}
	if route(opts) == "claude" {
		if c.cl == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("claude not configured")
		}
		// Best-effort: enforce JSON via instruction and function tool with schema
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForClaude(opts)
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(o.SystemInstruction), "json") {
			o.SystemInstruction = strings.TrimSpace(o.SystemInstruction + "\nRespond strictly in JSON.")
		}
		t := tools
		if len(jsonSchema) > 0 {
			t = append([]Tool{}, tools...)
			t = append(t, Tool{Name: "return_structured", Description: "Return strictly by schema", Parameters: jsonSchema})
		}
		r, err := c.cl.Generate(ctx, prompt, toClaudeTools(t), o)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromClaude(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsageFromClaude(r.Usage), Model: r.Model, RawJSON: r.RawJSON, OutputRaw: r.OutputRaw, SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources}, nil
	}
	if route(opts) == "deepseek" {
		if c.ds == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("deepseek not configured")
		}
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForDeepSeek(opts)
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(o.SystemInstruction), "json") {
			o.SystemInstruction = strings.TrimSpace(o.SystemInstruction + "\nRespond strictly in JSON.")
		}
		t := tools
		if len(jsonSchema) > 0 {
			t = append([]Tool{}, tools...)
			t = append(t, Tool{Name: "return_structured", Description: "Return strictly by schema", Parameters: jsonSchema})
		}
		r, err := c.ds.Generate(ctx, prompt, toDeepSeekTools(t), o)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromDeepSeek(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsageFromDeepSeek(r.Usage), Model: r.Model, RawJSON: r.RawJSON, OutputRaw: r.OutputRaw, SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources}, nil
	}
	return c.gem.GenerateJSON(ctx, prompt, tools, jsonSchema, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(opts))
}

// GenerateJSONStrict enforces structured output using provider-native strict schema when supported.
func (c *Client) GenerateJSONStrict(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, jsonSchema map[string]interface{}, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	switch route(opts) {
	case "openai":
		// Fallback: reuse JSON mode; OpenAI strictness handled via system instruction or tool defs.
		return c.GenerateJSON(ctx, prompt, tools, jsonSchema, opts)
	case "grok":
		if c.gr == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("grok not configured")
		}
		// Grok structured outputs via function calling (strict by tool/parameters)
		// Add return_structured tool with jsonSchema if provided
		t := append([]Tool{}, tools...)
		// Deduplicate return_structured if already present
		hasReturn := false
		for _, tt := range t {
			if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(tt.Name), "return_structured") {
				hasReturn = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !hasReturn && len(jsonSchema) > 0 {
			t = append(t, Tool{Name: "return_structured", Description: "Return strictly by schema", Parameters: jsonSchema})
		}
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForGrok(opts)
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(o.SystemInstruction), "only by calling the function") && len(jsonSchema) > 0 {
			o.SystemInstruction = strings.TrimSpace(o.SystemInstruction + "\nReturn the result ONLY by calling the function 'return_structured'. Do not output any text outside of the function call.")
		}
		r, err := c.gr.Generate(ctx, prompt, toGrokTools(t), o)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromGrok(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsageFromGrok(r.Usage), Model: r.Model, RawJSON: r.RawJSON, OutputRaw: r.OutputRaw, SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources}, nil
	case "claude":
		if c.cl == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("claude not configured")
		}
		// Use function tool with strict schema and required tool choice via instruction
		t := append([]Tool{}, tools...)
		// Deduplicate return_structured if already present
		hasReturn := false
		for _, tt := range t {
			if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(tt.Name), "return_structured") {
				hasReturn = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !hasReturn {
			t = append(t, Tool{Name: "return_structured", Description: "Return strictly by schema", Parameters: jsonSchema})
		}
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForClaude(opts)
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(o.SystemInstruction), "only by calling the function") {
			o.SystemInstruction = strings.TrimSpace(o.SystemInstruction + "\nReturn the result ONLY by calling the function 'return_structured'. Do not output any text outside of the function call.")
		}
		r, err := c.cl.Generate(ctx, prompt, toClaudeTools(t), o)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromClaude(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsageFromClaude(r.Usage), Model: r.Model, RawJSON: r.RawJSON, OutputRaw: r.OutputRaw, SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources}, nil
	case "deepseek":
		if c.ds == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("deepseek not configured")
		}
		t := append([]Tool{}, tools...)
		// Deduplicate return_structured if already present
		hasReturn := false
		for _, tt := range t {
			if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(tt.Name), "return_structured") {
				hasReturn = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !hasReturn {
			t = append(t, Tool{Name: "return_structured", Description: "Return strictly by schema", Parameters: jsonSchema})
		}
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForDeepSeek(opts)
		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(o.SystemInstruction), "only by calling the function") {
			o.SystemInstruction = strings.TrimSpace(o.SystemInstruction + "\nReturn the result ONLY by calling the function 'return_structured'. Do not output any text outside of the function call.")
		}
		r, err := c.ds.Generate(ctx, prompt, toDeepSeekTools(t), o)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromDeepSeek(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsageFromDeepSeek(r.Usage), Model: r.Model, RawJSON: r.RawJSON, OutputRaw: r.OutputRaw, SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources}, nil
	default:
		return c.gem.GenerateJSONStrict(ctx, prompt, tools, jsonSchema, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(opts))
	}
}

// ExecuteWithTools: run a tool loop (best-effort on OpenAI)
func (c *Client) ExecuteWithTools(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, reg g.ToolExecutor, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	if route(opts) == "openai" {
		if c.oa == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("openai not configured")
		}
		// First call with tools
		r, err := c.oa.Generate(ctx, prompt, toOATools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		// If tool calls, execute and append results, then ask again via Responses follow-up
		if len(r.ToolCalls) > 0 {
			// Start with previous output items to preserve call_id linkage
			input := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(r.OutputRaw)+1)
			input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})
			input = append(input, r.OutputRaw...)
			for _, tc := range r.ToolCalls {
				out, _ := reg.Execute(ctx, tc.Name, []byte(tc.Arguments))
				input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{
					"type":    "function_call_output",
					"call_id": tc.CallID,
					"output":  string(out),
				})
			}
			r2, err := c.oa.Respond(ctx, input, toOATools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts))
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return &GenerateResponse{Content: r2.Content, Model: r2.Model, Usage: toGemUsage(r2.Usage)}, nil
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, Model: r.Model, Usage: toGemUsage(r.Usage)}, nil
	}
	// Delegate to Gemini implementation with its registry
	return c.gem.ExecuteWithTools(ctx, prompt, tools, reg, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(opts))
}

// Stream: for OpenAI emit one chunk + done (placeholder streaming)
func (c *Client) Stream(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options, onEvent func(StreamEvent) error) error {
	switch route(opts) {
	case "openai":
		if c.oa == nil {
			return errors.New("openai not configured")
		}
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
		u, qs, srcs, err := c.oa.StreamWithExtras(ctx, prompt, toOATools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts), func(delta string) error {
			return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: delta})
		})
		if err != nil {
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: err.Error()})
			return err
		}
		log.Printf("[Combined Stream] OpenAI done event received, Usage before conversion: %+v", u)
		convertedUsage := toGemUsage(u)
		log.Printf("[Combined Stream] OpenAI done event, Usage after conversion: %+v", convertedUsage)
		return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: convertedUsage, SearchQueries: qs, Sources: srcs})
	case "grok":
		if c.gr == nil {
			return errors.New("grok not configured")
		}
		return c.gr.Stream(ctx, prompt, toGrokTools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForGrok(opts), func(ev gr.StreamEvent) error {
			switch ev.Type {
			case "start":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
			case "chunk":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: ev.Text})
			case "tool_call":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromGrok(ev.ToolCalls)})
			case "done":
				log.Printf("[Combined Stream] Grok done event received, Usage before conversion: %+v", ev.Usage)
				convertedUsage := toGemUsageFromGrok(ev.Usage)
				log.Printf("[Combined Stream] Grok done event, Usage after conversion: %+v", convertedUsage)
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: convertedUsage, Model: ev.Model, SearchQueries: ev.SearchQueries, Sources: ev.Sources})
			case "error":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: ev.Error})
			default:
				return nil
			}
		})
	case "claude":
		if c.cl == nil {
			return errors.New("claude not configured")
		}
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForClaude(opts)
		return c.cl.Stream(ctx, prompt, toClaudeTools(tools), o, func(ev cl.StreamEvent) error {
			switch ev.Type {
			case "start":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
			case "chunk":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: ev.Text})
			case "tool_call":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromClaude(ev.ToolCalls)})
			case "done":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: toGemUsageFromClaude(ev.Usage), Model: ev.Model})
			case "error":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: ev.Error})
			default:
				return nil
			}
		})
	case "deepseek":
		if c.ds == nil {
			return errors.New("deepseek not configured")
		}
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForDeepSeek(opts)
		return c.ds.Stream(ctx, prompt, toDeepSeekTools(tools), o, func(ev ds.StreamEvent) error {
			switch ev.Type {
			case "start":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
			case "chunk":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: ev.Text})
			case "tool_call":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromDeepSeek(ev.ToolCalls)})
			case "done":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: toGemUsageFromDeepSeek(ev.Usage), Model: ev.Model})
			case "error":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: ev.Error})
			default:
				return nil
			}
		})
	default:
		return c.gem.Stream(ctx, prompt, tools, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(opts), onEvent)
	}
}

func (c *Client) StreamWithTools(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, reg g.ToolExecutor, opts Options, onEvent func(StreamEvent) error) error {
	switch route(opts) {
	case "openai":
		if c.oa == nil {
			return errors.New("openai not configured")
		}
		// Start event
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
		// Step 1: request with tools
		r, err := c.oa.Generate(ctx, prompt, toOATools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts))
		if err != nil {
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: err.Error()})
			return err
		}
		if len(r.ToolCalls) == 0 {
			// No tools, emit content (single chunk placeholder) and done
			if r.Content != "" {
				_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: r.Content})
			}
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: toGemUsage(r.Usage), SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources})
			return nil
		}
		// Emit tool_call event(s)
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: toGemCalls(r.ToolCalls)})
		// Build follow-up input including previous output items to preserve call_id linkage
		input := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(r.OutputRaw)+len(r.ToolCalls)+1)
		if len(r.OutputRaw) > 0 {
			input = append(input, r.OutputRaw...)
		} else {
			// Fallback: include user prompt if no raw items present
			input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})
		}
		for _, tc := range r.ToolCalls {
			out, execErr := reg.Execute(ctx, tc.Name, []byte(tc.Arguments))
			if execErr != nil {
				_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: execErr.Error()})
				return execErr
			}
			// Emit tool_result (use Arguments field to carry result payload for consistency with Gemini)
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_result", ToolCalls: []g.ToolCall{{Name: tc.Name, Arguments: string(out), CallID: tc.CallID}}})
			input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{
				"type":    "function_call_output",
				"call_id": tc.CallID,
				"output":  string(out),
			})
		}
		// Step 2: respond with function_call_output appended
		r2, err := c.oa.Respond(ctx, input, toOATools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts))
		if err != nil {
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: err.Error()})
			return err
		}
		if r2.Content != "" {
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: r2.Content})
		}
		// Merge SearchQueries and Sources from both calls with deduplication
		mergedQueries := mergeUniqueStrings(r.SearchQueries, r2.SearchQueries)
		mergedSources := mergeUniqueStrings(r.Sources, r2.Sources)
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: toGemUsage(r2.Usage), SearchQueries: mergedQueries, Sources: mergedSources})
		return nil
	case "grok":
		if c.gr == nil {
			return errors.New("grok not configured")
		}
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
		// Single-step call to Grok
		r, err := c.gr.Generate(ctx, prompt, toGrokTools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForGrok(opts))
		if err != nil {
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: err.Error()})
			return err
		}
		if len(r.ToolCalls) == 0 {
			if r.Content != "" {
				_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: r.Content})
			}
			_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: toGemUsageFromGrok(r.Usage), SearchQueries: r.SearchQueries, Sources: r.Sources})
			return nil
		}
		// Emit tool_call(s). For now, do not perform follow-up Respond for Grok.
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromGrok(r.ToolCalls)})
		_ = onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: toGemUsageFromGrok(r.Usage)})
		return nil
	case "claude":
		if c.cl == nil {
			return errors.New("claude not configured")
		}
		// For now, emit tool_call events but do not perform follow-up tool execution in streaming mode
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForClaude(opts)
		return c.cl.Stream(ctx, prompt, toClaudeTools(tools), o, func(ev cl.StreamEvent) error {
			switch ev.Type {
			case "start":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
			case "chunk":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: ev.Text})
			case "tool_call":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromClaude(ev.ToolCalls)})
			case "done":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: toGemUsageFromClaude(ev.Usage), Model: ev.Model})
			case "error":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: ev.Error})
			default:
				return nil
			}
		})
	case "deepseek":
		if c.ds == nil {
			return errors.New("deepseek not configured")
		}
		o := c.normalizeOptionsForDeepSeek(opts)
		// Emit tool_call events; no follow-up execution in streaming path
		return c.ds.Stream(ctx, prompt, toDeepSeekTools(tools), o, func(ev ds.StreamEvent) error {
			switch ev.Type {
			case "start":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "start"})
			case "chunk":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "chunk", Text: ev.Text})
			case "tool_call":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "tool_call", ToolCalls: toGemToolsFromDeepSeek(ev.ToolCalls)})
			case "done":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "done", Usage: toGemUsageFromDeepSeek(ev.Usage), Model: ev.Model})
			case "error":
				return onEvent(StreamEvent{Type: "error", Error: ev.Error})
			default:
				return nil
			}
		})
	default:
		return c.gem.StreamWithTools(ctx, prompt, tools, reg, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(opts), onEvent)
	}
}

// Respond forwards to OpenAI Respond when provider is OpenAI; for Gemini not supported
func (c *Client) Respond(ctx context.Context, input []map[string]interface{}, tools []Tool, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	if route(opts) == "openai" {
		if c.oa == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("openai not configured")
		}
		r, err := c.oa.Respond(ctx, input, toOATools(tools), c.normalizeOptionsForOpenAI(opts))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &GenerateResponse{Content: r.Content, ToolCalls: toGemCalls(r.ToolCalls), IsToolStep: r.IsToolStep, Usage: toGemUsage(r.Usage), Model: r.Model}, nil
	}
	return nil, errors.New("respond not supported for gemini")
}

	out := make([]oa.Tool, 0, len(ts))
	for _, t := range ts {
		out = append(out, oa.Tool{Name: t.Name, Description: t.Description, Parameters: t.Parameters})
	}
	return out
}
