// mergeUniqueStrings combines two string slices and removes duplicates
func mergeUniqueStrings(a, b []string) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
	result := make([]string, 0, len(a)+len(b))
	for _, s := range a {
		if _, ok := seen[s]; !ok {
			seen[s] = struct{}{}
			result = append(result, s)
		}
	}
	for _, s := range b {
		if _, ok := seen[s]; !ok {
			seen[s] = struct{}{}
			result = append(result, s)
		}
	}
	return result
}

// GenAIGenerate performs a unified generation across providers with optional tools, web search, and strict JSON
func (c *Client) GenAIGenerate(ctx context.Context, req GenAIRequest) (*GenAIResponse, error) {
	// Build base options
	opts := g.Options{
		ModelOverride:     canonicalizeAlias(req.Model),
		Temperature:       req.Temperature,
		MaxOutputTokens:   req.MaxOutputTokens,
		GroundingEnabled:  req.WebSearchEnabled,
		SystemInstruction: req.SystemInstruction,
	}
	tools := req.Tools

	// Helper: merge extras from grounded call
	mergeExtras := func(base *GenerateResponse, extra *GenerateResponse) *GenerateResponse {
		// usage: sum tokens when both present
		base.Usage.PromptTokens += extra.Usage.PromptTokens
		base.Usage.OutputTokens += extra.Usage.OutputTokens
		base.Usage.TotalTokens += extra.Usage.TotalTokens
		if extra.Usage.ReasoningTokens > 0 {
			base.Usage.ReasoningTokens += extra.Usage.ReasoningTokens
		}
		if extra.Usage.ToolUsePromptTokens > 0 {
			base.Usage.ToolUsePromptTokens += extra.Usage.ToolUsePromptTokens
		}
		// sources/queries/attributions
		base.SearchQueries = append(base.SearchQueries, extra.SearchQueries...)
		base.Sources = append(base.Sources, extra.Sources...)
		base.Attributions = append(base.Attributions, extra.Attributions...)
		return base
	}

	// Helper: normalize strict JSON response - extract return_structured tool call arguments into Content
	normalizeStrictResponse := func(resp *GenerateResponse) *GenerateResponse {
		// If Content is empty but we have a return_structured tool call, extract its arguments into Content
		if resp.Content == "" && len(resp.ToolCalls) > 0 {
			for _, tc := range resp.ToolCalls {
				if tc.Name == "return_structured" && tc.Arguments != "" {
					resp.Content = tc.Arguments
					// Clear IsToolStep since we've normalized to Content
					resp.IsToolStep = false
					break
				}
			}
		}
		return resp
	}

	provider := route(opts)

	// If strict JSON requested
	if req.StrictJSONEnabled {
		// Special-case Gemini: strict JSON cannot run with grounding/tools in some modes
		if provider == "gemini" && req.WebSearchEnabled {
			// Step 1: strict JSON without grounding
			opts.GroundingEnabled = false
			strict, err := c.gem.GenerateJSONStrict(ctx, req.Prompt, tools, req.JSONSchema, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(opts))
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			// Step 2: grounded pass without tools (to fetch sources/queries)
			gopts := opts
			gopts.GroundingEnabled = true
			grounded, gerr := c.gem.Generate(ctx, req.Prompt, nil, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(gopts))
			if gerr == nil {
				strict = mergeExtras(strict, grounded)
			}
			// Normalize: extract return_structured arguments into Content if needed
			strict = normalizeStrictResponse(strict)
			return (*GenAIResponse)(strict), nil
		}
		// Other providers: attempt unified strict generation
		strict, err := c.GenerateJSONStrict(ctx, req.Prompt, tools, req.JSONSchema, opts)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		// Normalize: extract return_structured arguments into Content if needed
		strict = normalizeStrictResponse(strict)
		return (*GenAIResponse)(strict), nil
	}

	// Non-strict path
	// Ensure web search/tools applied when requested
	if !req.ToolCallingEnabled {
		// If tools disabled, clear tools slice
		tools = nil
	}
	// Special-case Gemini: tools + web search unsupported together → two-step
	if provider == "gemini" && req.ToolCallingEnabled && req.WebSearchEnabled {
		// Step 1: tools only
		to := opts
		to.GroundingEnabled = false
		first, err := c.gem.Generate(ctx, req.Prompt, tools, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(to))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		// Step 2: grounded only (no tools)
		go2 := opts
		go2.GroundingEnabled = true
		second, gerr := c.gem.Generate(ctx, req.Prompt, nil, c.normalizeOptionsForGemini(go2))
		if gerr == nil {
			first = mergeExtras(first, second)
		}
		return (*GenAIResponse)(first), nil
	}
	res, err := c.Generate(ctx, req.Prompt, tools, opts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return (*GenAIResponse)(res), nil
}

package openai

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Tool struct {
	Name        string                 `json:"name"`
	Description string                 `json:"description"`
	Parameters  map[string]interface{} `json:"parameters"`
}

type ToolCall struct {
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Arguments string `json:"arguments"`
	CallID    string `json:"callId,omitempty"`
}

type Usage struct {
	PromptTokens        int `json:"promptTokens"`
	OutputTokens        int `json:"outputTokens"`
	TotalTokens         int `json:"totalTokens"`
	ReasoningTokens     int `json:"reasoningTokens,omitempty"`
	ToolUsePromptTokens int `json:"toolUsePromptTokens,omitempty"`
}

type GenerateResponse struct {
	Content    string     `json:"content"`
	ToolCalls  []ToolCall `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
	IsToolStep bool       `json:"isToolStep"`
	Usage      Usage      `json:"usage"`
	Model      string     `json:"model"`
	// Raw output items from Responses API, used for follow-ups with function_call_output
	OutputRaw []map[string]interface{} `json:"-"`
	// RawJSON contains the unmodified JSON body returned by the provider
	RawJSON string `json:"-"`
	// Unified extras for parity with Gemini
	SearchQueries []string `json:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
	Sources       []string `json:"sources,omitempty"`
}

type Options struct {
	ModelOverride     string  `json:"modelOverride"`
	Temperature       float64 `json:"temperature"`
	MaxOutputTokens   int     `json:"maxOutputTokens"`
	GroundingEnabled  bool    `json:"groundingEnabled"`
	SystemInstruction string  `json:"systemInstruction"`
}

type Client struct {
	apiKey     string
	httpClient *http.Client
}

func NewClient(apiKey string) *Client {
	key := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(apiKey), "\"'")
    return &Client{apiKey: key, httpClient: &http.Client{Timeout: 240 * time.Second}}
}

func (c *Client) modelFrom(opts Options) string {
	if opts.ModelOverride != "" {
		return opts.ModelOverride
	}
	return "gpt-5"
}

// Generate uses Responses API (non-stream) and returns first text output; supports function tools
func (c *Client) Generate(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	// Build OpenAI Responses payload
	input := []map[string]interface{}{}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		// Provide system guidance also as a system message for stronger steer
		input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{"role": "system", "content": opts.SystemInstruction})
	}
	input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})
	req := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": model,
		"input": input,
	}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		req["instructions"] = opts.SystemInstruction
	}
	// GPT-5 family may not support temperature; omit for gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano
	if opts.Temperature > 0 && !(strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(model), "gpt-5")) {
		req["temperature"] = opts.Temperature
	}
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
		req["max_output_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
	}
	// Build tools list (function tools + optional web_search)
	tdefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools)+1)
	hasFuncTools := false
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		hasFuncTools = true
		for _, t := range tools {
			params := t.Parameters
			if params == nil {
				params = map[string]interface{}{"type": "object"}
			}
			params["additionalProperties"] = false
			if propsRaw, ok := params["properties"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				for k, v := range propsRaw {
					if m, ok := v.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						if _, has := m["type"]; !has {
							m["type"] = "string"
						}
						propsRaw[k] = m
					}
				}
			}
			tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{
				"type":        "function",
				"name":        t.Name,
				"description": t.Description,
				"parameters":  params,
				"strict":      true,
			})
		}
	}
	if opts.GroundingEnabled {
		tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{"type": "web_search"})
	}
	if len(tdefs) > 0 {
		req["tools"] = tdefs
		if hasFuncTools {
			req["tool_choice"] = "required"
		} else {
			req["tool_choice"] = "auto"
		}
		req["parallel_tool_calls"] = false
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(req)
	httpReq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", bytes.NewReader(b))
	httpReq.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.apiKey)
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("openai error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	// Minimal parse: look for output_text and tool calls
	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rb, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := &GenerateResponse{Model: model}
	out.RawJSON = string(rb)
	// Usage
	if u, ok := root["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
		if v, ok := u["input_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.PromptTokens = int(v)
		}
		if v, ok := u["output_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.OutputTokens = int(v)
		}
		if v, ok := u["total_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.TotalTokens = int(v)
		}
		if d, ok := u["output_tokens_details"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if v, ok := d["reasoning_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				out.Usage.ReasoningTokens = int(v)
			}
		}
	}
	if txt, _ := root["output_text"].(string); txt != "" {
		out.Content = txt
	}
	// Parse tool calls and assistant messages (best-effort)
	if arr, ok := root["output"].([]interface{}); ok {
		// capture raw items for follow-up calls
		out.OutputRaw = make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(arr))
		for _, it := range arr {
			if m, ok := it.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				out.OutputRaw = append(out.OutputRaw, m)
				typ, _ := m["type"].(string)
				if typ == "function_call" {
					name, _ := m["name"].(string)
					var argsJSON string
					if obj, ok := m["arguments"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						if b, err := json.Marshal(obj); err == nil {
							argsJSON = string(b)
						}
						// extract URLs from structured args
						extractURLsFromMap(obj, &out.Sources)
					} else if s, ok := m["arguments"].(string); ok {
						argsJSON = s
						extractURLsFromText(s, &out.Sources)
					}
					callID, _ := m["call_id"].(string)
					out.ToolCalls = append(out.ToolCalls, ToolCall{Name: name, Arguments: argsJSON, CallID: callID})
				} else if typ == "message" {
					if content, ok := m["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
						for _, c := range content {
							if cm, ok := c.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								if txt, _ := cm["text"].(string); txt != "" {
									out.Content += txt
									// Try parse as JSON for {"query":...} or {"sources":[...]}
									var tmp map[string]interface{}
									if json.Unmarshal([]byte(txt), &tmp) == nil {
										if q, ok := tmp["query"].(string); ok && q != "" {
											appendUnique(&out.SearchQueries, q)
										}
										if srcs, ok := tmp["sources"].([]interface{}); ok {
											for _, s := range srcs {
												if sm, ok := s.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
													if u, ok := sm["url"].(string); ok && u != "" {
														appendUnique(&out.Sources, u)
													}
												}
											}
										}
									}
									// Also scan free text for URLs
									extractURLsFromText(txt, &out.Sources)
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	out.IsToolStep = len(out.ToolCalls) > 0 && out.Content == ""
	return out, nil
}

// Respond allows passing a custom input list (for function_call_output follow-ups)
func (c *Client) Respond(ctx context.Context, input []map[string]interface{}, tools []Tool, opts Options) (*GenerateResponse, error) {
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	req := map[string]interface{}{
		"model": model,
		"input": input,
	}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		req["instructions"] = opts.SystemInstruction
	}
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
		req["max_output_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
	}
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		tdefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
		for _, t := range tools {
			params := t.Parameters
			if params == nil {
				params = map[string]interface{}{"type": "object"}
			}
			params["additionalProperties"] = false
			if propsRaw, ok := params["properties"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				for k, v := range propsRaw {
					if m, ok := v.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						if _, has := m["type"]; !has {
							m["type"] = "string"
						}
						propsRaw[k] = m
					}
				}
			}
			tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{"type": "function", "name": t.Name, "description": t.Description, "parameters": params, "strict": true})
		}
		if opts.GroundingEnabled {
			tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{"type": "web_search"})
		}
		req["tools"] = tdefs
		req["tool_choice"] = "required"
		req["parallel_tool_calls"] = false
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(req)
	httpReq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", bytes.NewReader(b))
	httpReq.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.apiKey)
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("openai error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	var root map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rb, &root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := &GenerateResponse{Model: model}
	out.RawJSON = string(rb)
	if u, ok := root["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
		if v, ok := u["input_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.PromptTokens = int(v)
		}
		if v, ok := u["output_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.OutputTokens = int(v)
		}
		if v, ok := u["total_tokens"].(float64); ok {
			out.Usage.TotalTokens = int(v)
		}
		if d, ok := u["output_tokens_details"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if v, ok := d["reasoning_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				out.Usage.ReasoningTokens = int(v)
			}
		}
	}
	if txt, _ := root["output_text"].(string); txt != "" {
		out.Content = txt
	}
	if arr, ok := root["output"].([]interface{}); ok {
		for _, it := range arr {
			if m, ok := it.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if m["type"] == "function_call" {
					name, _ := m["name"].(string)
					args, _ := m["arguments"].(string)
					callID, _ := m["call_id"].(string)
					out.ToolCalls = append(out.ToolCalls, ToolCall{Name: name, Arguments: args, CallID: callID})
				} else if m["type"] == "message" {
					if content, ok := m["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
						for _, c := range content {
							if cm, ok := c.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
								if txt, _ := cm["text"].(string); txt != "" {
									out.Content += txt
									var tmp map[string]interface{}
									if json.Unmarshal([]byte(txt), &tmp) == nil {
										if q, ok := tmp["query"].(string); ok && q != "" {
											appendUnique(&out.SearchQueries, q)
										}
										if srcs, ok := tmp["sources"].([]interface{}); ok {
											for _, s := range srcs {
												if sm, ok := s.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
													if u, ok := sm["url"].(string); ok && u != "" {
														appendUnique(&out.Sources, u)
													}
												}
											}
										}
									}
									extractURLsFromText(txt, &out.Sources)
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	out.IsToolStep = len(out.ToolCalls) > 0 && out.Content == ""
	return out, nil
}

// Helpers for parsing queries/URLs
func appendUnique(dst *[]string, v string) {
	for _, x := range *dst {
		if x == v {
			return
		}
	}
	*dst = append(*dst, v)
}

func extractURLsFromText(s string, dst *[]string) {
	parts := strings.Fields(s)
	for _, p := range parts {
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(p, "https://") {
			// Preserve closing ')' to keep Wikipedia-style URLs with parentheses intact
			u := strings.TrimRight(p, ".,;]\"'}")
			// If we accidentally have an opening '(' without matching ')', try to add ')'
			if strings.Count(u, "(") > strings.Count(u, ")") {
				u = u + ")"
			}
			appendUnique(dst, u)
		}
	}
}

func extractURLsFromMap(m map[string]interface{}, dst *[]string) {
	for _, v := range m {
		switch tv := v.(type) {
		case string:
			extractURLsFromText(tv, dst)
		case map[string]interface{}:
			extractURLsFromMap(tv, dst)
		case []interface{}:
			for _, it := range tv {
				if sm, ok := it.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					extractURLsFromMap(sm, dst)
				} else if ss, ok := it.(string); ok {
					extractURLsFromText(ss, dst)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// Stream streams text deltas using Responses API SSE
func (c *Client) Stream(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options, onDelta func(string) error) error {
	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	input := []map[string]interface{}{}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{"role": "system", "content": opts.SystemInstruction})
	}
	input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})
	req := map[string]interface{}{
		"model":  model,
		"input":  input,
		"stream": true,
	}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		req["instructions"] = opts.SystemInstruction
	}
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
		req["max_output_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
	}
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		tdefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
		for _, t := range tools {
			tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{"type": "function", "name": t.Name, "description": t.Description, "parameters": t.Parameters, "strict": true})
		}
		if opts.GroundingEnabled {
			tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{"type": "web_search"})
		}
		req["tools"] = tdefs
		// do not force required in streaming basic path; let the model decide
		req["parallel_tool_calls"] = false
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(req)
	httpReq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", bytes.NewReader(b))
	httpReq.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.apiKey)
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	httpReq.Header.Set("Accept", "text/event-stream")
	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		return fmt.Errorf("openai stream error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	reader := bufio.NewReader(resp.Body)
	var dataBuf strings.Builder
	flushEvent := func() error {
		payload := strings.TrimSpace(dataBuf.String())
		dataBuf.Reset()
		if payload == "" {
			return nil
		}
		if payload == "[DONE]" {
			return io.EOF
		}
		var m map[string]interface{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &m); err != nil {
			// best-effort: ignore non-JSON
			return nil
		}
		// Heuristics for Responses SSE: prefer output_text.delta
		if typ, _ := m["type"].(string); typ != "" {
			lt := strings.ToLower(typ)
			if strings.Contains(lt, "output_text.delta") {
				if d, _ := m["delta"].(string); d != "" {
					return onDelta(d)
				}
			}
			if strings.Contains(lt, "response.completed") {
				return io.EOF
			}
		}
		if d, _ := m["delta"].(string); d != "" {
			return onDelta(d)
		}
		if txt, _ := m["output_text"].(string); txt != "" {
			return onDelta(txt)
		}
		if content, ok := m["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
			var sb strings.Builder
			for _, c := range content {
				if cm, ok := c.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					if t, _ := cm["text"].(string); t != "" {
						sb.WriteString(t)
					}
				}
			}
			if sb.Len() > 0 {
				return onDelta(sb.String())
			}
		}
		return nil
	}
	for {
		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
		if err != nil {
			if err == io.EOF {
				break
			}
			return err
		}
		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "data:") {
			data := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data:"))
			if data == "[DONE]" {
				return nil
			}
			if data != "" {
				dataBuf.WriteString(data)
			}
		} else if line == "" { // end of event
			if err := flushEvent(); err != nil {
				if err == io.EOF {
					return nil
				}
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	// flush any remaining
	_ = flushEvent()
	return nil
}

// StreamWithExtras streams text deltas and returns collected usage, search queries and sources.
func (c *Client) StreamWithExtras(ctx context.Context, prompt string, tools []Tool, opts Options, onDelta func(string) error) (Usage, []string, []string, error) {
	var accUsage Usage
	queries := make([]string, 0)
	sources := make([]string, 0)

	model := c.modelFrom(opts)
	input := []map[string]interface{}{}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{"role": "system", "content": opts.SystemInstruction})
	}
	input = append(input, map[string]interface{}{"role": "user", "content": prompt})
	req := map[string]interface{}{
		"model":  model,
		"input":  input,
		"stream": true,
	}
	if opts.SystemInstruction != "" {
		req["instructions"] = opts.SystemInstruction
	}
	if opts.MaxOutputTokens > 0 {
		req["max_output_tokens"] = opts.MaxOutputTokens
	}
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		tdefs := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(tools))
		for _, t := range tools {
			tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{"type": "function", "name": t.Name, "description": t.Description, "parameters": t.Parameters, "strict": true})
		}
		if opts.GroundingEnabled {
			tdefs = append(tdefs, map[string]interface{}{"type": "web_search"})
		}
		req["tools"] = tdefs
		req["parallel_tool_calls"] = false
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(req)
	httpReq, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", bytes.NewReader(b))
	httpReq.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.apiKey)
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	httpReq.Header.Set("Accept", "text/event-stream")
	resp, err := c.httpClient.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return accUsage, queries, sources, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		rb, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		return accUsage, queries, sources, fmt.Errorf("openai stream error %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, string(rb))
	}
	reader := bufio.NewReader(resp.Body)
	var dataBuf strings.Builder
	flushEvent := func() error {
		payload := strings.TrimSpace(dataBuf.String())
		dataBuf.Reset()
		if payload == "" {
			return nil
		}
		if payload == "[DONE]" {
			return io.EOF
		}
		var m map[string]interface{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &m); err != nil {
			// best-effort: ignore non-JSON
			return nil
		}
		
		// Parse usage from any event that contains it (especially response.completed)
		if u, ok := m["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if v, ok := u["input_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				accUsage.PromptTokens = int(v)
			}
			if v, ok := u["output_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				accUsage.OutputTokens = int(v)
			}
			if v, ok := u["total_tokens"].(float64); ok {
				accUsage.TotalTokens = int(v)
			}
			if d, ok := u["output_tokens_details"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if v, ok := d["reasoning_tokens"].(float64); ok {
					accUsage.ReasoningTokens = int(v)
				}
			}
			// Log when usage is found for debugging
			log.Printf("[OpenAI Stream] Found usage in event: promptTokens=%d outputTokens=%d totalTokens=%d", accUsage.PromptTokens, accUsage.OutputTokens, accUsage.TotalTokens)
		}
		// Also check for usage at top level (some API versions)
		if typ, _ := m["type"].(string); typ != "" {
			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(typ), "response.completed") {
				// Log event type for debugging
				log.Printf("[OpenAI Stream] Received response.completed event")
			}
		}
		
		// Heuristics for Responses SSE: prefer output_text.delta
		// CRITICAL: Only call onDelta once per event to avoid duplicate chunks
		var textToSend string
		typ, _ := m["type"].(string)
		if typ != "" {
			lt := strings.ToLower(typ)
			if strings.Contains(lt, "response.completed") {
				return io.EOF
			}
			// Prefer output_text.delta for delta events
			if strings.Contains(lt, "output_text.delta") {
				if d, _ := m["delta"].(string); d != "" {
					textToSend = d
				}
			}
		}
		// Fallback to other fields if output_text.delta not found
		if textToSend == "" {
			if d, _ := m["delta"].(string); d != "" {
				textToSend = d
			} else if txt, _ := m["output_text"].(string); txt != "" {
				textToSend = txt
			} else if content, ok := m["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
				var sb strings.Builder
				for _, c := range content {
					if cm, ok := c.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
						if t, _ := cm["text"].(string); t != "" {
							sb.WriteString(t)
						}
					}
				}
				if sb.Len() > 0 {
					textToSend = sb.String()
				}
			}
		}
		// Send text only once
		if textToSend != "" {
			if onDelta != nil {
				_ = onDelta(textToSend)
			}
			extractURLsFromText(textToSend, &sources)
		}
		return nil
	}
	for {
		line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
		if err != nil {
			if err == io.EOF {
				break
			}
			return accUsage, queries, sources, err
		}
		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "data:") {
			data := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data:"))
			if data == "[DONE]" {
				break
			}
			if data != "" {
				dataBuf.WriteString(data)
			}
		} else if line == "" { // end of event
			if err := flushEvent(); err != nil {
				if err == io.EOF {
					break
				}
				return accUsage, queries, sources, err
			}
		}
	}
	// flush any remaining
	_ = flushEvent()
	
	// Calculate TotalTokens if not set
	if accUsage.TotalTokens == 0 && (accUsage.PromptTokens > 0 || accUsage.OutputTokens > 0) {
		accUsage.TotalTokens = accUsage.PromptTokens + accUsage.OutputTokens
		log.Printf("[OpenAI Stream] Calculated total_tokens: %d (prompt: %d + output: %d)", accUsage.TotalTokens, accUsage.PromptTokens, accUsage.OutputTokens)
	}
	
	// Log final usage before returning
	log.Printf("[OpenAI Stream] Final usage before return: promptTokens=%d outputTokens=%d totalTokens=%d reasoningTokens=%d", accUsage.PromptTokens, accUsage.OutputTokens, accUsage.TotalTokens, accUsage.ReasoningTokens)
	
	// Log final usage for debugging
	if accUsage.PromptTokens > 0 || accUsage.OutputTokens > 0 {
		log.Printf("[OpenAI Stream] Final usage: promptTokens=%d outputTokens=%d totalTokens=%d", accUsage.PromptTokens, accUsage.OutputTokens, accUsage.TotalTokens)
	} else {
		log.Printf("[OpenAI Stream] Warning: No usage data found in stream (promptTokens=%d outputTokens=%d)", accUsage.PromptTokens, accUsage.OutputTokens)
	}
	
	return accUsage, queries, sources, nil
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
)

var ErrInvalidTemplate = errors.New("invalid template")

// ArtifactTemplatesRepository manages artifact templates in Firestore
type ArtifactTemplatesRepository struct {
	col *firestore.CollectionRef
}

// NewArtifactTemplatesRepository creates a new repository instance
func NewArtifactTemplatesRepository(db *firestore.Client) *ArtifactTemplatesRepository {
	return &ArtifactTemplatesRepository{col: db.Collection("artifact_templates")}
}

// Create creates a new custom template
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, t *models.ArtifactTemplate) (string, error) {
	if t == nil || t.Name == "" || t.CreatedBy == "" {
		return "", ErrInvalidTemplate
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	t.CreatedAt = now
	t.UpdatedAt = now

	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	t.ID = doc.ID

	if _, err := doc.Set(ctx, t); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return doc.ID, nil
}

// Get retrieves a template by ID
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*models.ArtifactTemplate, error) {
	if id == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidTemplate
	}

	snap, err := r.col.Doc(id).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var t models.ArtifactTemplate
	if err := snap.DataTo(&t); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &t, nil
}

// ListPublic returns public (community) templates
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) ListPublic(ctx context.Context, category *string, limit int) ([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("isPublic", "==", true)

	if category != nil {
		q = q.Where("category", "==", *category)
	}

	q = q.OrderBy("usageCount", firestore.Desc)

	if limit > 0 {
		q = q.Limit(limit)
	}

	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	templates := make([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, 0, len(docs))
	for _, d := range docs {
		var t models.ArtifactTemplate
		if err := d.DataTo(&t); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		templates = append(templates, &t)
	}

	return templates, nil
}

// ListByTenant returns templates for a specific tenant
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) ListByTenant(ctx context.Context, tenantID string) ([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).OrderBy("createdAt", firestore.Desc)

	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	templates := make([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, 0, len(docs))
	for _, d := range docs {
		var t models.ArtifactTemplate
		if err := d.DataTo(&t); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		templates = append(templates, &t)
	}

	return templates, nil
}

// Update updates an existing template
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) Update(ctx context.Context, t *models.ArtifactTemplate) error {
	if t == nil || t.ID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidTemplate
	}

	t.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

	_, err := r.col.Doc(t.ID).Set(ctx, t)
	return err
}

// Delete deletes a template
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidTemplate
	}

	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}

// IncrementUsage increments the usage counter for a template
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) IncrementUsage(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidTemplate
	}

	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{
		{Path: "usageCount", Value: firestore.Increment(1)},
		{Path: "updatedAt", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
	})

	return err
}

// UpdateRating updates the rating for a template
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) UpdateRating(ctx context.Context, id string, newRating float64) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidTemplate
	}

	// Get current template to calculate new average
	template, err := r.Get(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	newRatingCount := template.RatingCount + 1
	newAvgRating := ((template.Rating * float64(template.RatingCount)) + newRating) / float64(newRatingCount)

	_, err = r.col.Doc(id).Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{
		{Path: "rating", Value: newAvgRating},
		{Path: "ratingCount", Value: newRatingCount},
		{Path: "updatedAt", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
	})

	return err
}

// ListFeatured returns featured templates
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) ListFeatured(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("isFeatured", "==", true).OrderBy("usageCount", firestore.Desc)

	if limit > 0 {
		q = q.Limit(limit)
	}

	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	templates := make([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, 0, len(docs))
	for _, d := range docs {
		var t models.ArtifactTemplate
		if err := d.DataTo(&t); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		templates = append(templates, &t)
	}

	return templates, nil
}

// SearchByTags searches templates by tags
func (r *ArtifactTemplatesRepository) SearchByTags(ctx context.Context, tags []string, limit int) ([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, error) {
	if len(tags) == 0 {
		return []*models.ArtifactTemplate{}, nil
	}

	// Firestore array-contains only works with single value, so we search for first tag
	// In production, you might want to use a more sophisticated search solution
	q := r.col.Where("tags", "array-contains", tags[0]).OrderBy("usageCount", firestore.Desc)

	if limit > 0 {
		q = q.Limit(limit)
	}

	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	templates := make([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, 0, len(docs))
	for _, d := range docs {
		var t models.ArtifactTemplate
		if err := d.DataTo(&t); err != nil {
			continue
		}

		// Filter by additional tags in application layer
		if len(tags) > 1 {
			hasAllTags := true
			for _, tag := range tags[1:] {
				found := false
				for _, tTag := range t.Tags {
					if tTag == tag {
						found = true
						break
					}
				}
				if !found {
					hasAllTags = false
					break
				}
			}
			if !hasAllTags {
				continue
			}
		}

		templates = append(templates, &t)
	}

	return templates, nil
}

Файл: cache.go

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
)

type ProcessedContentRepository struct{ col *firestore.CollectionRef }

func NewProcessedContentRepository(db *firestore.Client) *ProcessedContentRepository {
	return &ProcessedContentRepository{col: db.Collection("processed_content")}
}

type CachedProfile struct {
	TenantID    string                    `json:"tenantId"`
	SourceKey   string                    `json:"sourceKey"`
	ContentHash string                    `json:"contentHash"`
	Profile     *models.SourceProfileData `json:"profile"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time                 `json:"updatedAt"`
}

func HashContent(s string) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(s))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

// Get returns cached profile if content hash matches and not older than maxAge
func (r *ProcessedContentRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, tenantID, sourceKey, contentHash string, maxAge time.Duration) (*models.SourceProfileData, error) {
	// With firestore tags set to lowerCamel, use lowerCamel paths
	q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Where("sourceKey", "==", sourceKey).Limit(1)
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil || len(docs) == 0 {
		return nil, err
	}
	var c CachedProfile
	if err := docs[0].DataTo(&c); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c.ContentHash != contentHash {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if time.Since(c.UpdatedAt) > maxAge {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return c.Profile, nil
}

// Put saves/updates cache entry
func (r *ProcessedContentRepository) Put(ctx context.Context, tenantID, sourceKey, contentHash string, profile *models.SourceProfileData) error {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	docID := tenantID + "_" + sourceKey
	data := CachedProfile{TenantID: tenantID, SourceKey: sourceKey, ContentHash: contentHash, Profile: profile, UpdatedAt: now}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(docID).Set(ctx, data)
	return err
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
)

type ChunksRepository struct{ col *firestore.CollectionRef }

func NewChunksRepository(db *firestore.Client) *ChunksRepository {
	return &ChunksRepository{col: db.Collection("rag_chunks")}
}

func (r *ChunksRepository) Upsert(ctx context.Context, c *models.Chunk) error {
	if c == nil || c.ID == "" || c.DocID == "" || c.SourceID == "" || c.TenantID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	if c.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		c.CreatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(c.ID).Set(ctx, c)
	return err
}

func (r *ChunksRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, c *models.Chunk) (string, error) {
	if c == nil || c.DocID == "" || c.SourceID == "" || c.TenantID == "" {
		return "", ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	c.CreatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	c.ID = doc.ID
	if _, err := doc.Set(ctx, c); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return doc.ID, nil
}

func (r *ChunksRepository) ListByDoc(ctx context.Context, tenantID, docID string) ([]*models.Chunk, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Where("docId", "==", docID).OrderBy("position", firestore.Asc)
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	res := make([]*models.Chunk, 0, len(docs))
	for _, d := range docs {
		var c models.Chunk
		if err := d.DataTo(&c); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, &c)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// ListBySourcesRecent returns recent chunks for a set of sources (batched IN)
func (r *ChunksRepository) ListBySourcesRecent(ctx context.Context, tenantID string, sourceIDs []string, limit int) ([]*models.Chunk, error) {
	if len(sourceIDs) == 0 {
		return []*models.Chunk{}, nil
	}
	batchSize := 10
	var results []*models.Chunk
	for i := 0; i < len(sourceIDs); i += batchSize {
		end := i + batchSize
		if end > len(sourceIDs) {
			end = len(sourceIDs)
		}
		batch := sourceIDs[i:end]
		// Public chunks are global (tenantId may be empty), so filter only by sourceId and order by recency.
		q := r.col.Where("sourceId", "in", batch).OrderBy("createdAt", firestore.Desc)
		if limit > 0 {
			q = q.Limit(limit)
		}
		docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, d := range docs {
			var c models.Chunk
			if err := d.DataTo(&c); err != nil {
				continue
			}
			// For internal (tenant-scoped) chunks, enforce tenant match
			if strings.TrimSpace(c.TenantID) != "" && tenantID != c.TenantID {
				continue
			}
			results = append(results, &c)
		}
	}
	if limit > 0 && len(results) > limit {
		results = results[:limit]
	}
	return results, nil
}

// GetByIDs returns chunks by document IDs (batched lookups)
func (r *ChunksRepository) GetByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) ([]*models.Chunk, error) {
	if len(ids) == 0 {
		return []*models.Chunk{}, nil
	}
	var res []*models.Chunk
	// Firestore allows only 10 in array-contains-any/in; use direct doc gets
	for _, id := range ids {
		if strings.TrimSpace(id) == "" {
			continue
		}
		d, err := r.col.Doc(id).Get(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		var c models.Chunk
		if err := d.DataTo(&c); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, &c)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// DeleteByDoc deletes all chunks for a given document
func (r *ChunksRepository) DeleteByDoc(ctx context.Context, tenantID, docID string) error {
	if tenantID == "" || docID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	chunks, err := r.ListByDoc(ctx, tenantID, docID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, c := range chunks {
		if _, err := r.col.Doc(c.ID).Delete(ctx); err != nil {
			// Log but continue - best effort deletion
			continue
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Delete deletes a single chunk by ID
func (r *ChunksRepository) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/gcp"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
)

type DocumentsRepository struct {
	col         *firestore.CollectionRef
	storage     *gcp.GCSClient
	bucket      string
	useGCS      bool
}

func NewDocumentsRepository(db *firestore.Client) *DocumentsRepository {
	return &DocumentsRepository{col: db.Collection("rag_documents"), useGCS: false}
}

// WithStorage configures the repository to use GCS for storing document content
func (r *DocumentsRepository) WithStorage(storage *gcp.GCSClient, bucket string) *DocumentsRepository {
	r.storage = storage
	r.bucket = bucket
	r.useGCS = storage != nil && bucket != ""
	return r
}

// getObjectPath returns the GCS object path for a document
func (r *DocumentsRepository) getObjectPath(d *models.Document) string {
	// Format: {tenantId}/{sourceId}/{docId}.txt
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%s.txt", d.TenantID, d.SourceID, d.ID)
}

// getStoragePath returns the full gs:// path for a document
func (r *DocumentsRepository) getStoragePath(d *models.Document) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("gs://%s/%s", r.bucket, r.getObjectPath(d))
}

// uploadContent uploads document content to GCS and returns the storage path
func (r *DocumentsRepository) uploadContent(ctx context.Context, d *models.Document) (*string, error) {
	if !r.useGCS || d.FullText == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	objectPath := r.getObjectPath(d)
	contentType := "text/plain"
	if d.ContentType != "" {
		contentType = d.ContentType
	}
	metadata := map[string]string{
		"tenantId":   d.TenantID,
		"sourceId":   d.SourceID,
		"documentId": d.ID,
		"title":      d.Title,
	}
	if err := r.storage.UploadBytes(ctx, r.bucket, objectPath, []byte(d.FullText), contentType, metadata); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to upload document content to GCS: %w", err)
	}
	storagePath := r.getStoragePath(d)
	return &storagePath, nil
}

// deleteContent deletes document content from GCS
func (r *DocumentsRepository) deleteContent(ctx context.Context, d *models.Document) error {
	if !r.useGCS || d.StoragePath == nil {
		return nil
	}
	// Extract object path from gs://bucket/path
	gsPath := *d.StoragePath
	if !strings.HasPrefix(gsPath, "gs://") {
		return nil
	}
	// Remove gs://bucket/ prefix
	objectPath := strings.TrimPrefix(gsPath, fmt.Sprintf("gs://%s/", r.bucket))
	if err := r.storage.DeleteObject(ctx, r.bucket, objectPath); err != nil {
		// Log but don't fail - best effort deletion
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete document content from GCS: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *DocumentsRepository) Upsert(ctx context.Context, d *models.Document) error {
	if d == nil || d.ID == "" || d.SourceID == "" || d.TenantID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if d.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		d.CreatedAt = now
	}
	if d.IngestedAt.IsZero() {
		d.IngestedAt = now
	}
	d.UpdatedAt = now
	
	// Upload content to GCS if enabled and FullText is present
	if d.FullText != "" {
		storagePath, err := r.uploadContent(ctx, d)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if storagePath != nil {
			d.StoragePath = storagePath
		}
	}
	
	_, err := r.col.Doc(d.ID).Set(ctx, d)
	return err
}

func (r *DocumentsRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, d *models.Document) (string, error) {
	if d == nil || d.SourceID == "" || d.TenantID == "" {
		return "", ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	d.CreatedAt = now
	d.IngestedAt = now
	d.UpdatedAt = now
	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	d.ID = doc.ID
	
	// Upload content to GCS if enabled and FullText is present
	if d.FullText != "" {
		storagePath, err := r.uploadContent(ctx, d)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if storagePath != nil {
			d.StoragePath = storagePath
		}
	}
	
	if _, err := doc.Set(ctx, d); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return doc.ID, nil
}

func (r *DocumentsRepository) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*models.Document, error) {
	if id == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	snap, err := r.col.Doc(id).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var d models.Document
	if err := snap.DataTo(&d); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &d, nil
}

func (r *DocumentsRepository) GetByExternalID(ctx context.Context, tenantID, sourceID, externalID string) (*models.Document, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Where("sourceId", "==", sourceID).Where("externalId", "==", externalID).Limit(1)
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil || len(docs) == 0 {
		return nil, err
	}
	var d models.Document
	if err := docs[0].DataTo(&d); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &d, nil
}

// ---- CoreDocs (project-level attachments) ----

var ErrInvalidCoreDoc = errors.New("invalid core doc")

type CoreDocsRepo struct{ col *firestore.CollectionRef }

func NewCoreDocsRepo(db *firestore.Client) *CoreDocsRepo {
	return &CoreDocsRepo{col: db.Collection("core_docs")}
}

func (r *CoreDocsRepo) Create(ctx context.Context, d *models.CoreDoc) (string, error) {
	if d == nil || d.TenantID == "" || d.ProjectID == "" || d.Filename == "" {
		return "", ErrInvalidCoreDoc
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	d.CreatedAt = now
	d.UpdatedAt = now
	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	d.ID = doc.ID
	if _, err := doc.Set(ctx, d); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return doc.ID, nil
}

func (r *CoreDocsRepo) Upsert(ctx context.Context, d *models.CoreDoc) error {
	if d == nil || d.ID == "" || d.TenantID == "" || d.ProjectID == "" || d.Filename == "" {
		return ErrInvalidCoreDoc
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if d.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		d.CreatedAt = now
	}
	d.UpdatedAt = now
	_, err := r.col.Doc(d.ID).Set(ctx, d)
	return err
}

func (r *CoreDocsRepo) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*models.CoreDoc, error) {
	if id == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidCoreDoc
	}
	snap, err := r.col.Doc(id).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out models.CoreDoc
	if err := snap.DataTo(&out); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &out, nil
}

func (r *CoreDocsRepo) ListByProject(ctx context.Context, tenantID, projectID string, limit int) ([]*models.CoreDoc, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Where("projectId", "==", projectID).OrderBy("createdAt", firestore.Desc)
	if limit > 0 {
		q = q.Limit(limit)
	}
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	res := make([]*models.CoreDoc, 0, len(docs))
	for _, d := range docs {
		var cd models.CoreDoc
		if err := d.DataTo(&cd); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, &cd)
	}
	return res, nil
}

func (r *CoreDocsRepo) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) (bool, error) {
	if id == "" {
		return false, ErrInvalidCoreDoc
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

func (r *DocumentsRepository) ListBySource(ctx context.Context, tenantID, sourceID string, limit int) ([]*models.Document, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Where("sourceId", "==", sourceID).OrderBy("originPublishedAt", firestore.Desc)
	if limit > 0 {
		q = q.Limit(limit)
	}
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	res := make([]*models.Document, 0, len(docs))
	for _, d := range docs {
		var doc models.Document
		if err := d.DataTo(&doc); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, &doc)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// ListBySources returns latest documents for a set of source IDs with optional filters
func (r *DocumentsRepository) ListBySources(ctx context.Context, tenantID string, sourceIDs []string, limit int, language, documentType *string) ([]*models.Document, error) {
	if len(sourceIDs) == 0 {
		return []*models.Document{}, nil
	}
	// Firestore IN supports up to 10 values; batch if needed
	batchSize := 10
	var results []*models.Document
	for i := 0; i < len(sourceIDs); i += batchSize {
		end := i + batchSize
		if end > len(sourceIDs) {
			end = len(sourceIDs)
		}
		batch := sourceIDs[i:end]
		q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Where("sourceId", "in", batch).OrderBy("originPublishedAt", firestore.Desc)
		if limit > 0 {
			q = q.Limit(limit)
		}
		docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, d := range docs {
			var doc models.Document
			if err := d.DataTo(&doc); err != nil {
				continue
			}
			if language != nil && *language != "" && doc.Language != *language {
				continue
			}
			if documentType != nil && *documentType != "" && doc.DocumentType != *documentType {
				continue
			}
			results = append(results, &doc)
		}
	}
	if limit > 0 && len(results) > limit {
		results = results[:limit]
	}
	return results, nil
}

// Delete deletes a document by ID and its content from GCS if present
func (r *DocumentsRepository) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	// Get document first to delete content from GCS
	doc, err := r.GetByID(ctx, id)
	if err == nil && doc != nil {
		_ = r.deleteContent(ctx, doc) // Best effort deletion
	}
	_, err = r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}

// DeleteWithStorage deletes a document and its content from GCS (explicit version)
func (r *DocumentsRepository) DeleteWithStorage(ctx context.Context, d *models.Document) error {
	if d == nil || d.ID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	_ = r.deleteContent(ctx, d) // Best effort deletion
	_, err := r.col.Doc(d.ID).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}

// DeleteBySource deletes all documents for a source and their content from GCS
// Note: chunks should be deleted separately using ChunksRepository.DeleteByDoc
func (r *DocumentsRepository) DeleteBySource(ctx context.Context, tenantID, sourceID string) error {
	if tenantID == "" || sourceID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	// List all documents for this source
	docs, err := r.ListBySource(ctx, tenantID, sourceID, 0) // 0 = no limit
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// Delete each document (which will also delete content from GCS)
	for _, doc := range docs {
		_ = r.DeleteWithStorage(ctx, doc) // Best effort deletion
	}
	return nil
}

// GetByCoreDocID finds a document by CoreDocID stored in Attrs
func (r *DocumentsRepository) GetByCoreDocID(ctx context.Context, tenantID, coreDocID string) (*models.Document, error) {
	if tenantID == "" || coreDocID == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	// Query documents where attrs.coreDocId == coreDocID
	q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Limit(100)
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, d := range docs {
		var doc models.Document
		if err := d.DataTo(&doc); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if doc.Attrs != nil {
			if v, ok := doc.Attrs["coreDocId"].(string); ok && v == coreDocID {
				return &doc, nil
			}
		}
	}
	return nil, ErrInvalidDocument
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
)

// GenerationSessionsRepository manages generation sessions in Firestore
type GenerationSessionsRepository struct {
	col *firestore.CollectionRef
}

// NewGenerationSessionsRepository creates a new repository
func NewGenerationSessionsRepository(db *firestore.Client) *GenerationSessionsRepository {
	return &GenerationSessionsRepository{col: db.Collection("generation_sessions")}
}

// Create creates a new generation session
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, session *models.GenerationSession) (string, error) {
	if session == nil {
		return "", errors.New("session is nil")
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	session.CreatedAt = now
	session.UpdatedAt = now

	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	session.ID = doc.ID

	if _, err := doc.Set(ctx, session); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return doc.ID, nil
}

// Get retrieves a generation session by ID
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*models.GenerationSession, error) {
	snap, err := r.col.Doc(id).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var session models.GenerationSession
	if err := snap.DataTo(&session); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &session, nil
}

// Update updates a generation session
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) Update(ctx context.Context, session *models.GenerationSession) error {
	if session == nil || session.ID == "" {
		return errors.New("invalid session")
	}

	session.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()

	_, err := r.col.Doc(session.ID).Set(ctx, session)
	return err
}

// UpdateFields updates specific fields of a session
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) UpdateFields(ctx context.Context, id string, updates map[string]interface{}) error {
	if id == "" {
		return errors.New("session ID is required")
	}

	// Always update timestamp
	updates["updatedAt"] = time.Now().UTC()

	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Set(ctx, updates, firestore.MergeAll)
	return err
}

// Delete deletes a generation session
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}

// ListByArtifact lists all sessions for an artifact
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) ListByArtifact(ctx context.Context, artifactID string) ([]*models.GenerationSession, error) {
	docs, err := r.col.Where("artifactId", "==", artifactID).
		OrderBy("createdAt", firestore.Desc).
		Documents(ctx).GetAll()

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	sessions := make([]*models.GenerationSession, 0, len(docs))
	for _, doc := range docs {
		var session models.GenerationSession
		if err := doc.DataTo(&session); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		sessions = append(sessions, &session)
	}

	return sessions, nil
}

// GetActive retrieves the active session for an artifact (if any)
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) GetActive(ctx context.Context, artifactID string) (*models.GenerationSession, error) {
	docs, err := r.col.Where("artifactId", "==", artifactID).
		Where("status", "in", []string{"running", "pending"}).
		OrderBy("createdAt", firestore.Desc).
		Limit(1).
		Documents(ctx).GetAll()

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if len(docs) == 0 {
		return nil, nil // No active session
	}

	var session models.GenerationSession
	if err := docs[0].DataTo(&session); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &session, nil
}

// UpdateProgress updates session progress
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) UpdateProgress(ctx context.Context, id string, progress float64, currentSection *string) error {
	updates := map[string]interface{}{
		"progress":  progress,
		"updatedAt": time.Now().UTC(),
	}

	if currentSection != nil {
		updates["currentSection"] = *currentSection
	}

	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Set(ctx, updates, firestore.MergeAll)
	return err
}

// AddSectionResult adds a section result to the session
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) AddSectionResult(ctx context.Context, id string, sectionID string, result models.SectionResult) error {
	// Use Firestore map update syntax
	updates := []firestore.Update{
		{
			Path:  "sectionResults." + sectionID,
			Value: result,
		},
		{
			Path:  "updatedAt",
			Value: time.Now().UTC(),
		},
	}

	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Update(ctx, updates)
	return err
}

// AddError adds an error to the session
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) AddError(ctx context.Context, id string, genError models.GenerationError) error {
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{
		{
			Path:  "errors",
			Value: firestore.ArrayUnion(genError),
		},
		{
			Path:  "updatedAt",
			Value: time.Now().UTC(),
		},
	})
	return err
}

// MarkCompleted marks a session as completed
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) MarkCompleted(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	return r.UpdateFields(ctx, id, map[string]interface{}{
		"status":   "completed",
		"progress": 1.0,
	})
}

// MarkFailed marks a session as failed
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) MarkFailed(ctx context.Context, id string, errorMsg string) error {
	return r.UpdateFields(ctx, id, map[string]interface{}{
		"status": "failed",
		"errors": firestore.ArrayUnion(models.GenerationError{
			Message:   errorMsg,
			Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
		}),
	})
}

// MarkCancelled marks a session as cancelled
func (r *GenerationSessionsRepository) MarkCancelled(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	return r.UpdateFields(ctx, id, map[string]interface{}{
		"status": "cancelled",
	})
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
)

// ParticipantRef references an author entity (human/ai/system)
type ParticipantRef struct {
	ParticipantID string  `json:"participantId" firestore:"participantId"`
	Kind          string  `json:"kind" firestore:"kind"` // human|ai|system|tool
	DisplayName   *string `json:"displayName,omitempty" firestore:"displayName,omitempty"`
}

// AgentProfileSnapshot stores minimal model config alongside an interaction
// Note: full AgentProfiles collection is not required yet; two presets will be provided on the frontend
type AgentProfileSnapshot struct {
	Provider     string          `json:"provider" firestore:"provider"` // gemini|openai|grok
	Model        string          `json:"model" firestore:"model"`
	Version      *string         `json:"version,omitempty" firestore:"version,omitempty"`
	Capabilities map[string]bool `json:"capabilities,omitempty" firestore:"capabilities,omitempty"` // tools, webSearch, reasoning, refinePrevious, etc.
	Params       map[string]any  `json:"params,omitempty" firestore:"params,omitempty"`             // temperature, systemPromptHash, etc.
}

// InteractionMetadata contains extensible metadata flags and settings
type InteractionMetadata struct {
	Pinned *bool    `json:"pinned,omitempty" firestore:"pinned,omitempty"` // User-pinned for quick access
	Notes  []string `json:"notes,omitempty" firestore:"notes,omitempty"`
}

type Interaction struct {
	ID               string  `json:"id" firestore:"id"`
	TenantID         string  `json:"tenantId" firestore:"tenantId"`
	ProjectID        string  `json:"projectId" firestore:"projectId"`
	Kind             string  `json:"kind" firestore:"kind"` // e.g., "discovery.answer"
	Subkind          *string `json:"subkind,omitempty" firestore:"subkind,omitempty"`
	Content          string  `json:"content" firestore:"content"`
	ContentSanitized *string `json:"contentSanitized,omitempty" firestore:"contentSanitized,omitempty"`
	Summary          *string `json:"summary,omitempty" firestore:"summary,omitempty"`
	// Sections: optional grouping of interactions inside Unfold chat
	SectionID *string `json:"sectionId,omitempty" firestore:"sectionId,omitempty"`
	// Optional model/provider metadata for assistant/system interactions
	Model *string    `json:"model,omitempty" firestore:"model,omitempty"`
	Usage *UsageMeta `json:"usage,omitempty" firestore:"usage,omitempty"`
	// Extended multi-participant fields (optional, backward compatible)
	Author       *ParticipantRef       `json:"author,omitempty" firestore:"author,omitempty"`
	Recipients   []string              `json:"recipients,omitempty" firestore:"recipients,omitempty"`
	ReplyTo      *string               `json:"replyTo,omitempty" firestore:"replyTo,omitempty"`
	AgentProfile *AgentProfileSnapshot `json:"agentProfile,omitempty" firestore:"agentProfile,omitempty"`
	Evaluations  map[string]any        `json:"evaluations,omitempty" firestore:"evaluations,omitempty"`
	Metadata     *InteractionMetadata  `json:"metadata,omitempty" firestore:"metadata,omitempty"`
	// Relations between interactions (answers/refines/evaluates)
	Relations []struct {
		Type     string `json:"type" firestore:"type"`
		TargetID string `json:"targetId" firestore:"targetId"`
	} `json:"relations,omitempty" firestore:"relations,omitempty"`
	// Additional optional metadata used by the UI
	Language                 *string `json:"language,omitempty" firestore:"language,omitempty"`
	SystemInstructionApplied *string `json:"systemInstructionApplied,omitempty" firestore:"systemInstructionApplied,omitempty"`
	GenerationParams         *struct {
		Temperature      *float64 `json:"temperature,omitempty" firestore:"temperature,omitempty"`
		MaxOutputTokens  *int     `json:"maxOutputTokens,omitempty" firestore:"maxOutputTokens,omitempty"`
		GroundingEnabled *bool    `json:"groundingEnabled,omitempty" firestore:"groundingEnabled,omitempty"`
	} `json:"generationParams,omitempty" firestore:"generationParams,omitempty"`
	HighRisk *struct {
		Level     string   `json:"level" firestore:"level"`
		Score     float64  `json:"score" firestore:"score"`
		Rationale *string  `json:"rationale,omitempty" firestore:"rationale,omitempty"`
		Triggers  []string `json:"triggers,omitempty" firestore:"triggers,omitempty"`
	} `json:"highRisk,omitempty" firestore:"highRisk,omitempty"`
	DiscussionFacts *struct {
		Dependencies      *string `json:"dependencies,omitempty" firestore:"dependencies,omitempty"`           // What the decision/action depends on
		Prerequisites     *string `json:"prerequisites,omitempty" firestore:"prerequisites,omitempty"`         // What must happen first
		Participants      *string `json:"participants,omitempty" firestore:"participants,omitempty"`          // Who is involved (user, family, colleagues, clients)
		ParticipantRoles  *string `json:"participantRoles,omitempty" firestore:"participantRoles,omitempty"`  // Roles and relationships between participants
		AvailableResources *string `json:"availableResources,omitempty" firestore:"availableResources,omitempty"` // Not only constraints, but what is available
		PreviousAttempts  *string `json:"previousAttempts,omitempty" firestore:"previousAttempts,omitempty"` // Previous attempts or experience
		ResultFormat      *string `json:"resultFormat,omitempty" firestore:"resultFormat,omitempty"`         // Format of desired result
	} `json:"discussionFacts,omitempty" firestore:"discussionFacts,omitempty"`
	OriginalMessageID *string   `json:"originalMessageId,omitempty" firestore:"originalMessageId,omitempty"`
	CoreDocIDs        []string  `json:"coreDocIds,omitempty" firestore:"coreDocIds,omitempty"`
	SearchQueries     []string  `json:"searchQueries,omitempty" firestore:"searchQueries,omitempty"`
	Sources           []string  `json:"sources,omitempty" firestore:"sources,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt         time.Time `json:"createdAt" firestore:"createdAt"`
}

// UsageMeta captures token usage and related counters reported by providers
type UsageMeta struct {
	PromptTokens        int `json:"promptTokens,omitempty" firestore:"promptTokens,omitempty"`
	OutputTokens        int `json:"outputTokens,omitempty" firestore:"outputTokens,omitempty"`
	TotalTokens         int `json:"totalTokens,omitempty" firestore:"totalTokens,omitempty"`
	ReasoningTokens     int `json:"reasoningTokens,omitempty" firestore:"reasoningTokens,omitempty"`
	ToolUsePromptTokens int `json:"toolUsePromptTokens,omitempty" firestore:"toolUsePromptTokens,omitempty"`
}

type InteractionsRepository struct{ col *firestore.CollectionRef }

func NewInteractionsRepository(db *firestore.Client) *InteractionsRepository {
	return &InteractionsRepository{col: db.Collection("core_interactions")}
}

func (r *InteractionsRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, it *Interaction) (string, error) {
	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	it.ID = doc.ID
	it.CreatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	_, err := doc.Set(ctx, it)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return doc.ID, nil
}

// Update applies a partial update to an interaction document by id using merge semantics
func (r *InteractionsRepository) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, updates map[string]interface{}) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	if len(updates) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	// ensure server-side updated CreatedAt is not accidentally overwritten
	delete(updates, "id")
	delete(updates, "tenantId")
	delete(updates, "projectId")
	delete(updates, "createdAt")
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Set(ctx, updates, firestore.MergeAll)
	return err
}

// Get returns an interaction by id
func (r *InteractionsRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*Interaction, error) {
	if id == "" {
		return nil, ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	snap, err := r.col.Doc(id).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var it Interaction
	if err := snap.DataTo(&it); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &it, nil
}

// DeleteByID deletes an interaction document by id
func (r *InteractionsRepository) DeleteByID(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}

// DeleteByProject removes all interactions for a given project
func (r *InteractionsRepository) DeleteByProject(ctx context.Context, projectID string) error {
	// Delete documents matching either field casing (backward compatibility)
	fieldNames := []string{"projectId", "ProjectID"}
	for _, fname := range fieldNames {
		docs, err := r.col.Where(fname, "==", projectID).Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		for _, d := range docs {
			_, _ = r.col.Doc(d.Ref.ID).Delete(ctx)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// ListByProject returns interactions for a project ordered by createdAt asc
func (r *InteractionsRepository) ListByProject(ctx context.Context, projectID string) ([]*Interaction, error) {
	// Try modern field first, then legacy casing
	fieldNames := []string{"projectId", "ProjectID"}
	var res []*Interaction
	for i, fname := range fieldNames {
		q := r.col.Where(fname, "==", projectID).OrderBy("createdAt", firestore.Asc)
		docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			if i == len(fieldNames)-1 {
				return nil, err
			}
			continue
		}
		for _, d := range docs {
			var it Interaction
			if err := d.DataTo(&it); err != nil {
				continue
			}
			res = append(res, &it)
		}
		if len(res) > 0 {
			break
		}
	}
	return res, nil
}

func isPublicSource(kind string) bool {
	switch kind {
	case "web", "rss", "telegram_channel":
		return true

		return false
	}

// GetByUID scans users to find by Firebase UID (across tenants)
// Note: Firestore lacks cross-collection secondary index here; this is acceptable for low volumes.
func (r *UsersRepository) GetByUID(ctx context.Context, uid string) (*models.User, error) {
	docs, err := r.col.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, d := range docs {
		var u models.User
		if err := d.DataTo(&u); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		// Backward compatibility: documents created before firestore tags may have PascalCase field names
		if u.ID == "" {
			data := d.Data()
			if idRaw, ok := data["ID"].(string); ok {
				u.ID = idRaw
			}
			if tRaw, ok := data["TenantID"].(string); ok {
				u.TenantID = tRaw
			}
			if eRaw, ok := data["Email"].(string); ok {
				u.Email = eRaw
			}
			if sv, ok := data["SchemaVersion"].(string); ok {
				u.SchemaVersion = sv
			}
			// Minimal timestamps if present
			if ca, ok := data["CreatedAt"].(time.Time); ok {
				u.CreatedAt = ca
			}
			if ua, ok := data["UpdatedAt"].(time.Time); ok {
				u.UpdatedAt = ua
			}
			// If we successfully recovered ID, consider migrating document to lowerCamel
			if u.ID != "" && u.TenantID != "" {
				_ = r.Upsert(ctx, &u)
			}
		}
		if u.ID == uid {
			return &u, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, errors.New("user not found")
}

	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if p.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		p.CreatedAt = now
	}
	p.UpdatedAt = now
	if p.Pk == "" {
		p.Pk = p.TenantID
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(p.ID).Set(ctx, p)
	return err

func (r *ProjectsRepository) List(ctx context.Context, tenantID string, view *string) ([]*models.Project, error) {
	// With firestore tags set to lowerCamel, use lowerCamel paths
	query := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID)
	if view != nil {
		query = query.Where("view", "==", *view)
	}
	// Order by lastInteractionAt desc for Discovery chats
	query = query.OrderBy("lastInteractionAt", firestore.Desc).Limit(100)

	docs, err := query.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	projects := make([]*models.Project, 0, len(docs))
	for _, doc := range docs {
		var p models.Project
		if err := doc.DataTo(&p); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		projects = append(projects, &p)
	}
	return projects, nil
}

	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}

func (r *ProjectsRepository) UpdateLastInteraction(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{
		{Path: "lastInteractionAt", Value: now},
		{Path: "updatedAt", Value: now},
	})
	return err
}

	if err != nil || len(docs) == 0 {
		return nil, err
	}

	if err := docs[0].DataTo(&p); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &p, nil
}

// --- DataSources ---
func (r *DataSourcesRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, ds *models.DataSource) (string, error) {
	if ds == nil {
		return "", ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	ds.CreatedAt = now
	ds.UpdatedAt = now
	// Public sources (web/rss/telegram_channel) are stored globally
	if isPublicSource(ds.Kind) {
		ds.TenantID = ""
		ds.Pk = "global"
	} else {
		ds.Pk = ds.TenantID
	}
	if ds.FirstSeen.IsZero() {
		ds.FirstSeen = now
	}
	ds.LastSeen = now
	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	ds.ID = doc.ID
	if _, err := doc.Set(ctx, ds); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return doc.ID, nil
}

// --- SourceProfiles ---
func (r *SourceProfilesRepository) Upsert(ctx context.Context, sp *models.SourceProfile) error {
	if sp == nil || sp.ID == "" || sp.DataSourceID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if sp.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		sp.CreatedAt = now
	}
	sp.UpdatedAt = now
	if sp.SchemaVersion == "" {
		sp.SchemaVersion = "1.0"
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(sp.ID).Set(ctx, sp)
	return err
}

func (r *SourceProfilesRepository) GetByDataSource(ctx context.Context, tenantID, dataSourceID string) (*models.SourceProfile, error) {
	// Prefer global profile
	if docsGlobal, err := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", "").Documents(ctx).GetAll(); err == nil {
		for _, d := range docsGlobal {
			var sp models.SourceProfile
			if err := d.DataTo(&sp); err != nil {
				continue
			}
			if sp.DataSourceID == dataSourceID {
				return &sp, nil
			}
		}
	}
	// Fallback to tenant-scoped
	docsTenant, err2 := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err2 != nil {
		return nil, err2
	}
	for _, d := range docsTenant {
		var sp models.SourceProfile
		if err := d.DataTo(&sp); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if sp.DataSourceID == dataSourceID {
			return &sp, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("source profile not found")
}

// DeleteTenantScopedForSource removes tenant-scoped profile for a given dataSourceID (used during migration to global profiles)
func (r *SourceProfilesRepository) DeleteTenantScopedForSource(ctx context.Context, tenantID, dataSourceID string) error {
	docs, err := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, d := range docs {
		var sp models.SourceProfile
		if err := d.DataTo(&sp); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if sp.DataSourceID == dataSourceID {
			_, _ = r.col.Doc(d.Ref.ID).Delete(ctx)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *SourceProfilesRepository) ListByProject(ctx context.Context, tenantID, projectID string, sourcesRepo *DataSourcesRepository) ([]*models.SourceProfile, error) {
	// Load sources by project then map to profiles
	sources, err := sourcesRepo.ListByProject(ctx, tenantID, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(sources) == 0 {
		return []*models.SourceProfile{}, nil
	}
	// Build set of dataSourceIDs
	ids := make(map[string]struct{}, len(sources))
	for _, s := range sources {
		ids[s.ID] = struct{}{}
	}
	// Fetch tenant-specific and global profiles and filter by DataSourceID
	var res []*models.SourceProfile
	// Tenant-scoped
	if docs, err := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Documents(ctx).GetAll(); err == nil {
		for _, d := range docs {
			var sp models.SourceProfile
			if err := d.DataTo(&sp); err != nil {
				continue
			}
			if _, ok := ids[sp.DataSourceID]; ok {
				res = append(res, &sp)
			}
		}
	}
	// Global
	if docs, err := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", "").Documents(ctx).GetAll(); err == nil {
		for _, d := range docs {
			var sp models.SourceProfile
			if err := d.DataTo(&sp); err != nil {
				continue
			}
			if _, ok := ids[sp.DataSourceID]; ok {
				res = append(res, &sp)
			}
		}
	}
	return res, nil
}

// DeleteByProject deletes source profiles for all data sources belonging to a project
func (r *SourceProfilesRepository) DeleteByProject(ctx context.Context, tenantID, projectID string, sourcesRepo *DataSourcesRepository) error {
	// Load sources tied to this project (including related)
	sources, err := sourcesRepo.ListByProject(ctx, tenantID, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(sources) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	ids := make(map[string]struct{}, len(sources))
	for _, s := range sources {
		ids[s.ID] = struct{}{}
	}

	// Scan profiles by tenant and delete those pointing to the collected dataSourceIds
	docs, err := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, d := range docs {
		var sp models.SourceProfile
		if err := d.DataTo(&sp); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := ids[sp.DataSourceID]; ok {
			_, _ = r.col.Doc(d.Ref.ID).Delete(ctx)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *DataSourcesRepository) Upsert(ctx context.Context, ds *models.DataSource) error {
	if ds == nil || ds.ID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if ds.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		ds.CreatedAt = now
	}
	ds.UpdatedAt = now
	if isPublicSource(ds.Kind) {
		ds.TenantID = ""
		ds.Pk = "global"
	} else if ds.Pk == "" {
		ds.Pk = ds.TenantID
	}
	ds.LastSeen = now
	_, err := r.col.Doc(ds.ID).Set(ctx, ds)
	return err
}

func (r *DataSourcesRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*models.DataSource, error) {
	snap, err := r.col.Doc(id).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var ds models.DataSource
	if err := snap.DataTo(&ds); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &ds, nil
}

// FindByCanonicalSource finds a datasource by tenant + canonical source identifier (e.g., normalized URL or @username)
func (r *DataSourcesRepository) FindByCanonicalSource(ctx context.Context, tenantID, canonical string) (*models.DataSource, error) {
	// Search across all datasources (globals + tenant-scoped)
	docs, err := r.col.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var candidates []string
	for _, doc := range docs {
		var ds models.DataSource
		if err := doc.DataTo(&ds); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		// Check if canonical matches URI or ChannelUsername
		if ds.Details.URI != nil && *ds.Details.URI == canonical {
			fmt.Printf("[FindByCanonicalSource] Found match by URI: canonical=%s, id=%s\n", canonical, ds.ID)
			return &ds, nil
		}
		if ds.Details.ChannelUsername != nil && *ds.Details.ChannelUsername == canonical {
			fmt.Printf("[FindByCanonicalSource] Found match by ChannelUsername: canonical=%s, id=%s\n", canonical, ds.ID)
			return &ds, nil
		}
		// Collect candidates for debugging
		if ds.Details.ChannelUsername != nil {
			candidates = append(candidates, fmt.Sprintf("id=%s,channel=%s", ds.ID, *ds.Details.ChannelUsername))
		}
		if ds.Details.URI != nil {
			candidates = append(candidates, fmt.Sprintf("id=%s,uri=%s", ds.ID, *ds.Details.URI))
		}
	}

	fmt.Printf("[FindByCanonicalSource] No match for canonical=%s among %d sources: %v\n", canonical, len(candidates), candidates)
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("datasource not found")
}

// ListByProject returns datasources for a project (primary or related)
func (r *DataSourcesRepository) ListByProject(ctx context.Context, tenantID, projectID string) ([]*models.DataSource, error) {
	// Resolve via rag_source_projects linking table
	spRepo := NewSourceProjectsRepository(r.db)
	status := "active"
	links, err := spRepo.ListByProject(ctx, tenantID, projectID, &status)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(links) == 0 {
		return []*models.DataSource{}, nil
	}
	// Build set for fast lookup
	ids := make(map[string]struct{}, len(links))
	for _, l := range links {
		ids[l.SourceID] = struct{}{}
	}
	// Fetch all datasources (global + tenant) and filter by ids
	docs, err := r.col.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var sources []*models.DataSource
	for _, d := range docs {
		var ds models.DataSource
		if err := d.DataTo(&ds); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := ids[ds.ID]; ok {
			sources = append(sources, &ds)
		}
	}
	return sources, nil
}

// ListActiveByKinds returns active datasources filtered by kinds (using Firestore IN on kind)
func (r *DataSourcesRepository) ListActiveByKinds(ctx context.Context, kinds []string) ([]*models.DataSource, error) {
	if len(kinds) == 0 {
		return []*models.DataSource{}, nil
	}
	// Firestore IN supports up to 10 values
	q := r.col.Where("status", "==", "active").Where("kind", "in", kinds)
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var res []*models.DataSource
	for _, d := range docs {
		var ds models.DataSource
		if err := d.DataTo(&ds); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, &ds)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// DeleteByProject deletes sources where projectId == id, or removes id from relatedProjectIds
func (r *DataSourcesRepository) DeleteByProject(ctx context.Context, projectID string) error {
	// No-op in new model: linkage is managed in rag_source_projects
	return nil
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"sort"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
)

type RulesRepository struct{ col *firestore.CollectionRef }

func NewRulesRepository(db *firestore.Client) *RulesRepository {
	return &RulesRepository{col: db.Collection("rag_rules")}
}

func (r *RulesRepository) Upsert(ctx context.Context, rule *models.Rule) error {
	if rule == nil || rule.ID == "" || rule.TenantID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if rule.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		rule.CreatedAt = now
	}
	rule.UpdatedAt = now
	_, err := r.col.Doc(rule.ID).Set(ctx, rule)
	return err
}

func (r *RulesRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, rule *models.Rule) (string, error) {
	if rule == nil || rule.TenantID == "" {
		return "", ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	rule.CreatedAt = now
	rule.UpdatedAt = now
	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	rule.ID = doc.ID
	if _, err := doc.Set(ctx, rule); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return doc.ID, nil
}

// ListByScope returns rules filtered by scope level/id (simple client-side filtering for now)
func (r *RulesRepository) ListByScope(ctx context.Context, tenantID string, scope map[string]any) ([]*models.Rule, error) {
	docs, err := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var res []*models.Rule
	for _, d := range docs {
		var ru models.Rule
		if err := d.DataTo(&ru); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		match := true
		for k, v := range scope {
			if ru.Scope == nil {
				match = false
				break
			}
			if rv, ok := ru.Scope[k]; !ok || rv != v {
				match = false
				break
			}
		}
		if match {
			res = append(res, &ru)
		}
	}
	// sort by priority desc, then updatedAt desc
	sort.Slice(res, func(i, j int) bool {
		if res[i].Priority == res[j].Priority {
			return res[i].UpdatedAt.After(res[j].UpdatedAt)
		}
		return res[i].Priority > res[j].Priority
	})
	return res, nil
}

func (r *RulesRepository) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, patch map[string]any) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	patch["updatedAt"] = time.Now().UTC()
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Set(ctx, patch, firestore.MergeAll)
	return err
}

func (r *RulesRepository) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}
