package repo

import (
    "context"
    "time"

    "cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
)

type ShareToken struct {
    ID        string    `json:"id" firestore:"id"`
    ProjectID string    `json:"projectId" firestore:"projectId"`
    Token     string    `json:"token" firestore:"token"`
    IsActive  bool      `json:"isActive" firestore:"isActive"`
    ExpiresAt time.Time `json:"expiresAt" firestore:"expiresAt"`
    CreatedAt time.Time `json:"createdAt" firestore:"createdAt"`
    CreatedBy string    `json:"createdBy" firestore:"createdBy"`
    LastAccessedAt *time.Time `json:"lastAccessedAt,omitempty" firestore:"lastAccessedAt,omitempty"`
    ViewCount int       `json:"viewCount,omitempty" firestore:"viewCount,omitempty"`
}

type ShareTokensRepository struct{ col *firestore.CollectionRef }

func NewShareTokensRepository(db *firestore.Client) *ShareTokensRepository {
    return &ShareTokensRepository{col: db.Collection("core_share_tokens")}
}

func (r *ShareTokensRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, st *ShareToken) (string, error) {
    doc := r.col.NewDoc()
    st.ID = doc.ID
    if st.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
        st.CreatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
    }
    st.IsActive = true
    _, err := doc.Set(ctx, st)
    if err != nil {
        return "", err
    }
    return doc.ID, nil
}

func (r *ShareTokensRepository) GetByToken(ctx context.Context, token string) (*ShareToken, string, error) {
    q := r.col.Where("token", "==", token).Limit(1)
    docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
    if err != nil || len(docs) == 0 {
        return nil, "", err
    }
    var st ShareToken
    if err := docs[0].DataTo(&st); err != nil {
        return nil, "", err
    }
    return &st, docs[0].Ref.ID, nil
}

func (r *ShareTokensRepository) Revoke(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
    if id == "" { return ErrInvalidDocument }
    _, err := r.col.Doc(id).Set(ctx, map[string]any{"isActive": false}, firestore.MergeAll)
    return err
}

func (r *ShareTokensRepository) TouchAccess(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
    now := time.Now().UTC()
    _, err := r.col.Doc(id).Set(ctx, map[string]any{"lastAccessedAt": now, "viewCount": firestore.Increment(1)}, firestore.MergeAll)
    return err
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
)

var ErrSubscriptionNotFound = errors.New("subscription not found")

type SubscriptionsRepository struct {
	col *firestore.CollectionRef
}

func NewSubscriptionsRepository(db *firestore.Client) *SubscriptionsRepository {
	return &SubscriptionsRepository{col: db.Collection("subscriptions")}
}

// Upsert creates or updates a subscription
func (r *SubscriptionsRepository) Upsert(ctx context.Context, sub *models.Subscription) error {
	if sub == nil || sub.UserID == "" || sub.TenantID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if sub.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		sub.CreatedAt = now
	}
	sub.UpdatedAt = now
	// Use composite key: tenantId_userId
	docID := sub.TenantID + "_" + sub.UserID
	sub.ID = docID
	_, err := r.col.Doc(docID).Set(ctx, sub)
	return err
}

// Get retrieves a subscription by tenant and user ID
func (r *SubscriptionsRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string) (*models.Subscription, error) {
	docID := tenantID + "_" + userID
	snap, err := r.col.Doc(docID).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		// Check if error is NotFound from Firestore
		if status.Code(err) == codes.NotFound {
			return nil, ErrSubscriptionNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	if !snap.Exists() {
		return nil, ErrSubscriptionNotFound
	}
	var sub models.Subscription
	if err := snap.DataTo(&sub); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &sub, nil
}

// ListActive returns all active subscriptions (for billing processing)
func (r *SubscriptionsRepository) ListActive(ctx context.Context) ([]*models.Subscription, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("status", "==", "active")
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var subs []*models.Subscription
	for _, d := range docs {
		var sub models.Subscription
		if err := d.DataTo(&sub); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		subs = append(subs, &sub)
	}
	return subs, nil
}

// ListExpiringSoon returns subscriptions expiring within the specified duration
func (r *SubscriptionsRepository) ListExpiringSoon(ctx context.Context, within time.Duration) ([]*models.Subscription, error) {
	threshold := time.Now().UTC().Add(within)
	q := r.col.Where("status", "==", "active").
		Where("currentPeriodEnd", "<=", threshold).
		OrderBy("currentPeriodEnd", firestore.Asc)
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var subs []*models.Subscription
	for _, d := range docs {
		var sub models.Subscription
		if err := d.DataTo(&sub); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		subs = append(subs, &sub)
	}
	return subs, nil
}

// UpdateStatus updates subscription status
func (r *SubscriptionsRepository) UpdateStatus(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID, status string) error {
	docID := tenantID + "_" + userID
	_, err := r.col.Doc(docID).Update(ctx, []firestore.Update{
		{Path: "status", Value: status},
		{Path: "updatedAt", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
	})
	return err
}

// UpdateBillingPeriod updates billing period dates
func (r *SubscriptionsRepository) UpdateBillingPeriod(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, periodStart, periodEnd time.Time, nextBilling *time.Time) error {
	docID := tenantID + "_" + userID
	updates := []firestore.Update{
		{Path: "currentPeriodStart", Value: periodStart},
		{Path: "currentPeriodEnd", Value: periodEnd},
		{Path: "updatedAt", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
	}
	if nextBilling != nil {
		updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: "nextBillingDate", Value: nextBilling})
	} else {
		updates = append(updates, firestore.Update{Path: "nextBillingDate", Value: firestore.Delete})
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(docID).Update(ctx, updates)
	return err
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"
)

// UsageMetric represents a single GenAI API call usage record
type UsageMetric struct {
	ID            string  `json:"id" firestore:"id"`
	TenantID      string  `json:"tenantId" firestore:"tenantId"`
	UserID        string  `json:"userId" firestore:"userId"`
	ProjectID     *string `json:"projectId,omitempty" firestore:"projectId,omitempty"`
	InteractionID *string `json:"interactionId,omitempty" firestore:"interactionId,omitempty"`

	// Model information (actual model name, not alias)
	Provider   string  `json:"provider" firestore:"provider"`                         // gemini, openai, anthropic, grok, deepseek
	Model      string  `json:"model" firestore:"model"`                               // actual model name like "gemini-2.0-flash-exp", "gpt-4o", "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"
	ModelAlias *string `json:"modelAlias,omitempty" firestore:"modelAlias,omitempty"` // alias used (e.g., "gemini_fast")

	// Token usage
	InputTokens  int `json:"inputTokens" firestore:"inputTokens"`
	OutputTokens int `json:"outputTokens" firestore:"outputTokens"`
	TotalTokens  int `json:"totalTokens" firestore:"totalTokens"`

	// Cost information
	CostUSD float64 `json:"costUSD" firestore:"costUSD"`

	// Timing information (optional, for backward compatibility)
	DurationMs *int `json:"durationMs,omitempty" firestore:"durationMs,omitempty"` // Execution time in milliseconds

	// Metadata
	TaskType *string `json:"taskType,omitempty" firestore:"taskType,omitempty"` // e.g., "discovery.answer", "eval.stance", "genai.generate"
	Kind     string  `json:"kind" firestore:"kind"`                             // "included" or "on_demand"

	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"createdAt" firestore:"createdAt"`
}

// UsageMetricsRepository handles usage metrics storage and retrieval
type UsageMetricsRepository struct {
	col *firestore.CollectionRef
}

// NewUsageMetricsRepository creates a new UsageMetricsRepository
func NewUsageMetricsRepository(db *firestore.Client) *UsageMetricsRepository {
	return &UsageMetricsRepository{col: db.Collection("usage_metrics")}
}

// Create records a new usage metric
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, metric *UsageMetric) (string, error) {
	doc := r.col.NewDoc()
	metric.ID = doc.ID
	metric.CreatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	_, err := doc.Set(ctx, metric)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return doc.ID, nil
}

// CreateMetric is a convenience method that creates a usage metric from individual parameters
// This allows AITaskExecutor to save metrics without importing the UsageMetric struct
// durationMs is optional (can be nil for backward compatibility)
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) CreateMetric(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID, provider, model string, inputTokens, outputTokens int, cost float64, taskType, projectID *string, durationMs *int) (string, error) {
	metric := &UsageMetric{
		TenantID:     tenantID,
		UserID:       userID,
		ProjectID:    projectID,
		Provider:     provider,
		Model:        model,
		InputTokens:  inputTokens,
		OutputTokens: outputTokens,
		TotalTokens:  inputTokens + outputTokens,
		CostUSD:      cost,
		DurationMs:   durationMs,
		TaskType:     taskType,
		Kind:         "included",
	}
	return r.Create(ctx, metric)
}

// ListByUser returns usage metrics for a user within a time range
// limit: maximum number of records to return (default: 0 = all)
// offset: number of records to skip (default: 0)
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) ListByUser(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, startTime, endTime time.Time, limit, offset int) ([]*UsageMetric, int, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("tenantId", "==", tenantID).
		Where("userId", "==", userID).
		Where("createdAt", ">=", startTime).
		Where("createdAt", "<=", endTime).
		OrderBy("createdAt", firestore.Desc)

	// Get total count first (for pagination info)
	var totalCount int
	var docs []*firestore.DocumentSnapshot

	if limit > 0 {
		allDocs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		totalCount = len(allDocs)

		// Apply pagination
		if offset > 0 {
			q = q.Offset(offset)
		}
		q = q.Limit(limit)

		docs, err = q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
	} else {
		// If limit is 0, we need to get all docs anyway, so count them
		allDocs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		totalCount = len(allDocs)
		// Use the same docs for results
		docs = allDocs
	}

	var metrics []*UsageMetric
	for _, d := range docs {
		var m UsageMetric
		if err := d.DataTo(&m); err != nil {
			log.Printf("[ListByUser] Failed to parse document %s: %v", d.Ref.ID, err)
			continue
		}
		// Set ID from document reference
		m.ID = d.Ref.ID
		metrics = append(metrics, &m)
	}
	log.Printf("[ListByUser] Loaded %d metrics for user %s (tenant %s) from %v to %v", len(metrics), userID, tenantID, startTime, endTime)
	return metrics, totalCount, nil
}

// ModelAggregate represents aggregated usage for a model
type ModelAggregate struct {
	Count        int     `json:"count"`
	InputTokens  int     `json:"inputTokens"`
	OutputTokens int     `json:"outputTokens"`
	TotalTokens  int     `json:"totalTokens"`
	CostUSD      float64 `json:"costUSD"`
}

// AggregateByModel returns aggregated usage grouped by model
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) AggregateByModel(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, startTime, endTime time.Time) (map[string]ModelAggregate, error) {
	metrics, _, err := r.ListByUser(ctx, tenantID, userID, startTime, endTime, 0, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return r.AggregateByModelFromMetrics(ctx, metrics)
}

// AggregateByModelFromMetrics aggregates usage from already loaded metrics
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) AggregateByModelFromMetrics(ctx context.Context, metrics []*UsageMetric) (map[string]ModelAggregate, error) {
	agg := make(map[string]ModelAggregate)

	for _, m := range metrics {
		key := m.Provider + ":" + m.Model
		val := agg[key]
		val.Count++
		val.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
		val.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
		val.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
		val.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
		agg[key] = val
	}

	return agg, nil
}

// DailyTotal represents aggregated usage for a single day
type DailyTotal struct {
	InputTokens  int     `json:"inputTokens"`
	OutputTokens int     `json:"outputTokens"`
	TotalTokens  int     `json:"totalTokens"`
	CostUSD      float64 `json:"costUSD"`
	Count        int     `json:"count"`
}

// isPremiumModel determines if a model is considered "premium" (quality or balanced for Claude)
// Premium models are: _quality for any provider, or _balanced for Claude only
func isPremiumModel(provider string, modelAlias *string) bool {
	if modelAlias == nil {
		return false
	}
	alias := *modelAlias
	// Check for _quality suffix (any provider)
	if strings.HasSuffix(alias, "_quality") {
		return true
	}
	// Check for _balanced suffix (Claude only)
	if provider == "anthropic" && strings.HasSuffix(alias, "_balanced") {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// GetDailyTotals returns daily totals for a user
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) GetDailyTotals(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, startTime, endTime time.Time) (map[string]DailyTotal, error) {
	metrics, _, err := r.ListByUser(ctx, tenantID, userID, startTime, endTime, 0, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return r.GetDailyTotalsFromMetrics(ctx, metrics)
}

// GetDailyTotalsFromMetrics calculates daily totals from already loaded metrics
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) GetDailyTotalsFromMetrics(ctx context.Context, metrics []*UsageMetric) (map[string]DailyTotal, error) {
	daily := make(map[string]DailyTotal)

	for _, m := range metrics {
		dateKey := m.CreatedAt.Format("2006-01-02")
		val := daily[dateKey]
		val.Count++
		val.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
		val.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
		val.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
		val.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
		daily[dateKey] = val
	}

	return daily, nil
}

// TokenCategoryTotals represents token totals split by premium vs regular models
type TokenCategoryTotals struct {
	PremiumTokens TokenTotals `json:"premiumTokens"`
	RegularTokens TokenTotals `json:"regularTokens"`
}

// TokenTotals represents token usage totals
type TokenTotals struct {
	InputTokens  int     `json:"inputTokens"`
	OutputTokens int     `json:"outputTokens"`
	TotalTokens  int     `json:"totalTokens"`
	CostUSD      float64 `json:"costUSD"`
	Count        int     `json:"count"`
}

// GetTokenCategoryTotals returns token totals split by premium vs regular models
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) GetTokenCategoryTotals(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, startTime, endTime time.Time) (*TokenCategoryTotals, error) {
	metrics, _, err := r.ListByUser(ctx, tenantID, userID, startTime, endTime, 0, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return r.GetTokenCategoryTotalsFromMetrics(ctx, metrics)
}

// GetTokenCategoryTotalsFromMetrics calculates token category totals from already loaded metrics
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) GetTokenCategoryTotalsFromMetrics(ctx context.Context, metrics []*UsageMetric) (*TokenCategoryTotals, error) {
	var premium, regular TokenTotals

	for _, m := range metrics {
		if isPremiumModel(m.Provider, m.ModelAlias) {
			premium.Count++
			premium.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
			premium.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
			premium.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
			premium.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
		} else {
			regular.Count++
			regular.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
			regular.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
			regular.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
			regular.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
		}
	}

	return &TokenCategoryTotals{
		PremiumTokens: premium,
		RegularTokens: regular,
	}, nil
}

// UsageAggregates contains all aggregated usage data computed in a single pass
type UsageAggregates struct {
	ByModel         map[string]ModelAggregate `json:"byModel"`
	DailyTotals     map[string]DailyTotal     `json:"dailyTotals"`
	TokenCategories *TokenCategoryTotals      `json:"tokenCategories"`
	Totals          *DailyTotal               `json:"totals"`
}

// GetAllAggregates loads metrics once and computes all aggregations in a single pass
// This is much more efficient than calling separate aggregation methods
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) GetAllAggregates(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, startTime, endTime time.Time) (*UsageAggregates, error) {
	// Load metrics once
	metrics, _, err := r.ListByUser(ctx, tenantID, userID, startTime, endTime, 0, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Initialize aggregation structures
	byModel := make(map[string]ModelAggregate)
	dailyTotals := make(map[string]DailyTotal)
	var premium, regular TokenTotals
	var totals DailyTotal

	// Single pass through all metrics to compute all aggregations
	log.Printf("[GetAllAggregates] Processing %d metrics for user %s", len(metrics), userID)
	for _, m := range metrics {
		// 1. Aggregate by model (provider:model)
		modelKey := m.Provider + ":" + m.Model
		modelAgg := byModel[modelKey]
		modelAgg.Count++
		modelAgg.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
		modelAgg.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
		modelAgg.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
		modelAgg.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
		byModel[modelKey] = modelAgg

		// 2. Aggregate by day
		dateKey := m.CreatedAt.Format("2006-01-02")
		daily := dailyTotals[dateKey]
		daily.Count++
		daily.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
		daily.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
		daily.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
		daily.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
		dailyTotals[dateKey] = daily

		// 3. Aggregate by token category (premium vs regular)
		if isPremiumModel(m.Provider, m.ModelAlias) {
			premium.Count++
			premium.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
			premium.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
			premium.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
			premium.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
		} else {
			regular.Count++
			regular.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
			regular.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
			regular.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
			regular.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
		}

		// 4. Aggregate totals
		totals.Count++
		totals.InputTokens += m.InputTokens
		totals.OutputTokens += m.OutputTokens
		totals.TotalTokens += m.TotalTokens
		totals.CostUSD += m.CostUSD
	}

	log.Printf("[GetAllAggregates] Aggregation complete: byModel=%d entries, dailyTotals=%d entries, totals.count=%d", len(byModel), len(dailyTotals), totals.Count)
	if len(byModel) > 0 {
		for key, agg := range byModel {
			log.Printf("[GetAllAggregates] Model %s: count=%d, tokens=%d, cost=%.6f", key, agg.Count, agg.TotalTokens, agg.CostUSD)
		}
	}

	return &UsageAggregates{
		ByModel:         byModel,
		DailyTotals:     dailyTotals,
		TokenCategories: &TokenCategoryTotals{PremiumTokens: premium, RegularTokens: regular},
		Totals:          &totals,
	}, nil
}

// ListByUserPaginated returns paginated usage metrics with total count
// Returns events for the requested page and the total count of all matching events
// limit must be at least 200 for efficient grouping
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) ListByUserPaginated(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, startTime, endTime time.Time, page, limit int) ([]*UsageMetric, int, error) {
	if limit < 200 {
		limit = 200 // Minimum limit for efficient grouping
	}
	if page < 1 {
		page = 1
	}

	log.Printf("[ListByUserPaginated] Request: page=%d, limit=%d, user=%s, tenant=%s, startTime=%v, endTime=%v", page, limit, userID, tenantID, startTime, endTime)

	// Load all matching metrics (needed for accurate total count)
	// This is acceptable because we need them for aggregations anyway
	allMetrics, totalCount, err := r.ListByUser(ctx, tenantID, userID, startTime, endTime, 0, 0)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[ListByUserPaginated] Error loading metrics: %v", err)
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	log.Printf("[ListByUserPaginated] Loaded %d total metrics", totalCount)

	// Calculate pagination
	offset := (page - 1) * limit
	if offset >= totalCount {
		log.Printf("[ListByUserPaginated] Offset %d >= totalCount %d, returning empty slice", offset, totalCount)
		return []*UsageMetric{}, totalCount, nil
	}

	end := offset + limit
	if end > totalCount {
		end = totalCount
	}

	log.Printf("[ListByUserPaginated] Returning slice [%d:%d] (%d events)", offset, end, end-offset)

	// Return paginated slice
	return allMetrics[offset:end], totalCount, nil
}

// GetAverageTiming calculates average response time in seconds for a given model
// Uses historical data from the last 30 days
// Filters out outliers using IQR (Interquartile Range) method to avoid skewing from extreme values
// Returns average response time in seconds, or nil if not enough data is available
// Simply returns the average duration without considering token count
func (r *UsageMetricsRepository) GetAverageTiming(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID, provider, model string) (*float64, error) {
	// Look at last 30 days of data
	endTime := time.Now().UTC()
	startTime := endTime.AddDate(0, 0, -30)

	metrics, _, err := r.ListByUser(ctx, tenantID, userID, startTime, endTime, 0, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Filter metrics for this specific model
	// Note: DurationMs == nil means the metric was recorded before timing was added, so we skip it
	var relevantMetrics []*UsageMetric
	for _, m := range metrics {
		if m.Provider == provider && m.Model == model && m.DurationMs != nil {
			relevantMetrics = append(relevantMetrics, m)
		}
	}

	if len(relevantMetrics) == 0 {
		return nil, nil // Not enough data
	}

	// Extract durations for outlier filtering
	durations := make([]float64, 0, len(relevantMetrics))
	for _, m := range relevantMetrics {
		durationMs := float64(*m.DurationMs)
		durations = append(durations, durationMs)
	}

	// Filter outliers using IQR method
	// Sort durations to find quartiles
	sortedDurations := make([]float64, len(durations))
	copy(sortedDurations, durations)

	// Simple insertion sort (good enough for small datasets)
	for i := 1; i < len(sortedDurations); i++ {
		key := sortedDurations[i]
		j := i - 1
		for j >= 0 && sortedDurations[j] > key {
			sortedDurations[j+1] = sortedDurations[j]
			j--
		}
		sortedDurations[j+1] = key
	}

	// Calculate quartiles
	var q1, q3 float64
	n := len(sortedDurations)
	if n < 4 {
		// Too few samples, use all data
		q1 = sortedDurations[0]
		q3 = sortedDurations[n-1]
	} else {
		// Q1: 25th percentile, Q3: 75th percentile
		q1Idx := n / 4
		q3Idx := (3 * n) / 4
		q1 = sortedDurations[q1Idx]
		q3 = sortedDurations[q3Idx]
	}

	// Calculate IQR and bounds
	iqr := q3 - q1
	lowerBound := q1 - 1.5*iqr
	upperBound := q3 + 1.5*iqr

	// Also add hard limits: reject anything over 120 seconds total duration or under 10ms
	// This prevents extreme outliers from skewing results
	const maxDurationMs = 120000 // 120 seconds
	const minDurationMs = 10     // 10ms

	// Filter durations, keeping only those within bounds
	var filteredDurations []float64
	for _, d := range durations {
		if d >= lowerBound && d <= upperBound &&
			d >= minDurationMs && d <= maxDurationMs {
			filteredDurations = append(filteredDurations, d)
		}
	}

	// If filtering removed too many samples, use original data (but still apply hard limits)
	if len(filteredDurations) < len(durations)/2 {
		filteredDurations = filteredDurations[:0]
		for _, d := range durations {
			if d >= minDurationMs && d <= maxDurationMs {
				filteredDurations = append(filteredDurations, d)
			}
		}
	}

	if len(filteredDurations) == 0 {
		return nil, nil // All data filtered out as outliers
	}

	// Calculate average duration from filtered data
	var totalDurationMs float64
	for _, d := range filteredDurations {
		totalDurationMs += d
	}

	// Average milliseconds
	avgMs := totalDurationMs / float64(len(filteredDurations))

	// Convert to seconds and round to 1 decimal place
	avgSeconds := avgMs / 1000.0
	// Round to 1 decimal place
	avgSeconds = float64(int(avgSeconds*10+0.5)) / 10.0

	return &avgSeconds, nil
}

package repo

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"cloud.google.com/go/firestore"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
)

var ErrVoucherNotFound = errors.New("voucher not found")
var ErrVoucherExpired = errors.New("voucher expired")
var ErrVoucherExhausted = errors.New("voucher usage limit exceeded")
var ErrVoucherInactive = errors.New("voucher is not active")

type VouchersRepository struct {
	col *firestore.CollectionRef
}

func NewVouchersRepository(db *firestore.Client) *VouchersRepository {
	return &VouchersRepository{col: db.Collection("vouchers")}
}

// Create creates a new voucher
func (r *VouchersRepository) Create(ctx context.Context, voucher *models.Voucher) error {
	if voucher == nil || voucher.Code == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if voucher.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		voucher.CreatedAt = now
	}
	voucher.UpdatedAt = now
	if voucher.ID == "" {
		doc := r.col.NewDoc()
		voucher.ID = doc.ID
	} else {
		// Check if code already exists
		existing, _ := r.GetByCode(ctx, voucher.Code)
		if existing != nil {
			return errors.New("voucher code already exists")
		}
	}
	_, err := r.col.Doc(voucher.ID).Set(ctx, voucher)
	return err
}

// Get retrieves a voucher by ID
func (r *VouchersRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*models.Voucher, error) {
	snap, err := r.col.Doc(id).Get(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !snap.Exists() {
		return nil, ErrVoucherNotFound
	}
	var voucher models.Voucher
	if err := snap.DataTo(&voucher); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &voucher, nil
}

// GetByCode retrieves a voucher by code
func (r *VouchersRepository) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*models.Voucher, error) {
	q := r.col.Where("code", "==", code).Limit(1)
	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(docs) == 0 {
		return nil, ErrVoucherNotFound
	}
	var voucher models.Voucher
	if err := docs[0].DataTo(&voucher); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &voucher, nil
}

// ValidateAndUse validates a voucher and increments usage count
func (r *VouchersRepository) ValidateAndUse(ctx context.Context, code string) (*models.Voucher, error) {
	voucher, err := r.GetByCode(ctx, code)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()

	// Check if voucher is active
	if !voucher.IsActive {
		return nil, ErrVoucherInactive
	}

	// Check validity period
	if now.Before(voucher.ValidFrom) {
		return nil, errors.New("voucher not yet valid")
	}
	if voucher.ValidTo != nil && now.After(*voucher.ValidTo) {
		return nil, ErrVoucherExpired
	}

	// Check usage limit
	if voucher.MaxUses != nil && voucher.UsedCount >= *voucher.MaxUses {
		return nil, ErrVoucherExhausted
	}

	// Increment usage count
	voucher.UsedCount++
	voucher.UpdatedAt = now
	_, err = r.col.Doc(voucher.ID).Set(ctx, voucher)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return voucher, nil
}

// List returns all vouchers (optionally filtered by tier and active status)
// activeOnly: nil = show all, true = active only, false = inactive only
func (r *VouchersRepository) List(ctx context.Context, tier *models.SubscriptionTier, activeOnly *bool) ([]*models.Voucher, error) {
	q := r.col.Query
	if tier != nil {
		q = q.Where("tier", "==", string(*tier))
	}
	if activeOnly != nil {
		q = q.Where("isActive", "==", *activeOnly)
	}
	q = q.OrderBy("createdAt", firestore.Desc).Limit(500)

	docs, err := q.Documents(ctx).GetAll()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var vouchers []*models.Voucher
	for _, d := range docs {
		var v models.Voucher
		if err := d.DataTo(&v); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		vouchers = append(vouchers, &v)
	}
	return vouchers, nil
}

// Update updates a voucher
func (r *VouchersRepository) Update(ctx context.Context, voucher *models.Voucher) error {
	if voucher == nil || voucher.ID == "" {
		return ErrInvalidDocument
	}
	voucher.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	_, err := r.col.Doc(voucher.ID).Set(ctx, voucher)
	return err
}

// Delete deletes a voucher
func (r *VouchersRepository) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	_, err := r.col.Doc(id).Delete(ctx)
	return err
}

Файл: artifact_context_service.go
Путь: internal/services/artifact_context_service.go

package services

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// ArtifactContextService gathers context for artifact generation
type ArtifactContextService struct {
	interactionsRepo *repo.InteractionsRepository
	coreDocsRepo     *repo.CoreDocsRepo
	chunksRepo       *repo.ChunksRepository
}

// NewArtifactContextService creates a new context service
func NewArtifactContextService(
	interactionsRepo *repo.InteractionsRepository,
	coreDocsRepo *repo.CoreDocsRepo,
	chunksRepo *repo.ChunksRepository,
) *ArtifactContextService {
	return &ArtifactContextService{
		interactionsRepo: interactionsRepo,
		coreDocsRepo:     coreDocsRepo,
		chunksRepo:       chunksRepo,
	}
}

// GatheredContext contains all gathered context for generation
type GatheredContext struct {
	ConversationText string
	DocumentTexts    []DocumentContext
	SearchResults    []SearchResult
	PinnedMessages   []string
	TotalTokens      int
	ContextSnapshot  models.ArtifactContextSnapshot
}

// DocumentContext represents a document's content
type DocumentContext struct {
	ID    string
	Title string
	Text  string
}

// SearchResult represents a search result
type SearchResult struct {
	Text      string
	Source    string
	Relevance float64
}

// GatherContext collects context from all specified sources
func (s *ArtifactContextService) GatherContext(
	ctx context.Context,
	tenantID string,
	projectID string,
	sources models.ArtifactContextSources,
) (*GatheredContext, error) {
	result := &GatheredContext{
		DocumentTexts:  make([]DocumentContext, 0),
		SearchResults:  make([]SearchResult, 0),
		PinnedMessages: make([]string, 0),
	}

	// 1. Gather conversation context
	if sources.ConversationRange != nil {
		conversationText, err := s.gatherConversation(ctx, tenantID, projectID, sources.ConversationRange.From, sources.ConversationRange.To)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to gather conversation: %w", err)
		}
		result.ConversationText = conversationText
	}

	// 2. Gather document context
	if len(sources.Documents) > 0 {
		docs, err := s.gatherDocuments(ctx, sources.Documents)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to gather documents: %w", err)
		}
		result.DocumentTexts = docs
	}

	// 3. Gather search results
	if sources.SearchQuery != nil && *sources.SearchQuery != "" {
		searchResults, err := s.gatherSearchResults(ctx, tenantID, projectID, *sources.SearchQuery)
		if err != nil {
			// Log but don't fail - search is optional
			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to gather search results: %v\n", err)
		} else {
			result.SearchResults = searchResults
		}
	}

	// 4. Gather pinned messages
	if len(sources.PinnedMessages) > 0 {
		pinnedTexts, err := s.gatherPinnedMessages(ctx, tenantID, projectID, sources.PinnedMessages)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to gather pinned messages: %w", err)
		}
		result.PinnedMessages = pinnedTexts
	}

	// 5. Calculate total tokens (approximate)
	totalChars := len(result.ConversationText)
	for _, doc := range result.DocumentTexts {
		totalChars += len(doc.Text)
	}
	for _, sr := range result.SearchResults {
		totalChars += len(sr.Text)
	}
	for _, pm := range result.PinnedMessages {
		totalChars += len(pm)
	}
	result.TotalTokens = totalChars / 4 // Approximate

	// 6. Create context snapshot
	result.ContextSnapshot = s.createSnapshot(sources, result)

	return result, nil
}

// gatherConversation retrieves conversation messages in range
func (s *ArtifactContextService) gatherConversation(
	ctx context.Context,
	_ string, // tenantID
	projectID string,
	fromID string,
	toID string,
) (string, error) {
	// Get all interactions for project
	interactions, err := s.interactionsRepo.ListByProject(ctx, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	// Find range indices
	startIdx := -1
	endIdx := -1
	for i, interaction := range interactions {
		if interaction.ID == fromID {
			startIdx = i
		}
		if interaction.ID == toID {
			endIdx = i
		}
	}

	if startIdx == -1 || endIdx == -1 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("conversation range not found")
	}

	if startIdx > endIdx {
		startIdx, endIdx = endIdx, startIdx
	}

	// Build conversation text
	var builder strings.Builder
	for i := startIdx; i <= endIdx && i < len(interactions); i++ {
		interaction := interactions[i]
		role := string(interaction.Kind)
		content := interaction.Content
		if interaction.ContentSanitized != nil && *interaction.ContentSanitized != "" {
			content = *interaction.ContentSanitized
		}
		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("[%s]: %s\n\n", role, content))
	}

	return builder.String(), nil
}

// gatherDocuments retrieves document texts
func (s *ArtifactContextService) gatherDocuments(
	ctx context.Context,
	documentIDs []string,
) ([]DocumentContext, error) {
	docs := make([]DocumentContext, 0, len(documentIDs))

	for _, docID := range documentIDs {
		doc, err := s.coreDocsRepo.Get(ctx, docID)
		if err != nil {
			// Skip missing documents
			continue
		}

		text := ""
		if doc.ExtractedText != nil {
			text = *doc.ExtractedText
		}

		title := doc.Filename

		docs = append(docs, DocumentContext{
			ID:    doc.ID,
			Title: title,
			Text:  text,
		})
	}

	return docs, nil
}

}

// gatherPinnedMessages retrieves pinned message texts
func (s *ArtifactContextService) gatherPinnedMessages(
	ctx context.Context,
	_ string, // tenantID
	_ string, // projectID
	messageIDs []string,
) ([]string, error) {
	texts := make([]string, 0, len(messageIDs))

	for _, msgID := range messageIDs {
		interaction, err := s.interactionsRepo.Get(ctx, msgID)
		if err != nil {
			// Skip missing messages
			continue
		}

		content := interaction.Content
		if interaction.ContentSanitized != nil && *interaction.ContentSanitized != "" {
			content = *interaction.ContentSanitized
		}

		// Include notes if available
		if interaction.Metadata != nil && len(interaction.Metadata.Notes) > 0 {
			content += "\n\nNotes:\n"
			for _, note := range interaction.Metadata.Notes {
				content += fmt.Sprintf("- %s\n", note)
			}
		}

		texts = append(texts, content)
	}

	return texts, nil
}

// createSnapshot creates a context snapshot for versioning
func (s *ArtifactContextService) createSnapshot(
	sources models.ArtifactContextSources,
	gathered *GatheredContext,
) models.ArtifactContextSnapshot {
	snapshot := models.ArtifactContextSnapshot{
		Documents:      sources.Documents,
		PinnedMessages: sources.PinnedMessages,
		MessageCount:   0,
		DocumentTitles: make([]string, 0),
	}

	if sources.ConversationRange != nil {
		snapshot.ConversationRange = &struct {
			From string `json:"from" firestore:"from"`
			To   string `json:"to" firestore:"to"`
		}{
			From: sources.ConversationRange.From,
			To:   sources.ConversationRange.To,
		}
		// Approximate message count from conversation text
		snapshot.MessageCount = strings.Count(gathered.ConversationText, "\n\n")
	}

	if sources.SearchQuery != nil {
		snapshot.SearchQuery = sources.SearchQuery
		resultCount := len(gathered.SearchResults)
		snapshot.SearchResultCount = &resultCount
	}

	for _, doc := range gathered.DocumentTexts {
		snapshot.DocumentTitles = append(snapshot.DocumentTitles, doc.Title)
	}

	return snapshot
}

// OptimizeForModel trims context to fit within model limits
func (s *ArtifactContextService) OptimizeForModel(
	context *GatheredContext,
	modelName string,
	maxTokens int,
) *GatheredContext {
	if context.TotalTokens <= maxTokens {
		return context
	}

	// Calculate reduction ratio
	ratio := float64(maxTokens) / float64(context.TotalTokens)

	// Trim conversation (keep most recent)
	if len(context.ConversationText) > 0 {
		targetLen := int(float64(len(context.ConversationText)) * ratio)
		if targetLen < len(context.ConversationText) {
			// Keep the end (most recent)
			context.ConversationText = context.ConversationText[len(context.ConversationText)-targetLen:]
		}
	}

	// Trim documents (truncate each proportionally)
	for i := range context.DocumentTexts {
		targetLen := int(float64(len(context.DocumentTexts[i].Text)) * ratio)
		if targetLen < len(context.DocumentTexts[i].Text) {
			context.DocumentTexts[i].Text = context.DocumentTexts[i].Text[:targetLen] + "..."
		}
	}

	// Recalculate tokens
	totalChars := len(context.ConversationText)
	for _, doc := range context.DocumentTexts {
		totalChars += len(doc.Text)
	}
	context.TotalTokens = totalChars / 4

	return context
}

// GetContextDiff calculates the difference between two context snapshots
func (s *ArtifactContextService) GetContextDiff(
	oldSnapshot models.ArtifactContextSnapshot,
	newSnapshot models.ArtifactContextSnapshot,
) ContextDiff {
	diff := ContextDiff{
		NewMessages:        0,
		ChangedDocuments:   0,
		SearchChanged:      false,
		OverallChangeScore: 0.0,
	}

	// Calculate message difference
	diff.NewMessages = newSnapshot.MessageCount - oldSnapshot.MessageCount
	if diff.NewMessages < 0 {
		diff.NewMessages = 0
	}

	// Calculate document changes
	oldDocs := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, docID := range oldSnapshot.Documents {
		oldDocs[docID] = true
	}
	for _, docID := range newSnapshot.Documents {
		if !oldDocs[docID] {
			diff.ChangedDocuments++
		}
	}

	// Check search query change
	oldQuery := ""
	if oldSnapshot.SearchQuery != nil {
		oldQuery = *oldSnapshot.SearchQuery
	}
	newQuery := ""
	if newSnapshot.SearchQuery != nil {
		newQuery = *newSnapshot.SearchQuery
	}
	diff.SearchChanged = oldQuery != newQuery

	// Calculate overall change score (0-1)
	messageScore := float64(diff.NewMessages) / 10.0 // 10 new messages = 1.0
	if messageScore > 1.0 {
		messageScore = 1.0
	}

	docScore := float64(diff.ChangedDocuments) / 3.0 // 3 new docs = 1.0
	if docScore > 1.0 {
		docScore = 1.0
	}

	searchScore := 0.0
	if diff.SearchChanged {
		searchScore = 0.5
	}

	diff.OverallChangeScore = (messageScore + docScore + searchScore) / 3.0

	return diff
}

// ContextDiff represents changes between two context snapshots
type ContextDiff struct {
	NewMessages        int
	ChangedDocuments   int
	SearchChanged      bool
	OverallChangeScore float64 // 0-1
}

package services

import (
	"context"

	"time"

	gen_combined "github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/genai/combined"

)

// ArtifactExecutorService handles AI generation for artifact sections
type ArtifactExecutorService struct {
	genaiClient      *gen_combined.Client
	contextSvc       *ArtifactContextService
	publisher        *realtime.Publisher
	usageMetricsRepo interface {
		CreateMetric(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID, provider, model string, inputTokens, outputTokens int, cost float64, taskType, projectID *string, durationMs *int) (string, error)
	}
	modelManager interface {
		CalculateProcessingCost(modelName string, inputTokens int, outputTokens int) (float64, error)
	}
}

// NewArtifactExecutorService creates a new executor service
func NewArtifactExecutorService(
	genaiClient *gen_combined.Client,
	contextSvc *ArtifactContextService,
	publisher *realtime.Publisher,
) *ArtifactExecutorService {
	return &ArtifactExecutorService{
		genaiClient: genaiClient,
		contextSvc:  contextSvc,
		publisher:   publisher,
	}
}

// WithUsageMetrics sets the usage metrics repository and model manager
func (s *ArtifactExecutorService) WithUsageMetrics(repo interface {
	CreateMetric(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID, provider, model string, inputTokens, outputTokens int, cost float64, taskType, projectID *string, durationMs *int) (string, error)
}, modelMgr interface {
	CalculateProcessingCost(modelName string, inputTokens int, outputTokens int) (float64, error)
}) *ArtifactExecutorService {
	s.usageMetricsRepo = repo
	s.modelManager = modelMgr
	return s
}

// SectionGenerationRequest contains parameters for generating a section
type SectionGenerationRequest struct {
	Section            models.ArtifactSection
	Context            *GatheredContext
	GenerationSettings models.GenerationSettings
	Model              string // Model alias (gemini_quality, gpt_fast, etc.)
	StreamCallback     func(chunk string) error
	SessionID          string // For WebSocket routing
	ArtifactID         string // For WebSocket routing
	TenantID           string // For WebSocket routing
	ProjectID          string // For WebSocket routing
	UserID             string // For usage tracking
	StreamID           string // For ordering and FE filtering
}

// SectionGenerationResult contains the result of section generation
type SectionGenerationResult struct {
	Content    string
	TokensUsed int
	Duration   time.Duration
	Model      string
	Quality    *SectionQuality
}

// SectionQuality contains quality metrics for a generated section
type SectionQuality struct {
	Overall      float64 // 0-1
	Coherence    float64 // 0-1
	Completeness float64 // 0-1
	Relevance    float64 // 0-1
}

// GenerateSection generates content for a single section
func (s *ArtifactExecutorService) GenerateSection(
	ctx context.Context,
	req SectionGenerationRequest,
) (*SectionGenerationResult, error) {
	startTime := time.Now()

	// Build prompt with context
	prompt := s.buildSectionPrompt(req.Section, req.Context, req.GenerationSettings)

	// Prepare GenAI request
	genReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{
		Model:             req.Model,
		Prompt:            prompt,
		SystemInstruction: req.GenerationSettings.SystemPrompt,
		Temperature:       0.7,
		MaxOutputTokens:   4096,
	}

	// Execute generation
	resp, err := s.genaiClient.GenAIGenerate(ctx, genReq)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate section: %w", err)
	}

	duration := time.Since(startTime)
	durationMs := int(duration.Milliseconds())

	// Save usage metrics
	s.saveUsageMetric(ctx, req.TenantID, req.ProjectID, req.UserID, resp.Model, resp.Usage.PromptTokens, resp.Usage.OutputTokens, "artifact.generate", &durationMs)

	// Calculate quality if context is available
	var quality *SectionQuality
	if req.Context != nil {
		quality, _ = s.evaluateQuality(ctx, resp.Content, req.Section.Prompt, req.Context)
	}

	return &SectionGenerationResult{
		Content:    resp.Content,
		TokensUsed: resp.Usage.TotalTokens,
		Duration:   duration,
		Model:      resp.Model,
		Quality:    quality,
	}, nil
}

// GenerateSectionStreaming generates content with streaming callback
func (s *ArtifactExecutorService) GenerateSectionStreaming(
	ctx context.Context,
	req SectionGenerationRequest,
) (*SectionGenerationResult, error) {
	startTime := time.Now()

	// Publish section generation started event
	if s.publisher != nil && req.SessionID != "" {
		_ = s.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, realtime.EventArtifactSectionGenerating, req.TenantID, map[string]interface{}{
			"sessionId":    req.SessionID,
			"artifactId":   req.ArtifactID,
			"sectionId":    req.Section.ID,
			"sectionTitle": req.Section.Title,
			"projectId":    req.ProjectID,
			"streamId":     req.StreamID,
		})
	}

	// Build prompt
	prompt := s.buildSectionPrompt(req.Section, req.Context, req.GenerationSettings)

	// Prepare options for streaming
	opts := gen_combined.Options{
		ModelOverride:     req.Model,
		SystemInstruction: req.GenerationSettings.SystemPrompt,
		Temperature:       0.7,
		MaxOutputTokens:   4096,
	}

	// Accumulate content
	var fullContent strings.Builder
	var totalTokens int

	// Stream generation
	err := s.genaiClient.Stream(ctx, prompt, nil, opts, func(evt gen_combined.StreamEvent) error {
		if evt.Type == "chunk" && evt.Text != "" {
			fullContent.WriteString(evt.Text)

			// Publish chunk event
			if s.publisher != nil && req.SessionID != "" {
				_ = s.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, realtime.EventArtifactSectionChunk, req.TenantID, map[string]interface{}{
					"sessionId":  req.SessionID,
					"artifactId": req.ArtifactID,
					"sectionId":  req.Section.ID,
					"chunk":      evt.Text,
					"projectId":  req.ProjectID,
					"streamId":   req.StreamID,
				})
			}

			if req.StreamCallback != nil {
				if err := req.StreamCallback(evt.Text); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		if evt.Type == "done" {
			totalTokens = evt.Usage.TotalTokens
			// Save usage metrics after streaming completes
			inputToks := evt.Usage.PromptTokens
			outputToks := evt.Usage.OutputTokens
			if inputToks == 0 && outputToks == 0 {
				// Estimate from content if usage not provided
				inputToks = len(prompt) / 4
				outputToks = len(fullContent.String()) / 4
			}
			modelName := evt.Model
			if modelName == "" {
				modelName = req.Model
			}
			durationMs := int(time.Since(startTime).Milliseconds())
			s.saveUsageMetric(ctx, req.TenantID, req.ProjectID, req.UserID, modelName, inputToks, outputToks, "artifact.stream", &durationMs)
		}
		return nil
	})

	if err != nil {
		// Publish error event
		if s.publisher != nil && req.SessionID != "" {
			_ = s.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, realtime.EventArtifactGenerationError, req.TenantID, map[string]interface{}{
				"sessionId":  req.SessionID,
				"artifactId": req.ArtifactID,
				"sectionId":  req.Section.ID,
				"error":      err.Error(),
				"projectId":  req.ProjectID,
				"streamId":   req.StreamID,
			})
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("streaming generation failed: %w", err)
	}

	duration := time.Since(startTime)
	content := fullContent.String()

	// Calculate quality
	var quality *SectionQuality
	if req.Context != nil {
		quality, _ = s.evaluateQuality(ctx, content, req.Section.Prompt, req.Context)
	}

	result := &SectionGenerationResult{
		Content:    content,
		TokensUsed: totalTokens,
		Duration:   duration,
		Model:      req.Model,
		Quality:    quality,
	}

	// Publish section completed event
	if s.publisher != nil && req.SessionID != "" {
		_ = s.publisher.PublishJSON(ctx, realtime.EventArtifactSectionCompleted, req.TenantID, map[string]interface{}{
			"sessionId":  req.SessionID,
			"artifactId": req.ArtifactID,
			"sectionId":  req.Section.ID,
			"tokensUsed": totalTokens,
			"durationMs": duration.Milliseconds(),
			"quality":    quality,
			"projectId":  req.ProjectID,
			"streamId":   req.StreamID,
		})
	}

	return result, nil
}

// buildSectionPrompt constructs the full prompt for section generation
func (s *ArtifactExecutorService) buildSectionPrompt(
	section models.ArtifactSection,
	context *GatheredContext,
	settings models.GenerationSettings,
) string {
	var builder strings.Builder

	// Section instructions
	builder.WriteString("Generate content for the following section:\n\n")
	builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Section Title:** %s\n\n", section.Title))

	if section.Description != nil && *section.Description != "" {
		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Description:** %s\n\n", *section.Description))
	}

	builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Instructions:** %s\n\n", section.Prompt))

	// Add generation settings context
	if settings.Tone != nil && *settings.Tone != "" {
		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Tone:** %s\n", *settings.Tone))
	}
	if settings.Audience != nil && *settings.Audience != "" {
		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Target Audience:** %s\n", *settings.Audience))
	}
	if settings.DetailLevel != nil && *settings.DetailLevel != "" {
		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Detail Level:** %s\n", *settings.DetailLevel))
	}
	builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Language:** %s\n\n", settings.PreferredLanguage))

	// Add context if available
	if context != nil {
		builder.WriteString("---\n\n**Context for Generation:**\n\n")

		if context.ConversationText != "" {
			builder.WriteString("**Conversation History:**\n")
			builder.WriteString(context.ConversationText)
			builder.WriteString("\n\n")
		}

		if len(context.DocumentTexts) > 0 {
			builder.WriteString("**Reference Documents:**\n\n")
			for _, doc := range context.DocumentTexts {
				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### %s\n\n", doc.Title))
				// Truncate if too long
				text := doc.Text
				if len(text) > 5000 {
					text = text[:5000] + "...\n[Document truncated]"
				}
				builder.WriteString(text)
				builder.WriteString("\n\n")
			}
		}

		if len(context.PinnedMessages) > 0 {
			builder.WriteString("**Key Points (Pinned Messages):**\n\n")
			for i, msg := range context.PinnedMessages {
				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%d. %s\n", i+1, msg))
			}
			builder.WriteString("\n")
		}

		if len(context.SearchResults) > 0 {
			builder.WriteString("**Search Results:**\n\n")
			for _, result := range context.SearchResults {
				builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("- %s (Source: %s)\n", result.Text, result.Source))
			}
			builder.WriteString("\n")
		}
	}

	builder.WriteString("---\n\n")
	builder.WriteString("Generate the section content now. Write in a clear, professional manner appropriate for the specified audience and tone.")

	return builder.String()
}

// evaluateQuality evaluates the quality of generated content
func (s *ArtifactExecutorService) evaluateQuality(
	ctx context.Context,
	content string,
	originalPrompt string,
	_ *GatheredContext, // context parameter (unused)
) (*SectionQuality, error) {
	// Build evaluation prompt
	evalPrompt := fmt.Sprintf(`Evaluate the quality of the following generated content on three dimensions:

		1. **Coherence** (0-1): How well-structured and logically organized is the text?
		2. **Completeness** (0-1): How thoroughly does it address the requirements?
		3. **Relevance** (0-1): How relevant is it to the provided context and instructions?

		**Original Instructions:**
		%s

		**Generated Content:**
		%s

		Return a JSON object with scores:
		{
		"coherence": 0.0-1.0,
		"completeness": 0.0-1.0,
		"relevance": 0.0-1.0
}`, originalPrompt, content)

	// Use gemini_fast for quick evaluation
	genReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{
		Model:             "gemini_fast",
		Prompt:            evalPrompt,
		MaxOutputTokens:   256,
		StrictJSONEnabled: true,
		JSONSchema: map[string]interface{}{
			"type": "object",
			"properties": map[string]interface{}{
				"coherence":    map[string]interface{}{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1},
				"completeness": map[string]interface{}{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1},
				"relevance":    map[string]interface{}{"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1},
			},
			"required": []string{"coherence", "completeness", "relevance"},
		},
	}

	resp, err := s.genaiClient.GenAIGenerate(ctx, genReq)
	if err != nil {
		// Quality evaluation is optional, don't fail the whole generation
		return nil, err
	}

	// Skip saving metrics for quality evaluation (internal call without user context)

	// Parse quality scores
	var scores struct {
		Coherence    float64 `json:"coherence"`
		Completeness float64 `json:"completeness"`
		Relevance    float64 `json:"relevance"`
	}

	// Try to parse JSON from content
	content = strings.TrimSpace(resp.Content)
	if err := parseJSON(content, &scores); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	overall := (scores.Coherence + scores.Completeness + scores.Relevance) / 3.0

	return &SectionQuality{
		Overall:      overall,
		Coherence:    scores.Coherence,
		Completeness: scores.Completeness,
		Relevance:    scores.Relevance,
	}, nil
}

// AssembleDocument uses orchestrator model to create final assembled document
func (s *ArtifactExecutorService) AssembleDocument(
	ctx context.Context,
	sections []models.ArtifactSection,
	config models.ArtifactConfig,
) (string, error) {
	// Build assembly prompt
	var builder strings.Builder

	builder.WriteString("Assemble the following sections into a cohesive, well-formatted document.\n\n")
	builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Document Format:** %s\n", config.Format))
	builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Document Focus:** %s\n\n", config.Focus))

	if config.GenerationSettings.OrchestratorSystemPrompt != nil {
		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Additional Instructions:** %s\n\n", *config.GenerationSettings.OrchestratorSystemPrompt))
	}

	builder.WriteString("**Sections to Assemble:**\n\n")

	for _, section := range sections {
		builder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("### %s\n\n", section.Title))
		if section.Content != nil {
			builder.WriteString(*section.Content)
		} else {
			builder.WriteString("[Section not generated]")
		}
		builder.WriteString("\n\n")
	}

	builder.WriteString("---\n\n")
	builder.WriteString("Create a final, polished document that:\n")
	builder.WriteString("1. Maintains consistency in tone and style throughout\n")
	builder.WriteString("2. Ensures smooth transitions between sections\n")
	builder.WriteString("3. Removes any redundancy or contradictions\n")
	builder.WriteString("4. Applies appropriate formatting for the document type\n")
	builder.WriteString("5. Adds a brief introduction and conclusion if appropriate\n\n")
	builder.WriteString("Return the complete assembled document.")

	// Use orchestrator model
	genReq := gen_combined.GenAIRequest{
		Model:             config.OrchestratorModel,
		Prompt:            builder.String(),
		SystemInstruction: config.GenerationSettings.SystemPrompt,
		Temperature:       0.5,
		MaxOutputTokens:   8192,
	}

	resp, err := s.genaiClient.GenAIGenerate(ctx, genReq)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to assemble document: %w", err)
	}

	// Skip saving metrics for document assembly (internal call without user context)

	return resp.Content, nil
}

// saveUsageMetric saves usage metrics if repository is available
func (s *ArtifactExecutorService) saveUsageMetric(_ context.Context, tenantID, projectID, userID, modelName string, inputTokens, outputTokens int, taskType string, durationMs *int) {
	if s.usageMetricsRepo == nil || s.modelManager == nil {
		return
	}

	// Skip if tenantID is empty (for internal calls like quality evaluation)
	if tenantID == "" {
		return
	}

	// Determine provider from model name (similar to genai.go)
	provider := s.determineProvider(modelName)

	// Calculate cost
	cost, err := s.modelManager.CalculateProcessingCost(modelName, inputTokens, outputTokens)
	if err != nil {
		cost = 0
	}

	// Prepare taskType and projectID pointers
	taskTypePtr := &taskType
	var projectIDPtr *string
	if projectID != "" {
		projectIDPtr = &projectID
	}

	// Save asynchronously to avoid blocking
	// Use a new context with timeout to avoid cancellation from parent context
	go func() {
		metricCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_, err := s.usageMetricsRepo.CreateMetric(metricCtx, tenantID, userID, provider, modelName, inputTokens, outputTokens, cost, taskTypePtr, projectIDPtr, durationMs)
		if err != nil {
			// Log error silently to avoid blocking
		}
	}()
}

// determineProvider determines the provider from model name
func (s *ArtifactExecutorService) determineProvider(modelName string) string {
	modelLower := strings.ToLower(modelName)

	if strings.Contains(modelLower, "gemini") {
		return "gemini"
	}
	if strings.Contains(modelLower, "gpt") || strings.Contains(modelLower, "o1") || strings.Contains(modelLower, "o3") {
		return "openai"
	}
	if strings.Contains(modelLower, "claude") {
		return "anthropic"
	}
	if strings.Contains(modelLower, "grok") {
		return "grok"
	}
	if strings.Contains(modelLower, "deepseek") {
		return "deepseek"
	}

	return "unknown"
}

// Helper function to parse JSON
func parseJSON(content string, target interface{}) error {
	// Remove markdown code fences if present
	content = strings.TrimSpace(content)
	content = strings.TrimPrefix(content, "```json")
	content = strings.TrimPrefix(content, "```")
	content = strings.TrimSuffix(content, "```")
	content = strings.TrimSpace(content)

	return json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), target)
}


================================================================================

package services

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// ArtifactOrchestratorService coordinates artifact generation process
type ArtifactOrchestratorService struct {
	sessionsRepo *repo.GenerationSessionsRepository
	coreDocsRepo *repo.CoreDocsRepo
	executor     *ArtifactExecutorService
	contextSvc   *ArtifactContextService
}

// NewArtifactOrchestratorService creates a new orchestrator service
func NewArtifactOrchestratorService(
	sessionsRepo *repo.GenerationSessionsRepository,
	coreDocsRepo *repo.CoreDocsRepo,
	executor *ArtifactExecutorService,
	contextSvc *ArtifactContextService,
) *ArtifactOrchestratorService {
	return &ArtifactOrchestratorService{
		sessionsRepo: sessionsRepo,
		coreDocsRepo: coreDocsRepo,
		executor:     executor,
		contextSvc:   contextSvc,
	}
}

// StartGenerationRequest contains parameters for starting generation
type StartGenerationRequest struct {
	ArtifactID string
	Mode       string // "auto" | "interactive"
	TenantID   string
	ProjectID  string
}

// StartGeneration creates a new generation session
func (s *ArtifactOrchestratorService) StartGeneration(
	ctx context.Context,
	req StartGenerationRequest,
) (*models.GenerationSession, error) {
	// Load artifact
	artifact, err := s.coreDocsRepo.Get(ctx, req.ArtifactID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load artifact: %w", err)
	}

	if artifact.ArtifactConfig == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("not an artifact")
	}

	// Check for active session
	activeSession, err := s.sessionsRepo.GetActive(ctx, req.ArtifactID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to check active session: %w", err)
	}
	if activeSession != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("generation already in progress (session: %s)", activeSession.ID)
	}

	// Create new session
	session := &models.GenerationSession{
		ArtifactID:        req.ArtifactID,
		Mode:              req.Mode,
		Status:            "pending",
		PreferredLanguage: artifact.ArtifactConfig.GenerationSettings.PreferredLanguage,
		SystemPrompt:      artifact.ArtifactConfig.GenerationSettings.SystemPrompt,
		CompletedSections: []string{},
		Progress:          0.0,
		SectionResults:    make(map[string]models.SectionResult),
		Errors:            []models.GenerationError{},
	}

	sessionID, err := s.sessionsRepo.Create(ctx, session)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create session: %w", err)
	}

	session.ID = sessionID

	// If auto mode, start generation immediately
	if req.Mode == "auto" {
		go s.runAutoGeneration(context.Background(), sessionID, req.TenantID, req.ProjectID)
	}

	return session, nil
}

// GenerateSectionRequest contains parameters for generating a section
type GenerateSectionRequest struct {
	SessionID      string
	SectionID      string
	TenantID       string
	ProjectID      string
	UserID         string // For usage tracking
	PromptOverride *string
	ModelOverride  *string
	StreamCallback func(chunk string) error
	StreamID       string
}

// GenerateSection generates a specific section
func (s *ArtifactOrchestratorService) GenerateSection(
	ctx context.Context,
	req GenerateSectionRequest,
) (*models.SectionResult, error) {
	// Load session
	session, err := s.sessionsRepo.Get(ctx, req.SessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load session: %w", err)
	}

	// Load artifact
	artifact, err := s.coreDocsRepo.Get(ctx, session.ArtifactID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load artifact: %w", err)
	}

	// Find section
	var section *models.ArtifactSection
	for i := range artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure {
		if artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure[i].ID == req.SectionID {
			section = &artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure[i]
			break
		}
	}
	if section == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("section not found: %s", req.SectionID)
	}

	// Apply overrides
	if req.PromptOverride != nil {
		section.Prompt = *req.PromptOverride
	}

	model := artifact.ArtifactConfig.DefaultModel
	if section.Model != nil {
		model = *section.Model
	}
	if req.ModelOverride != nil {
		model = *req.ModelOverride
	}

	// Gather context
	gatheredContext, err := s.contextSvc.GatherContext(ctx, artifact.TenantID, req.ProjectID, artifact.ArtifactConfig.ContextSources)
	if err != nil {
		// Log but don't fail - generation can proceed without context
		fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to gather context: %v\n", err)
	}

	// Update session status
	_ = s.sessionsRepo.UpdateFields(ctx, req.SessionID, map[string]interface{}{
		"status":         "running",
		"currentSection": req.SectionID,
	})

	// Generate section
	genReq := SectionGenerationRequest{
		Section:            *section,
		Context:            gatheredContext,
		GenerationSettings: artifact.ArtifactConfig.GenerationSettings,
		Model:              model,
		StreamCallback:     req.StreamCallback,
		SessionID:          req.SessionID,
		ArtifactID:         session.ArtifactID,
		TenantID:           req.TenantID,
		ProjectID:          req.ProjectID,
		UserID:             req.UserID,
		StreamID:           req.StreamID,
	}

	var genResult *SectionGenerationResult
	if req.StreamCallback != nil {
		genResult, err = s.executor.GenerateSectionStreaming(ctx, genReq)
	} else {
		genResult, err = s.executor.GenerateSection(ctx, genReq)
	}

	if err != nil {
		// Record error
		genErr := models.GenerationError{
			SectionID: &req.SectionID,
			Message:   err.Error(),
			Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
		}
		_ = s.sessionsRepo.AddError(ctx, req.SessionID, genErr)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("section generation failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Create section result
	sectionResult := models.SectionResult{
		SectionID:  req.SectionID,
		Content:    genResult.Content,
		Model:      genResult.Model,
		TokensUsed: genResult.TokensUsed,
		Duration:   genResult.Duration,
		Status:     "completed",
	}

	if genResult.Quality != nil {
		sectionResult.Quality = &genResult.Quality.Overall
	}

	// Save result to session
	_ = s.sessionsRepo.AddSectionResult(ctx, req.SessionID, req.SectionID, sectionResult)

	// Update artifact section content
	for i := range artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure {
		if artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure[i].ID == req.SectionID {
			now := time.Now().UTC()
			artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure[i].Content = &genResult.Content
			artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure[i].GeneratedAt = &now
			artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure[i].TokensUsed = &genResult.TokensUsed
			break
		}
	}
	_ = s.coreDocsRepo.Upsert(ctx, artifact)

	// Update progress
	completed := len(session.SectionResults) + 1
	total := len(artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure)
	progress := float64(completed) / float64(total)
	_ = s.sessionsRepo.UpdateProgress(ctx, req.SessionID, progress, nil)

	return &sectionResult, nil
}

// AssembleDocument assembles the final document from generated sections
func (s *ArtifactOrchestratorService) AssembleDocument(
	ctx context.Context,
	sessionID string,
) (string, error) {
	// Load session
	session, err := s.sessionsRepo.Get(ctx, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to load session: %w", err)
	}

	// Load artifact
	artifact, err := s.coreDocsRepo.Get(ctx, session.ArtifactID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to load artifact: %w", err)
	}

	// Assemble using executor
	assembled, err := s.executor.AssembleDocument(ctx, artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure, *artifact.ArtifactConfig)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("assembly failed: %w", err)
	}

	return assembled, nil
}

// GetSession returns generation session by ID
func (s *ArtifactOrchestratorService) GetSession(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*models.GenerationSession, error) {
	return s.sessionsRepo.Get(ctx, sessionID)
}

// RestoreVersion sets artifact content to a specified version snapshot and saves new version with trigger "restore"
func (s *ArtifactOrchestratorService) RestoreVersion(ctx context.Context, artifactID string, versionID string) error {
	artifact, err := s.coreDocsRepo.Get(ctx, artifactID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load artifact: %w", err)
	}
	if artifact.ArtifactConfig == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("not an artifact")
	}
	var target *models.ArtifactVersion
	for i := range artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions {
		if artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions[i].ID == versionID {
			target = &artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions[i]
			break
		}
	}
	if target == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("version not found: %s", versionID)
	}
	// Restore section contents
	for i := range artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure {
		sec := &artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure[i]
		if snap, ok := target.Sections[sec.ID]; ok {
			sec.Content = &snap.Content
			t := snap.GeneratedAt
			sec.GeneratedAt = &t
			sec.TokensUsed = &snap.TokensUsed
		}
	}
	if err := s.coreDocsRepo.Upsert(ctx, artifact); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// Append a new version noting the restore action
	restored := models.ArtifactVersion{
		ID:                fmt.Sprintf("v%d", len(artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions)+1),
		Timestamp:         time.Now().UTC(),
		Trigger:           "restore",
		FullDocument:      target.FullDocument,
		Sections:          target.Sections,
		ContextSnapshot:   target.ContextSnapshot,
		GenerationMeta:    target.GenerationMeta,
		GenerationMode:    target.GenerationMode,
		GenerationParams:  target.GenerationParams,
		StructureSnapshot: target.StructureSnapshot,
	}
	artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions = append(artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions, restored)
	return s.coreDocsRepo.Upsert(ctx, artifact)
}

// SaveVersion saves the current state as a new version
func (s *ArtifactOrchestratorService) SaveVersion(
	ctx context.Context,
	sessionID string,
	trigger string,
) (*models.ArtifactVersion, error) {
	// Load session
	session, err := s.sessionsRepo.Get(ctx, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load session: %w", err)
	}

	// Load artifact
	artifact, err := s.coreDocsRepo.Get(ctx, session.ArtifactID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load artifact: %w", err)
	}

	// Assemble document
	fullDocument, err := s.AssembleDocument(ctx, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to assemble document: %w", err)
	}

	// Create version
	version := models.ArtifactVersion{
		ID:           fmt.Sprintf("v%d", len(artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions)+1),
		Timestamp:    time.Now().UTC(),
		Trigger:      trigger,
		FullDocument: fullDocument,
		Sections:     make(map[string]models.ArtifactSectionSnapshot),
		ContextSnapshot: s.contextSvc.createSnapshot(
			artifact.ArtifactConfig.ContextSources,
			&GatheredContext{}, // Simplified - would need actual context
		),
		GenerationMeta: models.ArtifactGenerationMeta{
			TotalTokensUsed:   0, // Would calculate from session results
			DurationMs:        0,
			SectionsGenerated: len(session.SectionResults),
			Errors:            []string{},
		},
		GenerationMode: session.Mode,
		GenerationParams: models.GenerationParams{
			PreferredLanguage: session.PreferredLanguage,
			SystemPrompt:      session.SystemPrompt,
			OrchestratorModel: artifact.ArtifactConfig.OrchestratorModel,
			SectionModels:     make(map[string]string),
		},
		StructureSnapshot: artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure,
	}

	// Add section snapshots
	for _, section := range artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure {
		if section.Content != nil {
			snapshot := models.ArtifactSectionSnapshot{
				Content:     *section.Content,
				Prompt:      section.Prompt,
				Model:       artifact.ArtifactConfig.DefaultModel,
				TokensUsed:  0,
				GeneratedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
			}
			if section.Model != nil {
				snapshot.Model = *section.Model
			}
			if section.TokensUsed != nil {
				snapshot.TokensUsed = *section.TokensUsed
			}
			version.Sections[section.ID] = snapshot
		}
	}

	// Add version to artifact
	artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions = append([]models.ArtifactVersion{version}, artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions...)
	artifact.ArtifactConfig.CurrentVersionID = version.ID

	// Trim old versions if needed
	maxVersions := artifact.ArtifactConfig.VersionsRetained
	if maxVersions == 0 {
		maxVersions = 10
	}
	if len(artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions) > maxVersions {
		artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions = artifact.ArtifactConfig.Versions[:maxVersions]
	}

	// Save artifact
	if err := s.coreDocsRepo.Upsert(ctx, artifact); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to save version: %w", err)
	}

	// Mark session as completed
	_ = s.sessionsRepo.MarkCompleted(ctx, sessionID)

	return &version, nil
}

// CancelGeneration cancels an in-progress generation
func (s *ArtifactOrchestratorService) CancelGeneration(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
	return s.sessionsRepo.MarkCancelled(ctx, sessionID)
}

// runAutoGeneration runs automatic generation for all sections
func (s *ArtifactOrchestratorService) runAutoGeneration(ctx context.Context, sessionID, tenantID, projectID string) {
	// Load session
	session, err := s.sessionsRepo.Get(ctx, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		_ = s.sessionsRepo.MarkFailed(ctx, sessionID, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to load session: %v", err))
		return
	}

	// Load artifact
	artifact, err := s.coreDocsRepo.Get(ctx, session.ArtifactID)
	if err != nil {
		_ = s.sessionsRepo.MarkFailed(ctx, sessionID, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to load artifact: %v", err))
		return
	}

	// Generate each section
	for _, section := range artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure {
		// Check if session was cancelled
		currentSession, _ := s.sessionsRepo.Get(ctx, sessionID)
		if currentSession != nil && currentSession.Status == "cancelled" {
			return
		}

		// Generate section
		_, err := s.GenerateSection(ctx, GenerateSectionRequest{
			SessionID: sessionID,
			SectionID: section.ID,
			TenantID:  tenantID,
			ProjectID: projectID,
			UserID:    "", // Auto-generation doesn't have user context
		})

		if err != nil {
			// Log error but continue with other sections
			fmt.Printf("Auto-generation error for section %s: %v\n", section.ID, err)
		}
	}

	// Save as version
	_, err = s.SaveVersion(ctx, sessionID, "auto")
	if err != nil {
		_ = s.sessionsRepo.MarkFailed(ctx, sessionID, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to save version: %v", err))
		return
	}
}


================================================================================
