package services

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/ai"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/artifacts/templates"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// ArtifactTemplateService manages artifact templates
type ArtifactTemplateService struct {
	repo         *repo.ArtifactTemplatesRepository
	coreDocsRepo *repo.CoreDocsRepo
	aiExecutor   *ai.AITaskExecutor
}

// NewArtifactTemplateService creates a new template service
func NewArtifactTemplateService(
	repo *repo.ArtifactTemplatesRepository,
	coreDocsRepo *repo.CoreDocsRepo,
	aiExecutor *ai.AITaskExecutor,
) *ArtifactTemplateService {
	return &ArtifactTemplateService{
		repo:         repo,
		coreDocsRepo: coreDocsRepo,
		aiExecutor:   aiExecutor,
	}
}

// GetTemplate retrieves a template by ID (system or custom)
func (s *ArtifactTemplateService) GetTemplate(ctx context.Context, id string) (*models.ArtifactTemplate, error) {
	// First check system templates
	if template, err := templates.GetSystemTemplate(id); err == nil {
		return template, nil
	}

	// If not found in system templates, check Firestore
	return s.repo.Get(ctx, id)
}

// ListAvailableTemplates returns all templates available to a tenant
func (s *ArtifactTemplateService) ListAvailableTemplates(
	ctx context.Context,
	tenantID string,
	category *string,
) ([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, error) {
	result := make([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, 0)

	// 1. System templates
	var systemTemplates []*models.ArtifactTemplate
	if category != nil {
		systemTemplates = templates.ListSystemTemplatesByCategory(*category)
	} else {
		systemTemplates = templates.ListSystemTemplates()
	}
	result = append(result, systemTemplates...)

	// 2. Public (community) templates
	publicTemplates, err := s.repo.ListPublic(ctx, category, 0)
	if err == nil {
		result = append(result, publicTemplates...)
	}

	// 3. Tenant-specific templates
	tenantTemplates, err := s.repo.ListByTenant(ctx, tenantID)
	if err == nil {
		// Filter by category if specified
		if category != nil {
			filtered := make([]*models.ArtifactTemplate, 0)
			for _, t := range tenantTemplates {
				if t.Category == *category {
					filtered = append(filtered, t)
				}
			}
			result = append(result, filtered...)
		} else {
			result = append(result, tenantTemplates...)
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// CreateCustomTemplate creates a new custom template
func (s *ArtifactTemplateService) CreateCustomTemplate(
	ctx context.Context,
	template *models.ArtifactTemplate,
	tenantID, userID string,
) (string, error) {
	template.CreatedBy = userID
	template.TenantID = &tenantID
	template.IsPublic = false
	template.Type = "custom"
	template.UsageCount = 0
	template.Rating = 0
	template.RatingCount = 0

	return s.repo.Create(ctx, template)
}

// PublishToCommunity publishes a template to the community
func (s *ArtifactTemplateService) PublishToCommunity(
	ctx context.Context,
	templateID, userID string,
) error {
	template, err := s.repo.Get(ctx, templateID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Check ownership
	if template.CreatedBy != userID {
		return errors.New("unauthorized: only template creator can publish")
	}

	template.IsPublic = true
	template.Type = "community"

	return s.repo.Update(ctx, template)
}

// UpdateTemplate updates an existing template (owner-only)
func (s *ArtifactTemplateService) UpdateTemplate(ctx context.Context, t *models.ArtifactTemplate, userID string) error {
	if t == nil || t.ID == "" {
		return errors.New("invalid template")
	}
	existing, err := s.repo.Get(ctx, t.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if existing.CreatedBy != userID {
		return errors.New("unauthorized")
	}
	// Preserve immutable fields
	t.CreatedBy = existing.CreatedBy
	t.CreatedAt = existing.CreatedAt
	t.UsageCount = existing.UsageCount
	t.Rating = existing.Rating
	t.RatingCount = existing.RatingCount
	return s.repo.Update(ctx, t)
}

// DeleteTemplate deletes a template (owner-only)
func (s *ArtifactTemplateService) DeleteTemplate(ctx context.Context, id, userID string) error {
	existing, err := s.repo.Get(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if existing.CreatedBy != userID {
		return errors.New("unauthorized")
	}
	return s.repo.Delete(ctx, id)
}

// CreateFromArtifactRequest contains options for creating a template from an artifact
type CreateFromArtifactRequest struct {
	ArtifactID            string
	TemplateName          string
	Description           string
	Category              string
	IncludeExamples       bool
	IncludePromptHistory  bool
	IncludeSettings       bool
	Visibility            string // "private" | "team" | "public"
	SectionCustomizations map[string]SectionCustomization
}

// SectionCustomization allows customizing sections when creating template
type SectionCustomization struct {
	Include      bool
	NewTitle     *string
	NewPrompt    *string
	MakeRequired *bool
}

// CreateFromArtifact creates a template from an existing artifact
func (s *ArtifactTemplateService) CreateFromArtifact(
	ctx context.Context,
	req CreateFromArtifactRequest,
	tenantID, userID string,
) (string, error) {
	// 1. Load artifact
	artifact, err := s.coreDocsRepo.Get(ctx, req.ArtifactID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("artifact not found: %w", err)
	}

	if artifact.ArtifactConfig == nil {
		return "", errors.New("not an artifact")
	}

	// 2. Check access
	if artifact.TenantID != tenantID {
		return "", errors.New("unauthorized")
	}

	// 3. Convert structure to template
	sectionTemplates := make([]models.SectionTemplate, 0)

	for _, section := range artifact.ArtifactConfig.Structure {
		// Skip sections not included
		if customization, ok := req.SectionCustomizations[section.ID]; ok && !customization.Include {
			continue
		}

		// Determine best prompt
		prompt := section.Prompt
		if req.IncludePromptHistory && len(section.PromptHistory) > 0 {
			// Find prompt with highest quality
			bestQuality := 0.0
			for _, ph := range section.PromptHistory {
				if ph.ResultQuality != nil && *ph.ResultQuality > bestQuality {
					bestQuality = *ph.ResultQuality
					prompt = ph.Prompt
				}
			}
		}

		// Apply customizations
		title := section.Title
		required := section.Required

		if customization, ok := req.SectionCustomizations[section.ID]; ok {
			if customization.NewTitle != nil {
				title = *customization.NewTitle
			}
			if customization.NewPrompt != nil {
				prompt = *customization.NewPrompt
			}
			if customization.MakeRequired != nil {
				required = *customization.MakeRequired
			}
		}

		// Add example content if requested
		var exampleContent *string
		if req.IncludeExamples && section.Content != nil {
			example := *section.Content
			if len(example) > 500 {
				example = example[:500] + "..."
			}
			exampleContent = &example
		}

		sectionTemplate := models.SectionTemplate{
			ID:             section.ID,
			Title:          title,
			Order:          section.Order,
			Description:    getStringOrDefault(section.Description, ""),
			PromptTemplate: prompt,
			Required:       required,
			Editable:       section.Editable,
			DependsOn:      section.DependsOn,
			ExampleContent: exampleContent,
		}

		sectionTemplates = append(sectionTemplates, sectionTemplate)
	}

	// 4. Create system prompts
	systemPrompts := make(map[string]string)
	if req.IncludeSettings {
		lang := artifact.ArtifactConfig.GenerationSettings.PreferredLanguage
		systemPrompts[lang] = artifact.ArtifactConfig.GenerationSettings.SystemPrompt
	}

	// 5. Determine visibility
	isPublic := false
	templateType := "custom"
	var templateTenantID *string

	switch req.Visibility {
	case "private":
		templateTenantID = &tenantID
		isPublic = false
	case "team":
		templateTenantID = &tenantID
		isPublic = false
	case "public":
		templateTenantID = nil
		isPublic = true
		templateType = "community"
	default:
		templateTenantID = &tenantID
		isPublic = false
	}

	// 6. Create template
	template := &models.ArtifactTemplate{
		Name:                         req.TemplateName,
		Description:                  req.Description,
		Category:                     req.Category,
		Type:                         templateType,
		RecommendedFormat:            artifact.ArtifactConfig.Format,
		RecommendedFocus:             artifact.ArtifactConfig.Focus,
		RecommendedOrchestratorModel: artifact.ArtifactConfig.OrchestratorModel,
		RecommendedSectionModel:      artifact.ArtifactConfig.DefaultModel,
		DefaultStructure:             sectionTemplates,
		SystemPrompts:                systemPrompts,
		CreatedBy:                    userID,
		TenantID:                     templateTenantID,
		IsPublic:                     isPublic,
		IsFeatured:                   false,
		UsageCount:                   0,
		Rating:                       0,
		RatingCount:                  0,
		SourceArtifactID:             &req.ArtifactID,
		Tags:                         extractTags(req.TemplateName, req.Description),
	}

	return s.repo.Create(ctx, template)
}

// StructureRequirements defines requirements for AI structure generation
type StructureRequirements struct {
	DocumentType string // "proposal", "brief", "report", etc.
	Topic        string
	Audience     string // "technical", "executive", "general"
	DetailLevel  string // "brief", "moderate", "detailed"
	Language     string
}

// GenerateStructure uses AI to generate a document structure
func (s *ArtifactTemplateService) GenerateStructure(
	ctx context.Context,
	requirements StructureRequirements,
) ([]models.SectionTemplate, error) {
	// Build prompt for AI
	prompt := fmt.Sprintf(`Generate a document structure for the following requirements:

Document Type: %s
Topic: %s
Target Audience: %s
Detail Level: %s
Language: %s

Return a JSON array of sections. Each section should have:
- id: unique identifier (lowercase, underscores)
- title: section title
- order: numeric order (starting from 1)
- description: what this section should contain
- promptTemplate: detailed prompt for generating this section's content
- required: boolean indicating if section is required
- editable: boolean indicating if user can edit/remove

The structure should be logical, comprehensive, and appropriate for the document type and audience.
Include 4-8 sections depending on the detail level.

Example format:
[
  {
    "id": "executive_summary",
    "title": "Executive Summary",
    "order": 1,
    "description": "High-level overview for decision makers",
    "promptTemplate": "Provide a concise executive summary...",
    "required": true,
    "editable": false
  }
]`,
		requirements.DocumentType,
		requirements.Topic,
		requirements.Audience,
		requirements.DetailLevel,
		requirements.Language,
	)

	// Create verifier for structure generation
	verifier := &structureVerifier{}

	// Execute AI task
	task := &ai.AITask{
		TaskType:     ai.TaskTypeTextProcessing,
		InputContent: prompt,
		AIRequirements: ai.AIRequirements{
			MinContextWindow:   8000,
			MinCapabilityScore: 80,
		},
		Verifier:        verifier,
		EnableTelemetry: true,
	}

	result, err := s.aiExecutor.ExecuteStructuredTask(ctx, task)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate structure: %w", err)
	}

	// Type assert result
	sections, ok := result.([]models.SectionTemplate)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected result type from structure generation")
	}

	return sections, nil
}

// structureVerifier verifies and parses structure generation results
type structureVerifier struct{}

func (v *structureVerifier) VerifyAndParse(jsonStr string) (interface{}, error) {
	var sections []models.SectionTemplate
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(jsonStr), &sections); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse sections: %w", err)
	}

	// Validate sections
	if len(sections) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("no sections generated")
	}

	for i, section := range sections {
		if section.ID == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("section %d missing ID", i)
		}
		if section.Title == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("section %s missing title", section.ID)
		}
		if section.PromptTemplate == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("section %s missing prompt template", section.ID)
		}
	}

	return sections, nil
}

// Helper functions

func getStringOrDefault(ptr *string, defaultValue string) string {
	if ptr != nil {
		return *ptr
	}
	return defaultValue
}

func extractTags(name, description string) []string {
	tags := make([]string, 0)

	text := strings.ToLower(name + " " + description)

	keywords := []string{
		"proposal", "brief", "report", "summary", "contract",
		"technical", "business", "legal", "research",
		"meeting", "api", "design", "architecture",
		"executive", "analysis", "documentation",
	}

	for _, keyword := range keywords {
		if strings.Contains(text, keyword) {
			tags = append(tags, keyword)
		}
	}

	return tags
}


================================================================================

Путь: internal/services/subscription_service.go

package services

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/models"
	"github.com/igorkirisyuk/sanskrite/internal/repo"
)

// SubscriptionService handles subscription business logic
type SubscriptionService struct {
	subsRepo     *repo.SubscriptionsRepository
	vouchersRepo *repo.VouchersRepository
	usersRepo    *repo.UsersRepository
	logger       *log.Logger
}

// NewSubscriptionService creates a new subscription service
func NewSubscriptionService(
	subsRepo *repo.SubscriptionsRepository,
	vouchersRepo *repo.VouchersRepository,
	usersRepo *repo.UsersRepository,
	logger *log.Logger,
) *SubscriptionService {
	return &SubscriptionService{
		subsRepo:     subsRepo,
		vouchersRepo: vouchersRepo,
		usersRepo:    usersRepo,
		logger:       logger,
	}
}

// GetOrCreateSubscription gets existing subscription or creates a free one (or Max for admins)
func (s *SubscriptionService) GetOrCreateSubscription(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string) (*models.Subscription, error) {
	// Try to get existing subscription
	sub, err := s.subsRepo.Get(ctx, tenantID, userID)
	if err == nil {
		return sub, nil
	}
	if err != repo.ErrSubscriptionNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Check if user is admin - admins get Max tier automatically
	isAdmin := false
	if user, err := s.usersRepo.GetByIDAndTenant(ctx, userID, tenantID); err == nil && user != nil && user.Role != nil {
		isAdmin = strings.ToLower(*user.Role) == "admin"
	}

	// Create subscription for new user
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	// Set period end far in the future (effectively never expires)
	periodEnd := now.AddDate(100, 0, 0) // 100 years in the future

	var tier models.SubscriptionTier
	if isAdmin {
		tier = models.SubscriptionTierMax
	} else {
		tier = models.SubscriptionTierFree
	}

	sub = &models.Subscription{
		TenantID:           tenantID,
		UserID:             userID,
		Tier:               tier,
		Status:             "active",
		StartedAt:          now,
		CurrentPeriodStart: now,
		CurrentPeriodEnd:   periodEnd,
		NextBillingDate:    nil, // No billing for free or admin Max tier
		CreatedAt:          now,
		UpdatedAt:          now,
	}

	if err := s.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create subscription: %w", err)
	}

	if s.logger != nil {
		if isAdmin {
			s.logger.Printf("Created Max subscription for admin user %s in tenant %s", userID, tenantID)
		} else {
			s.logger.Printf("Created free subscription for user %s in tenant %s", userID, tenantID)
		}
	}

	return sub, nil
}

// ApplyVoucher applies a voucher code to a user's subscription
func (s *SubscriptionService) ApplyVoucher(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID, voucherCode string) (*models.Subscription, error) {
	// Validate and use voucher
	voucher, err := s.vouchersRepo.ValidateAndUse(ctx, voucherCode)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid voucher: %w", err)
	}

	// Get or create subscription
	sub, err := s.GetOrCreateSubscription(ctx, tenantID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()

	// Calculate new period end based on voucher duration
	var periodStart time.Time
	var periodEnd time.Time
	var nextBilling *time.Time

	if sub.Status == "active" && sub.CurrentPeriodEnd.After(now) {
		// Extend existing subscription from current period end
		periodStart = sub.CurrentPeriodEnd
		periodEnd = sub.CurrentPeriodEnd.AddDate(0, voucher.DurationMonths, 0)
	} else {
		// Start new period from now
		periodStart = now
		periodEnd = now.AddDate(0, voucher.DurationMonths, 0)
	}

	// Set next billing date (only for paid tiers)
	if voucher.Tier != models.SubscriptionTierFree {
		nextBilling = &periodEnd
	}

	// Update subscription
	sub.Tier = voucher.Tier
	sub.Status = "active"
	sub.CurrentPeriodStart = periodStart
	sub.CurrentPeriodEnd = periodEnd
	sub.NextBillingDate = nextBilling
	sub.VoucherID = &voucher.ID
	sub.UpdatedAt = now

	if err := s.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update subscription: %w", err)
	}

	if s.logger != nil {
		s.logger.Printf("Applied voucher %s (tier: %s, duration: %d months) to user %s in tenant %s",
			voucherCode, voucher.Tier, voucher.DurationMonths, userID, tenantID)
	}

	return sub, nil
}

// CheckSubscription checks if user has active subscription of required tier
// Returns subscription and whether it's valid
func (s *SubscriptionService) CheckSubscription(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string, requiredTier models.SubscriptionTier) (*models.Subscription, bool, error) {
	// Check if user is admin (admins bypass subscription checks)
	user, err := s.usersRepo.GetByIDAndTenant(ctx, userID, tenantID)
	if err == nil && user != nil && user.Role != nil && *user.Role == "admin" {
		// Admin bypass - return a mock subscription
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		adminSub := &models.Subscription{
			TenantID:           tenantID,
			UserID:             userID,
			Tier:               models.SubscriptionTierMax, // Admins get max tier
			Status:             "active",
			CurrentPeriodStart: now,
			CurrentPeriodEnd:   now.AddDate(100, 0, 0),
		}
		return adminSub, true, nil
	}

	// Get subscription
	sub, err := s.GetOrCreateSubscription(ctx, tenantID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false, err
	}

	// Check if subscription is active
	if sub.Status != "active" {
		return sub, false, nil
	}

	// Check if subscription period has expired
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if now.After(sub.CurrentPeriodEnd) {
		// Expired - downgrade to free
		if err := s.downgradeToFree(ctx, tenantID, userID); err != nil {
			s.logger.Printf("Failed to downgrade expired subscription: %v", err)
		}
		return sub, false, nil
	}

	// Check tier hierarchy: free < pro < max
	tierLevel := map[models.SubscriptionTier]int{
		models.SubscriptionTierFree: 0,
		models.SubscriptionTierPro:  1,
		models.SubscriptionTierMax:  2,
	}

	userLevel := tierLevel[sub.Tier]
	requiredLevel := tierLevel[requiredTier]

	return sub, userLevel >= requiredLevel, nil
}

// downgradeToFree downgrades subscription to free tier
func (s *SubscriptionService) downgradeToFree(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string) error {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	periodEnd := now.AddDate(100, 0, 0) // 100 years

	sub := &models.Subscription{
		TenantID:           tenantID,
		UserID:             userID,
		Tier:               models.SubscriptionTierFree,
		Status:             "active",
		CurrentPeriodStart: now,
		CurrentPeriodEnd:   periodEnd,
		NextBillingDate:    nil,
		UpdatedAt:          now,
	}

	return s.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub)
}

// ProcessBillingCycle processes monthly billing cycle
// This should be called periodically (e.g., daily via cron) to update subscriptions
func (s *SubscriptionService) ProcessBillingCycle(ctx context.Context) error {
	now := time.Now().UTC()

	// Find subscriptions that need billing processing
	// This includes:
	// 1. Subscriptions where currentPeriodEnd has passed (expired)
	// 2. Subscriptions where nextBillingDate is today or passed

	activeSubs, err := s.subsRepo.ListActive(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list active subscriptions: %w", err)
	}

	processed := 0
	expired := 0

	for _, sub := range activeSubs {
		// Check if subscription period has expired
		if now.After(sub.CurrentPeriodEnd) {
			wasCancelledAtPeriodEnd := sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd
			// If cancelled at period end, mark as cancelled first
			if sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd {
				sub.Status = "cancelled"
				sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd = false
				sub.UpdatedAt = now
				if err := s.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub); err != nil {
					if s.logger != nil {
						s.logger.Printf("Failed to mark cancelled subscription %s: %v", sub.ID, err)
					}
					continue
				}
			}
			// Expired subscription - downgrade to free
			if err := s.downgradeToFree(ctx, sub.TenantID, sub.UserID); err != nil {
				if s.logger != nil {
					s.logger.Printf("Failed to downgrade expired subscription %s: %v", sub.ID, err)
				}
				continue
			}
			expired++
			if s.logger != nil {
				if wasCancelledAtPeriodEnd {
					s.logger.Printf("Cancelled and downgraded subscription for user %s in tenant %s (cancelled at period end)", sub.UserID, sub.TenantID)
				} else {
					s.logger.Printf("Downgraded expired subscription for user %s in tenant %s", sub.UserID, sub.TenantID)
				}
			}
			continue
		}

		// Check if billing date has arrived (for paid tiers)
		if sub.NextBillingDate != nil && !now.Before(*sub.NextBillingDate) {
			// If cancelled at period end, don't renew - let it expire naturally
			if sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd {
				if s.logger != nil {
					s.logger.Printf("Skipping renewal for subscription %s (cancelled at period end)", sub.ID)
				}
				continue
			}

			// Renew billing period (for paid subscriptions)
			// For now, if no payment is set up, we extend by another month
			// In production, this would trigger payment processing
			if sub.PaymentID == nil {
				// No payment set up - extend period by 1 month (grace period)
				newPeriodStart := sub.CurrentPeriodEnd
				newPeriodEnd := newPeriodStart.AddDate(0, 1, 0)
				nextBilling := newPeriodEnd

				if err := s.subsRepo.UpdateBillingPeriod(ctx, sub.TenantID, sub.UserID, newPeriodStart, newPeriodEnd, &nextBilling); err != nil {
					if s.logger != nil {
						s.logger.Printf("Failed to renew billing period for subscription %s: %v", sub.ID, err)
					}
					continue
				}
				processed++
				if s.logger != nil {
					s.logger.Printf("Renewed billing period for subscription %s (user %s, tenant %s)", sub.ID, sub.UserID, sub.TenantID)
				}
			}
			// TODO: Integrate with payment provider (Stripe, PayPal, etc.)
		}
	}

	if s.logger != nil {
		s.logger.Printf("Billing cycle processed: %d renewed, %d expired", processed, expired)
	}

	return nil
}

// GetSubscriptionTier returns the effective subscription tier for a user
func (s *SubscriptionService) GetSubscriptionTier(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string) (models.SubscriptionTier, error) {
	sub, valid, err := s.CheckSubscription(ctx, tenantID, userID, models.SubscriptionTierFree)
	if err != nil {
		return models.SubscriptionTierFree, err
	}
	if !valid {
		return models.SubscriptionTierFree, nil
	}
	return sub.Tier, nil
}

// EnsureAdminMaxSubscription ensures admin users have Max tier subscription
// This is called automatically when an admin makes their first request
func (s *SubscriptionService) EnsureAdminMaxSubscription(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string) error {
	// Get or create subscription
	sub, err := s.GetOrCreateSubscription(ctx, tenantID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// If already Max tier, nothing to do
	if sub.Tier == models.SubscriptionTierMax {
		return nil
	}

	// Upgrade to Max tier
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	sub.Tier = models.SubscriptionTierMax
	sub.Status = "active"
	sub.CurrentPeriodStart = now
	sub.CurrentPeriodEnd = now.AddDate(100, 0, 0) // Effectively never expires
	sub.NextBillingDate = nil
	sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd = false // Reset cancellation flag
	sub.UpdatedAt = now

	if err := s.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to upgrade admin subscription: %w", err)
	}

	if s.logger != nil {
		s.logger.Printf("Auto-upgraded admin %s to Max subscription", userID)
	}

	return nil
}

// CancelSubscriptionAtPeriodEnd cancels subscription at the end of current billing period
// Subscription remains active until CurrentPeriodEnd, then auto-renewal stops
func (s *SubscriptionService) CancelSubscriptionAtPeriodEnd(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string) (*models.Subscription, error) {
	sub, err := s.GetOrCreateSubscription(ctx, tenantID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Can only cancel paid subscriptions
	if sub.Tier == models.SubscriptionTierFree {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot cancel free subscription")
	}

	// Already cancelled?
	if sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd {
		return sub, nil
	}

	// Mark for cancellation at period end
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd = true
	sub.UpdatedAt = now

	if err := s.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to cancel subscription: %w", err)
	}

	if s.logger != nil {
		s.logger.Printf("Marked subscription for cancellation at period end (user %s, tenant %s, period ends %s)",
			userID, tenantID, sub.CurrentPeriodEnd.Format(time.RFC3339))
	}

	return sub, nil
}

// ResumeSubscription resumes a cancelled subscription (for PayPal subscriptions that were resumed)
func (s *SubscriptionService) ResumeSubscription(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userID string) (*models.Subscription, error) {
	sub, err := s.GetOrCreateSubscription(ctx, tenantID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Reset cancellation flag
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	sub.CancelAtPeriodEnd = false
	sub.Status = "active"
	sub.UpdatedAt = now

	if err := s.subsRepo.Upsert(ctx, sub); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resume subscription: %w", err)
	}

	if s.logger != nil {
		s.logger.Printf("Resumed subscription (user %s, tenant %s)", userID, tenantID)
	}

	return sub, nil
}
